texts.psa.80.2: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.
texts.psa.80.3: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.4: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
texts.psa.80.5: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
texts.psa.80.6: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.
texts.psa.80.7: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.8: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.
texts.psa.80.9: Thou preparedst [room] before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.
texts.psa.80.10: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were [like] cedars of God.
texts.psa.80.11: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.
texts.psa.80.12: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?
texts.psa.80.13: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.
texts.psa.80.14: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,
texts.psa.80.15: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.16: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
texts.psa.80.17: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.18: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.
texts.psa.80.19: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.81.1: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph. Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
texts.psa.81.2: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.
texts.psa.81.3: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.
texts.psa.81.4: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.
texts.psa.81.5: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, [Where] I heard a language that I knew not.
texts.psa.81.6: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.
texts.psa.81.7: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah
texts.psa.81.8: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!
texts.psa.81.9: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.
texts.psa.81.10: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
texts.psa.81.11: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.
texts.psa.81.12: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.
texts.psa.81.13: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!
texts.psa.81.14: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.
texts.psa.81.15: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.
texts.psa.81.16: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.
texts.psa.82.1: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.
texts.psa.82.2: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
texts.psa.82.3: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
texts.psa.82.4: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.82.5: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
texts.psa.82.6: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.
texts.psa.82.7: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.
texts.psa.82.8: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
texts.psa.83.1: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
texts.psa.83.2: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
texts.psa.83.3: Thy take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.
texts.psa.83.4: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
texts.psa.83.5: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:
texts.psa.83.6: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;
texts.psa.83.7: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:
texts.psa.83.8: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. Selah
texts.psa.83.9: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
texts.psa.83.10: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.
texts.psa.83.11: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
texts.psa.83.12: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.
texts.psa.83.13: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
texts.psa.83.14: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,
texts.psa.83.15: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.
texts.psa.83.16: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.83.17: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;
texts.psa.83.18: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth.
texts.psa.84.1: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!
texts.psa.84.2: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.
texts.psa.84.3: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.
texts.psa.84.4: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. Selah
texts.psa.84.5: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways [to Zion].
texts.psa.84.6: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.
texts.psa.84.7: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.
texts.psa.84.8: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
texts.psa.84.9: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.
texts.psa.84.10: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
texts.psa.84.11: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
texts.psa.84.12: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
texts.psa.85.1: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
texts.psa.85.2: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. Selah
texts.psa.85.3: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.
texts.psa.85.4: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.
texts.psa.85.5: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
texts.psa.85.6: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?
texts.psa.85.7: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.
texts.psa.85.8: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.
texts.psa.85.9: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.
texts.psa.85.10: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
texts.psa.85.11: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
texts.psa.85.12: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.
texts.psa.85.13: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way [to walk in].
texts.psa.86.1: A Prayer of David Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
texts.psa.86.2: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
texts.psa.86.3: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.
texts.psa.86.4: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
texts.psa.86.5: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.
texts.psa.86.6: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.86.7: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.
texts.psa.86.8: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.
texts.psa.86.9: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.
texts.psa.86.10: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.
texts.psa.86.11: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.
texts.psa.86.12: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.
texts.psa.86.13: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
texts.psa.86.14: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.
texts.psa.86.15: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.
texts.psa.86.16: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.
texts.psa.86.17: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me.
texts.psa.87.1: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
texts.psa.87.2: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
texts.psa.87.3: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah
texts.psa.87.4: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.
texts.psa.87.5: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.
texts.psa.87.6: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. Selah
texts.psa.87.7: They that sing as well as they that dance [shall say], All my fountains are in thee.
texts.psa.88.1: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.
texts.psa.88.2: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.
texts.psa.88.3: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.
texts.psa.88.4: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,
texts.psa.88.5: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.
texts.psa.88.6: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.
texts.psa.88.7: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah
texts.psa.88.8: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
texts.psa.88.9: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.
texts.psa.88.10: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are decreased arise and praise thee? Selah
texts.psa.88.11: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?
texts.psa.88.12: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.psa.88.13: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
texts.psa.88.14: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?
texts.psa.88.15: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
texts.psa.88.16: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
texts.psa.88.17: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.
texts.psa.88.18: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
texts.psa.89.1: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
texts.psa.89.2: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.
texts.psa.89.3: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:
texts.psa.89.4: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. Selah
texts.psa.89.5: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
texts.psa.89.6: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,
texts.psa.89.7: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?
texts.psa.89.8: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.
texts.psa.89.9: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
texts.psa.89.10: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.
texts.psa.89.11: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
texts.psa.89.12: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.
texts.psa.89.13: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
texts.psa.89.14: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.
texts.psa.89.15: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.89.16: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.
texts.psa.89.17: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.
texts.psa.89.18: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.
texts.psa.89.19: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
texts.psa.89.20: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:
texts.psa.89.21: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
texts.psa.89.22: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
texts.psa.89.23: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.
texts.psa.89.24: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.
texts.psa.89.25: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.
texts.psa.89.26: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.
texts.psa.89.27: I also will make him [my] first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
texts.psa.89.28: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.
texts.psa.89.29: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
texts.psa.89.30: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;
texts.psa.89.31: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;
texts.psa.89.32: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
texts.psa.89.33: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
texts.psa.89.34: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
texts.psa.89.35: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:
texts.psa.89.36: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.
texts.psa.89.37: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And [as] the faithful witness in the sky. Selah
texts.psa.89.38: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
texts.psa.89.39: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.
texts.psa.89.40: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
texts.psa.89.41: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.
texts.psa.89.42: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
texts.psa.89.43: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
texts.psa.89.44: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
texts.psa.89.45: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah
texts.psa.89.46: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? [How long] shall thy wrath burn like fire?
texts.psa.89.47: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!
texts.psa.89.48: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
texts.psa.89.49: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?
texts.psa.89.50: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty peoples,
texts.psa.89.51: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
texts.psa.89.52: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen. BOOK IV
texts.psa.90.1: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.
texts.psa.90.2: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
texts.psa.90.3: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
texts.psa.90.4: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
texts.psa.90.5: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
texts.psa.90.6: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
texts.psa.90.7: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.
texts.psa.90.8: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.90.9: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
texts.psa.90.10: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.
texts.psa.90.11: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?
texts.psa.90.12: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
texts.psa.90.13: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
texts.psa.90.14: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
texts.psa.90.15: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.
texts.psa.90.16: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.
texts.psa.90.17: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
texts.psa.91.1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
texts.psa.91.2: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
texts.psa.91.3: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.
texts.psa.91.4: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.
texts.psa.91.5: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
texts.psa.91.6: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
texts.psa.91.7: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; [But] it shall not come nigh thee.
texts.psa.91.8: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.
texts.psa.91.9: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;
texts.psa.91.10: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
texts.psa.91.11: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
texts.psa.91.12: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
texts.psa.91.13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.
texts.psa.91.14: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
texts.psa.91.15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.
texts.psa.91.16: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.
texts.psa.92.1: A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;
texts.psa.92.2: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,
texts.psa.92.3: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
texts.psa.92.4: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
texts.psa.92.5: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.
texts.psa.92.6: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:
texts.psa.92.7: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.
texts.psa.92.8: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.
texts.psa.92.9: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
texts.psa.92.10: But my horn hast thou exalted like [the horn of] the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.
texts.psa.92.11: Mine eye also hath seen [my desire] on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard [my desire] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
texts.psa.92.12: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
texts.psa.92.13: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
texts.psa.92.14: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:
texts.psa.92.15: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
texts.psa.93.1: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
texts.psa.93.2: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
texts.psa.93.3: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
texts.psa.93.4: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
texts.psa.93.5: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
texts.psa.94.1: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
texts.psa.94.2: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud [their] desert.
texts.psa.94.3: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
texts.psa.94.4: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
texts.psa.94.5: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.
texts.psa.94.6: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.
texts.psa.94.7: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
texts.psa.94.8: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
texts.psa.94.9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
texts.psa.94.10: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, [Even] he that teacheth man knowledge?
texts.psa.94.11: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
texts.psa.94.12: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
texts.psa.94.13: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
texts.psa.94.14: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
texts.psa.94.15: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
texts.psa.94.16: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
texts.psa.94.17: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
texts.psa.94.18: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
texts.psa.94.19: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.
texts.psa.94.20: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
texts.psa.94.21: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
texts.psa.94.22: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
texts.psa.94.23: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
texts.psa.95.1: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
texts.psa.95.2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
texts.psa.95.3: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
texts.psa.95.4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.
texts.psa.95.5: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.
texts.psa.95.6: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:
texts.psa.95.7: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!
texts.psa.95.8: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
texts.psa.95.9: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.
texts.psa.95.10: Forty years long was I grieved with [that] generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
texts.psa.95.11: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
texts.psa.96.1: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.2: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
texts.psa.96.3: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
texts.psa.96.4: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.
texts.psa.96.5: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.
texts.psa.96.6: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
texts.psa.96.7: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
texts.psa.96.8: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
texts.psa.96.9: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.10: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.
texts.psa.96.11: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
texts.psa.96.12: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy
texts.psa.96.13: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
texts.psa.97.1: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
texts.psa.97.2: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
texts.psa.97.3: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
texts.psa.97.4: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
texts.psa.97.5: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
texts.psa.97.6: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
texts.psa.97.7: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
texts.psa.97.8: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.97.9: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
texts.psa.97.10: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.97.11: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
texts.psa.97.12: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial [name].
texts.psa.98.1: A Psalm. Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
texts.psa.98.2: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
texts.psa.98.3: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
texts.psa.98.4: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
texts.psa.98.5: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
texts.psa.98.6: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
texts.psa.98.7: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
texts.psa.98.8: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
texts.psa.98.9: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
texts.psa.99.1: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth [above] the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
texts.psa.99.2: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
texts.psa.99.3: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
texts.psa.99.4: The king's strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
texts.psa.99.5: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
texts.psa.99.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
texts.psa.99.7: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
texts.psa.99.8: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
texts.psa.99.9: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
texts.psa.100.1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
texts.psa.100.2: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
texts.psa.100.3: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
texts.psa.100.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
texts.psa.100.5: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
texts.psa.101.1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
texts.psa.101.2: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
texts.psa.101.3: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.
texts.psa.101.4: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
texts.psa.101.5: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
texts.psa.101.6: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.
texts.psa.101.7: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
texts.psa.101.8: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.1: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.
texts.psa.102.2: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
texts.psa.102.3: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.
texts.psa.102.4: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
texts.psa.102.5: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
texts.psa.102.6: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
texts.psa.102.7: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
texts.psa.102.8: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
texts.psa.102.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
texts.psa.102.10: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
texts.psa.102.11: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
texts.psa.102.12: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial [name] unto all generations.
texts.psa.102.13: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
texts.psa.102.14: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.
texts.psa.102.15: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
texts.psa.102.16: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.
texts.psa.102.17: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
texts.psa.102.18: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.19: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;
texts.psa.102.20: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
texts.psa.102.21: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;
texts.psa.102.22: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.23: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
texts.psa.102.24: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.
texts.psa.102.25: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.
texts.psa.102.26: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
texts.psa.102.27: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
texts.psa.102.28: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
texts.psa.103.1: [A Psalm] of David. Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, [bless] his holy name.
texts.psa.103.2: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
texts.psa.103.3: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;
texts.psa.103.4: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
texts.psa.103.5: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, [So that] thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
texts.psa.103.6: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.
texts.psa.103.7: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
texts.psa.103.8: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.
texts.psa.103.9: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.
texts.psa.103.10: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.
texts.psa.103.11: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.12: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
texts.psa.103.13: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.14: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
texts.psa.103.15: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
texts.psa.103.16: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
texts.psa.103.17: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children's children;
texts.psa.103.18: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.
texts.psa.103.19: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
texts.psa.103.20: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
texts.psa.103.21: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
texts.psa.103.22: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
texts.psa.104.1: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
texts.psa.104.2: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
texts.psa.104.3: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
texts.psa.104.4: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
texts.psa.104.5: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.
texts.psa.104.6: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.
texts.psa.104.7: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
texts.psa.104.8: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
texts.psa.104.9: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
texts.psa.104.10: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;
texts.psa.104.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.
texts.psa.104.12: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.
texts.psa.104.13: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
texts.psa.104.14: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,
texts.psa.104.15: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, [And] oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man's heart.
texts.psa.104.16: The trees of Jehovah are filled [with moisture], The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
texts.psa.104.17: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
texts.psa.104.18: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
texts.psa.104.19: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
texts.psa.104.20: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
texts.psa.104.21: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
texts.psa.104.22: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.
texts.psa.104.23: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.
texts.psa.104.24: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
texts.psa.104.25: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
texts.psa.104.26: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.
texts.psa.104.27: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.
texts.psa.104.28: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
texts.psa.104.29: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
texts.psa.104.30: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
texts.psa.104.31: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:
texts.psa.104.32: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
texts.psa.104.33: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
texts.psa.104.34: Let thy meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.
texts.psa.104.35: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.105.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.
texts.psa.105.2: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvelous works.
texts.psa.105.3: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
texts.psa.105.4: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
texts.psa.105.5: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
texts.psa.105.6: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
texts.psa.105.7: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.
texts.psa.105.8: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
texts.psa.105.9: [The covenant] which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,
texts.psa.105.10: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
texts.psa.105.11: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
texts.psa.105.12: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.
texts.psa.105.13: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.
texts.psa.105.14: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
texts.psa.105.15: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
texts.psa.105.16: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.
texts.psa.105.17: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:
texts.psa.105.18: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in [chains of] iron,
texts.psa.105.19: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.
texts.psa.105.20: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
texts.psa.105.21: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;
texts.psa.105.22: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
texts.psa.105.23: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.24: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.
texts.psa.105.25: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.
texts.psa.105.26: He sent Moses his servant, [And] Aaron whom he had chosen.
texts.psa.105.27: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.
texts.psa.105.29: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
texts.psa.105.30: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.
texts.psa.105.31: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.
texts.psa.105.32: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.
texts.psa.105.33: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.
texts.psa.105.34: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,
texts.psa.105.35: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
texts.psa.105.36: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.
texts.psa.105.37: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.
texts.psa.105.38: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
texts.psa.105.39: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
texts.psa.105.40: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
texts.psa.105.41: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places [like] a river.
texts.psa.105.42: For he remembered his holy word, [And] Abraham his servant.
texts.psa.105.43: And he brought forth his people with joy, [And] his chosen with singing.
texts.psa.105.44: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:
texts.psa.105.45: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] forever.
texts.psa.106.2: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
texts.psa.106.3: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
texts.psa.106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,
texts.psa.106.5: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
texts.psa.106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
texts.psa.106.7: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
texts.psa.106.8: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
texts.psa.106.9: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
texts.psa.106.10: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
texts.psa.106.11: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
texts.psa.106.12: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.
texts.psa.106.13: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,
texts.psa.106.14: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
texts.psa.106.15: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
texts.psa.106.16: They envied Moses also in the camp, [And] Aaron the saint of Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
texts.psa.106.18: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
texts.psa.106.19: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
texts.psa.106.20: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
texts.psa.106.21: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,
texts.psa.106.22: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, [And] terrible things by the Red Sea.
texts.psa.106.23: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy [them].
texts.psa.106.24: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,
texts.psa.106.25: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.26: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
texts.psa.106.27: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
texts.psa.106.28: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
texts.psa.106.29: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.
texts.psa.106.30: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.
texts.psa.106.31: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.
texts.psa.106.32: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
texts.psa.106.33: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
texts.psa.106.34: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,
texts.psa.106.35: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,
texts.psa.106.36: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.
texts.psa.106.37: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
texts.psa.106.38: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
texts.psa.106.39: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.
texts.psa.106.40: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.
texts.psa.106.41: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
texts.psa.106.42: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
texts.psa.106.43: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.
texts.psa.106.44: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:
texts.psa.106.45: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
texts.psa.106.46: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
texts.psa.106.47: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
texts.psa.106.48: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah. BOOK V
texts.psa.107.1: O give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.107.2: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say [so], Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
texts.psa.107.3: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
texts.psa.107.4: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.5: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
texts.psa.107.6: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,
texts.psa.107.7: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.8: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.9: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.
texts.psa.107.10: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,
texts.psa.107.11: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:
texts.psa.107.12: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.
texts.psa.107.13: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.
texts.psa.107.15: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.16: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
texts.psa.107.17: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
texts.psa.107.18: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
texts.psa.107.19: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.20: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth [them] from their destructions.
texts.psa.107.21: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.22: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.
texts.psa.107.23: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;
texts.psa.107.24: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.
texts.psa.107.25: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.
texts.psa.107.26: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.
texts.psa.107.27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits' end.
texts.psa.107.28: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.29: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
texts.psa.107.30: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
texts.psa.107.31: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.32: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.
texts.psa.107.33: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
texts.psa.107.34: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
texts.psa.107.35: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
texts.psa.107.36: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,
texts.psa.107.37: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.
texts.psa.107.38: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
texts.psa.107.39: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
texts.psa.107.40: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
texts.psa.107.41: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh [him] families like a flock.
texts.psa.107.42: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
texts.psa.107.43: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.
texts.psa.108.1: A Song, A Psalm of David. My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
texts.psa.108.2: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
texts.psa.108.3: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
texts.psa.108.4: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth [reacheth] unto the skies.
texts.psa.108.5: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
texts.psa.108.6: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
texts.psa.108.7: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
texts.psa.108.8: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
texts.psa.108.9: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.
texts.psa.108.10: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
texts.psa.108.11: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
texts.psa.108.12: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
texts.psa.108.13: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
texts.psa.109.1: For the Chief Musicion. A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
texts.psa.109.2: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
texts.psa.109.3: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
texts.psa.109.4: For my love they are my adversaries: But I [give myself unto] prayer.
texts.psa.109.5: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
texts.psa.109.6: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
texts.psa.109.7: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
texts.psa.109.8: Let his days be few; [And] let another take his office.
texts.psa.109.9: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
texts.psa.109.10: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek [their bread] out of their desolate places.
texts.psa.109.11: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.
texts.psa.109.12: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.
texts.psa.109.13: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
texts.psa.109.14: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.psa.109.15: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
texts.psa.109.16: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay [them].
texts.psa.109.17: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.
texts.psa.109.18: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
texts.psa.109.19: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
texts.psa.109.20: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
texts.psa.109.21: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name's sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;
texts.psa.109.22: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
texts.psa.109.23: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
texts.psa.109.24: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.
texts.psa.109.25: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.
texts.psa.109.26: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:
texts.psa.109.27: That they may know that this is thy hand; [That] thou, Jehovah, hast done it.
texts.psa.109.28: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.
texts.psa.109.29: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
texts.psa.109.30: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
texts.psa.109.31: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
texts.psa.110.1: A Psalm of David. Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
texts.psa.110.2: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
texts.psa.110.3: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.
texts.psa.110.4: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
texts.psa.110.5: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
texts.psa.110.6: He will judge among the nations, He will fill [the places] with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.
texts.psa.110.7: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
texts.psa.111.1: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
texts.psa.111.2: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
texts.psa.111.3: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
texts.psa.111.4: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
texts.psa.111.5: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
texts.psa.111.6: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
texts.psa.111.7: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.
texts.psa.111.8: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.
texts.psa.111.9: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.
texts.psa.111.10: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do [his commandments]: His praise endureth for ever.
texts.psa.112.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
texts.psa.112.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
texts.psa.112.3: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
texts.psa.112.4: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [He is] gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
texts.psa.112.5: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
texts.psa.112.6: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
texts.psa.112.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
texts.psa.112.8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see [his desire] upon his adversaries.
texts.psa.112.9: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
texts.psa.112.10: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
texts.psa.113.1: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.113.2: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
texts.psa.113.3: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.
texts.psa.113.4: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
texts.psa.113.5: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,
texts.psa.113.6: That humbleth himself to behold [The things that are] in heaven and in the earth?
texts.psa.113.7: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;
texts.psa.113.8: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.
texts.psa.113.9: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [And to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.114.1: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
texts.psa.114.2: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
texts.psa.114.3: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.
texts.psa.114.4: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
texts.psa.114.5: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
texts.psa.114.6: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?
texts.psa.114.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
texts.psa.114.8: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
texts.psa.115.1: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth's sake.
texts.psa.115.2: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?
texts.psa.115.3: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
texts.psa.115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
texts.psa.115.5: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
texts.psa.115.6: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
texts.psa.115.7: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
texts.psa.115.8: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
texts.psa.115.9: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.10: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.11: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.12: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless [us]: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
texts.psa.115.13: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.
texts.psa.115.14: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.
texts.psa.115.15: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.115.16: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
texts.psa.115.17: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;
texts.psa.115.18: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.116.1: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
texts.psa.116.2: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call [upon him] as long as I live.
texts.psa.116.3: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
texts.psa.116.4: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
texts.psa.116.5: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
texts.psa.116.6: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
texts.psa.116.7: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
texts.psa.116.8: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, [And] my feet from falling.
texts.psa.116.9: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.
texts.psa.116.10: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
texts.psa.116.11: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
texts.psa.116.12: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?
texts.psa.116.13: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.116.14: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.
texts.psa.116.15: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.
texts.psa.116.16: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.
texts.psa.116.17: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.116.18: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,
texts.psa.116.19: In the courts of Jehovah's house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.117.1: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
texts.psa.117.2: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah [endureth] for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.118.1: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.2: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.3: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.4: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.5: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me [and set me] in a large place.
texts.psa.118.6: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
texts.psa.118.7: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.
texts.psa.118.8: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.
texts.psa.118.9: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.
texts.psa.118.10: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
texts.psa.118.11: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
texts.psa.118.12: They compassed me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
texts.psa.118.13: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.
texts.psa.118.14: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
texts.psa.118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
texts.psa.118.17: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.
texts.psa.118.18: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.
texts.psa.118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.
texts.psa.118.20: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.
texts.psa.118.21: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.22: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.
texts.psa.118.23: This is Jehovah's doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
texts.psa.118.24: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
texts.psa.118.25: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
texts.psa.118.26: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
texts.psa.118.27: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
texts.psa.118.28: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
texts.psa.118.29: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.119.1: ALEPH. Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
texts.psa.119.2: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.
texts.psa.119.3: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.
texts.psa.119.4: Thou hast commanded [us] thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.
texts.psa.119.5: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!
texts.psa.119.6: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.7: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.8: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly. BETH.
texts.psa.119.9: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.10: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.11: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
texts.psa.119.12: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.13: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.14: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
texts.psa.119.15: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
texts.psa.119.16: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. GIMEL.
texts.psa.119.17: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.
texts.psa.119.18: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.
texts.psa.119.19: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.
texts.psa.119.20: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.
texts.psa.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.22: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.23: Princes also sat and talked against me; [But] thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.24: Thy testimonies also are my delight [And] my counsellors. DALETH.
texts.psa.119.25: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.26: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.27: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.
texts.psa.119.28: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
texts.psa.119.29: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.
texts.psa.119.30: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
texts.psa.119.31: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
texts.psa.119.32: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart. HE.
texts.psa.119.33: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
texts.psa.119.34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
texts.psa.119.35: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
texts.psa.119.36: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.
texts.psa.119.37: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
texts.psa.119.38: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which [is in order] unto the fear of thee.
texts.psa.119.39: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.
texts.psa.119.40: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness. VAV.
texts.psa.119.41: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.42: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.
texts.psa.119.43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.
texts.psa.119.44: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.
texts.psa.119.45: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.46: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.
texts.psa.119.47: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.
texts.psa.119.48: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes. ZAYIN.
texts.psa.119.49: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.
texts.psa.119.50: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.
texts.psa.119.51: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [Yet] have I not swerved from thy law.
texts.psa.119.52: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.
texts.psa.119.53: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
texts.psa.119.54: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
texts.psa.119.55: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.
texts.psa.119.56: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts. HHETH.
texts.psa.119.57: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.
texts.psa.119.58: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.59: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.60: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.61: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; [But] I have not forgotten thy law.
texts.psa.119.62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.
texts.psa.119.63: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.64: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes. TETH.
