texts.psa.78.39: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
texts.psa.78.40: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
texts.psa.78.41: Yes, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
texts.psa.78.42: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
texts.psa.78.43: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
texts.psa.78.44: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
texts.psa.78.45: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
texts.psa.78.46: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
texts.psa.78.47: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.
texts.psa.78.48: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
texts.psa.78.49: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
texts.psa.78.50: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
texts.psa.78.51: And smote all the first-born in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
texts.psa.78.52: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
texts.psa.78.53: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
texts.psa.78.54: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
texts.psa.78.55: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
texts.psa.78.56: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
texts.psa.78.57: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
texts.psa.78.58: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
texts.psa.78.59: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
texts.psa.78.60: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
texts.psa.78.61: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
texts.psa.78.62: He gave over his people also to the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
texts.psa.78.63: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
texts.psa.78.64: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
texts.psa.78.65: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
texts.psa.78.66: And he smote his enemies in the hinder part: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
texts.psa.78.67: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
texts.psa.78.68: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
texts.psa.78.69: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
texts.psa.78.70: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheep-folds:
texts.psa.78.71: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
texts.psa.78.72: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
texts.psa.79.1: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen have come into thy inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
texts.psa.79.2: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food to the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints, to the beasts of the earth.
texts.psa.79.3: Their blood have they shed like water around Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
texts.psa.79.4: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to them that are around us.
texts.psa.79.5: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
texts.psa.79.6: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
texts.psa.79.7: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling-place.
texts.psa.79.8: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily succor us: for we are brought very low.
texts.psa.79.9: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
texts.psa.79.10: Why should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by avenging the blood of thy servants which is shed.
texts.psa.79.11: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
texts.psa.79.12: And render to our neighbors seven-fold into their bosom their reproach, with which they have reproached thee, O Lord.
texts.psa.79.13: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will show forth thy praise to all generations.
texts.psa.80.1: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim Eduth, A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubim, shine forth.
texts.psa.80.2: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
texts.psa.80.3: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.4: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
texts.psa.80.5: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
texts.psa.80.6: Thou makest us a strife to our neighbors: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
texts.psa.80.7: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.8: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
texts.psa.80.9: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
texts.psa.80.10: The hills were covered with the shade of it, and its boughs were like the goodly cedars.
texts.psa.80.11: She sent out her boughs to the sea, and her branches to the river.
texts.psa.80.12: Why hast thou then broke down her hedges, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck her?
texts.psa.80.13: The boar from the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
texts.psa.80.14: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
texts.psa.80.15: And the vineyard which thy right hand planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.16: It is burnt with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
texts.psa.80.17: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.18: So will we not go back from thee: revive us, and we will call upon thy name.
texts.psa.80.19: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.81.1: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud to God our strength: make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
texts.psa.81.2: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
texts.psa.81.3: Blow the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
texts.psa.81.4: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
texts.psa.81.5: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
texts.psa.81.6: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
texts.psa.81.7: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
texts.psa.81.8: Hear, O my people, and I will testify to thee; O Israel, if thou wilt hearken to me;
texts.psa.81.9: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
texts.psa.81.10: I am the LORD thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
texts.psa.81.11: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would not obey me.
texts.psa.81.12: So I gave them up to their own hearts lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
texts.psa.81.13: O that my people had hearkened to me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
texts.psa.81.14: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
texts.psa.81.15: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves to him: and their time should have endured for ever.
texts.psa.81.16: He would have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock I should have satisfied thee.
texts.psa.82.1: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
texts.psa.82.2: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
texts.psa.82.3: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
texts.psa.82.4: Deliver the poor and needy: deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.82.5: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
texts.psa.82.6: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the Most High.
texts.psa.82.7: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
texts.psa.82.8: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou wilt inherit all nations.
texts.psa.83.1: A song, or Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
texts.psa.83.2: For lo, thy enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
texts.psa.83.3: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
texts.psa.83.4: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
texts.psa.83.5: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee,
texts.psa.83.6: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
texts.psa.83.7: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
texts.psa.83.8: Assur also is joined with them: they have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
texts.psa.83.9: Do to them as to the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
texts.psa.83.10: Who perished at En-dor: they became as dung for the earth.
texts.psa.83.11: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yes, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
texts.psa.83.12: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
texts.psa.83.13: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
texts.psa.83.14: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
texts.psa.83.15: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
texts.psa.83.16: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
texts.psa.83.17: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yes, let them be put to shame, and perish:
texts.psa.83.18: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
texts.psa.84.1: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
texts.psa.84.2: My soul longeth, and even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
texts.psa.84.3: Yes, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thy altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
texts.psa.84.4: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
texts.psa.84.5: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
texts.psa.84.6: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
texts.psa.84.7: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
texts.psa.84.8: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
texts.psa.84.9: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thy anointed.
texts.psa.84.10: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a door-keeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
texts.psa.84.11: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
texts.psa.84.12: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
texts.psa.85.1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. LORD, thou hast been favorable to thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
texts.psa.85.2: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
texts.psa.85.3: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thy anger.
texts.psa.85.4: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thy anger towards us to cease.
texts.psa.85.5: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thy anger to all generations?
texts.psa.85.6: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
texts.psa.85.7: Show us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
texts.psa.85.8: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace to his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
texts.psa.85.9: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
texts.psa.85.10: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
texts.psa.85.11: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
texts.psa.85.12: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
texts.psa.85.13: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
texts.psa.86.1: A Prayer of David. Bow down thy ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
texts.psa.86.2: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
texts.psa.86.3: Be merciful to me, O Lord: for I cry to thee daily.
texts.psa.86.4: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for to thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
texts.psa.86.5: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and abundant in mercy to all them that call upon thee.
texts.psa.86.6: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.86.7: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
texts.psa.86.8: Among the gods there is none like thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like thy works.
texts.psa.86.9: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
texts.psa.86.10: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
texts.psa.86.11: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
texts.psa.86.12: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
texts.psa.86.13: For great is thy mercy towards me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
texts.psa.86.14: O God, the proud have risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
texts.psa.86.15: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious; long-suffering, and abundant in mercy and truth.
texts.psa.86.16: O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.
texts.psa.86.17: Show me a token for good; that they who hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
texts.psa.87.1: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
texts.psa.87.2: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
texts.psa.87.3: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
texts.psa.87.4: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Cush; this man was born there.
texts.psa.87.5: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the Highest himself shall establish her.
texts.psa.87.6: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
texts.psa.87.7: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
texts.psa.88.1: A Song or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
texts.psa.88.2: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thy ear to my cry;
texts.psa.88.3: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh to the grave.
texts.psa.88.4: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
texts.psa.88.5: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
texts.psa.88.6: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
texts.psa.88.7: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
texts.psa.88.8: Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination to them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
texts.psa.88.9: My eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands to thee.
texts.psa.88.10: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
texts.psa.88.11: Shall thy loving-kindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
texts.psa.88.12: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.psa.88.13: But to thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
texts.psa.88.14: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
texts.psa.88.15: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
texts.psa.88.16: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
texts.psa.88.17: They came around me daily like water; they encompassed me together.
texts.psa.88.18: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and my acquaintance into darkness.
texts.psa.89.1: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
texts.psa.89.2: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.
texts.psa.89.3: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant,
texts.psa.89.4: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
texts.psa.89.5: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD; thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
texts.psa.89.6: For who in the heaven can be compared to the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the LORD?
texts.psa.89.7: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence by all them that are about him.
texts.psa.89.8: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like to thee? or to thy faithfulness around thee?
texts.psa.89.9: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when its waves arise, thou stillest them.
texts.psa.89.10: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thy enemies with thy strong arm.
texts.psa.89.11: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world, and the fullness of it, thou hast founded them.
texts.psa.89.12: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
texts.psa.89.13: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
texts.psa.89.14: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
texts.psa.89.15: Blessed are the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.89.16: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
texts.psa.89.17: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.
texts.psa.89.18: For the LORD is our defense; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
texts.psa.89.19: Then thou didst speak in vision to thy holy one, and say, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
texts.psa.89.20: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
texts.psa.89.21: With whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.
texts.psa.89.22: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
texts.psa.89.23: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and afflict them that hate him.
texts.psa.89.24: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
texts.psa.89.25: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
texts.psa.89.26: He shall cry to me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
texts.psa.89.27: Also I will make him my first-born, higher than the kings of the earth.
texts.psa.89.28: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
texts.psa.89.29: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
texts.psa.89.30: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
texts.psa.89.31: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
texts.psa.89.32: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
texts.psa.89.33: Nevertheless my loving-kindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
texts.psa.89.34: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that hath gone out of my lips.
texts.psa.89.35: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie to David.
texts.psa.89.36: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
texts.psa.89.37: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
texts.psa.89.38: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thy anointed.
texts.psa.89.39: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
texts.psa.89.40: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
texts.psa.89.41: All that pass by the way plunder him: he is a reproach to his neighbors.
texts.psa.89.42: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
texts.psa.89.43: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
texts.psa.89.44: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
texts.psa.89.45: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
texts.psa.89.46: How long, LORD, wilt thou hide thyself? for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
texts.psa.89.47: Remember how short my time is: why hast thou made all men in vain?
texts.psa.89.48: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
texts.psa.89.49: Lord, where are thy former loving-kindnesses, which thou didst swear to David in thy truth?
texts.psa.89.50: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
texts.psa.89.51: With which thy enemies have reproached, O LORD; with which they have reproached the footsteps of thy anointed
texts.psa.89.52: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen and amen.
texts.psa.90.1: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.
texts.psa.90.2: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
texts.psa.90.3: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
texts.psa.90.4: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
texts.psa.90.5: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; in the morning they are like grass which groweth.
texts.psa.90.6: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
texts.psa.90.7: For we are consumed by thy anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
texts.psa.90.8: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.90.9: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years, as a tale that is told.
texts.psa.90.10: The days of our years are seventy years; and if by reason of strength they are eighty years, yet is their strength labor and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
texts.psa.90.11: Who knoweth the power of thy anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
texts.psa.90.12: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts to wisdom.
texts.psa.90.13: Return, O LORD, how long? and repent thou concerning thy servants.
texts.psa.90.14: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
texts.psa.90.15: Make us glad according to the days in which thou hast afflicted us, and the years in which we have seen evil.
texts.psa.90.16: Let thy work appear to thy servants, and thy glory to their children.
texts.psa.90.17: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yes, the work of our hands establish thou it.
texts.psa.91.1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
texts.psa.91.2: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
texts.psa.91.3: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
texts.psa.91.4: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
texts.psa.91.5: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
texts.psa.91.6: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noon-day.
texts.psa.91.7: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
texts.psa.91.8: Only with thy eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
texts.psa.91.9: Because thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, even the Most High, thy habitation;
texts.psa.91.10: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
texts.psa.91.11: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
texts.psa.91.12: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
texts.psa.91.13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
texts.psa.91.14: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
texts.psa.91.15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honor him.
texts.psa.91.16: With long life will I satisfy him, and show him my salvation.
texts.psa.92.1: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, and to sing praises to thy name, O Most High.
texts.psa.92.2: To show forth thy loving-kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night.
texts.psa.92.3: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
texts.psa.92.4: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
texts.psa.92.5: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
texts.psa.92.6: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
texts.psa.92.7: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
texts.psa.92.8: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
texts.psa.92.9: For lo, thy enemies, O LORD, for lo, thy enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
texts.psa.92.10: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
texts.psa.92.11: My eye also shall see my desire on my enemies, and my ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
texts.psa.92.12: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
texts.psa.92.13: Those that are planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
texts.psa.92.14: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
texts.psa.92.15: To show that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
texts.psa.93.1: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, with which he hath girded himself: the world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
texts.psa.93.2: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
texts.psa.93.3: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift their waves.
texts.psa.93.4: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yes, than the mighty waves of the sea.
texts.psa.93.5: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thy house, O LORD, for ever.
texts.psa.94.1: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, show thyself.
texts.psa.94.2: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
texts.psa.94.3: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
texts.psa.94.4: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
texts.psa.94.5: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thy heritage.
texts.psa.94.6: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
texts.psa.94.7: Yet they say, The LORD will not see, neither will the God of Jacob regard it.
texts.psa.94.8: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
texts.psa.94.9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
texts.psa.94.10: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall he not correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall he not know?
texts.psa.94.11: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
texts.psa.94.12: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
texts.psa.94.13: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
texts.psa.94.14: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
texts.psa.94.15: But judgment shall return to righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
texts.psa.94.16: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
texts.psa.94.17: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
texts.psa.94.18: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
texts.psa.94.19: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, thy comforts delight my soul.
texts.psa.94.20: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
texts.psa.94.21: They assemble themselves against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
texts.psa.94.22: But the LORD is my defense; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
texts.psa.94.23: And he will bring upon them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness; yes, the LORD our God will cut them off.
texts.psa.95.1: O come, let us sing to the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
texts.psa.95.2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
texts.psa.95.3: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
texts.psa.95.4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
texts.psa.95.5: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
texts.psa.95.6: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
texts.psa.95.7: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, if ye will hear his voice,
texts.psa.95.8: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
texts.psa.95.9: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
texts.psa.95.10: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
texts.psa.95.11: To whom I swore in my wrath, that they should not enter into my rest.
texts.psa.96.1: O sing to the LORD a new song: sing to the LORD, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.2: Sing to the LORD, bless his name; show forth his salvation from day to day.
texts.psa.96.3: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
texts.psa.96.4: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
texts.psa.96.5: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
texts.psa.96.6: Honor and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
texts.psa.96.7: Give to the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give to the LORD glory and strength.
texts.psa.96.8: Give to the LORD the glory due to his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
texts.psa.96.9: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.10: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he will judge the people righteously.
texts.psa.96.11: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fullness of it.
texts.psa.96.12: Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice before the LORD:
texts.psa.96.13: For he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
texts.psa.97.1: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad.
texts.psa.97.2: Clouds and darkness surround him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
texts.psa.97.3: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
texts.psa.97.4: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
texts.psa.97.5: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
texts.psa.97.6: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
texts.psa.97.7: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols; worship him, all ye gods.
texts.psa.97.8: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
texts.psa.97.9: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
texts.psa.97.10: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.97.11: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
texts.psa.97.12: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
texts.psa.98.1: A Psalm. O sing to the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvelous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
texts.psa.98.2: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shown in the sight of the heathen.
texts.psa.98.3: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth towards the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
texts.psa.98.4: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
texts.psa.98.5: Sing to the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
texts.psa.98.6: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
texts.psa.98.7: Let the sea roar, and the fullness of it, the world, and they that dwell therein.
texts.psa.98.8: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
texts.psa.98.9: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness will he judge the world, and the people with equity.
texts.psa.99.1: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he setteth between the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
texts.psa.99.2: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all people.
texts.psa.99.3: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
texts.psa.99.4: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
texts.psa.99.5: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
texts.psa.99.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
texts.psa.99.7: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
texts.psa.99.8: Thou didst answer them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
texts.psa.99.9: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
texts.psa.100.1: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all ye lands.
texts.psa.100.2: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
texts.psa.100.3: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
texts.psa.100.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful to him, and bless his name.
texts.psa.100.5: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
texts.psa.101.1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: to thee, O LORD, will I sing.
texts.psa.101.2: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
texts.psa.101.3: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
texts.psa.101.4: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
texts.psa.101.5: Whoever privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I cut off: him that hath a high look and a proud heart I will not suffer.
texts.psa.101.6: My eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
texts.psa.101.7: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
texts.psa.101.8: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all who practice wickedness from the city of the LORD.
texts.psa.102.1: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come to thee.
texts.psa.102.2: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thy ear to me: in the day when I call, answer me speedily.
texts.psa.102.3: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
texts.psa.102.4: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
texts.psa.102.5: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my skin.
texts.psa.102.6: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
texts.psa.102.7: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
texts.psa.102.8: My enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are enraged against me are sworn against me.
texts.psa.102.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
texts.psa.102.10: Because of thy indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
texts.psa.102.11: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
texts.psa.102.12: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance to all generations.
texts.psa.102.13: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favor her, yes, the set time, is come.
texts.psa.102.14: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favor the dust thereof.
texts.psa.102.15: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD: and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
texts.psa.102.16: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he will appear in his glory.
texts.psa.102.17: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
texts.psa.102.18: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
texts.psa.102.19: For he hath looked down from the hight of his sanctuary; from heaven hath the LORD beheld the earth;
texts.psa.102.20: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
texts.psa.102.21: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
texts.psa.102.22: When the people are assembled, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
texts.psa.102.23: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
texts.psa.102.24: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
texts.psa.102.25: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
texts.psa.102.26: They shall perish, but thou wilt endure: yes, all of them shall grow old like a garment; as a vesture wilt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
texts.psa.102.27: But thou art the same, and thy years will have no end.
texts.psa.102.28: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
texts.psa.103.1: A Psalm of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
texts.psa.103.2: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
texts.psa.103.3: Who forgiveth all thy iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
texts.psa.103.4: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with loving-kindness and tender mercies;
texts.psa.103.5: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
texts.psa.103.6: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
texts.psa.103.7: He made known his ways to Moses, his acts to the children of Israel.
texts.psa.103.8: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in mercy.
texts.psa.103.9: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
texts.psa.103.10: He hath not dealt with us according to our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
texts.psa.103.11: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy towards them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.12: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
texts.psa.103.13: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.14: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
texts.psa.103.15: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
texts.psa.103.16: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and its place shall know it no more.
texts.psa.103.17: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness to children's children;
texts.psa.103.18: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
texts.psa.103.19: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
texts.psa.103.20: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening to the voice of his word.
texts.psa.103.21: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
texts.psa.103.22: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
texts.psa.104.1: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honor and majesty.
texts.psa.104.2: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
texts.psa.104.3: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
texts.psa.104.4: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
texts.psa.104.5: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
texts.psa.104.6: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
texts.psa.104.7: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
texts.psa.104.8: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys to the place which thou hast founded for them.
texts.psa.104.9: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
texts.psa.104.10: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
texts.psa.104.11: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
texts.psa.104.12: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
texts.psa.104.13: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
texts.psa.104.14: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
texts.psa.104.15: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
texts.psa.104.16: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
texts.psa.104.17: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
texts.psa.104.18: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
texts.psa.104.19: He appointeth the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
texts.psa.104.20: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: in which all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
texts.psa.104.21: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
texts.psa.104.22: The sun ariseth, they collect, and lay themselves down in their dens.
texts.psa.104.23: Man goeth forth to his work and to his labor until the evening.
texts.psa.104.24: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
texts.psa.104.25: So is this great and wide sea, in which are creeping animals innumerable, both small and great beasts.
texts.psa.104.26: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, which thou hast made to play therein.
texts.psa.104.27: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their food in due season.
texts.psa.104.28: That which thou givest them, they gather: thou openest thy hand, they are filled with good.
texts.psa.104.29: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
texts.psa.104.30: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
texts.psa.104.31: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
texts.psa.104.32: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
texts.psa.104.33: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
texts.psa.104.34: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
texts.psa.104.35: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.105.1: O give thanks to the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
texts.psa.105.2: Sing to him, sing psalms to him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
texts.psa.105.3: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
texts.psa.105.4: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
texts.psa.105.5: Remember his wonderful works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
texts.psa.105.6: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
texts.psa.105.7: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
texts.psa.105.8: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
texts.psa.105.9: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;
texts.psa.105.10: And confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
texts.psa.105.11: Saying, To thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
texts.psa.105.12: When they were a few men in number; yes, very few, and strangers in it.
texts.psa.105.13: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
texts.psa.105.14: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yes, he reproved kings for their sakes;
texts.psa.105.15: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
texts.psa.105.16: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he broke the whole staff of bread.
texts.psa.105.17: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
texts.psa.105.18: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
texts.psa.105.19: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
texts.psa.105.20: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
texts.psa.105.21: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
texts.psa.105.22: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
texts.psa.105.23: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.24: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
texts.psa.105.25: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
texts.psa.105.26: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
texts.psa.105.27: They showed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
texts.psa.105.29: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
texts.psa.105.30: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
texts.psa.105.31: He spoke, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their borders.
texts.psa.105.32: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
texts.psa.105.33: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; and broke the trees of their borders.
texts.psa.105.34: He spoke, and the locusts came, and caterpillars, and that without number,
texts.psa.105.35: And ate up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
texts.psa.105.36: He smote also all the first-born in their land, the chief of all their strength.
texts.psa.105.37: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
texts.psa.105.38: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
texts.psa.105.39: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
texts.psa.105.40: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
texts.psa.105.41: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
texts.psa.105.42: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
texts.psa.105.43: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
texts.psa.105.44: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labor of the people;
texts.psa.105.45: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.106.1: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks to the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.106.2: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can show forth all his praise?
texts.psa.106.3: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
texts.psa.106.4: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor that thou bearest to thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
texts.psa.106.5: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thy inheritance.
texts.psa.106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
texts.psa.106.7: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
texts.psa.106.8: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
texts.psa.106.9: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
texts.psa.106.10: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
texts.psa.106.11: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
texts.psa.106.12: Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
texts.psa.106.13: They soon forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel:
texts.psa.106.14: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
texts.psa.106.15: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
texts.psa.106.16: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
texts.psa.106.17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
texts.psa.106.18: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
texts.psa.106.19: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped the molten image.
texts.psa.106.20: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
texts.psa.106.21: They forgot God their savior, who had done great things in Egypt;
texts.psa.106.22: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
texts.psa.106.23: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
texts.psa.106.24: Yes, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
texts.psa.106.25: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not to the voice of the LORD.
texts.psa.106.26: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
texts.psa.106.27: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
texts.psa.106.28: They joined themselves also to Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
texts.psa.106.29: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague broke in upon them.
texts.psa.106.30: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
texts.psa.106.31: And that was counted to him for righteousness to all generations for ever.
texts.psa.106.32: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
texts.psa.106.33: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.
texts.psa.106.34: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
texts.psa.106.35: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
texts.psa.106.36: And they served their idols: which were a snare to them.
texts.psa.106.37: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,
texts.psa.106.38: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
texts.psa.106.39: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went astray with their own inventions.
texts.psa.106.40: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
texts.psa.106.41: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
texts.psa.106.42: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
texts.psa.106.43: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel; and were brought low for their iniquity.
texts.psa.106.44: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
texts.psa.106.45: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
texts.psa.106.46: He made them also to be pitied by all those that carried them captives.
texts.psa.106.47: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks to thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
texts.psa.106.48: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.107.1: O give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.107.2: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
texts.psa.107.3: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
texts.psa.107.4: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
texts.psa.107.5: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
texts.psa.107.6: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.7: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.8: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.9: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
texts.psa.107.10: Such as sit in darkness and in the shades of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
texts.psa.107.11: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the Most High:
texts.psa.107.12: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; they fell down, and there was none to help.
texts.psa.107.13: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shades of death, and broke their bands asunder.
texts.psa.107.15: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.16: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron asunder.
texts.psa.107.17: Fools, because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
texts.psa.107.18: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; and they draw near to the gates of death.
texts.psa.107.19: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, he saveth them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.20: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
texts.psa.107.21: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.22: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
texts.psa.107.23: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business on great waters;
texts.psa.107.24: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
texts.psa.107.25: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up its waves.
texts.psa.107.26: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
texts.psa.107.27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
texts.psa.107.28: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
texts.psa.107.29: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves of the sea are still.
texts.psa.107.30: Then are they glad because they are quiet; so he bringeth them to their desired haven.
texts.psa.107.31: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
texts.psa.107.32: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
texts.psa.107.33: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the water-springs into dry ground;
texts.psa.107.34: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell in it.
texts.psa.107.35: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into water-springs.
texts.psa.107.36: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
texts.psa.107.37: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
texts.psa.107.38: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
texts.psa.107.39: Again, they are diminished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
texts.psa.107.40: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
texts.psa.107.41: Yet he setteth the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
texts.psa.107.42: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
texts.psa.107.43: Whoever is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the loving-kindness of the LORD.
texts.psa.108.1: A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
texts.psa.108.2: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
texts.psa.108.3: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises to thee among the nations.
texts.psa.108.4: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth to the clouds.
texts.psa.108.5: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
texts.psa.108.6: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
texts.psa.108.7: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
texts.psa.108.8: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Judah is my lawgiver;
texts.psa.108.9: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
texts.psa.108.10: Who will bring me into the strong city: who will lead me into Edom?
texts.psa.108.11: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our armies?
texts.psa.108.12: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
texts.psa.108.13: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he will tread down our enemies.
texts.psa.109.1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
texts.psa.109.2: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
texts.psa.109.3: They encompassed me also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
texts.psa.109.4: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself to prayer.
texts.psa.109.5: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
texts.psa.109.6: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
texts.psa.109.7: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
texts.psa.109.8: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
texts.psa.109.9: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
texts.psa.109.10: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
texts.psa.109.11: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let strangers spoil his labor.
texts.psa.109.12: Let there be none to extend mercy to him: neither let there be any to favor his fatherless children.
texts.psa.109.13: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
texts.psa.109.14: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
texts.psa.109.15: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
texts.psa.109.16: Because that he remembered not to show mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
texts.psa.109.17: As he loved cursing, so let it come to him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
texts.psa.109.18: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
texts.psa.109.19: Let it be to him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle with which he is girded continually.
texts.psa.109.20: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
texts.psa.109.21: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
texts.psa.109.22: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
texts.psa.109.23: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
texts.psa.109.24: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
texts.psa.109.25: I became also a reproach to them: when they looked upon me they shook their heads.
texts.psa.109.26: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
texts.psa.109.27: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
texts.psa.109.28: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
texts.psa.109.29: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
texts.psa.109.30: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
texts.psa.109.31: For he will stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
texts.psa.110.1: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thy enemies thy footstool.
texts.psa.110.2: The LORD will send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.
texts.psa.110.3: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness: from the womb of the morning, thou hast the dew of thy youth.
texts.psa.110.4: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedek.
texts.psa.110.5: The Lord at thy right hand will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
texts.psa.110.6: He will judge among the heathen, he will fill the places with the dead bodies; he will wound the heads over many countries.
texts.psa.110.7: He will drink of the brook in the way: therefore will he lift up the head.
texts.psa.111.1: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
texts.psa.111.2: The works of the LORD are great, sought out by all them that have pleasure in them.
texts.psa.111.3: His work is honorable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
texts.psa.111.4: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
texts.psa.111.5: He hath given food to them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
texts.psa.111.6: He hath shown his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
texts.psa.111.7: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
texts.psa.111.8: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
texts.psa.111.9: He sent redemption to his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
texts.psa.111.10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
texts.psa.112.1: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
texts.psa.112.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
texts.psa.112.3: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
texts.psa.112.4: To the upright there ariseth light in darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
texts.psa.112.5: A good man showeth favor, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
texts.psa.112.6: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
texts.psa.112.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
texts.psa.112.8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he seeth his desire upon his enemies.
texts.psa.112.9: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honor.
texts.psa.112.10: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
texts.psa.113.1: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
texts.psa.113.2: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
texts.psa.113.3: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.
texts.psa.113.4: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
texts.psa.113.5: Who is like to the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high.
texts.psa.113.6: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
texts.psa.113.7: He raiseth the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
texts.psa.113.8: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
texts.psa.113.9: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.114.1: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of a foreign language;
texts.psa.114.2: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
texts.psa.114.3: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
texts.psa.114.4: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
texts.psa.114.5: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
texts.psa.114.6: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
texts.psa.114.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
texts.psa.114.8: Who turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
texts.psa.115.1: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
texts.psa.115.2: Why should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
texts.psa.115.3: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatever he pleased.
texts.psa.115.4: Their idols are silver and gold; the work of men's hands.
texts.psa.115.5: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
texts.psa.115.6: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
texts.psa.115.7: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
texts.psa.115.8: They that make them are like them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
texts.psa.115.9: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.10: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.11: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.12: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
texts.psa.115.13: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
texts.psa.115.14: The LORD will increase you more and more, you and your children.
texts.psa.115.15: Ye are blessed of the LORD who made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.115.16: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
texts.psa.115.17: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
texts.psa.115.18: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for ever. Praise the LORD.
texts.psa.116.1: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
texts.psa.116.2: Because he hath inclined his ear to me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
texts.psa.116.3: The sorrows of death encompassed me, and the pains of hell came upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
texts.psa.116.4: Then I called upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
texts.psa.116.5: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yes, our God is merciful.
texts.psa.116.6: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
texts.psa.116.7: Return to thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
texts.psa.116.8: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
texts.psa.116.9: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
texts.psa.116.10: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
texts.psa.116.11: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
texts.psa.116.12: What shall I render to the LORD for all his benefits towards me?
texts.psa.116.13: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
texts.psa.116.14: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
texts.psa.116.15: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
texts.psa.116.16: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
texts.psa.116.17: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
texts.psa.116.18: I will pay my vows to the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
texts.psa.116.19: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.117.1: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
texts.psa.117.2: For his merciful kindness is great towards us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.118.1: O give thanks to the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.118.2: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.118.3: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.118.4: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.118.5: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
texts.psa.118.6: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do to me?
texts.psa.118.7: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
texts.psa.118.8: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
texts.psa.118.9: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
texts.psa.118.10: All nations encompassed me: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
texts.psa.118.11: They encompassed me; yes, they encompassed me: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
texts.psa.118.12: They encompassed me like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
texts.psa.118.13: Thou hast violently thrust at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
texts.psa.118.14: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
texts.psa.118.16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
texts.psa.118.17: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
texts.psa.118.18: The LORD hath chastened me severely: but he hath not given me over to death.
texts.psa.118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter them, and I will praise the LORD:
texts.psa.118.20: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
texts.psa.118.21: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.22: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
texts.psa.118.23: This is the LORD'S doing; it is wonderful in our eyes.
texts.psa.118.24: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
texts.psa.118.25: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
texts.psa.118.26: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
texts.psa.118.27: God is the LORD, who hath shown us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
texts.psa.118.28: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
texts.psa.118.29: O give thanks to the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.119.1: ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
texts.psa.119.2: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
texts.psa.119.3: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
texts.psa.119.4: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
texts.psa.119.5: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
texts.psa.119.6: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect to all thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.7: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.8: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
texts.psa.119.9: BETH. Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed to it, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.10: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.11: Thy word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against thee.
texts.psa.119.12: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.13: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.14: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
texts.psa.119.15: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect to thy ways.
texts.psa.119.16: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
texts.psa.119.17: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
