texts.psa.119.18: Open thou my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
texts.psa.119.19: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
texts.psa.119.20: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath to thy judgments at all times.
texts.psa.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, who do err from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.22: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.23: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.24: Thy testimonies also are my delight, and my counselors.
texts.psa.119.25: DALETH. My soul cleaveth to the dust: revive thou me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.26: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.27: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
texts.psa.119.28: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.29: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
texts.psa.119.30: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
texts.psa.119.31: I have adhered to thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
texts.psa.119.32: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
texts.psa.119.33: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it to the end.
texts.psa.119.34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yes, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
texts.psa.119.35: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for in that do I delight.
texts.psa.119.36: Incline my heart to thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
texts.psa.119.37: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and revive thou me in thy way.
texts.psa.119.38: Establish thy word to thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
texts.psa.119.39: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
texts.psa.119.40: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: revive me in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.41: VAU. Let thy mercies come also to me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.42: So shall I have with which to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
texts.psa.119.43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.44: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
texts.psa.119.45: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.46: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
texts.psa.119.47: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
texts.psa.119.48: My hands also will I lift to thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.49: ZAIN. Remember the word to thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
texts.psa.119.50: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath revived me.
texts.psa.119.51: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet I have not declined from thy law.
texts.psa.119.52: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
texts.psa.119.53: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
texts.psa.119.54: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
texts.psa.119.55: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
texts.psa.119.56: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.57: CHETH. Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
texts.psa.119.58: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: be merciful to me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.59: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.60: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.61: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
texts.psa.119.62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to thee, because of thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.63: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.64: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.65: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.67: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
texts.psa.119.68: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.69: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
texts.psa.119.70: Their heart is as gross as fat; but I delight in thy law.
texts.psa.119.71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.72: The law of thy mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.
texts.psa.119.73: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.74: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
texts.psa.119.75: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
texts.psa.119.76: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word to thy servant.
texts.psa.119.77: Let thy tender mercies come to me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
texts.psa.119.78: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.79: Let those that fear thee turn to me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.80: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I may not be ashamed.
texts.psa.119.81: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
texts.psa.119.82: My eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
texts.psa.119.83: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet I do not forget thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.84: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
texts.psa.119.85: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not according to thy law.
texts.psa.119.86: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
texts.psa.119.87: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.88: Revive me after thy loving-kindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.89: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
texts.psa.119.90: Thy faithfulness is to all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
texts.psa.119.91: They continue this day according to thy ordinances: for all are thy servants.
texts.psa.119.92: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in my affliction.
texts.psa.119.93: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast revived me.
texts.psa.119.94: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.95: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.96: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
texts.psa.119.97: MEM. O how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
texts.psa.119.98: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.
texts.psa.119.99: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
texts.psa.119.100: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.101: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
texts.psa.119.102: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
texts.psa.119.103: How sweet are thy words to my taste! yes, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
texts.psa.119.104: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
texts.psa.119.105: NUN. Thy word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path.
texts.psa.119.106: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.107: I am afflicted very much: revive me, O LORD, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.108: Accept, I beseech thee, the free-will-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.109: My soul is continually in my hand: yet I do not forget thy law.
texts.psa.119.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.111: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
texts.psa.119.112: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes always, even to the end.
texts.psa.119.113: SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
texts.psa.119.114: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
texts.psa.119.115: Depart from me, ye evil-doers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
texts.psa.119.116: Uphold me according to thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
texts.psa.119.117: Support me, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect to thy statutes continually.
texts.psa.119.118: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
texts.psa.119.119: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.120: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.121: AIN. I have done judgment and justice; leave me not to my oppressors.
texts.psa.119.122: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
texts.psa.119.123: My eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.124: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.125: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.126: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
texts.psa.119.127: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yes, above fine gold.
texts.psa.119.128: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
texts.psa.119.129: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
texts.psa.119.130: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding to the simple.
texts.psa.119.131: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.132: Look thou upon me, and be merciful to me, as thou usest to do to those that love thy name.
texts.psa.119.133: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
texts.psa.119.134: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.135: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: and teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.136: Rivers of waters run down my eyes, because they keep not thy law.
texts.psa.119.137: TSADDI. Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.138: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
texts.psa.119.139: My zeal hath consumed me; because my enemies have forgotten thy words.
texts.psa.119.140: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
texts.psa.119.141: I am small and despised: yet I do not forget thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.142: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
texts.psa.119.143: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
texts.psa.119.144: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
texts.psa.119.145: KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.146: I cried to thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.147: I came before the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
texts.psa.119.148: My eyes anticipated the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
texts.psa.119.149: Hear my voice, according to thy loving-kindness: O LORD, revive me according to thy judgment.
texts.psa.119.150: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
texts.psa.119.151: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
texts.psa.119.152: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
texts.psa.119.153: RESH. Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
texts.psa.119.154: Plead my cause, and deliver me: revive me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.155: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.156: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: revive me according to thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.157: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet I do not decline from thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.158: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
texts.psa.119.159: Consider how I love thy precepts: revive me, O LORD, according to thy loving-kindness.
texts.psa.119.160: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
texts.psa.119.161: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
texts.psa.119.162: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
texts.psa.119.163: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
texts.psa.119.164: Seven times a day do I praise thee, because of thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.165: Great peace have they who love thy law: and nothing shall cause them to stumble.
texts.psa.119.166: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and performed thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.167: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
texts.psa.119.168: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
texts.psa.119.169: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.170: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.171: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.172: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
texts.psa.119.173: Let thy hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.174: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
texts.psa.119.175: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
texts.psa.119.176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
texts.psa.120.1: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and he heard me.
texts.psa.120.2: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
texts.psa.120.3: What shall be given to thee? or what shall be done to thee, thou false tongue?
texts.psa.120.4: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
texts.psa.120.5: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
texts.psa.120.6: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
texts.psa.120.7: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
texts.psa.121.1: A Song of degrees. I will lift up my eyes to the hills, from whence cometh my help.
texts.psa.121.2: My help cometh from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.121.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
texts.psa.121.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
texts.psa.121.5: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
texts.psa.121.6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
texts.psa.121.7: The LORD will preserve thee from all evil: he will preserve thy soul.
texts.psa.121.8: The LORD will preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for ever.
texts.psa.122.1: A Song of degrees of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
texts.psa.122.2: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
texts.psa.122.3: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together:
texts.psa.122.4: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to the testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
texts.psa.122.5: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
texts.psa.122.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
texts.psa.122.7: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
texts.psa.122.8: For my brethren and companions' sake, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
texts.psa.122.9: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
texts.psa.123.1: A Song of degrees. To thee I raise my eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
texts.psa.123.2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until he shall have mercy upon us.
texts.psa.123.3: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us; for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
texts.psa.123.4: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
texts.psa.124.1: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
texts.psa.124.2: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
texts.psa.124.3: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
texts.psa.124.4: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
texts.psa.124.5: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
texts.psa.124.6: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
texts.psa.124.7: Our soul hath escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
texts.psa.124.8: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.125.1: A Song of degrees. They that trust in the LORD, shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
texts.psa.125.2: As the mountains are round Jerusalem, so the LORD is around his people from henceforth even for ever.
texts.psa.125.3: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to iniquity.
texts.psa.125.4: Do good, O LORD, to those that are good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
texts.psa.125.5: As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
texts.psa.126.1: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
texts.psa.126.2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
texts.psa.126.3: The LORD hath done great things for us; of which we are glad.
texts.psa.126.4: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
texts.psa.126.5: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
texts.psa.126.6: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless return with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
texts.psa.127.1: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Except the LORD shall build the house, they labor in vain that build it: except the LORD shall keep the city, the watchman waketh in vain.
texts.psa.127.2: It is vain for you to rise early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
texts.psa.127.3: Lo, children are a heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
texts.psa.127.4: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man: so are children of the youth.
texts.psa.127.5: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
texts.psa.128.1: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
texts.psa.128.2: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
texts.psa.128.3: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thy house: thy children like olive plants around thy table.
texts.psa.128.4: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
texts.psa.128.5: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
texts.psa.128.6: Yes, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
texts.psa.129.1: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
texts.psa.129.2: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
texts.psa.129.3: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
texts.psa.129.4: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
texts.psa.129.5: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
texts.psa.129.6: Let them be as the grass upon the house-tops, which withereth before it groweth up:
texts.psa.129.7: With which the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom.
texts.psa.129.8: Neither do they who go by, say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
texts.psa.130.1: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried to thee, O LORD.
texts.psa.130.2: Lord, hear my voice: let thy ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.130.3: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
texts.psa.130.4: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
texts.psa.130.5: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
texts.psa.130.6: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
texts.psa.130.7: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
texts.psa.130.8: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
texts.psa.131.1: A Song of degrees of David. LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
texts.psa.131.2: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself as a child that is weaned by his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
texts.psa.131.3: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
texts.psa.132.1: A Song of degrees. LORD, remember David and all his afflictions;
texts.psa.132.2: How he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the mighty God of Jacob;
texts.psa.132.3: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
texts.psa.132.4: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
texts.psa.132.5: Until I find a place for the LORD, a habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
texts.psa.132.6: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
texts.psa.132.7: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
texts.psa.132.8: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
texts.psa.132.9: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
texts.psa.132.10: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thy anointed.
texts.psa.132.11: The LORD hath sworn in truth to David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
texts.psa.132.12: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them; their children also shall sit upon thy throne for ever.
texts.psa.132.13: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
texts.psa.132.14: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
texts.psa.132.15: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
texts.psa.132.16: I will also clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
texts.psa.132.17: There will I make the horn of David to bud, I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
texts.psa.132.18: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
texts.psa.133.1: A Song of degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
texts.psa.133.2: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garment;
texts.psa.133.3: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for ever.
texts.psa.134.1: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, who by night stand in the house of the LORD.
texts.psa.134.2: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
texts.psa.134.3: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
texts.psa.135.1: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
texts.psa.135.2: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
texts.psa.135.3: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good; sing praises to his name; for it is pleasant.
texts.psa.135.4: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob to himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
texts.psa.135.5: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
texts.psa.135.6: Whatever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
texts.psa.135.7: He causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
texts.psa.135.8: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, both of man and beast.
texts.psa.135.9: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
texts.psa.135.10: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
texts.psa.135.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
texts.psa.135.12: And gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel his people.
texts.psa.135.13: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
texts.psa.135.14: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent concerning his servants.
texts.psa.135.15: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
texts.psa.135.16: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not.
texts.psa.135.17: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
texts.psa.135.18: They that make them are like them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
texts.psa.135.19: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
texts.psa.135.20: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
texts.psa.135.21: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.136.1: O give thanks to the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.2: O give thanks to the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.3: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.4: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.5: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.6: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.7: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.8: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.9: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.10: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.11: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.12: With a strong hand, and with an out-stretched arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.13: To him who divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.14: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.15: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.16: To him who led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.17: To him who smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.18: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.19: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.20: And Og king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.21: And gave their land for a heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.22: Even a heritage to Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.23: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
texts.psa.136.24: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.25: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.136.26: O give thanks to the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
texts.psa.137.1: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
texts.psa.137.2: We hung our harps upon the willows in the midst of it.
texts.psa.137.3: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
texts.psa.137.4: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a foreign land?
texts.psa.137.5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her skill.
texts.psa.137.6: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
texts.psa.137.7: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Raze it, raze it, even to its foundation.
texts.psa.137.8: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
texts.psa.137.9: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
texts.psa.138.1: A Psalm of David. I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise to thee.
texts.psa.138.2: I will worship towards thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
texts.psa.138.3: In the day when I cried thou didst answer me, and strengthen me with strength in my soul.
texts.psa.138.4: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
texts.psa.138.5: Yes, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
texts.psa.138.6: Though the LORD is high, yet hath he respect to the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
texts.psa.138.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies, and thy right hand will save me.
texts.psa.138.8: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works thy own hands.
texts.psa.139.1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
texts.psa.139.2: Thou knowest my down-sitting and my up rising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
texts.psa.139.3: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
texts.psa.139.4: For there is not a word on my tongue, but lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
texts.psa.139.5: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thy hand upon me.
texts.psa.139.6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain to it.
texts.psa.139.7: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
texts.psa.139.8: If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
texts.psa.139.9: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
texts.psa.139.10: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
texts.psa.139.11: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
texts.psa.139.12: Yes, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
texts.psa.139.13: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
texts.psa.139.14: I will praise thee: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: wonderful are thy works; and that my soul well knoweth.
texts.psa.139.15: My substance was not hid from thee when I was made in secret, and curiously formed in the lowest parts of the earth.
texts.psa.139.16: Thy eyes saw my substance, yet being imperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
texts.psa.139.17: How precious also are thy thoughts to me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
texts.psa.139.18: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
texts.psa.139.19: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
texts.psa.139.20: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thy enemies take thy name in vain.
texts.psa.139.21: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
texts.psa.139.22: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them my enemies.
texts.psa.139.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart; try me, and know my thoughts:
texts.psa.139.24: And see if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
texts.psa.140.1: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
texts.psa.140.2: Who imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they assembled for war.
texts.psa.140.3: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adder's poison is under their lips. Selah.
texts.psa.140.4: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
texts.psa.140.5: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the way side: they have set gins for me. Selah.
texts.psa.140.6: I said to the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
texts.psa.140.7: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
texts.psa.140.8: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
texts.psa.140.9: As for the head of those that encompass me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
texts.psa.140.10: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not again.
texts.psa.140.11: Let not an evil speaker be established on the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
texts.psa.140.12: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
texts.psa.140.13: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
texts.psa.141.1: A Psalm of David. LORD, I cry to thee: make haste to me; give ear to my voice, when I cry to thee.
texts.psa.141.2: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
texts.psa.141.3: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
texts.psa.141.4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practice wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
texts.psa.141.5: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
texts.psa.141.6: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
texts.psa.141.7: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
texts.psa.141.8: But my eyes are to thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
texts.psa.141.9: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
texts.psa.141.10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst I escape.
texts.psa.142.1: Maschil of David; a prayer when he was in the cave. I cried to the LORD with my voice; with my voice to the LORD I made my supplication.
texts.psa.142.2: I poured out my complaint before him; I showed before him my trouble.
texts.psa.142.3: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way in which I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
texts.psa.142.4: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
texts.psa.142.5: I cried to thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
texts.psa.142.6: Attend to my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
texts.psa.142.7: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall encompass me; for thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
texts.psa.143.1: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.143.2: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
texts.psa.143.3: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
texts.psa.143.4: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
texts.psa.143.5: I remember the days of old, I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
texts.psa.143.6: I stretch forth my hands to thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
texts.psa.143.7: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like them that go down into the pit.
texts.psa.143.8: Cause me to hear thy loving-kindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way in which I should walk; for I lift up my soul to thee.
texts.psa.143.9: Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies: I flee to thee to hide me.
texts.psa.143.10: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
texts.psa.143.11: Revive me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
texts.psa.143.12: And of thy mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
texts.psa.144.1: A Psalm of David. Blessed be the LORD my strength, who teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight;
texts.psa.144.2: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
texts.psa.144.3: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
texts.psa.144.4: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
texts.psa.144.5: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
texts.psa.144.6: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot thy arrows, and destroy them.
texts.psa.144.7: Send thy hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
texts.psa.144.8: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
texts.psa.144.9: I will sing a new song to thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises to thee.
texts.psa.144.10: It is he that giveth salvation to kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
texts.psa.144.11: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
texts.psa.144.12: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
texts.psa.144.13: That our granaries may be full, affording all manner of store; that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
texts.psa.144.14: That our oxen may be strong to labor; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
texts.psa.144.15: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yes, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
texts.psa.145.1: David's Psalm of praise. I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.145.2: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.145.3: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
texts.psa.145.4: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
texts.psa.145.5: I will speak of the glorious honor of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
texts.psa.145.6: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
texts.psa.145.7: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
texts.psa.145.8: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
texts.psa.145.9: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
texts.psa.145.10: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
texts.psa.145.11: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
texts.psa.145.12: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
texts.psa.145.13: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
texts.psa.145.14: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
texts.psa.145.15: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their food in due season.
texts.psa.145.16: Thou openest thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living creature.
texts.psa.145.17: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
texts.psa.145.18: The LORD is nigh to all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
texts.psa.145.19: He will fulfill the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
texts.psa.145.20: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
texts.psa.145.21: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.146.1: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
texts.psa.146.2: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises to my God while I have any being.
texts.psa.146.3: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
texts.psa.146.4: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
texts.psa.146.5: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
texts.psa.146.6: Who made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that is in them: who keepeth truth for ever:
texts.psa.146.7: Who executeth judgment for the oppressed: who giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
texts.psa.146.8: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
texts.psa.146.9: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
texts.psa.146.10: The LORD will reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.147.1: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
texts.psa.147.2: The LORD buildeth up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
texts.psa.147.3: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
texts.psa.147.4: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
texts.psa.147.5: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
texts.psa.147.6: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
texts.psa.147.7: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp to our God:
texts.psa.147.8: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
texts.psa.147.9: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
texts.psa.147.10: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
texts.psa.147.11: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
texts.psa.147.12: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
texts.psa.147.13: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
texts.psa.147.14: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
texts.psa.147.15: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
texts.psa.147.16: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
texts.psa.147.17: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
texts.psa.147.18: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
texts.psa.147.19: He showeth his word to Jacob, his statutes and his judgments to Israel.
texts.psa.147.20: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.148.1: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the hights.
texts.psa.148.2: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
texts.psa.148.3: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
texts.psa.148.4: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens.
texts.psa.148.5: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
texts.psa.148.6: He hath also established them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
texts.psa.148.7: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
texts.psa.148.8: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapors; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
texts.psa.148.9: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
texts.psa.148.10: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping animals, and flying fowl:
texts.psa.148.11: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
texts.psa.148.12: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
texts.psa.148.13: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
texts.psa.148.14: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.149.1: Praise ye the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
texts.psa.149.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
texts.psa.149.3: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises to him with the timbrel and harp:
texts.psa.149.4: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
texts.psa.149.5: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
texts.psa.149.6: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
texts.psa.149.7: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
texts.psa.149.8: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
texts.psa.149.9: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honor have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
texts.psa.150.1: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
texts.psa.150.2: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
texts.psa.150.3: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
texts.psa.150.4: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
texts.psa.150.5: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
texts.psa.150.6: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

texts.psa.1.1: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, and standeth not in the way of sinners, and sitteth not in the seat of scorners;
texts.psa.1.2: But his delight is in Jehovah's law, and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
texts.psa.1.3: And he [is] as a tree planted by brooks of water, which giveth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf fadeth not; and all that he doeth prospereth.
texts.psa.1.4: The wicked are not so; but are as the chaff which the wind driveth away.
texts.psa.1.5: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
texts.psa.1.6: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
texts.psa.2.1: Why are the nations in tumultuous agitation, and [why] do the peoples meditate a vain thing?
texts.psa.2.2: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the princes plot together, against Jehovah and against his anointed:
texts.psa.2.3: Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us!
texts.psa.2.4: He that dwelleth in the heavens shall laugh, the Lord shall have them in derision.
texts.psa.2.5: Then will he speak to them in his anger, and in his fierce displeasure will he terrify them:
texts.psa.2.6: And *I* have anointed my king upon Zion, the hill of my holiness.
texts.psa.2.7: I will declare the decree: Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; *I* this day have begotten thee.
texts.psa.2.8: Ask of me, and I will give thee nations for an inheritance, and for thy possession the ends of the earth:
texts.psa.2.9: Thou shalt break them with a sceptre of iron, as a potter's vessel thou shalt dash them in pieces.
texts.psa.2.10: And now, O kings, be ye wise, be admonished, ye judges of the earth.
texts.psa.2.11: Serve Jehovah with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
texts.psa.2.12: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, though his anger burn but a little. Blessed are all who have their trust in him.
texts.psa.3.1: {A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.} Jehovah, how many are they that trouble me, many they that rise up against me!
texts.psa.3.2: Many say of my soul, There is no salvation for him in God. Selah.
texts.psa.3.3: But thou, Jehovah, art a shield about me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
texts.psa.3.4: With my voice will I call to Jehovah, and he will answer me from the hill of his holiness. Selah.
texts.psa.3.5: I laid me down and slept; I awaked, for Jehovah sustaineth me.
texts.psa.3.6: I will not fear for myriads of the people that have set themselves against me round about.
texts.psa.3.7: Arise, Jehovah; save me, my God! For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheekbone, thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
texts.psa.3.8: Salvation is of Jehovah; thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
texts.psa.4.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.} When I call, answer me, O God of my righteousness: in pressure thou hast enlarged me; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.
texts.psa.4.2: Ye sons of men, till when is my glory [to be put] to shame? [How long] will ye love vanity, will ye seek after a lie? Selah.
texts.psa.4.3: But know that Jehovah hath set apart the pious [man] for himself: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.
texts.psa.4.4: Be moved with anger, and sin not; meditate in your own hearts upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
texts.psa.4.5: Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and confide in Jehovah.
texts.psa.4.6: Many say, Who shall cause us to see good? Lift up upon us the light of thy countenance, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.4.7: Thou hast put joy in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their new wine was in abundance.
texts.psa.4.8: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for thou, Jehovah, alone makest me to dwell in safety.
texts.psa.5.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.} Give ear to my words, O Jehovah; consider my meditation.
texts.psa.5.2: Hearken unto the voice of my crying, my king and my God; for to thee will I pray.
texts.psa.5.3: Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; in the morning will I address myself to thee, and will look up.
texts.psa.5.4: For thou art not a ùGod that hath pleasure in wickedness; evil shall not sojourn with thee.
texts.psa.5.5: Insolent fools shall not stand before thine eyes; thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
texts.psa.5.6: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth a man of blood and deceit.
texts.psa.5.7: But as for me, in the greatness of thy loving-kindness will I enter thy house; I will bow down toward the temple of thy holiness in thy fear.
texts.psa.5.8: Lead me, Jehovah, in thy righteousness, because of my foes; make thy way plain before me.
texts.psa.5.9: For there is no certainty in their mouth; their inward part is perversion, their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
texts.psa.5.10: Bring guilt upon them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels: drive them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against thee.
texts.psa.5.11: And all that trust in thee shall rejoice: for ever shall they shout joyously, and thou wilt protect them; and they that love thy name shall exult in thee.
texts.psa.5.12: For thou, Jehovah, wilt bless the righteous [man]; with favour wilt thou surround him as [with] a shield.
texts.psa.6.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments, upon Sheminith. A Psalm of David.} Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, and chasten me not in thy hot displeasure.
texts.psa.6.2: Be gracious unto me, Jehovah, for I am withered; Jehovah, heal me, for my bones tremble.
texts.psa.6.3: And my soul trembleth exceedingly: and thou, Jehovah, till how long?
texts.psa.6.4: Return, Jehovah, free my soul; save me for thy loving-kindness' sake.
texts.psa.6.5: For in death there is no remembrance of thee; in Sheol who shall give thanks unto thee?
texts.psa.6.6: I am wearied with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I dissolve my couch with my tears.
texts.psa.6.7: Mine eye wasteth away through grief; it hath grown old because of all mine oppressors.
texts.psa.6.8: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.
texts.psa.6.9: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah receiveth my prayer.
texts.psa.6.10: All mine enemies shall be ashamed and tremble exceedingly; they will turn, they will be ashamed suddenly.
texts.psa.7.1: {Shiggaion of David, which he sang to Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush the Benjaminite.} Jehovah my God, in thee have I trusted: save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me;
texts.psa.7.2: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, crushing it while there is no deliverer.
texts.psa.7.3: Jehovah my God, if I have done this, if there be iniquity in my hands;
texts.psa.7.4: If I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed I have freed him that without cause oppressed me;)
texts.psa.7.5: Let the enemy pursue after my soul, and take [it], and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
texts.psa.7.6: Arise, Jehovah, in thine anger; lift thyself up against the raging of mine oppressors, and awake for me: thou hast commanded judgment.
texts.psa.7.7: And the assembly of the peoples shall encompass thee; and for their sakes return thou on high.
texts.psa.7.8: Jehovah shall minister judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity which is in me.
texts.psa.7.9: Oh let the wrong of the wicked come to an end, and establish thou the righteous [man]; even thou that triest the hearts and reins, the righteous God.
texts.psa.7.10: My shield is with God, who saveth the upright in heart.
texts.psa.7.11: God is a righteous judge, and a ùGod who is indignant all the day.
texts.psa.7.12: If one turn not, he will sharpen his sword; he hath bent his bow and made it ready,
texts.psa.7.13: And he hath prepared for him instruments of death; his arrows hath he made burning.
texts.psa.7.14: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood:
texts.psa.7.15: He digged a pit, and hollowed it out, and is fallen into the hole that he made.
texts.psa.7.16: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
texts.psa.7.17: I will praise Jehovah according to his righteousness, and will sing forth the name of Jehovah the Most High.
texts.psa.8.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David.} Jehovah our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy majesty above the heavens.
texts.psa.8.2: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established praise because of thine adversaries, to still the enemy and the avenger.
texts.psa.8.3: When I see thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and stars, which thou hast established;
texts.psa.8.4: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
texts.psa.8.5: Thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and splendour.
texts.psa.8.6: Thou hast made him to rule over the works of thy hands; thou hast put everything under his feet:
texts.psa.8.7: Sheep and oxen, all of them, and also the beasts of the field;
texts.psa.8.8: The fowl of the heavens, and the fishes of the sea, [whatever] passeth through the paths of the seas.
texts.psa.8.9: Jehovah our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
texts.psa.9.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.} I will praise Jehovah with my whole heart; I will recount all thy marvellous works.
texts.psa.9.2: I will be glad and rejoice in thee; I will sing forth thy name, O Most High.
texts.psa.9.3: When mine enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished at thy presence:
texts.psa.9.4: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause. Thou sittest on the throne, judging righteously.
texts.psa.9.5: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.9.6: O enemy! destructions are ended for ever. -- Thou hast also destroyed cities, even the remembrance of them hath perished.
texts.psa.9.7: But Jehovah sitteth for ever; he hath ordained his throne for judgment.
texts.psa.9.8: And it is he that will judge the world with righteousness; he shall execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.
texts.psa.9.9: And Jehovah will be a refuge to the oppressed one, a refuge in times of distress.
texts.psa.9.10: And they that know thy name will confide in thee; for thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
texts.psa.9.11: Sing psalms to Jehovah who dwelleth in Zion; tell among the peoples his doings.
texts.psa.9.12: For when he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them; the cry of the afflicted ones hath he not forgotten.
texts.psa.9.13: Be gracious unto me, O Jehovah; consider mine affliction from them that hate me, lifting me up from the gates of death:
texts.psa.9.14: That I may declare all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will be joyful in thy salvation.
texts.psa.9.15: The nations are sunk down in the pit [that] they made; in the net that they hid is their own foot taken.
texts.psa.9.16: Jehovah is known [by] the judgment he hath executed: the wicked is ensnared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
texts.psa.9.17: The wicked shall be turned into Sheol, all the nations that forget God.
texts.psa.9.18: For the needy one shall not be forgotten alway; the hope of the meek shall not perish for ever.
texts.psa.9.19: Arise, Jehovah; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.
texts.psa.9.20: Put them in fear, Jehovah: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
texts.psa.10.1: Why, Jehovah, standest thou afar off? [Why] hidest thou thyself in times of distress?
texts.psa.10.2: The wicked, in his pride, doth hotly pursue the afflicted. They shall be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
texts.psa.10.3: For the wicked boasteth of his soul's desire, and he blesseth the covetous; he contemneth Jehovah.
texts.psa.10.4: The wicked [saith], in the haughtiness of his countenance, He doth not search out: all his thoughts are, There is no God!
texts.psa.10.5: His ways always succeed; thy judgments are far above out of his sight; [as for] all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
texts.psa.10.6: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; from generation to generation I shall be in no adversity.
texts.psa.10.7: His mouth is full of cursing, and deceit, and oppression; under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
texts.psa.10.8: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; in the secret places doth he slay the innocent: his eyes watch for the wretched.
texts.psa.10.9: He lieth in wait secretly, like a lion in his thicket; he lieth in wait to catch the afflicted: he doth catch the afflicted, drawing him into his net.
texts.psa.10.10: He croucheth, he boweth down, that the wretched may fall by his strong ones.
texts.psa.10.11: He saith in his heart, ùGod hath forgotten, he hideth his face, he will never see [it].
texts.psa.10.12: Arise, Jehovah; O ùGod, lift up thy hand: forget not the afflicted.
texts.psa.10.13: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it].
texts.psa.10.14: Thou hast seen [it], for thou thyself beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite by thy hand. The wretched committeth himself unto thee; thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
texts.psa.10.15: Break thou the arm of the wicked, and as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness [till] thou find none.
texts.psa.10.16: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: the nations have perished out of his land.
texts.psa.10.17: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek, thou hast established their heart: thou causest thine ear to hear,
texts.psa.10.18: To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed one, that the man of the earth may terrify no more.
texts.psa.11.1: {To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David.} In Jehovah have I put my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain?
texts.psa.11.2: For behold, the wicked bend the bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may in darkness shoot at the upright in heart.
texts.psa.11.3: If the foundations be destroyed, what shall the righteous do?
texts.psa.11.4: Jehovah [is] in the temple of his holiness; Jehovah, -- his throne is in the heavens: his eyes behold, his eyelids try the children of men.
texts.psa.11.5: Jehovah trieth the righteous one; but the wicked, and him that loveth violence, his soul hateth.
texts.psa.11.6: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone; and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
texts.psa.11.7: For righteous is Jehovah; he loveth righteousness, his countenance doth behold the upright.
texts.psa.12.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Sheminith. A Psalm of David.} Save, Jehovah, for the godly man is gone; for the faithful have failed from among the children of men.
texts.psa.12.2: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour: [with] flattering lip, with a double heart, do they speak.
texts.psa.12.3: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaketh proud things,
texts.psa.12.4: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail, our lips are our own: who [is] lord over us?
texts.psa.12.5: Because of the oppression of the afflicted, because of the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith Jehovah, I will set [him] in safety, at whom they puff.
texts.psa.12.6: The words of Jehovah are pure words, silver tried in the furnace of earth, purified seven times.
texts.psa.12.7: Thou, Jehovah, wilt keep them, thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
texts.psa.12.8: The wicked walk about on every side, when vileness is exalted among the children of men.
texts.psa.13.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} How long, Jehovah, wilt thou forget me for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
texts.psa.13.2: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, with sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
texts.psa.13.3: Consider, answer me, O Jehovah my God! lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;
texts.psa.13.4: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him! [lest] mine adversaries be joyful when I am moved.
texts.psa.13.5: As for me, I have confided in thy loving-kindness; my heart shall be joyful in thy salvation.
texts.psa.13.6: I will sing unto Jehovah, for he hath dealt bountifully with me.
texts.psa.14.1: {To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David.} The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They have corrupted themselves, they have done abominable works: there is none that doeth good.
texts.psa.14.2: Jehovah looked down from the heavens upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
texts.psa.14.3: They have all gone aside, they are together become corrupt: there is none that doeth good, not even one.
texts.psa.14.4: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, eating up my people [as] they eat bread? They call not upon Jehovah.
texts.psa.14.5: There were they in great fear; for God is in the generation of the righteous.
texts.psa.14.6: Ye have shamed the counsel of the afflicted, because Jehovah [was] his refuge.
texts.psa.14.7: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah turneth again the captivity of his people, Jacob shall be glad, Israel shall rejoice.
texts.psa.15.1: {A Psalm of David.} Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tent? who shall dwell in the hill of thy holiness?
texts.psa.15.2: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth from his heart.
texts.psa.15.3: [He that] slandereth not with his tongue, doeth not evil to his companion, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour;
texts.psa.15.4: In whose eyes the depraved person is contemned, and who honoureth them that fear Jehovah; who, if he have sworn to his own hurt, changeth it not;
texts.psa.15.5: [He that] putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these [things] shall never be moved.
texts.psa.16.1: {Michtam of David.} Preserve me, O ùGod: for I trust in thee.
texts.psa.16.2: Thou [my soul] hast said to Jehovah, Thou art the Lord: my goodness [extendeth] not to thee; --
texts.psa.16.3: To the saints that are on the earth, and to the excellent [thou hast said], In them is all my delight.
texts.psa.16.4: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another: their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, and I will not take up their names into my lips.
texts.psa.16.5: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
texts.psa.16.6: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
texts.psa.16.7: I will bless Jehovah, who giveth me counsel; even in the nights my reins instruct me.
texts.psa.16.8: I have set Jehovah continually before me; because [he is] at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
texts.psa.16.9: Therefore my heart rejoiceth, and my glory exulteth; my flesh moreover shall dwell in hope.
texts.psa.16.10: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol, neither wilt thou allow thy Holy One to see corruption.
texts.psa.16.11: Thou wilt make known to me the path of life: thy countenance is fulness of joy; at thy right hand are pleasures for evermore.
texts.psa.17.1: {A Prayer of David.} Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; give ear unto my prayer, which is not out of feigned lips.
texts.psa.17.2: Let my judgment come forth from thy presence, let thine eyes regard equity.
texts.psa.17.3: Thou hast proved my heart, thou hast visited me by night; thou hast tried me, thou hast found nothing: my thought goeth not beyond my word.
texts.psa.17.4: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept from the paths of the violent [man].
texts.psa.17.5: When thou holdest my goings in thy paths, my footsteps slip not.
texts.psa.17.6: I have called upon thee, for thou answerest me, O ùGod. Incline thine ear unto me, hear my speech.
texts.psa.17.7: Shew wondrously thy loving-kindnesses, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that trust [in thee] from those that rise up [against them].
texts.psa.17.8: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
texts.psa.17.9: From the wicked that destroy me, my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
texts.psa.17.10: They are enclosed in their own fat; with their mouth they speak proudly.
texts.psa.17.11: They have now encompassed us in our steps; their eyes have they set, bowing down to the earth.
texts.psa.17.12: He is like a lion that is greedy of its prey, and as a young lion lurking in secret places.
texts.psa.17.13: Arise, Jehovah, anticipate him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, thy sword;
texts.psa.17.14: From men [who are] thy hand, O Jehovah, from men of this age: their portion is in [this] life, and their belly thou fillest with thy hid [treasure]; they have their fill of sons, and leave the rest of their [substance] to their children.
texts.psa.17.15: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
texts.psa.18.1: {To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David, the servant of Jehovah, who spoke to Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies and out of the hand of Saul. And he said,} I will love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.
texts.psa.18.2: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my ùGod, my rock, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
texts.psa.18.3: I will call upon Jehovah, who is to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
texts.psa.18.4: The bands of death encompassed me, and torrents of Belial made me afraid.
texts.psa.18.5: The bands of Sheol surrounded me, the cords of death encountered me.
texts.psa.18.6: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, and I cried out to my God; he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, into his ears.
texts.psa.18.7: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled and shook, because he was wroth.
texts.psa.18.8: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals burned forth from it.
texts.psa.18.9: And he bowed the heavens, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
texts.psa.18.10: And he rode upon a cherub and did fly; yea, he flew fast upon the wings of the wind.
texts.psa.18.11: He made darkness his secret place, his tent round about him: darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
texts.psa.18.12: From the brightness before him his thick clouds passed forth: hail and coals of fire.
texts.psa.18.13: And Jehovah thundered in the heavens, and the Most High uttered his voice: hail and coals of fire.
texts.psa.18.14: And he sent his arrows, and scattered [mine enemies]; and he shot forth lightnings, and discomfited them.
texts.psa.18.15: And the beds of the waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at thy rebuke, Jehovah, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
texts.psa.18.16: He reached forth from above, he took me, he drew me out of great waters:
texts.psa.18.17: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me; for they were mightier than I.
texts.psa.18.18: They encountered me in the day of my calamity, but Jehovah was my stay.
texts.psa.18.19: And he brought me forth into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
texts.psa.18.20: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
texts.psa.18.21: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
texts.psa.18.22: For all his ordinances were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me;
texts.psa.18.23: And I was upright with him, and kept myself from mine iniquity.
texts.psa.18.24: And Jehovah hath recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
texts.psa.18.25: With the gracious thou dost shew thyself gracious; with the upright man thou dost shew thyself upright;
texts.psa.18.26: With the pure thou dost shew thyself pure; and with the perverse thou dost shew thyself contrary.
texts.psa.18.27: For it is thou that savest the afflicted people; but the haughty eyes wilt thou bring down.
texts.psa.18.28: For it is thou that makest my lamp to shine: Jehovah my God enlighteneth my darkness.
texts.psa.18.29: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
texts.psa.18.30: As for ùGod, his way is perfect; the word of Jehovah is tried: he is a shield to all that trust in him.
texts.psa.18.31: For who is +God save Jehovah? and who is a rock if not our God?
texts.psa.18.32: The ùGod who girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect,
texts.psa.18.33: Who maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], and setteth me upon my high places;
texts.psa.18.34: Who teacheth my hands to war, and mine arms bend a bow of brass;
texts.psa.18.35: And thou didst give me the shield of thy salvation, and thy right hand held me up; and thy condescending gentleness hath made me great.
texts.psa.18.36: Thou didst enlarge my steps under me, and mine ankles have not wavered.
texts.psa.18.37: I pursued mine enemies, and overtook them; and I turned not again till they were consumed.
texts.psa.18.38: I crushed them, and they were not able to rise: they fell under my feet.
texts.psa.18.39: And thou girdedst me with strength to battle; thou didst subdue under me those that rose up against me.
texts.psa.18.40: And mine enemies didst thou make to turn their backs unto me, and those that hated me I destroyed.
texts.psa.18.41: They cried, and there was none to save; -- unto Jehovah, and he answered them not.
texts.psa.18.42: And I did beat them small as dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
texts.psa.18.43: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; thou hast made me the head of the nations: a people I knew not doth serve me.
texts.psa.18.44: At the hearing of the ear, they obey me: strangers come cringing unto me.
texts.psa.18.45: Strangers have faded away, and they come trembling forth from their close places.
texts.psa.18.46: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of my salvation,
texts.psa.18.47: The ùGod who hath avenged me, and hath subjected the peoples to me;
texts.psa.18.48: Who hath delivered me from mine enemies: yea, thou hast lifted me up above them that rose up against me; from the man of violence hast thou delivered me.
texts.psa.18.49: Therefore will I give thanks to thee, Jehovah, among the nations, and will sing psalms to thy name.
texts.psa.18.50: [It is he] who giveth great deliverances to his king, and sheweth loving-kindness to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
texts.psa.19.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} The heavens declare the glory of ùGod; and the expanse sheweth the work of his hands.
texts.psa.19.2: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
texts.psa.19.3: There is no speech and there are no words, yet their voice is heard.
texts.psa.19.4: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their language to the extremity of the world. In them hath he set a tent for the sun,
texts.psa.19.5: And he is as a bridegroom going forth from his chamber; he rejoiceth as a strong man to run the race.
texts.psa.19.6: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, and his circuit unto the ends of it; and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
texts.psa.19.7: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple;
texts.psa.19.8: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes;
texts.psa.19.9: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever; the judgments of Jehovah are truth, they are righteous altogether:
texts.psa.19.10: They are more precious than gold, yea, than much fine gold; and sweeter than honey and the dropping of the honeycomb.
texts.psa.19.11: Moreover, by them is thy servant enlightened; in keeping them there is great reward.
texts.psa.19.12: Who understandeth [his] errors? Purify me from secret [faults].
texts.psa.19.13: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be perfect, and I shall be innocent from great transgression.
texts.psa.19.14: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
texts.psa.20.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob protect thee;
texts.psa.20.2: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
texts.psa.20.3: Remember all thine oblations, and accept thy burnt-offering; Selah.
texts.psa.20.4: Grant thee according to thy heart, and fulfil all thy counsels.
texts.psa.20.5: We will triumph in thy salvation, and in the name of our God will we set up our banners. Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions!
texts.psa.20.6: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; he answereth him from the heavens of his holiness, with the saving strength of his right hand.
texts.psa.20.7: Some make mention of chariots, and some of horses, but we of the name of Jehovah our God.
texts.psa.20.8: They are bowed down and fallen; but we are risen and stand upright.
texts.psa.20.9: Save, Jehovah! Let the king answer us in the day we call.
texts.psa.21.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} The king shall joy in thy strength, Jehovah; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice.
texts.psa.21.2: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
texts.psa.21.3: For thou hast met him with the blessings of goodness; thou hast set a crown of pure gold on his head.
texts.psa.21.4: He asked life of thee; thou gavest [it] him, length of days for ever and ever.
texts.psa.21.5: His glory is great through thy salvation; majesty and splendour hast thou laid upon him.
texts.psa.21.6: For thou hast made him to be blessings for ever; thou hast filled him with joy by thy countenance.
texts.psa.21.7: For the king confideth in Jehovah: and through the loving-kindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.
