texts.psa.21.8: Thy hand shall find out all thine enemies; thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
texts.psa.21.9: Thou shalt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thy presence; Jehovah shall swallow them up in his anger, and the fire shall devour them:
texts.psa.21.10: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
texts.psa.21.11: For they intended evil against thee; they imagined a mischievous device, which they could not execute.
texts.psa.21.12: For thou wilt make them turn their back; thou wilt make ready thy bowstring against their face.
texts.psa.21.13: Be thou exalted, Jehovah, in thine own strength: we will sing and celebrate thy power.
texts.psa.22.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Aijeleth-Shahar. A Psalm of David.} My ùGod, my ùGod, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou] far from my salvation, from the words of my groaning?
texts.psa.22.2: My God, I cry by day, and thou answerest not; and by night, and there is no rest for me:
texts.psa.22.3: And thou art holy, thou that dwellest amid the praises of Israel.
texts.psa.22.4: Our fathers confided in thee: they confided, and thou didst deliver them.
texts.psa.22.5: They cried unto thee, and were delivered; they confided in thee, and were not confounded.
texts.psa.22.6: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and the despised of the people.
texts.psa.22.7: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying:]
texts.psa.22.8: Commit it to Jehovah -- let him rescue him; let him deliver him, because he delighteth in him!
texts.psa.22.9: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; thou didst make me trust, upon my mother's breasts.
texts.psa.22.10: I was cast upon thee from the womb; thou art my ùGod from my mother's belly.
texts.psa.22.11: Be not far from me, for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
texts.psa.22.12: Many bulls have encompassed me; Bashan's strong ones have beset me round.
texts.psa.22.13: They gape upon me with their mouth, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion.
texts.psa.22.14: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is become like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
texts.psa.22.15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaveth to my palate; and thou hast laid me in the dust of death.
texts.psa.22.16: For dogs have encompassed me; an assembly of evil-doers have surrounded me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
texts.psa.22.17: I may count all my bones. They look, they stare upon me;
texts.psa.22.18: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
texts.psa.22.19: But thou, Jehovah, be not far [from me]; O my strength, haste thee to help me.
texts.psa.22.20: Deliver my soul from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog;
texts.psa.22.21: Save me from the lion's mouth. Yea, from the horns of the buffaloes hast thou answered me.
texts.psa.22.22: I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
texts.psa.22.23: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and revere him, all ye the seed of Israel.
texts.psa.22.24: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him: but when he cried unto him, he heard.
texts.psa.22.25: My praise is from thee, in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
texts.psa.22.26: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; they shall praise Jehovah that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
texts.psa.22.27: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah, and all the families of the nations shall worship before thee:
texts.psa.22.28: For the kingdom is Jehovah's, and he ruleth among the nations.
texts.psa.22.29: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship; all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, and he that cannot keep alive his own soul.
texts.psa.22.30: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
texts.psa.22.31: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [it].
texts.psa.23.1: {A Psalm of David.} Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
texts.psa.23.2: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; he leadeth me beside still waters.
texts.psa.23.3: He restoreth my soul; he leadeth me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
texts.psa.23.4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
texts.psa.23.5: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; thou hast anointed my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
texts.psa.23.6: Surely, goodness and loving-kindness shall follow me all the days of my life; and I will dwell in the house of Jehovah for the length of the days.
texts.psa.24.1: {Of David. A Psalm.} The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
texts.psa.24.2: For it was he that founded it upon seas, and established it upon floods.
texts.psa.24.3: Who shall ascend into the mount of Jehovah? and who shall stand in his holy place?
texts.psa.24.4: He that hath blameless hands and a pure heart; who lifteth not up his soul unto vanity, nor sweareth deceitfully:
texts.psa.24.5: He shall receive blessing from Jehovah, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
texts.psa.24.6: This is the generation of them that seek unto him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
texts.psa.24.7: Lift up your heads, ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.
texts.psa.24.8: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
texts.psa.24.9: Lift up your heads, ye gates; yea, lift up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in.
texts.psa.24.10: Who is he, this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
texts.psa.25.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Unto thee, Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.
texts.psa.25.2: My God, I confide in thee; let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
texts.psa.25.3: Yea, none that wait on thee shall be ashamed: they shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.
texts.psa.25.4: Make me to know thy ways, O Jehovah; teach me thy paths.
texts.psa.25.5: Make me to walk in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
texts.psa.25.6: Remember, Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy loving-kindnesses; for they are from everlasting.
texts.psa.25.7: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; according to thy loving-kindness remember thou me, for thy goodness' sake, Jehovah.
texts.psa.25.8: Good and upright is Jehovah; therefore will he instruct sinners in the way:
texts.psa.25.9: The meek will he guide in judgment, and the meek will he teach his way.
texts.psa.25.10: All the paths of Jehovah are loving-kindness and truth for such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
texts.psa.25.11: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, thou wilt indeed pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
texts.psa.25.12: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? him will he instruct in the way [that] he should choose.
texts.psa.25.13: His soul shall dwell in prosperity, and his seed shall inherit the earth.
texts.psa.25.14: The secret of Jehovah is with them that fear him, that he may make known his covenant to them.
texts.psa.25.15: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; for he will bring my feet out of the net.
texts.psa.25.16: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; for I am solitary and afflicted.
texts.psa.25.17: The troubles of my heart are increased: bring me out of my distresses;
texts.psa.25.18: Consider mine affliction and my travail, and forgive all my sins.
texts.psa.25.19: Consider mine enemies, for they are many, and they hate me [with] cruel hatred.
texts.psa.25.20: Keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I trust in thee.
texts.psa.25.21: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
texts.psa.25.22: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
texts.psa.26.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have confided in Jehovah: I shall not slip.
texts.psa.26.2: Prove me, Jehovah, and test me; try my reins and my heart:
texts.psa.26.3: For thy loving-kindness is before mine eyes, and I have walked in thy truth.
texts.psa.26.4: I have not sat with vain persons, neither have I gone in with dissemblers;
texts.psa.26.5: I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and I have not sat with the wicked.
texts.psa.26.6: I will wash my hands in innocency, and will encompass thine altar, O Jehovah,
texts.psa.26.7: That I may cause the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and declare all thy marvellous works.
texts.psa.26.8: Jehovah, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thy glory dwelleth.
texts.psa.26.9: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood;
texts.psa.26.10: In whose hands are evil devices, and their right hand is full of bribes.
texts.psa.26.11: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity. Redeem me, and be gracious unto me.
texts.psa.26.12: My foot standeth in an even place; in the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
texts.psa.27.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Jehovah is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
texts.psa.27.2: When evil-doers, mine adversaries and mine enemies, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
texts.psa.27.3: If a host encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; if war rise against me, in this will I be confident.
texts.psa.27.4: One [thing] have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Jehovah, and to inquire [of him] in his temple.
texts.psa.27.5: For in the day of evil he will hide me in his pavilion; in the secret of his tent will he keep me concealed: he will set me high upon a rock.
texts.psa.27.6: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; and I will offer in his tent sacrifices of shouts of joy: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms unto Jehovah.
texts.psa.27.7: Hear, Jehovah; with my voice do I call; be gracious unto me, and answer me.
texts.psa.27.8: My heart said for thee, Seek ye my face. Thy face, O Jehovah, will I seek.
texts.psa.27.9: Hide not thy face from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
texts.psa.27.10: For had my father and my mother forsaken me, then had Jehovah taken me up.
texts.psa.27.11: Teach me thy way, Jehovah, and lead me in an even path, because of mine enemies.
texts.psa.27.12: Deliver me not over to the will of mine adversaries; for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.
texts.psa.27.13: Unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah in the land of the living ...!
texts.psa.27.14: Wait for Jehovah; be strong and let thy heart take courage: yea, wait for Jehovah.
texts.psa.28.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Unto thee, Jehovah, do I call; my rock, be not silent unto me, lest, [if] thou keep silence toward me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
texts.psa.28.2: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward the oracle of thy holiness.
texts.psa.28.3: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbours, and mischief is in their heart.
texts.psa.28.4: Give them according to their doing, and according to the wickedness of their deeds; give them after the work of their hands, render to them their desert.
texts.psa.28.5: For they regard not the deeds of Jehovah, nor the work of his hands: he will destroy them, and not build them up.
texts.psa.28.6: Blessed be Jehovah, for he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.28.7: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; my heart confided in him, and I was helped: therefore my heart exulteth, and with my song will I praise him.
texts.psa.28.8: Jehovah is their strength; and he is the stronghold of salvation to his anointed one.
texts.psa.28.9: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance; and feed them, and lift them up for ever.
texts.psa.29.1: {A Psalm of David.} Give unto Jehovah, ye sons of the mighty ones, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;
texts.psa.29.2: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; worship Jehovah in holy splendour.
texts.psa.29.3: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: the ùGod of glory thundereth, -- Jehovah upon great waters.
texts.psa.29.4: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; the voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
texts.psa.29.5: The voice of Jehovah breaketh cedars; yea, Jehovah breaketh the cedars of Lebanon:
texts.psa.29.6: And he maketh them to skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young buffalo.
texts.psa.29.7: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth out flames of fire.
texts.psa.29.8: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
texts.psa.29.9: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, and layeth bare the forests; and in his temple doth every one say, Glory!
texts.psa.29.10: Jehovah sitteth upon the flood; yea, Jehovah sitteth as king for ever.
texts.psa.29.11: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
texts.psa.30.1: {A Psalm of David: dedication-song of the house.} I will extol thee, Jehovah; for thou hast delivered me, and hast not made mine enemies to rejoice over me.
texts.psa.30.2: Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
texts.psa.30.3: Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol, thou hast quickened me from among those that go down to the pit.
texts.psa.30.4: Sing psalms unto Jehovah, ye saints of his, and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.
texts.psa.30.5: For a moment [is passed] in his anger, a life in his favour; at even weeping cometh for the night, and at morn there is rejoicing.
texts.psa.30.6: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.
texts.psa.30.7: Jehovah, by thy favour thou hadst made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.
texts.psa.30.8: I called to thee, Jehovah, and unto the Lord did I make supplication:
texts.psa.30.9: What profit is there in my blood, in my going down to the pit? shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
texts.psa.30.10: Hear, O Jehovah, and be gracious unto me; Jehovah, be my helper.
texts.psa.30.11: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
texts.psa.30.12: That [my] glory may sing psalms of thee, and not be silent. Jehovah my God, I will praise thee for ever.
texts.psa.31.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} In thee, Jehovah, do I trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.31.2: Incline thine ear to me, deliver me speedily; be a strong rock to me, a house of defence to save me.
texts.psa.31.3: For thou art my rock and my fortress; and, for thy name's sake, thou wilt lead me and guide me.
texts.psa.31.4: Draw me out of the net that they have hidden for me; for thou art my strength.
texts.psa.31.5: Into thy hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, Jehovah, [thou] ùGod of truth.
texts.psa.31.6: I have hated them that observe lying vanities; and as for me, I have confided in Jehovah.
texts.psa.31.7: I will be glad and rejoice in thy loving-kindness, for thou hast seen mine affliction; thou hast known the troubles of my soul,
texts.psa.31.8: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large place.
texts.psa.31.9: Be gracious unto me, Jehovah, for I am in trouble: mine eye wasteth away with vexation, my soul and my belly.
texts.psa.31.10: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength faileth through mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted.
texts.psa.31.11: More than to all mine oppressors, I am become exceedingly a reproach, even to my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that see me without flee from me.
texts.psa.31.12: I am forgotten in [their] heart as a dead man; I am become like a broken vessel.
texts.psa.31.13: For I have heard the slander of many -- terror on every side -- when they take counsel together against me: they plot to take away my life.
texts.psa.31.14: But I confided in thee, Jehovah; I said, thou art my God.
texts.psa.31.15: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from my persecutors.
texts.psa.31.16: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy loving-kindness.
texts.psa.31.17: Jehovah, let me not be ashamed; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, let them be silent in Sheol.
texts.psa.31.18: Let the lying lips become dumb, which speak insolently against the righteous in pride and contempt.
texts.psa.31.19: [Oh] how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee, before the sons of men!
texts.psa.31.20: Thou keepest them concealed in the secret of thy presence from the conspiracies of man; thou hidest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
texts.psa.31.21: Blessed be Jehovah; for he hath shewn me wondrously his loving-kindness in a strong city.
texts.psa.31.22: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes; nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
texts.psa.31.23: Love Jehovah, all ye his saints. Jehovah preserveth the faithful, and plentifully requiteth the proud doer.
texts.psa.31.24: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all ye that hope in Jehovah.
texts.psa.32.1: {Of David. Instruction.} Blessed is he [whose] transgression is forgiven, [whose] sin is covered!
texts.psa.32.2: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah reckoneth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile!
texts.psa.32.3: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old, through my groaning all the day long.
texts.psa.32.4: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me; my moisture was turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
texts.psa.32.5: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity I covered not; I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah, and *thou* forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
texts.psa.32.6: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee at a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they will not reach him.
texts.psa.32.7: Thou art a hiding-place for me; thou preservest me from trouble; thou dost encompass me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
texts.psa.32.8: I will instruct thee and teach thee the way in which thou shalt go; I will counsel [thee] with mine eye upon thee.
texts.psa.32.9: Be ye not as a horse, as a mule, which have no understanding: whose trappings must be bit and bridle, for restraint, or they will not come unto thee.
texts.psa.32.10: Many sorrows hath the wicked; but he that confideth in Jehovah, loving-kindness shall encompass him.
texts.psa.32.11: Rejoice in Jehovah, and be glad, ye righteous; and shout for joy, all ye upright in heart.
texts.psa.33.1: Exult, ye righteous, in Jehovah: praise is comely for the upright.
texts.psa.33.2: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp; sing psalms unto him with the ten-stringed lute.
texts.psa.33.3: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud sound.
texts.psa.33.4: For the word of Jehovah is right, and all his work is in faithfulness.
texts.psa.33.5: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the loving-kindness of Jehovah.
texts.psa.33.6: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
texts.psa.33.7: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; he layeth up the deeps in storehouses.
texts.psa.33.8: Let all the earth fear Jehovah; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
texts.psa.33.9: For *he* spoke, and it was [done]; *he* commanded, and it stood fast.
texts.psa.33.10: Jehovah frustrateth the counsel of the nations; he maketh the thoughts of the peoples of none effect.
texts.psa.33.11: The counsel of Jehovah standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.
texts.psa.33.12: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, the people that he hath chosen for his inheritance!
texts.psa.33.13: Jehovah looketh from the heavens; he beholdeth all the sons of men:
texts.psa.33.14: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth upon all the inhabitants of the earth;
texts.psa.33.15: He who fashioneth the hearts of them all, who considereth all their works.
texts.psa.33.16: The king is not saved by the multitude of [his] forces; a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
texts.psa.33.17: The horse is a vain thing for safety; neither doth he deliver by his great power.
texts.psa.33.18: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his loving-kindness,
texts.psa.33.19: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
texts.psa.33.20: Our soul waiteth for Jehovah: he is our help and our shield.
texts.psa.33.21: For in him shall our heart rejoice, because we have confided in his holy name.
texts.psa.33.22: Let thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, according as we have hoped in thee.
texts.psa.34.1: {[A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.} I will bless Jehovah at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
texts.psa.34.2: My soul shall make its boast in Jehovah: the meek shall hear, and rejoice.
texts.psa.34.3: Magnify Jehovah with me, and let us exalt his name together.
texts.psa.34.4: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
texts.psa.34.5: They looked unto him, and were enlightened, and their faces were not confounded.
texts.psa.34.6: This afflicted one called, and Jehovah heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.
texts.psa.34.7: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
texts.psa.34.8: Taste and see that Jehovah is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him!
texts.psa.34.9: Fear Jehovah, ye his saints; for there is no want to them that fear him.
texts.psa.34.10: The young lions are in need and suffer hunger; but they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good.
texts.psa.34.11: Come, ye sons, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.
texts.psa.34.12: What man is he that desireth life, [and] loveth days, that he may see good?
texts.psa.34.13: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile;
texts.psa.34.14: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
texts.psa.34.15: The eyes of Jehovah are upon the righteous, and his ears are toward their cry;
texts.psa.34.16: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth:
texts.psa.34.17: [The righteous] cry, and Jehovah heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
texts.psa.34.18: Jehovah is nigh to those that are of a broken heart, and saveth them that are of a contrite spirit.
texts.psa.34.19: Many are the adversities of the righteous, but Jehovah delivereth him out of them all:
texts.psa.34.20: He keepeth all his bones; not one of them is broken.
texts.psa.34.21: Evil shall destroy the wicked; and they that hate the righteous shall bear their guilt.
texts.psa.34.22: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; and none of them that trust in him shall bear guilt.
texts.psa.35.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Strive, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me; fight against them that fight against me:
texts.psa.35.2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help;
texts.psa.35.3: And draw out the spear, and stop [the way] against my pursuers: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
texts.psa.35.4: Let them be put to shame and confounded that seek after my life; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that devise my hurt:
texts.psa.35.5: Let them be as chaff before the wind, and let the angel of Jehovah drive [them] away;
texts.psa.35.6: Let their way be dark and slippery, and let the angel of Jehovah pursue them.
texts.psa.35.7: For without cause have they hidden for me their net [in] a pit; without cause they have digged [it] for my soul.
texts.psa.35.8: Let destruction come upon him unawares, and let his net which he hath hidden catch himself: for destruction let him fall therein.
texts.psa.35.9: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah; it shall rejoice in his salvation.
texts.psa.35.10: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, who deliverest the afflicted from one stronger than he, yea, the afflicted and the needy from him that spoileth him!
texts.psa.35.11: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; they lay to my charge things which I know not.
texts.psa.35.12: They reward me evil for good, [to] the bereavement of my soul.
texts.psa.35.13: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I chastened my soul with fasting, and my prayer returned into mine own bosom:
texts.psa.35.14: I behaved myself as though [he had been] a friend, a brother to me; I bowed down in sadness, as one that mourneth [for] a mother.
texts.psa.35.15: But at my halting they rejoiced, and gathered together: the slanderers gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; they did tear [me], and ceased not:
texts.psa.35.16: With profane jesters for bread, they have gnashed their teeth against me.
texts.psa.35.17: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, my only one from the young lions.
texts.psa.35.18: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise thee among much people.
texts.psa.35.19: Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; let them not wink with the eye that hate me without cause.
texts.psa.35.20: For they speak not peace; and they devise deceitful words against the quiet in the land.
texts.psa.35.21: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said, Aha! aha! our eye hath seen [it].
texts.psa.35.22: Thou hast seen [it], Jehovah: keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me.
texts.psa.35.23: Stir up thyself, and awake for my right, for my cause, my God and Lord!
texts.psa.35.24: Judge me, Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness, and let them not rejoice over me.
texts.psa.35.25: Let them not say in their heart, Aha! so would we have it. Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
texts.psa.35.26: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine adversity; let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
texts.psa.35.27: Let them exult and rejoice that delight in my righteousness; and let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, who delighteth in the prosperity of his servant.
texts.psa.35.28: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness, [and] of thy praise, all the day.
texts.psa.36.1: {To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of the servant of Jehovah; of David.} The transgression of the wicked uttereth within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
texts.psa.36.2: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, [even] when his iniquity is found to be hateful.
texts.psa.36.3: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, to do good.
texts.psa.36.4: He deviseth wickedness up on his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good: he abhorreth not evil.
texts.psa.36.5: Jehovah, thy loving-kindness is in the heavens, and thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.
texts.psa.36.6: Thy righteousness is like the high mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: thou, Jehovah, preservest man and beast.
texts.psa.36.7: How precious is thy loving-kindness, O God! So the sons of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.
texts.psa.36.8: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
texts.psa.36.9: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
texts.psa.36.10: Continue thy loving-kindness unto them that know thee, and thy righteousness to the upright in heart;
texts.psa.36.11: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
texts.psa.36.12: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.
texts.psa.37.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, and be not envious of them that work unrighteousness;
texts.psa.37.2: for they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and fade as the green herb.
texts.psa.37.3: Confide in Jehovah, and do good; dwell in the land, and feed on faithfulness;
texts.psa.37.4: and delight thyself in Jehovah, and he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
texts.psa.37.5: Commit thy way unto Jehovah, and rely upon him: he will bring [it] to pass;
texts.psa.37.6: and he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
texts.psa.37.7: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him that prospereth in his way, because of the man that bringeth mischievous devices to pass.
texts.psa.37.8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself: it [would be] only to do evil.
texts.psa.37.9: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait on Jehovah, they shall possess the land.
texts.psa.37.10: For yet a little while, and the wicked is not; and thou considerest his place, but he is not.
texts.psa.37.11: But the meek shall possess the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of prosperity.
texts.psa.37.12: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth his teeth against him.
texts.psa.37.13: The Lord laugheth at him; for he seeth that his day is coming.
texts.psa.37.14: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the afflicted and needy, to slay those that are upright in [the] way:
texts.psa.37.15: their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
texts.psa.37.16: The little that the righteous hath is better than the abundance of many wicked;
texts.psa.37.17: for the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.
texts.psa.37.18: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever:
texts.psa.37.19: they shall not be ashamed in the time of evil, and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
texts.psa.37.20: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume, like smoke shall they consume away.
texts.psa.37.21: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; but the righteous is gracious and giveth:
texts.psa.37.22: for those blessed of him shall possess the land, and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.
texts.psa.37.23: The steps of a man are established by Jehovah, and he delighteth in his way:
texts.psa.37.24: though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down, for Jehovah upholdeth his hand.
texts.psa.37.25: I have been young, and now am old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread:
texts.psa.37.26: all the day he is gracious and lendeth, and his seed shall be a blessing.
texts.psa.37.27: Depart from evil, and do good, and dwell for evermore;
texts.psa.37.28: for Jehovah loveth judgment, and will not forsake his saints: They are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
texts.psa.37.29: The righteous shall possess the land, and dwell therein for ever.
texts.psa.37.30: The mouth of the righteous proffereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh judgment;
texts.psa.37.31: the law of his God is in his heart; his goings shall not slide.
texts.psa.37.32: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him:
texts.psa.37.33: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
texts.psa.37.34: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, and he will exalt thee to possess the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].
texts.psa.37.35: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading like a green tree in its native soil:
texts.psa.37.36: but he passed away, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, but he was not found.
texts.psa.37.37: Mark the perfect, and behold the upright, for the end of [that] man is peace;
texts.psa.37.38: but the transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.
texts.psa.37.39: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
texts.psa.37.40: And Jehovah will help them and deliver them: he will deliver them from the wicked, and save them; for they trust in him.
texts.psa.38.1: {A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.} Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
texts.psa.38.2: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand cometh down upon me.
texts.psa.38.3: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; no peace in my bones, because of my sin.
texts.psa.38.4: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
texts.psa.38.5: My wounds stink, they are corrupt, because of my foolishness.
texts.psa.38.6: I am depressed; I am bowed down beyond measure; I go mourning all the day.
texts.psa.38.7: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
texts.psa.38.8: I am faint and broken beyond measure; I roar by reason of the agitation of my heart.
texts.psa.38.9: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my sighing is not hid from thee.
texts.psa.38.10: My heart throbbeth, my strength hath left me; and the light of mine eyes, it also is no more with me.
texts.psa.38.11: My lovers and mine associates stand aloof from my stroke; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
texts.psa.38.12: And they that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.
texts.psa.38.13: But I, as a deaf [man], hear not; and am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
texts.psa.38.14: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
texts.psa.38.15: For in thee, Jehovah, do I hope: *thou* wilt answer, O Lord my God.
texts.psa.38.16: For I said, Let them not rejoice over me! When my foot slipped, they magnified [themselves] against me.
texts.psa.38.17: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.
texts.psa.38.18: For I will declare mine iniquity, I am grieved for my sin.
texts.psa.38.19: But mine enemies are lively, they are strong; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied:
texts.psa.38.20: And they that render evil for good are adversaries unto me; because I pursue what is good.
texts.psa.38.21: Forsake me not, Jehovah; O my God, be not far from me.
texts.psa.38.22: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
texts.psa.39.1: {To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.} I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a muzzle, while the wicked is before me.
texts.psa.39.2: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
texts.psa.39.3: My heart burned within me; the fire was kindled in my musing: I spoke with my tongue,
texts.psa.39.4: Make me to know, Jehovah, mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: I shall know how frail I am.
texts.psa.39.5: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] hand-breadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before thee; verily, every man, [even] the high placed, is altogether vanity. Selah.
texts.psa.39.6: Verily, man walketh in a vain show; verily they are disquieted in vain; he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.
texts.psa.39.7: And now, what wait I for, Lord? my hope is in thee.
texts.psa.39.8: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the foolish.
texts.psa.39.9: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; for *thou* hast done [it].
texts.psa.39.10: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.
texts.psa.39.11: When thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely, every man is vanity. Selah.
texts.psa.39.12: Hear my prayer, Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; be not silent at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, a sojourner, like all my fathers.
texts.psa.39.13: Look away from me, and let me recover strength, before I go hence and be no more.
texts.psa.40.1: {To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.} I waited patiently for Jehovah; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
texts.psa.40.2: And he brought me up out of the pit of destruction, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock; he hath established my goings:
texts.psa.40.3: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, praise unto our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall confide in Jehovah.
texts.psa.40.4: Blessed is the man that hath made Jehovah his confidence, and turneth not to the proud, and to such as turn aside to lies.
texts.psa.40.5: Thou, O Jehovah my God, hast multiplied thy marvellous works, and thy thoughts toward us: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee; would I declare and speak [them], they are more than can be numbered.
texts.psa.40.6: Sacrifice and oblation thou didst not desire: ears hast thou prepared me. Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not demanded;
texts.psa.40.7: Then said I, Behold, I come, in the volume of the book it is written of me --
texts.psa.40.8: To do thy good pleasure, my God, is my delight, and thy law is within my heart.
texts.psa.40.9: I have published righteousness in the great congregation: behold, I have not withheld my lips, Jehovah, *thou* knowest.
texts.psa.40.10: I have not hidden thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy loving-kindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
texts.psa.40.11: Withhold not thou, Jehovah, thy tender mercies from me; let thy loving-kindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
texts.psa.40.12: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head: and my heart hath failed me.
texts.psa.40.13: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me; Jehovah, make haste to my help.
texts.psa.40.14: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;
texts.psa.40.15: Let them be desolate, because of their shame, that say unto me, Aha! Aha!
texts.psa.40.16: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee; let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified!
texts.psa.40.17: But I am afflicted and needy: the Lord thinketh upon me. Thou art my help and my deliverer: my God, make no delay.
texts.psa.41.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} Blessed is he that understandeth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.
texts.psa.41.2: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive; he shall be made happy in the land; and thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.
texts.psa.41.3: Jehovah will sustain him upon the bed of languishing: thou turnest all his bed in his sickness.
texts.psa.41.4: As for me, I said, Jehovah, be gracious unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
texts.psa.41.5: Mine enemies wish me evil: When will he die, and his name perish?
texts.psa.41.6: And if one come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; his heart gathereth wickedness to itself: he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].
texts.psa.41.7: All that hate me whisper together against me; against me do they devise my hurt.
texts.psa.41.8: A thing of Belial cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he is laid down, he will rise up no more.
texts.psa.41.9: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I confided, who did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me.
texts.psa.41.10: But thou, Jehovah, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
texts.psa.41.11: By this I know that thou delightest in me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
texts.psa.41.12: But as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
texts.psa.41.13: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity! Amen, and Amen.
texts.psa.42.1: {To the chief Musician. An instruction; of the sons of Korah.} As the hart panteth after the water-brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
texts.psa.42.2: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living ùGod: when shall I come and appear before God?
texts.psa.42.3: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say unto me all the day, Where is thy God?
texts.psa.42.4: These things I remember and have poured out my soul within me: how I passed along with the multitude, how I went on with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a festive multitude.
texts.psa.42.5: Why art thou cast down, my soul, and art disquieted in me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [for] the health of his countenance.
texts.psa.42.6: My God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, and the Hermons, from mount Mizar.
texts.psa.42.7: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy cataracts; all thy breakers and thy billows are gone over me.
texts.psa.42.8: In the day-time will Jehovah command his loving-kindness, and in the night his song shall be with me, a prayer unto the ùGod of my life.
texts.psa.42.9: I will say unto ùGod my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
texts.psa.42.10: As with a crushing in my bones mine adversaries reproach me, while they say unto me all the day, Where is thy God?
texts.psa.42.11: Why art thou cast down, my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.
texts.psa.43.1: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; deliver me from the deceitful and unrighteous man.
texts.psa.43.2: For thou art the God of my strength: why hast thou cast me off? why go I about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
texts.psa.43.3: Send out thy light and thy truth: *they* shall lead me, *they* shall bring me to thy holy mount, and unto thy habitations.
texts.psa.43.4: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto the ùGod of the gladness of my joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.
texts.psa.43.5: Why art thou cast down, my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God; for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.
texts.psa.44.1: {To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction.} O God, with our ears have we heard, our fathers have told us, the work thou wroughtest in their days, in the days of old:
texts.psa.44.2: Thou, by thy hand, didst dispossess the nations, but them thou didst plant; thou didst afflict the peoples, but them didst thou cause to spread out.
texts.psa.44.3: For not by their own sword did they take possession of the land, neither did their own arm save them; but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst delight in them.
texts.psa.44.4: Thou thyself art my king, O God: command deliverance for Jacob.
texts.psa.44.5: Through thee will we push down our adversaries; through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
texts.psa.44.6: For I will not put confidence in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
texts.psa.44.7: For thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.
texts.psa.44.8: In God will we boast all the day, and we will praise thy name for ever. Selah.
texts.psa.44.9: But thou hast cast off, and put us to confusion, and dost not go forth with our armies;
texts.psa.44.10: Thou hast made us to turn back from the adversary, and they that hate us spoil for themselves;
texts.psa.44.11: Thou hast given us over like sheep [appointed] for meat, and hast scattered us among the nations;
texts.psa.44.12: Thou hast sold thy people for nought, and hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price;
texts.psa.44.13: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision for them that are round about us;
texts.psa.44.14: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
texts.psa.44.15: All the day my confusion is before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
texts.psa.44.16: Because of the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the avenger.
texts.psa.44.17: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely against thy covenant:
texts.psa.44.18: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy path;
texts.psa.44.19: Though thou hast crushed us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
texts.psa.44.20: If we had forgotten the name of our God, and stretched out our hands to a strange ùgod,
texts.psa.44.21: Would not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
texts.psa.44.22: But for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
texts.psa.44.23: Awake, why sleepest thou, Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.
texts.psa.44.24: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
texts.psa.44.25: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
texts.psa.44.26: Rise up for our help, and redeem us for thy loving-kindness' sake.
texts.psa.45.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction; -- a song of the Beloved.} My heart is welling forth [with] a good matter: I say what I have composed touching the king. My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
texts.psa.45.2: Thou art fairer than the sons of men; grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
texts.psa.45.3: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O mighty one, [in] thy majesty and thy splendour;
texts.psa.45.4: And [in] thy splendour ride prosperously, because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
texts.psa.45.5: Thine arrows are sharp -- peoples fall under thee -- in the heart of the king's enemies.
texts.psa.45.6: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom:
texts.psa.45.7: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy companions.
texts.psa.45.8: Myrrh and aloes, cassia, are all thy garments; out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
texts.psa.45.9: Kings' daughters are among thine honourable women; upon thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
texts.psa.45.10: Hearken, daughter, and see, and incline thine ear; and forget thine own people and thy father's house:
texts.psa.45.11: And the king will desire thy beauty; for he is thy Lord, and worship thou him.
texts.psa.45.12: And the daughter of Tyre with a gift, the rich ones among the people, shall court thy favour.
texts.psa.45.13: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of wrought gold:
texts.psa.45.14: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of embroidery; the virgins behind her, her companions, shall be brought in unto thee:
texts.psa.45.15: With joy and gladness shall they be brought; they shall enter into the king's palace.
texts.psa.45.16: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons; princes shalt thou make them in all the earth.
texts.psa.45.17: I will make thy name to be remembered throughout all generations; therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.
texts.psa.46.1: {To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. On Alamoth. A song.} God is our refuge and strength, a help in distresses, very readily found.
texts.psa.46.2: Therefore will we not fear though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the heart of the seas;
texts.psa.46.3: Though the waters thereof roar [and] foam, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
texts.psa.46.4: There is a river the streams whereof make glad the city of God, the sanctuary of the habitations of the Most High.
texts.psa.46.5: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her at the dawn of the morning.
texts.psa.46.6: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
texts.psa.46.7: Jehovah of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.
texts.psa.46.8: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, what desolations he hath made in the earth:
texts.psa.46.9: He hath made wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariots in the fire.
texts.psa.46.10: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
texts.psa.46.11: Jehovah of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our high fortress. Selah.
texts.psa.47.1: {To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.} All ye peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God with the voice of triumph!
texts.psa.47.2: For Jehovah, the Most High, is terrible, a great king over all the earth.
texts.psa.47.3: He subdueth the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.
texts.psa.47.4: He hath chosen our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
texts.psa.47.5: God is gone up amid shouting, Jehovah amid the sound of the trumpet.
texts.psa.47.6: Sing psalms of God, sing psalms; sing psalms unto our King, sing psalms!
texts.psa.47.7: For God is the King of all the earth; sing psalms with understanding.
texts.psa.47.8: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
texts.psa.47.9: The willing-hearted of the peoples have gathered together, [with] the people of the God of Abraham. For unto God [belong] the shields of the earth: he is greatly exalted.
texts.psa.48.1: {A Song; a Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.} Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the hill of his holiness.
texts.psa.48.2: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
texts.psa.48.3: God is known in her palaces as a high fortress.
texts.psa.48.4: For behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together;
texts.psa.48.5: They saw, -- so they marvelled; they were troubled, they fled in consternation:
texts.psa.48.6: Trembling took hold upon them there; anguish, as of a woman in travail.
texts.psa.48.7: With an east wind thou hast broken the ships of Tarshish.
texts.psa.48.8: As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God doth establish it for ever. Selah.
texts.psa.48.9: We have thought, O God, of thy loving-kindness, in the midst of thy temple.
texts.psa.48.10: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
texts.psa.48.11: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
texts.psa.48.12: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: count the towers thereof;
texts.psa.48.13: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces: that ye may tell it to the generation following.
texts.psa.48.14: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide until death.
texts.psa.49.1: {To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.} Hear this, all ye peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world:
texts.psa.49.2: Both men of low and men of high degree, rich and poor alike.
texts.psa.49.3: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding:
texts.psa.49.4: I will incline mine ear to a parable, I will open my riddle upon the harp.
texts.psa.49.5: Wherefore should I fear in the days of adversity, [when] the iniquity of my supplanters encompasseth me? --
texts.psa.49.6: They depend upon their wealth, and boast themselves in the abundance of their riches. ...
texts.psa.49.7: None can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him,
texts.psa.49.8: (For the redemption of their soul is costly, and must be given up for ever,)
texts.psa.49.9: That he should still live perpetually, [and] not see corruption.
texts.psa.49.10: For he seeth that wise men die; all alike, the fool and the brutish perish, and they leave their wealth to others.
texts.psa.49.11: Their inward thought is, that their houses are for ever, their dwelling-places from generation to generation: they call the lands after their own names.
texts.psa.49.12: Nevertheless, man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
texts.psa.49.13: This their way is their folly, yet they that come after them delight in their sayings. Selah.
texts.psa.49.14: Like sheep are they laid in Sheol: Death feedeth on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their comeliness shall be for Sheol to consume, that there be no habitation for them.
texts.psa.49.15: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol: for he will receive me. Selah.
texts.psa.49.16: Be not afraid when a man becometh rich, when the glory of his house is increased:
texts.psa.49.17: For when he dieth, he shall carry nothing away; his glory shall not descend after him.
texts.psa.49.18: Though he blessed his soul in his lifetime, -- and men will praise thee when thou doest well to thyself, --
texts.psa.49.19: It shall go to the generation of his fathers: they shall never see light.
texts.psa.49.20: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
texts.psa.50.1: {A Psalm. Of Asaph.} ùGod, Elohim-Jehovah, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
texts.psa.50.2: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.
texts.psa.50.3: Our God will come, and will not keep silence: fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
texts.psa.50.4: He will call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people:
texts.psa.50.5: Gather unto me my godly ones, those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice!
texts.psa.50.6: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; for God executeth judgment himself. Selah.
texts.psa.50.7: Hear, my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, thy God.
texts.psa.50.8: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices, or thy burnt-offerings, continually before me;
texts.psa.50.9: I will take no bullock out of thy house, [nor] he-goats out of thy folds:
texts.psa.50.10: For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle upon a thousand hills;
texts.psa.50.11: I know all the fowl of the mountains, and the roaming creatures of the field are mine:
texts.psa.50.12: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
texts.psa.50.13: Should I eat the flesh of bulls, and drink the blood of goats?
texts.psa.50.14: Offer unto God thanksgiving, and perform thy vows unto the Most High;
texts.psa.50.15: And call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
texts.psa.50.16: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant into thy mouth,
texts.psa.50.17: Seeing thou hast hated correction and hast cast my words behind thee?
texts.psa.50.18: When thou sawest a thief, thou didst take pleasure in him, and thy portion was with adulterers;
texts.psa.50.19: Thou lettest thy mouth loose to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit;
texts.psa.50.20: Thou sittest [and] speakest against thy brother, thou revilest thine own mother's son:
texts.psa.50.21: These [things] hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether as thyself: [but] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.
texts.psa.50.22: Now consider this, ye that forget +God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be no deliverer.
texts.psa.50.23: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me; and to him that ordereth [his] way will I shew the salvation of God.
texts.psa.51.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.} Be gracious unto me, O God, according to thy loving-kindness; according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
texts.psa.51.2: Wash me fully from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
texts.psa.51.3: For I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is continually before me.
texts.psa.51.4: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done what is evil in thy sight; that thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, be clear when thou judgest.
texts.psa.51.5: Behold, in iniquity was I brought forth, and in sin did my mother conceive me.
texts.psa.51.6: Behold, thou wilt have truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden [part] thou wilt make me to know wisdom.
texts.psa.51.7: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
texts.psa.51.8: Make me to hear gladness and joy; [that] the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
texts.psa.51.9: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
texts.psa.51.10: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
texts.psa.51.11: Cast me not away from thy presence, and take not the spirit of thy holiness from me.
texts.psa.51.12: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, and let a willing spirit sustain me.
texts.psa.51.13: I will teach transgressors thy ways, and sinners shall return unto thee.
texts.psa.51.14: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
texts.psa.51.15: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare thy praise.
texts.psa.51.16: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
texts.psa.51.17: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
texts.psa.51.18: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.
texts.psa.51.19: Then shalt thou have sacrifices of righteousness, burnt-offering, and whole burnt-offering; then shall they offer up bullocks upon thine altar.
texts.psa.52.1: {To the chief Musician: an instruction. Of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David came to the house of Ahimelech.} Why boastest thou thyself in evil, thou mighty man? The loving-kindness of ùGod [abideth] continually.
texts.psa.52.2: Thy tongue deviseth mischievous things, like a sharp razor, practising deceit.
texts.psa.52.3: Thou hast loved evil rather than good, lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
texts.psa.52.4: Thou hast loved all devouring words, O deceitful tongue!
texts.psa.52.5: ùGod shall likewise destroy thee for ever; he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of [thy] tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
texts.psa.52.6: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, [saying,]
texts.psa.52.7: Behold the man that made not God his strength, but put confidence in the abundance of his riches, [and] strengthened himself in his avarice.
texts.psa.52.8: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I will confide in the loving-kindness of God for ever and ever.
texts.psa.52.9: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done [it]; and I will wait on thy name, before thy godly ones, for it is good.
texts.psa.53.1: {To the chief Musician. On Mahalath: an instruction. Of David.} The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God! They have corrupted themselves, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
texts.psa.53.2: God looked down from the heavens upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
texts.psa.53.3: Every one of them is gone back, they are together become corrupt: there is none that doeth good, not even one.
texts.psa.53.4: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, eating up my people [as] they eat bread? they call not upon God.
texts.psa.53.5: There were they in great fear, where no fear was; for God scattereth the bones of him that encampeth against thee. Thou hast put [them] to shame, for God hath despised them.
texts.psa.53.6: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God turneth again the captivity of his people, Jacob shall be glad, Israel shall rejoice.
texts.psa.54.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David; when the Ziphites came, and said to Saul, Is not David hiding himself with us?} O God, by thy name save me, and by thy strength do me justice.
texts.psa.54.2: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
texts.psa.54.3: For strangers are risen up against me, and the violent seek after my life: they have not set God before them. Selah.
texts.psa.54.4: Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is among them that uphold my soul.
texts.psa.54.5: He will requite evil to mine enemies: in thy truth cut them off.
texts.psa.54.6: I will freely sacrifice unto thee; I will praise thy name, O Jehovah, because it is good.
texts.psa.54.7: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; and mine eye hath seen [its desire] upon mine enemies.
texts.psa.55.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments: an instruction. Of David.} Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
texts.psa.55.2: Attend unto me, and answer me: I wander about in my plaint, and I moan aloud,
texts.psa.55.3: Because of the voice of the enemy; because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in anger they persecute me.
texts.psa.55.4: My heart is writhing within me, and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
texts.psa.55.5: Fear and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
texts.psa.55.6: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away, and be at rest;
texts.psa.55.7: Behold, I would flee afar off, I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah;
texts.psa.55.8: I would hasten my escape from the stormy wind, from the tempest.
texts.psa.55.9: Swallow [them] up, Lord; divide their tongue: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
texts.psa.55.10: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; and iniquity and mischief are in the midst of it.
texts.psa.55.11: Perversities are in the midst thereof; and oppression and deceit depart not from its streets.
texts.psa.55.12: For it is not an enemy that hath reproached me -- then could I have borne it; neither is it he that hateth me that hath magnified [himself] against me -- then would I have hidden myself from him;
texts.psa.55.13: But it was thou, a man mine equal, mine intimate, my familiar friend. ...
texts.psa.55.14: We who held sweet intercourse together. To the house of God we walked amid the throng.
texts.psa.55.15: Let death seize upon them, let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwellings, in their midst.
texts.psa.55.16: As for me, unto God will I call; and Jehovah will save me.
texts.psa.55.17: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray and moan aloud; and he will hear my voice.
texts.psa.55.18: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me: for there were many about me.
texts.psa.55.19: ùGod will hear, and afflict them: he that is seated of old, (Selah) ... because there is no change in them, and they fear not God.
texts.psa.55.20: He hath put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him; he hath profaned his covenant.
texts.psa.55.21: Smooth were the milky [words] of his mouth, but his heart was war; his words were softer than oil, yet are they drawn swords.
texts.psa.55.22: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and *he* will sustain thee: he will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
texts.psa.55.23: And thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days. But as for me, I will confide in thee.
texts.psa.56.1: {To the chief Musician. On Jonathelem-rechokim. Of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath.} Be gracious unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: all the day long fighting he oppresseth me.
texts.psa.56.2: Mine enemies would swallow [me] up all the day long; for they are many that fight against me haughtily.
texts.psa.56.3: In the day that I am afraid, I will confide in thee.
texts.psa.56.4: In God will I praise his word, in God I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can flesh do unto me?
texts.psa.56.5: All the day long they wrest my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
texts.psa.56.6: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves; they mark my steps, because they wait for my soul.
texts.psa.56.7: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.
texts.psa.56.8: *Thou* countest my wanderings; put my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
texts.psa.56.9: Then shall mine enemies return backward in the day when I call: this I know, for God is for me.
texts.psa.56.10: In God will I praise [his] word; in Jehovah will I praise [his] word.
texts.psa.56.11: In God have I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can man do unto me?
texts.psa.56.12: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thanks unto thee.
texts.psa.56.13: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; [wilt thou] not [keep] my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
texts.psa.57.1: {To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul in the cave.} Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me; for my soul taketh refuge in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings do I take refuge, until the calamities be overpast.
texts.psa.57.2: I will call unto God, the Most High; unto ùGod that performeth [all] for me.
texts.psa.57.3: He will send from the heavens and save me; he hath covered with reproach him that would swallow me up. Selah. God hath sent forth his loving-kindness and his truth.
texts.psa.57.4: My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down [among] them that breathe out flames, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
texts.psa.57.5: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; let thy glory be above all the earth!
texts.psa.57.6: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down: they have digged a pit before me; they are fallen into the midst thereof. Selah.
texts.psa.57.7: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms.
texts.psa.57.8: Awake, my glory; awake, lute and harp: I will wake the dawn.
texts.psa.57.9: I will give thee thanks among the peoples, O Lord; of thee will I sing psalms among the nations:
texts.psa.57.10: For thy loving-kindness is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
texts.psa.57.11: Be exalted above the heavens, O God; let thy glory be above all the earth!
texts.psa.58.1: {To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam.} Is righteousness indeed silent? Do ye speak it? Do ye judge with equity, ye sons of men?
texts.psa.58.2: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.
texts.psa.58.3: The wicked go astray from the womb; they err as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
texts.psa.58.4: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: [they are] like the deaf adder which stoppeth her ear;
texts.psa.58.5: Which doth not hearken to the voice of enchanters, of one charming ever so wisely.
texts.psa.58.6: O God, break their teeth in their mouth; break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.58.7: Let them melt away as waters that flow off; when he aimeth his arrows, let them be as blunted:
texts.psa.58.8: Let them be as a snail that melteth as it passeth away; [like] the untimely birth of a woman, let them not see the sun.
texts.psa.58.9: Before your pots feel the thorns, green or burning, -- they shall be whirled away.
texts.psa.58.10: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; he shall wash his footsteps in the blood of the wicked:
texts.psa.58.11: And men shall say, Verily there is fruit for the righteous; verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.
texts.psa.59.1: {To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.} Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; secure me on high from them that rise up against me.
texts.psa.59.2: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from men of blood.
texts.psa.59.3: For behold, they lie in wait for my soul; strong ones are gathered against me: not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.59.4: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to meet me, and behold.
texts.psa.59.5: Yea, do thou, Jehovah, the God of hosts, the God of Israel, arise to visit all the nations: be not gracious to any plotters of iniquity. Selah.
texts.psa.59.6: They return in the evening; they howl like a dog, and go round about the city:
texts.psa.59.7: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: for who [say they] doth hear?
texts.psa.59.8: But thou, Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; thou wilt have all the nations in derision.
texts.psa.59.9: Their strength! ... I will take heed to thee; for God is my high fortress.
texts.psa.59.10: God, whose loving-kindness will come to meet me, -- God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.
texts.psa.59.11: Slay them not, lest my people forget; by thy power make them wander, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
texts.psa.59.12: [Because of] the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and because of cursing and lying which they speak.
texts.psa.59.13: Make an end in wrath, make an end, that they may be no more; that they may know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
texts.psa.59.14: And in the evening they shall return, they shall howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
texts.psa.59.15: They shall wander about for meat, and stay all night if they be not satisfied.
texts.psa.59.16: But as for me, I will sing of thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of thy loving-kindness in the morning; for thou hast been to me a high fortress, and a refuge in the day of my trouble.
texts.psa.59.17: Unto thee, my strength, will I sing psalms; for God is my high fortress, the God of my mercy.
texts.psa.60.1: {To the chief Musician. On Shushan. Testimony. Michtam of David; to teach: when he strove with the Syrians of Mesopotamia, and the Syrians of Zobah, and Joab returned, and smote the Edomites in the valley of salt, twelve thousand.} O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased: restore us again.
texts.psa.60.2: Thou hast made the earth to tremble, thou hast rent it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
texts.psa.60.3: Thou hast shewn thy people hard things; thou hast made us to drink the wine of bewilderment.
texts.psa.60.4: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth, (Selah,)
texts.psa.60.5: That thy beloved ones may be delivered. Save with thy right hand, and answer me.
texts.psa.60.6: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
texts.psa.60.7: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;
texts.psa.60.8: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast my sandal; Philistia, shout aloud because of me.
texts.psa.60.9: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me unto Edom?
texts.psa.60.10: [Wilt] not thou, O God, who didst cast us off? and didst not go forth, O God, with our armies?
texts.psa.60.11: Give us help from trouble; for vain is man's deliverance.
texts.psa.60.12: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
texts.psa.61.1: {To the chief Musician. On a stringed instrument. [A Psalm] of David.} Hear, O God, my cry; attend unto my prayer.
texts.psa.61.2: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: thou wilt lead me on to a rock which is too high for me.
texts.psa.61.3: For thou hast been a refuge for me, a strong tower from before the enemy.
texts.psa.61.4: I will sojourn in thy tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
texts.psa.61.5: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows; thou hast given [me] the inheritance of those that fear thy name.
texts.psa.61.6: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: his years shall be as many generations.
texts.psa.61.7: He shall abide before God for ever: bestow loving-kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
texts.psa.61.8: So will I sing forth thy name for ever, performing my vows from day to day.
texts.psa.62.1: {To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.} Upon God alone doth my soul rest peacefully; from him is my salvation.
texts.psa.62.2: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.
texts.psa.62.3: How long will ye assail a man; will ye [seek], all of you, to break him down as a bowing wall or a tottering fence?
texts.psa.62.4: They only consult to thrust [him] down from his excellency; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouth, but in their inward part they curse. Selah.
texts.psa.62.5: Upon God alone, O my soul, rest peacefully; for my expectation is from him.
texts.psa.62.6: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be moved.
texts.psa.62.7: With God is my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.
texts.psa.62.8: Confide in him at all times, ye people; pour out your heart before him: God is our refuge. Selah.
texts.psa.62.9: Men of low degree are only vanity; men of high degree, a lie: laid in the balance, they go up together [lighter] than vanity.
texts.psa.62.10: Put not confidence in oppression, and become not vain in robbery; if wealth increase, set not your heart upon it.
texts.psa.62.11: Once hath God spoken, twice have I heard this, that strength [belongeth] unto God.
texts.psa.62.12: And unto thee, O Lord, [belongeth] loving-kindness; for *thou* renderest to every man according to his work.
texts.psa.63.1: {A Psalm of David; when he was in the wilderness of Judah.} O God, thou art my ùGod; early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh languisheth for thee, in a dry and weary land without water:
texts.psa.63.2: To see thy power and thy glory, as I have beheld thee in the sanctuary;
texts.psa.63.3: For thy loving-kindness is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.
texts.psa.63.4: So will I bless thee while I live; I will lift up my hands in thy name.
texts.psa.63.5: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, and my mouth shall praise [thee] with joyful lips.
texts.psa.63.6: When I remember thee upon my bed, I meditate on thee in the night-watches:
texts.psa.63.7: For thou hast been my help, and in the shadow of thy wings will I sing for joy.
texts.psa.63.8: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
texts.psa.63.9: But those that seek my soul, to destroy [it], shall go into the lower parts of the earth;
texts.psa.63.10: They shall be given over to the power of the sword; they shall be the portion of foxes.
texts.psa.63.11: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: for the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
texts.psa.64.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} Hear, O God, my voice in my plaint; preserve my life from fear of the enemy:
texts.psa.64.2: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, from the tumultuous crowd of the workers of iniquity,
texts.psa.64.3: Who have sharpened their tongue like a sword, [and] have aimed their arrow, a bitter word;
texts.psa.64.4: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
texts.psa.64.5: They encourage themselves in an evil matter, they concert to hide snares; they say, Who will see them?
texts.psa.64.6: They devise iniquities: We have it ready, the plan is diligently sought out. And each one's inward [thought] and heart is deep.
texts.psa.64.7: But God will shoot an arrow at them: suddenly are they wounded;
texts.psa.64.8: By their own tongue they are made to fall over one another: all that see them shall flee away.
texts.psa.64.9: And all men shall fear, and shall declare God's doing; and they shall wisely consider his work.
texts.psa.64.10: The righteous shall rejoice in Jehovah, and trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
texts.psa.65.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David: a Song.} Praise waiteth for thee in silence, O God, in Zion; and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
texts.psa.65.2: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
texts.psa.65.3: Iniquities have prevailed against me: our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.
texts.psa.65.4: Blessed is he whom thou choosest and causest to approach: he shall dwell in thy courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, of thy holy temple.
texts.psa.65.5: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation, thou confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the distant regions of the sea. ...
texts.psa.65.6: Who by his strength established the mountains, being girded with power;
texts.psa.65.7: Who stilleth the raging of the seas, the raging of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
texts.psa.65.8: And they that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens; thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
texts.psa.65.9: Thou hast visited the earth, thou hast watered it; thou greatly enrichest it: the river of God is full of water; thou providest their corn, when thou hast so prepared it:
texts.psa.65.10: Thou dost satiate its furrows, thou smoothest its clods, thou makest it soft with showers; thou blessest the springing thereof.
texts.psa.65.11: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness, and thy paths drop fatness:
texts.psa.65.12: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are girded with gladness.
texts.psa.65.13: The meadows are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.
texts.psa.66.1: {To the chief Musician. A Song: a Psalm.} Shout aloud unto God, all the earth:
texts.psa.66.2: Sing forth the glory of his name, make his praise glorious;
texts.psa.66.3: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! because of the greatness of thy strength, thine enemies come cringing unto thee.
texts.psa.66.4: All the earth shall worship thee, and sing psalms unto thee: they shall sing forth thy name. Selah.
texts.psa.66.5: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in [his] doings toward the children of men.
texts.psa.66.6: He turned the sea into dry [land]; they went through the river on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
