texts.psa.66.7: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes observe the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
texts.psa.66.8: Bless our God, ye peoples, and make the voice of his praise to be heard;
texts.psa.66.9: Who hath set our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
texts.psa.66.10: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
texts.psa.66.11: Thou broughtest us into a net, thou didst lay a heavy burden upon our loins;
texts.psa.66.12: Thou didst cause men to ride over our head; we went through fire and through water: but thou hast brought us out into abundance.
texts.psa.66.13: I will go into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will perform my vows to thee,
texts.psa.66.14: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
texts.psa.66.15: I will offer up unto thee burnt-offerings of fatted beasts, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
texts.psa.66.16: Come, hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
texts.psa.66.17: I called unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
texts.psa.66.18: Had I regarded iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not hear.
texts.psa.66.19: But God hath heard; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
texts.psa.66.20: Blessed be God, who hath not turned away my prayer, nor his loving-kindness from me!
texts.psa.67.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm: a Song.} God be gracious unto us, and bless us, [and] cause his face to shine upon us; Selah,
texts.psa.67.2: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy salvation among all nations.
texts.psa.67.3: Let the peoples praise thee, O God, let all the peoples praise thee.
texts.psa.67.4: Let the nations rejoice and sing for joy: for thou wilt judge the peoples equitably; and the nations upon earth, thou wilt guide them. Selah.
texts.psa.67.5: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; let all the peoples praise thee.
texts.psa.67.6: The earth will yield her increase; God, our God, will bless us:
texts.psa.67.7: God will bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
texts.psa.68.1: {To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm: a Song.} Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, and let them that hate him flee before him.
texts.psa.68.2: As smoke is driven, thou wilt drive them away; as wax melteth before the fire, the wicked shall perish at the presence of God.
texts.psa.68.3: But the righteous shall rejoice: they shall exult before God and be glad with joy.
texts.psa.68.4: Sing unto God, sing forth his name; cast up a way for him that rideth in the deserts: his name is Jah; and rejoice before him.
texts.psa.68.5: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
texts.psa.68.6: God maketh the solitary into families; those that were bound he bringeth out into prosperity: but the rebellious dwell in a parched [land].
texts.psa.68.7: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness -- (Selah) --
texts.psa.68.8: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God, yon Sinai, at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
texts.psa.68.9: Thou, O God, didst pour a plentiful rain upon thine inheritance, and when it was weary thou strengthenedst it.
texts.psa.68.10: Thy flock hath dwelt therein: thou hast prepared in thy goodness, for the afflicted, O God!
texts.psa.68.11: The Lord gives the word: great the host of the publishers.
texts.psa.68.12: Kings of armies flee; they flee, and she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.
texts.psa.68.13: Though ye have lain among the sheepfolds, [ye shall be as] wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with green gold.
texts.psa.68.14: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it became snow-white as Zalmon.
texts.psa.68.15: [As] mount Bashan is the mount of God, a many-peaked mountain, [as] mount Bashan.
texts.psa.68.16: Why do ye look with envy, ye many-peaked mountains, upon the mount that God hath desired for his abode? yea, Jehovah will dwell [there] for ever.
texts.psa.68.17: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them: it is a Sinai in holiness.
texts.psa.68.18: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts in Man, and even [for] the rebellious, for the dwelling [there] of Jah Elohim.
texts.psa.68.19: Blessed be the Lord: day by day doth he load us [with good], the ùGod who is our salvation. Selah.
texts.psa.68.20: Our ùGod is the ùGod of salvation; and with Jehovah, the Lord, are the goings forth [even] from death.
texts.psa.68.21: Verily God will smite the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of him that goeth on still in his trespasses.
texts.psa.68.22: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [them] again from the depth of the sea;
texts.psa.68.23: That thou mayest dip thy foot in blood: the tongue of thy dogs has its portion from enemies.
texts.psa.68.24: They have seen thy goings, O God, the goings of my ùGod, my King, in the sanctuary.
texts.psa.68.25: The singers went before, the players on stringed instruments after, in the midst of maidens playing on tabrets.
texts.psa.68.26: In the congregations bless ye God, the Lord, -- [ye] from the fountain of Israel.
texts.psa.68.27: There is little Benjamin, their ruler; the princes of Judah, their company; the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
texts.psa.68.28: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
texts.psa.68.29: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
texts.psa.68.30: Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the assembly of the strong, with the calves of the peoples: [every one] submitteth himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples that delight in war.
texts.psa.68.31: Great ones shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall quickly stretch out her hands unto God.
texts.psa.68.32: Ye kingdoms of the earth, sing unto God; sing psalms of the Lord, (Selah,)
texts.psa.68.33: Of him that rideth upon the heavens, the heavens which are of old: lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.
texts.psa.68.34: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
texts.psa.68.35: Terrible art thou, O God, out of thy sanctuaries, -- the ùGod of Israel! He it is that giveth strength and might unto the people. Blessed be God!
texts.psa.69.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.} Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.
texts.psa.69.2: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into the depths of waters, and the flood overfloweth me.
texts.psa.69.3: I am weary with my crying, my throat is parched; mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
texts.psa.69.4: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
texts.psa.69.5: Thou, O God, knowest my foolishness, and my trespasses are not hidden from thee.
texts.psa.69.6: Let not them that wait on thee, Lord, Jehovah of hosts, be ashamed through me; let not those that seek thee be confounded through me, O God of Israel.
texts.psa.69.7: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; confusion hath covered my face.
texts.psa.69.8: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's sons;
texts.psa.69.9: For the zeal of thy house hath devoured me, and the reproaches of them that reproach thee have fallen upon me.
texts.psa.69.10: And I wept, my soul was fasting: that also was to my reproach; --
texts.psa.69.11: And I made sackcloth my garment: then I became a proverb to them.
texts.psa.69.12: They that sit in the gate talk of me, and [I am] the song of the drunkards.
texts.psa.69.13: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy loving-kindness answer me, according to the truth of thy salvation:
texts.psa.69.14: Deliver me out of the mire, let me not sink; let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the depths of waters.
texts.psa.69.15: Let not the flood of waters overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up; and let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.
texts.psa.69.16: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy loving-kindness is good: according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, turn toward me;
texts.psa.69.17: And hide not thy face from thy servant, for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.
texts.psa.69.18: Draw nigh unto my soul, be its redeemer; ransom me because of mine enemies.
texts.psa.69.19: *Thou* knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
texts.psa.69.20: Reproach hath broken my heart, and I am overwhelmed: and I looked for sympathy, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
texts.psa.69.21: Yea, they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
texts.psa.69.22: Let their table become a snare before them, and their very welfare a trap;
texts.psa.69.23: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not, and make their loins continually to shake.
texts.psa.69.24: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let the fierceness of thine anger take hold of them.
texts.psa.69.25: Let their habitation be desolate; let there be no dweller in their tents.
texts.psa.69.26: For they persecute him whom *thou* hast smitten, and they talk for the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.
texts.psa.69.27: Add iniquity unto their iniquity, and let them not come into thy righteousness.
texts.psa.69.28: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
texts.psa.69.29: But I am afflicted and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me secure on high.
texts.psa.69.30: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving;
texts.psa.69.31: And it shall please Jehovah more than an ox, -- a bullock with horns and cloven hoofs.
texts.psa.69.32: The meek shall see it, they shall be glad; ye that seek God, your heart shall live.
texts.psa.69.33: For Jehovah heareth the needy, and despiseth not his prisoners.
texts.psa.69.34: Let heavens and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moveth therein.
texts.psa.69.35: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; and they shall dwell there, and possess it:
texts.psa.69.36: And the seed of his servants shall inherit it, and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
texts.psa.70.1: {To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David: to bring to remembrance.} Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Jehovah, [hasten] to my help.
texts.psa.70.2: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;
texts.psa.70.3: Let them turn back because of their shame that say, Aha! Aha!
texts.psa.70.4: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee, and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified!
texts.psa.70.5: But I am afflicted and needy: make haste unto me, O God. Thou art my help and my deliverer: O Jehovah, make no delay.
texts.psa.71.1: In thee, Jehovah, do I trust: let me never be ashamed.
texts.psa.71.2: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me; incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
texts.psa.71.3: Be to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
texts.psa.71.4: My God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
texts.psa.71.5: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah, my confidence from my youth.
texts.psa.71.6: On thee have I been stayed from the womb; from the bowels of my mother thou didst draw me forth: my praise shall be continually of thee.
texts.psa.71.7: I have been as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
texts.psa.71.8: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, with thy glory, all the day.
texts.psa.71.9: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
texts.psa.71.10: For mine enemies speak against me, and they that watch for my soul consult together,
texts.psa.71.11: Saying, God hath forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is none to deliver.
texts.psa.71.12: O God, be not far from me; my God, hasten to my help.
texts.psa.71.13: Let them be ashamed, let them be consumed, that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
texts.psa.71.14: But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise thee yet more and more.
texts.psa.71.15: My mouth shall declare thy righteousness, [and] thy salvation all the day: for I know not the numbers [thereof].
texts.psa.71.16: I will go in the might of the Lord Jehovah; I will recall thy righteousness, thine alone.
texts.psa.71.17: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth, and hitherto have I proclaimed thy marvellous works:
texts.psa.71.18: Now also, when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not, until I have proclaimed thine arm unto [this] generation, thy might to every one that is to come.
texts.psa.71.19: And thy righteousness, O God, reacheth on high, thou who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee?
texts.psa.71.20: Thou, who hast shewn us many and sore troubles, wilt revive us again, and wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth;
texts.psa.71.21: Thou wilt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
texts.psa.71.22: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, my God; unto thee will I sing psalms with the harp, thou holy One of Israel.
texts.psa.71.23: My lips shall exult when I sing psalms unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
texts.psa.71.24: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day; for they shall be ashamed, for they shall be brought to confusion, that seek my hurt.
texts.psa.72.1: {For Solomon.} O God, give the king thy judgments, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
texts.psa.72.2: He will judge thy people with righteousness, and thine afflicted with judgment.
texts.psa.72.3: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.
texts.psa.72.4: He will do justice to the afflicted of the people; he will save the children of the needy, and will break in pieces the oppressor.
texts.psa.72.5: They shall fear thee as long as sun and moon endure, from generation to generation.
texts.psa.72.6: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
texts.psa.72.7: In his days shall the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace till the moon be no more.
texts.psa.72.8: And he shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
texts.psa.72.9: The dwellers in the desert shall bow before him, and his enemies shall lick the dust.
texts.psa.72.10: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer tribute:
texts.psa.72.11: Yea, all kings shall bow down before him; all nations shall serve him.
texts.psa.72.12: For he will deliver the needy who crieth, and the afflicted, who hath no helper;
texts.psa.72.13: He will have compassion on the poor and needy, and will save the souls of the needy:
texts.psa.72.14: He will redeem their souls from oppression and violence, and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
texts.psa.72.15: And he shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually: all the day shall he be blessed.
texts.psa.72.16: There shall be abundance of corn in the earth, upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon; and they of the city shall bloom like the herb of the earth.
texts.psa.72.17: His name shall endure for ever; his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and [men] shall bless themselves in him; all nations shall call him blessed.
texts.psa.72.18: Blessed be Jehovah Elohim, the God of Israel, who alone doeth wondrous things!
texts.psa.72.19: And blessed be his glorious name for ever! and let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen, and Amen.
texts.psa.72.20: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
texts.psa.73.1: {A Psalm of Asaph.} Truly God is good to Israel, to such as are of a pure heart.
texts.psa.73.2: But as for me, my feet were almost gone, my steps had well nigh slipped;
texts.psa.73.3: For I was envious at the arrogant, seeing the prosperity of the wicked.
texts.psa.73.4: For they have no pangs in their death, and their body is well nourished;
texts.psa.73.5: They have not the hardships of mankind, neither are they plagued like [other] men:
texts.psa.73.6: Therefore pride encompasseth them as a neck-chain, violence covereth them [as] a garment;
texts.psa.73.7: Their eyes stand out from fatness, they exceed the imaginations of their heart:
texts.psa.73.8: They mock and speak wickedly of oppression, they speak loftily:
texts.psa.73.9: They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
texts.psa.73.10: Therefore his people turn hither, and waters in fulness are wrung out to them.
texts.psa.73.11: And they say, How can ùGod know, and is there knowledge in the Most High?
texts.psa.73.12: Behold, these are the wicked, and they prosper in the world: they heap up riches.
texts.psa.73.13: Truly have I purified my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency:
texts.psa.73.14: For all the day have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
texts.psa.73.15: If I said, I will speak thus, behold, I should be faithless to the generation of thy children.
texts.psa.73.16: When I thought to be able to know this, it was a grievous task in mine eyes;
texts.psa.73.17: Until I went into the sanctuaries of ùGod; [then] understood I their end.
texts.psa.73.18: Truly thou settest them in slippery places, thou castest them down in ruins.
texts.psa.73.19: How are they suddenly made desolate! they pass away, consumed with terrors.
texts.psa.73.20: As a dream, when one awaketh, wilt thou, Lord, on arising despise their image.
texts.psa.73.21: When my heart was in a ferment, and I was pricked in my reins,
texts.psa.73.22: Then I was brutish and knew nothing; I was [as] a beast with thee.
texts.psa.73.23: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden my right hand;
texts.psa.73.24: Thou wilt guide me by thy counsel, and after the glory, thou wilt receive me.
texts.psa.73.25: Whom have I in the heavens? and there is none upon earth I desire beside thee.
texts.psa.73.26: My flesh and my heart faileth: God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.
texts.psa.73.27: For behold, they that are far from thee shall perish; thou destroyest every one that goeth a whoring from thee.
texts.psa.73.28: But as for me, it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord Jehovah, that I may declare all thy works.
texts.psa.74.1: {An instruction: of Asaph.} Why, O God, hast thou cast off for ever? [why] doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
texts.psa.74.2: Remember thine assembly, which thou hast purchased of old, which thou hast redeemed [to be] the portion of thine inheritance, this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
texts.psa.74.3: Lift up thy steps unto the perpetual desolations: everything in the sanctuary hath the enemy destroyed.
texts.psa.74.4: Thine adversaries roar in the midst of thy place of assembly; they set up their signs [for] signs.
texts.psa.74.5: [A man] was known as he could lift up axes in the thicket of trees;
texts.psa.74.6: And now they break down its carved work altogether, with hatchets and hammers.
texts.psa.74.7: They have set on fire thy sanctuary, they have profaned the habitation of thy name to the ground.
texts.psa.74.8: They said in their heart, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all ùGod's places of assembly in the land.
texts.psa.74.9: We see not our signs; there is no more any prophet, neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
texts.psa.74.10: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy contemn thy name for ever?
texts.psa.74.11: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, and thy right hand? [pluck it] out of thy bosom: consume [them].
texts.psa.74.12: But God is my king of old, accomplishing deliverances in the midst of the earth.
texts.psa.74.13: *Thou* didst divide the sea by thy strength; thou didst break the heads of the monsters on the waters:
texts.psa.74.14: *Thou* didst break in pieces the heads of leviathan, thou gavest him to be meat to those that people the desert.
texts.psa.74.15: *Thou* didst cleave fountain and torrent, *thou* driedst up ever-flowing rivers.
texts.psa.74.16: The day is thine, the night also is thine; *thou* hast prepared the moon and the sun:
texts.psa.74.17: *Thou* hast set all the borders of the earth; summer and winter -- *thou* didst form them.
texts.psa.74.18: Remember this, that an enemy hath reproached Jehovah, and a foolish people have contemned thy name.
texts.psa.74.19: Give not up the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; forget not the troop of thine afflicted for ever.
texts.psa.74.20: Have respect unto the covenant; for the dark places of the earth are full of the dwellings of violence.
texts.psa.74.21: Oh let not the oppressed one return ashamed; let the afflicted and needy praise thy name.
texts.psa.74.22: Rise up, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day;
texts.psa.74.23: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: the tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.
texts.psa.75.1: {To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.} Unto thee we give thanks, O God, we give thanks; and thy name is near: thy marvellous works declare it.
texts.psa.75.2: When I shall receive the assembly, I will judge with equity.
texts.psa.75.3: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have established its pillars. Selah.
texts.psa.75.4: I said unto the boastful, Boast not; and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
texts.psa.75.5: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not arrogantly with a [stiff] neck.
texts.psa.75.6: For not from the east nor from the west, nor yet from the south doth exaltation [come]:
texts.psa.75.7: For God is the judge; he putteth down one and exalteth another.
texts.psa.75.8: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and it foameth with wine, it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same; yea, the dregs thereof shall all the wicked of the earth drain off, [and] drink.
texts.psa.75.9: But as for me, I will declare for ever; I will sing psalms to the God of Jacob.
texts.psa.75.10: And all the horns of the wicked will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
texts.psa.76.1: {To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.} In Judah is God known, his name is great in Israel;
texts.psa.76.2: And in Salem is his tent, and his dwelling-place in Zion.
texts.psa.76.3: There broke he the flashings of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.
texts.psa.76.4: More glorious art thou, more excellent, than the mountains of prey.
texts.psa.76.5: The stout-hearted are made a spoil, they have slept their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.
texts.psa.76.6: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
texts.psa.76.7: Thou, thou art to be feared, and who can stand before thee when once thou art angry?
texts.psa.76.8: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from the heavens; the earth feared, and was still,
texts.psa.76.9: When God rose up to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
texts.psa.76.10: For the fury of man shall praise thee; the remainder of fury wilt thou gird on thyself.
texts.psa.76.11: Vow and pay unto Jehovah your God: let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that is to be feared.
texts.psa.76.12: He cutteth off the spirit of princes; [he] is terrible to the kings of the earth.
texts.psa.77.1: {To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.} My voice is unto God, and I will cry; my voice is unto God, and he will give ear unto me.
texts.psa.77.2: In the day of my trouble, I sought the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; my soul refused to be comforted.
texts.psa.77.3: I remembered God, and I moaned; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
texts.psa.77.4: Thou holdest open mine eyelids; I am full of disquiet and cannot speak.
texts.psa.77.5: I consider the days of old, the years of ancient times.
texts.psa.77.6: I remember my song in the night; I muse in mine own heart, and my spirit maketh diligent search.
texts.psa.77.7: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
texts.psa.77.8: Hath his loving-kindness ceased for ever? hath [his] word come to an end from generation to generation?
texts.psa.77.9: Hath ùGod forgotten to be gracious? or hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
texts.psa.77.10: Then said I, This is my weakness: -- the years of the right hand of the Most High
texts.psa.77.11: Will I remember, -- the works of Jah; for I will remember thy wonders of old,
texts.psa.77.12: And I will meditate upon all thy work, and muse upon thy doings.
texts.psa.77.13: O God, thy way is in the sanctuary: who is so great a ùgod as God?
texts.psa.77.14: Thou art the ùGod that doest wonders; thou hast declared thy strength among the peoples.
texts.psa.77.15: Thou hast with [thine] arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
texts.psa.77.16: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they trembled, yea, the depths were troubled:
texts.psa.77.17: The thick clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound, yea, thine arrows went abroad:
texts.psa.77.18: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind, lightnings lit up the world; the earth was troubled and it quaked.
texts.psa.77.19: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths are in the great waters; and thy footsteps are not known.
texts.psa.77.20: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
texts.psa.78.1: {An instruction. Of Asaph.} Give ear, O my people, to my law; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
texts.psa.78.2: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter riddles from of old,
texts.psa.78.3: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us:
texts.psa.78.4: We will not hide [them] from their sons, shewing forth to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, and his strength, and his marvellous works which he hath done.
texts.psa.78.5: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
texts.psa.78.6: That the generation to come might know [them], the children that should be born; that they might rise up and tell [them] to their children,
texts.psa.78.7: And that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of ùGod, but observe his commandments;
texts.psa.78.8: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that prepared not their heart, and whose spirit was not stedfast with ùGod.
texts.psa.78.9: The sons of Ephraim, armed bowmen, turned back in the day of battle.
texts.psa.78.10: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
texts.psa.78.11: And forgot his doings, and his marvellous works which he had shewn them.
texts.psa.78.12: In the sight of their fathers had he done wonders, in the land of Egypt, the field of Zoan.
texts.psa.78.13: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; and made the waters to stand as a heap;
texts.psa.78.14: And he led them with a cloud in the daytime, and all the night with the light of fire.
texts.psa.78.15: He clave rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as out of the depths, abundantly;
texts.psa.78.16: And he brought streams out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
texts.psa.78.17: Yet they still went on sinning against him, provoking the Most High in the desert;
texts.psa.78.18: And they tempted ùGod in their heart, by asking meat for their lust;
texts.psa.78.19: And they spoke against God: they said, Is ùGod able to prepare a table in the wilderness?
texts.psa.78.20: Behold, he smote the rock, and waters gushed out, and streams overflowed; is he able to give bread also, or provide flesh for his people?
texts.psa.78.21: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; and fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also went up against Israel:
texts.psa.78.22: Because they believed not in God, and confided not in his salvation;
texts.psa.78.23: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens,
texts.psa.78.24: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them the corn of the heavens.
texts.psa.78.25: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; he sent them provision to the full.
texts.psa.78.26: He caused the east wind to rise in the heavens, and by his strength he brought the south wind;
texts.psa.78.27: And he rained flesh upon them as dust, and feathered fowl as the sand of the seas,
texts.psa.78.28: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations:
texts.psa.78.29: And they did eat, and were well filled; for that they lusted after, he brought to them.
texts.psa.78.30: They were not alienated from their lust, their meat was yet in their mouths,
texts.psa.78.31: When the anger of God went up against them; and he slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
texts.psa.78.32: For all this, they sinned still, and believed not in his marvellous works;
texts.psa.78.33: And he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
texts.psa.78.34: When he slew them, then they sought him, and returned and sought early after ùGod;
texts.psa.78.35: And they remembered that God was their rock, and ùGod, the Most High, their redeemer.
texts.psa.78.36: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied unto him with their tongue;
texts.psa.78.37: For their heart was not firm toward him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
texts.psa.78.38: But he was merciful: he forgave the iniquity, and destroyed [them] not; but many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his fury:
texts.psa.78.39: And he remembered that they were flesh, a breath that passeth away and cometh not again.
texts.psa.78.40: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
texts.psa.78.41: And they turned again and tempted ùGod, and grieved the Holy One of Israel.
texts.psa.78.42: They remembered not his hand, the day when he delivered them from the oppressor,
texts.psa.78.43: How he set his signs in Egypt, and his miracles in the field of Zoan;
texts.psa.78.44: And turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, that they could not drink;
texts.psa.78.45: He sent dog-flies among them, which devoured them, and frogs, which destroyed them;
texts.psa.78.46: And he gave their increase unto the caterpillar, and their labour unto the locust;
texts.psa.78.47: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with hail-stones;
texts.psa.78.48: And he delivered up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to thunderbolts.
texts.psa.78.49: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and distress, -- a mission of angels of woes.
texts.psa.78.50: He made a way for his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
texts.psa.78.51: And he smote all the firstborn in Egypt, the first-fruits of their vigour in the tents of Ham.
texts.psa.78.52: And he made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock;
texts.psa.78.53: And he led them safely, so that they were without fear; and the sea covered their enemies.
texts.psa.78.54: And he brought them to his holy border, this mountain, which his right hand purchased;
texts.psa.78.55: And he drove out the nations before them, and allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
texts.psa.78.56: But they tempted and provoked God, the Most High, and kept not his testimonies,
texts.psa.78.57: And they drew back and dealt treacherously like their fathers: they turned like a deceitful bow.
texts.psa.78.58: And they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
texts.psa.78.59: God heard, and was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
texts.psa.78.60: And he forsook the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent where he had dwelt among men,
texts.psa.78.61: And gave his strength into captivity, and his glory into the hand of the oppressor;
texts.psa.78.62: And delivered up his people unto the sword, and was very wroth with his inheritance:
texts.psa.78.63: The fire consumed their young men, and their maidens were not praised in [nuptial] song;
texts.psa.78.64: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows made no lamentation.
texts.psa.78.65: Then the Lord awoke as one out of sleep, like a mighty man that shouteth aloud by reason of wine;
texts.psa.78.66: And he smote his adversaries in the hinder part, and put them to everlasting reproach.
texts.psa.78.67: And he rejected the tent of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim,
texts.psa.78.68: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved;
texts.psa.78.69: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he hath founded for ever.
texts.psa.78.70: And he chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
texts.psa.78.71: From following the suckling-ewes, he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
texts.psa.78.72: And he fed them according to the integrity of his heart, and led them by the skilfulness of his hands.
texts.psa.79.1: {A Psalm of Asaph.} O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance: thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
texts.psa.79.2: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowl of the heavens, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth:
texts.psa.79.3: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem, and there was none to bury [them].
texts.psa.79.4: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and a derision to them that are round about us.
texts.psa.79.5: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
texts.psa.79.6: Pour out thy fury upon the nations that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name:
texts.psa.79.7: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his habitation.
texts.psa.79.8: Remember not against us the iniquities of [our] forefathers; let thy tender mercies speedily come to meet us: for we are brought very low.
texts.psa.79.9: Help us, O God of our salvation, because of the glory of thy name; and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.
texts.psa.79.10: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants that is shed be known among the nations in our sight.
texts.psa.79.11: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thine arm, preserve those that are appointed to die;
texts.psa.79.12: And render unto our neighbours, sevenfold into their bosom, their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
texts.psa.79.13: And we, thy people and the sheep of thy pasture, will give thanks unto thee for ever; we will shew forth thy praise from generation to generation.
texts.psa.80.1: {To the chief Musician. On Shoshannim-Eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm.} Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that sittest [between] the cherubim, shine forth.
texts.psa.80.2: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy strength, and come to our deliverance.
texts.psa.80.3: O God, restore us; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.4: Jehovah, God of hosts, how long will thine anger smoke against the prayer of thy people?
texts.psa.80.5: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure:
texts.psa.80.6: Thou hast made us a strife unto our neighbours, and our enemies mock among themselves.
texts.psa.80.7: Restore us, O God of hosts; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.80.8: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt; thou didst cast out the nations, and plant it:
texts.psa.80.9: Thou preparedst space before it, and it took deep root, and filled the land;
texts.psa.80.10: The mountains were covered with its shadow, and the branches thereof were [like] cedars of ùGod;
texts.psa.80.11: It sent out its boughs unto the sea, and its shoots unto the river.
texts.psa.80.12: Why hast thou broken down its fences, so that all who pass by the way do pluck it?
texts.psa.80.13: The boar out of the forest doth waste it, and the beast of the field doth feed off it.
texts.psa.80.14: O God of hosts, return, we beseech thee; look down from the heavens, and behold, and visit this vine;
texts.psa.80.15: Even the stock which thy right hand hath planted, and the young plant thou madest strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.16: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
texts.psa.80.17: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou hast made strong for thyself.
texts.psa.80.18: So will we not go back from thee. Revive us, and we will call upon thy name.
texts.psa.80.19: Restore us, O Jehovah, God of hosts; cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
texts.psa.81.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.} Sing ye joyously unto God our strength, shout aloud unto the God of Jacob;
texts.psa.81.2: Raise a song, and sound the tambour, the pleasant harp with the lute.
texts.psa.81.3: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the set time, on our feast day:
texts.psa.81.4: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob;
texts.psa.81.5: He ordained it in Joseph [for] a testimony, when he went forth over the land of Egypt, [where] I heard a language that I knew not.
texts.psa.81.6: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
texts.psa.81.7: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
texts.psa.81.8: Hear, my people, and I will testify unto thee; O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!
texts.psa.81.9: There shall no strange ùgod be in thee, neither shalt thou worship any foreign ùgod.
texts.psa.81.10: I am Jehovah thy God, that brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
texts.psa.81.11: But my people hearkened not to my voice, and Israel would none of me.
texts.psa.81.12: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' stubbornness: they walked after their own counsels.
texts.psa.81.13: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, that Israel had walked in my ways!
texts.psa.81.14: I would soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
texts.psa.81.15: The haters of Jehovah would have come cringing unto him; but their time would have been for ever.
texts.psa.81.16: And he would have fed them with the finest of wheat; yea, with honey out of the rock would I have satisfied thee.
texts.psa.82.1: {A Psalm of Asaph.} God standeth in the assembly of ùGod, he judgeth among the gods.
texts.psa.82.2: How long will ye judge unrighteously, and accept the person of the wicked? Selah.
texts.psa.82.3: Judge the poor and the fatherless, do justice to the afflicted and the destitute;
texts.psa.82.4: Rescue the poor and needy, deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.82.5: They know not, neither do they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are moved.
texts.psa.82.6: I have said, Ye are gods, and all of you are children of the Most High;
texts.psa.82.7: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
texts.psa.82.8: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for *thou* shalt inherit all the nations.
texts.psa.83.1: {A Song; a Psalm of Asaph.} O God, keep not silence; hold not thy peace, and be not still, O ùGod:
texts.psa.83.2: For behold, thine enemies make a tumult; and they that hate thee lift up the head.
texts.psa.83.3: They take crafty counsel against thy people, and consult against thy hidden ones:
texts.psa.83.4: They say, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation, and let the name of Israel be mentioned no more.
texts.psa.83.5: For they have consulted together with one heart: they have made an alliance together against thee.
texts.psa.83.6: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagarites;
texts.psa.83.7: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia, with the inhabitants of Tyre;
texts.psa.83.8: Asshur also is joined with them: they are an arm to the sons of Lot. Selah.
texts.psa.83.9: Do unto them as to Midian; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the torrent of Kishon:
texts.psa.83.10: Who were destroyed at Endor; they became as dung for the ground.
texts.psa.83.11: Make their nobles as Oreb and as Zeeb; and all their chiefs as Zebah and as Zalmunna.
texts.psa.83.12: For they have said, Let us take to ourselves God's dwelling-places in possession.
texts.psa.83.13: O my God, make them like a whirling thing, like stubble before the wind.
texts.psa.83.14: As fire burneth a forest, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire,
texts.psa.83.15: So pursue them with thy tempest, and terrify them with thy whirlwind.
texts.psa.83.16: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.83.17: Let them be put to shame and be dismayed for ever, and let them be confounded and perish:
texts.psa.83.18: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, art the Most High over all the earth.
texts.psa.84.1: {To the chief Musician. Upon the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.} How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!
texts.psa.84.2: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living ùGod.
texts.psa.84.3: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she layeth her young, thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, my King and my God.
texts.psa.84.4: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be constantly praising thee. Selah.
texts.psa.84.5: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee, -- they, in whose heart are the highways.
texts.psa.84.6: Passing through the valley of Baca, they make it a well-spring; yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.
texts.psa.84.7: They go from strength to strength: [each one] will appear before God in Zion.
texts.psa.84.8: Jehovah, God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
texts.psa.84.9: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
texts.psa.84.10: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
texts.psa.84.11: For Jehovah Elohim is a sun and shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
texts.psa.84.12: Jehovah of hosts, blessed is the man that confideth in thee!
texts.psa.85.1: {To the chief Musician. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.} Thou hast been favourable, Jehovah, unto thy land; thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob:
texts.psa.85.2: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
texts.psa.85.3: Thou hast withdrawn all thy wrath; thou hast turned from the fierceness of thine anger.
texts.psa.85.4: Bring us back, O God of our salvation, and cause thine indignation toward us to cease.
texts.psa.85.5: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger from generation to generation?
texts.psa.85.6: Wilt thou not revive us again, that thy people may rejoice in thee?
texts.psa.85.7: Shew us thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, and grant us thy salvation.
texts.psa.85.8: I will hear what ùGod, Jehovah, will speak; for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his godly ones: but let them not turn again to folly.
texts.psa.85.9: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
texts.psa.85.10: Loving-kindness and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other:
texts.psa.85.11: Truth shall spring out of the earth, and righteousness shall look down from the heavens.
texts.psa.85.12: Jehovah also will give what is good, and our land shall yield its increase.
texts.psa.85.13: Righteousness shall go before him, and shall set his footsteps on the way.
texts.psa.86.1: {A Prayer of David.} Incline thine ear, Jehovah, answer me; for I am afflicted and needy.
texts.psa.86.2: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O thou my God, save thy servant who confideth in thee.
texts.psa.86.3: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; for unto thee do I call all the day.
texts.psa.86.4: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; for unto thee, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
texts.psa.86.5: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, and art of great loving-kindness unto all that call upon thee.
texts.psa.86.6: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer, and attend to the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.86.7: In the day of my distress I will call upon thee, for thou wilt answer me.
texts.psa.86.8: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, Lord, and there is nothing like unto thy works.
texts.psa.86.9: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord, and shall glorify thy name.
texts.psa.86.10: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God, thou alone.
texts.psa.86.11: Teach me thy way, Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
texts.psa.86.12: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
texts.psa.86.13: For great is thy loving-kindness toward me, and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
texts.psa.86.14: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of the violent seek after my soul, and they have not set thee before them.
texts.psa.86.15: But thou, Lord, art a ùGod merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in goodness and truth.
texts.psa.86.16: Turn toward me, and be gracious unto me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
texts.psa.86.17: Shew me a token for good, that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed; for thou, Jehovah, hast helped me and comforted me.
texts.psa.87.1: {Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song.} His foundation is in the mountains of holiness.
texts.psa.87.2: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion more than all the habitations of Jacob.
texts.psa.87.3: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
texts.psa.87.4: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon among them that know me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: this [man] was born there.
texts.psa.87.5: And of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; and the Most High himself shall establish her.
texts.psa.87.6: Jehovah will count, when he inscribeth the peoples, This [man] was born there. Selah.
texts.psa.87.7: As well the singers as the dancers [shall say], All my springs are in thee.
texts.psa.88.1: {A Song, a Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the chief Musician. Upon Mahalath Leannoth. An instruction. Of Heman the Ezrahite.} Jehovah, God of my salvation, I have cried by day [and] in the night before thee.
texts.psa.88.2: Let my prayer come before thee; incline thine ear unto my cry.
texts.psa.88.3: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draweth nigh to Sheol.
texts.psa.88.4: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no strength:
texts.psa.88.5: Prostrate among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave; whom thou rememberest no more, and who are cut off from thy hand.
texts.psa.88.6: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the deeps.
texts.psa.88.7: Thy fury lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.
texts.psa.88.8: Thou hast put my familiar friends far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
texts.psa.88.9: Mine eye consumeth by reason of affliction. Upon thee, Jehovah, have I called every day; I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
texts.psa.88.10: Wilt thou do wonders to the dead? shall the shades arise and praise thee? Selah.
texts.psa.88.11: Shall thy loving-kindness be declared in the grave? thy faithfulness in Destruction?
texts.psa.88.12: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
texts.psa.88.13: But as for me, Jehovah, I cry unto thee, and in the morning my prayer cometh before thee.
texts.psa.88.14: Why, O Jehovah, castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?
texts.psa.88.15: I am afflicted and expiring from my youth up; I suffer thy terrors, [and] I am distracted.
texts.psa.88.16: Thy fierce anger hath gone over me; thy terrors have brought me to nought:
texts.psa.88.17: They have surrounded me all the day like water; they have compassed me about together.
texts.psa.88.18: Lover and associate hast thou put far from me: my familiar friends are darkness.
texts.psa.89.1: {An instruction. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.} I will sing of the loving-kindness of Jehovah for ever; with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness from generation to generation.
texts.psa.89.2: For I said, Loving-kindness shall be built up for ever; in the very heavens wilt thou establish thy faithfulness.
texts.psa.89.3: I have made a covenant with mine elect, I have sworn unto David my servant:
texts.psa.89.4: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne from generation to generation. Selah.
texts.psa.89.5: And the heavens shall celebrate thy wonders, O Jehovah, and thy faithfulness in the congregation of the saints.
texts.psa.89.6: For who in the heaven can be compared to Jehovah? [who] among the sons of the mighty shall be likened to Jehovah?
texts.psa.89.7: ùGod is greatly to be feared in the council of the saints, and terrible for all that are round about him.
texts.psa.89.8: Jehovah, God of hosts, who is like unto thee, the strong Jah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.
texts.psa.89.9: *Thou* rulest the pride of the sea: when its waves arise, *thou* stillest them.
texts.psa.89.10: Thou hast crushed Rahab as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.
texts.psa.89.11: Thine are the heavens, the earth also is thine; the world and its fulness, *thou* hast founded them.
texts.psa.89.12: The north and the south, *thou* hast created them: Tabor and Hermon triumph in thy name.
texts.psa.89.13: Thine is the arm of might: strong is thy hand, high is thy right hand.
texts.psa.89.14: Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of thy throne; loving-kindness and truth go before thy face.
texts.psa.89.15: Blessed is the people that know the shout of joy: they walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.89.16: In thy name are they joyful all the day, and in thy righteousness are they exalted.
texts.psa.89.17: For thou art the glory of their strength; and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
texts.psa.89.18: For Jehovah is our shield, and the Holy One of Israel, our king.
texts.psa.89.19: Then thou spakest in vision of thy Holy One, and saidst, I have laid help upon a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
texts.psa.89.20: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
texts.psa.89.21: With whom my hand shall be established; and mine arm shall strengthen him.
texts.psa.89.22: No enemy shall exact upon him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him;
texts.psa.89.23: But I will beat down his adversaries before his face, and will smite them that hate him.
texts.psa.89.24: And my faithfulness and my loving-kindness shall be with him, and by my name shall his horn be exalted.
texts.psa.89.25: And I will set his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
texts.psa.89.26: *He* shall call unto me, Thou art my father, my ùGod, and the rock of my salvation;
texts.psa.89.27: And as to me, I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
texts.psa.89.28: My loving-kindness will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him;
texts.psa.89.29: And I will establish his seed for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
texts.psa.89.30: If his sons forsake my law, and walk not in mine ordinances;
texts.psa.89.31: If they profane my statutes, and keep not my commandments:
texts.psa.89.32: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
texts.psa.89.33: Nevertheless my loving-kindness will I not utterly take from him, nor belie my faithfulness;
texts.psa.89.34: My covenant will I not profane, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
texts.psa.89.35: Once have I sworn by my holiness; I will not lie unto David:
texts.psa.89.36: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me;
texts.psa.89.37: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and the witness in the sky is firm. Selah.
texts.psa.89.38: But thou hast rejected and cast off; thou hast been very wroth with thine anointed:
texts.psa.89.39: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant; thou hast profaned his crown to the ground:
texts.psa.89.40: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
texts.psa.89.41: All that pass by the way plunder him; he is become a reproach to his neighbours.
texts.psa.89.42: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his oppressors; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice:
texts.psa.89.43: Yea, thou hast turned back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him stand in the battle.
texts.psa.89.44: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground;
texts.psa.89.45: The days of his youth hast thou shortened; thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
texts.psa.89.46: How long, Jehovah, wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy fury burn like fire?
texts.psa.89.47: Remember, as regards me, what life is. Wherefore hast thou created all the children of men to be vanity?
texts.psa.89.48: What man liveth, and shall not see death? Shall he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
texts.psa.89.49: Where, Lord, are thy former loving-kindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?
texts.psa.89.50: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants -- that I bear in my bosom [that of] all the mighty peoples --
texts.psa.89.51: Wherewith thine enemies, O Jehovah, have reproached, wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
texts.psa.89.52: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore! Amen, and Amen.
texts.psa.90.1: {A Prayer of Moses, the man of God.} Lord, *thou* hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.
texts.psa.90.2: Before the mountains were brought forth, and thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from eternity to eternity thou art ùGod.
texts.psa.90.3: Thou makest [mortal] man to return to dust, and sayest, Return, children of men.
texts.psa.90.4: For a thousand years, in thy sight, are as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.
texts.psa.90.5: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning they are like grass [that] groweth up:
texts.psa.90.6: In the morning it flourisheth and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down and withereth.
texts.psa.90.7: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy fury are we troubled.
texts.psa.90.8: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.
texts.psa.90.9: For all our days pass away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a [passing] thought.
texts.psa.90.10: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if, by reason of strength, they be fourscore years, yet their pride is labour and vanity, for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
texts.psa.90.11: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? and thy wrath according to the fear of thee?
texts.psa.90.12: So teach [us] to number our days, that we may acquire a wise heart.
texts.psa.90.13: Return, Jehovah: how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
texts.psa.90.14: Satisfy us early with thy loving-kindness; that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
texts.psa.90.15: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, according to the years [wherein] we have seen evil.
texts.psa.90.16: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy majesty unto their sons.
texts.psa.90.17: And let the beauty of Jehovah our God be upon us; and establish thou the work of our hands upon us: yea, the work of our hands, establish thou it.
texts.psa.91.1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
texts.psa.91.2: I say of Jehovah, My refuge and my fortress; my God, I will confide in him.
texts.psa.91.3: Surely *he* shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the destructive pestilence.
texts.psa.91.4: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou find refuge: his truth is a shield and buckler.
texts.psa.91.5: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, for the arrow that flieth by day,
texts.psa.91.6: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
texts.psa.91.7: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.
texts.psa.91.8: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, and see the reward of the wicked.
texts.psa.91.9: Because *thou* hast made Jehovah, my refuge, the Most High, thy dwelling-place,
texts.psa.91.10: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
texts.psa.91.11: For he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways:
texts.psa.91.12: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
texts.psa.91.13: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and the adder; the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under foot.
texts.psa.91.14: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
texts.psa.91.15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honour him.
texts.psa.91.16: With length of days will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
texts.psa.92.1: {A Psalm, a Song, for the Sabbath day.} It is good to give thanks unto Jehovah, and to sing psalms unto thy name, O Most High;
texts.psa.92.2: To declare thy loving-kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness in the nights,
texts.psa.92.3: Upon an instrument of ten strings and upon the lute; upon the Higgaion with the harp.
texts.psa.92.4: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work; I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
texts.psa.92.5: Jehovah, how great are thy works! Thy thoughts are very deep:
texts.psa.92.6: A brutish man knoweth not, neither doth a fool understand it.
texts.psa.92.7: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity flourish, it is that they may be destroyed for ever.
texts.psa.92.8: And thou, Jehovah, art on high for evermore.
texts.psa.92.9: For lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, for lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
texts.psa.92.10: But my horn shalt thou exalt like a buffalo's: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
texts.psa.92.11: And mine eye shall see [its desire] on mine enemies; mine ears shall hear [it] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
texts.psa.92.12: The righteous shall shoot forth like a palm-tree; he shall grow like a cedar on Lebanon.
texts.psa.92.13: Those that are planted in the house of Jehovah shall flourish in the courts of our God:
texts.psa.92.14: They are still vigorous in old age, they are full of sap and green;
texts.psa.92.15: To shew that Jehovah is upright: [he is] my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
texts.psa.93.1: Jehovah reigneth, he hath clothed himself with majesty: Jehovah hath clothed himself, he hath girded himself with strength; yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved.
texts.psa.93.2: Thy throne is established of old; thou art from eternity.
texts.psa.93.3: The floods lifted up, O Jehovah, the floods lifted up their voice; the floods lifted up their roaring waves.
texts.psa.93.4: Jehovah on high is mightier than the voices of many waters, than the mighty breakers of the sea.
texts.psa.93.5: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for ever.
texts.psa.94.1: O ùGod of vengeances, Jehovah, ùGod of vengeances, shine forth;
texts.psa.94.2: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth, render the reward to the proud.
texts.psa.94.3: How long shall the wicked, O Jehovah, how long shall the wicked triumph?
texts.psa.94.4: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak insolence -- all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
texts.psa.94.5: They crush thy people, O Jehovah, and afflict thine inheritance;
texts.psa.94.6: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless,
texts.psa.94.7: And say, Jah will not see, neither will the God of Jacob regard [it].
texts.psa.94.8: Understand, ye brutish among the people; and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
texts.psa.94.9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
texts.psa.94.10: He that instructeth the nations, shall not he correct -- he that teacheth man knowledge?
texts.psa.94.11: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
texts.psa.94.12: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jah, and whom thou teachest out of thy law;
texts.psa.94.13: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
texts.psa.94.14: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance;
texts.psa.94.15: For judgment shall return unto righteousness, and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
texts.psa.94.16: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
texts.psa.94.17: If Jehovah had not been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
texts.psa.94.18: When I said, My foot slippeth, thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
texts.psa.94.19: In the multitude of my anxious thoughts within me thy comforts have delighted my soul.
texts.psa.94.20: Shall the throne of wickedness be united to thee, which frameth mischief into a law?
texts.psa.94.21: They band together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.
texts.psa.94.22: But Jehovah will be my high tower; and my God the rock of my refuge.
texts.psa.94.23: And he will bring upon them their iniquity, and will cut them off in their own evil: Jehovah our God will cut them off.
texts.psa.95.1: Come, let us sing aloud to Jehovah, let us shout for joy to the rock of our salvation;
texts.psa.95.2: Let us come before his face with thanksgiving; let us shout aloud unto him with psalms.
texts.psa.95.3: For Jehovah is a great ùGod, and a great king above all gods.
texts.psa.95.4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his also:
texts.psa.95.5: The sea is his, and he made it, and his hands formed the dry [land].
texts.psa.95.6: Come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker.
texts.psa.95.7: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand. To-day if ye hear his voice,
texts.psa.95.8: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, as [in] the day of Massah, in the wilderness;
texts.psa.95.9: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
texts.psa.95.10: Forty years was I grieved with the generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways;
texts.psa.95.11: So that I swore in mine anger, that they should not enter into my rest.
texts.psa.96.1: Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.2: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; publish his salvation from day to day.
texts.psa.96.3: Declare his glory among the nations, his wondrous works among all the peoples.
texts.psa.96.4: For Jehovah is great and exceedingly to be praised; he is terrible above all gods.
texts.psa.96.5: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; but Jehovah made the heavens.
texts.psa.96.6: Majesty and splendour are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
texts.psa.96.7: Give unto Jehovah, ye families of peoples, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;
texts.psa.96.8: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; bring an oblation and come into his courts;
texts.psa.96.9: Worship Jehovah in holy splendour; tremble before him, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.10: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth! yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved; he will execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.
texts.psa.96.11: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
texts.psa.96.12: Let the field exult and all that is therein. Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy,
texts.psa.96.13: Before Jehovah, for he cometh; for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.
texts.psa.97.1: Jehovah reigneth: let the earth be glad, let the many isles rejoice.
texts.psa.97.2: Clouds and darkness are round about him; righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.
texts.psa.97.3: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his adversaries round about.
texts.psa.97.4: His lightnings lightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
texts.psa.97.5: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
texts.psa.97.6: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.
texts.psa.97.7: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols. Worship him, all ye gods.
texts.psa.97.8: Zion heard, and rejoiced; and the daughters of Judah were glad, because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.97.9: For thou, Jehovah, art the Most High above all the earth; thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.
texts.psa.97.10: Ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints, he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
texts.psa.97.11: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
texts.psa.97.12: Rejoice in Jehovah, ye righteous; and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.
texts.psa.98.1: {A Psalm.} Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: for he hath done wondrous things; his right hand and his holy arm hath wrought salvation for him.
texts.psa.98.2: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the nations.
texts.psa.98.3: He hath remembered his loving-kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
texts.psa.98.4: Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth; break forth and shout for joy, and sing psalms.
texts.psa.98.5: Sing psalms unto Jehovah with the harp: with the harp, and the voice of a song;
texts.psa.98.6: With trumpets and sound of cornet, make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
texts.psa.98.7: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein;
texts.psa.98.8: Let the floods clap [their] hands; let the mountains sing for joy together,
texts.psa.98.9: Before Jehovah, for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
texts.psa.99.1: Jehovah reigneth: let the peoples tremble. He sitteth [between the] cherubim: let the earth be moved.
texts.psa.99.2: Jehovah is great in Zion, and he is high above all the peoples.
texts.psa.99.3: They shall praise thy great and terrible name, -- it is holy! --
texts.psa.99.4: And the strength of the king that loveth justice. *Thou* hast established equity: it is thou that executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
texts.psa.99.5: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at his footstool. He is holy!
texts.psa.99.6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name: they called unto Jehovah, and *he* answered them.
texts.psa.99.7: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud: they kept his testimonies, and the statute that he gave them.
texts.psa.99.8: Jehovah, our God, *thou* answeredst them: a forgiving ùGod wast thou unto them, though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
texts.psa.99.9: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at the hill of his holiness; for holy is Jehovah our God.
texts.psa.100.1: {A Psalm of thanksgiving.} Shout aloud unto Jehovah, all the earth!
texts.psa.100.2: Serve Jehovah with joy: come before his presence with exultation.
texts.psa.100.3: Know that Jehovah is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
texts.psa.100.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving [and] into his courts with praise; give thanks unto him, bless his name:
texts.psa.100.5: For Jehovah is good; his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever; and his faithfulness from generation to generation.
texts.psa.101.1: {A Psalm of David.} I will sing of loving-kindness and judgment: unto thee, Jehovah, will I sing psalms.
texts.psa.101.2: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. When wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.
texts.psa.101.3: I will set no thing of Belial before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
texts.psa.101.4: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know evil.
texts.psa.101.5: Whoso secretly slandereth his neighbour, him will I destroy; him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
texts.psa.101.6: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
texts.psa.101.7: He that practiseth deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehoods shall not subsist in my sight.
texts.psa.101.8: Every morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land: to cut off all workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.1: {A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.} Jehovah, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto thee.
texts.psa.102.2: Hide not thy face from me: in the day of my trouble, incline thine ear unto me; in the day I call, answer me speedily.
texts.psa.102.3: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a firebrand.
texts.psa.102.4: My heart is smitten and withered like grass; yea, I have forgotten to eat my bread.
texts.psa.102.5: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my flesh.
texts.psa.102.6: I am become like the pelican of the wilderness, I am as an owl in desolate places;
texts.psa.102.7: I watch, and am like a sparrow alone upon the housetop.
texts.psa.102.8: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; they that are mad against me swear by me.
texts.psa.102.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
texts.psa.102.10: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath; for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
texts.psa.102.11: My days are like a lengthened-out shadow, and I, I am withered like grass.
texts.psa.102.12: But thou, Jehovah, abidest for ever, and thy memorial from generation to generation.
texts.psa.102.13: *Thou* wilt rise up, thou wilt have mercy upon Zion: for it is the time to be gracious to her, for the set time is come.
texts.psa.102.14: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour her dust.
texts.psa.102.15: And the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
texts.psa.102.16: When Jehovah shall build up Zion, he will appear in his glory.
texts.psa.102.17: He will regard the prayer of the destitute one, and not despise their prayer.
texts.psa.102.18: This shall be written for the generation to come; and a people that shall be created shall praise Jah:
texts.psa.102.19: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from the heavens hath Jehovah beheld the earth,
texts.psa.102.20: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, to loose those that are appointed to die;
texts.psa.102.21: That the name of Jehovah may be declared in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
texts.psa.102.22: When the peoples shall be gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.23: He weakened my strength in the way, he shortened my days.
texts.psa.102.24: I said, My ùGod, take me not away in the midst of my days! ... Thy years are from generation to generation.
texts.psa.102.25: Of old hast thou founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of thy hands:
texts.psa.102.26: *They* shall perish, but *thou* continuest; and all of them shall grow old as a garment: as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed.
texts.psa.102.27: But thou art the Same, and thy years shall have no end.
texts.psa.102.28: The children of thy servants shall abide, and their seed shall be established before thee.
texts.psa.103.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Bless Jehovah, O my soul; and all that is within me, [bless] his holy name!
texts.psa.103.2: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
texts.psa.103.3: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases;
texts.psa.103.4: Who redeemeth thy life from the pit, who crowneth thee with loving-kindness and tender mercies;
texts.psa.103.5: Who satisfieth thine old age with good [things]; thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
texts.psa.103.6: Jehovah executeth righteousness and justice for all that are oppressed.
texts.psa.103.7: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
texts.psa.103.8: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving-kindness.
texts.psa.103.9: He will not always chide, neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.
texts.psa.103.10: He hath not dealt with us according to our sins, nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
texts.psa.103.11: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving-kindness toward them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.12: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
texts.psa.103.13: As a father pitieth [his] children, so Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
texts.psa.103.14: For himself knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
texts.psa.103.15: As for man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth:
texts.psa.103.16: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone, and the place thereof knoweth it no more.
texts.psa.103.17: But the loving-kindness of Jehovah is from everlasting and to everlasting, upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children,
texts.psa.103.18: To such as keep his covenant and to those that remember his precepts to do them.
texts.psa.103.19: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom ruleth over all.
texts.psa.103.20: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, mighty in strength, that execute his word, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
texts.psa.103.21: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his that do his will.
texts.psa.103.22: Bless Jehovah, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless Jehovah, O my soul!
texts.psa.104.1: Bless Jehovah, O my soul! Jehovah my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with majesty and splendour;
texts.psa.104.2: Covering thyself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent-curtain; --
texts.psa.104.3: Who layeth the beams of his upper chambers in the waters, who maketh clouds his chariot, who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
texts.psa.104.4: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flame of fire.
texts.psa.104.5: He laid the earth upon its foundations: it shall not be removed for ever.
texts.psa.104.6: Thou hadst covered it with the deep, as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains:
texts.psa.104.7: At thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away; --
texts.psa.104.8: The mountains rose, the valleys sank, unto the place which thou hadst founded for them; --
texts.psa.104.9: Thou hast set a bound which they may not pass over, that they turn not again to cover the earth.
texts.psa.104.10: He sendeth the springs into the valleys: they run among the mountains;
texts.psa.104.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses quench their thirst.
texts.psa.104.12: The birds of heaven dwell by them; they give forth their voice from among the branches.
texts.psa.104.13: He watereth the mountains from his upper-chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
texts.psa.104.14: He maketh the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man; bringing forth bread out of the earth,
texts.psa.104.15: And wine which gladdeneth the heart of man; making [his] face shine with oil; and with bread he strengtheneth man's heart.
texts.psa.104.16: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted,
texts.psa.104.17: Where the birds make their nests; [as for] the stork, the fir trees are her house.
texts.psa.104.18: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the cliffs, a refuge for the rock-badgers.
texts.psa.104.19: He made the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth its going down.
texts.psa.104.20: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth:
texts.psa.104.21: The young lions roar after the prey, and to seek their food from ùGod.
texts.psa.104.22: The sun ariseth, they retreat, and lay them down in their dens.
texts.psa.104.23: Man goeth forth unto his work, and to his labour until the evening.
texts.psa.104.24: How manifold are thy works, O Jehovah! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
texts.psa.104.25: Yonder is the great and wide sea: therein are moving things innumerable, living creatures small and great.
texts.psa.104.26: There go the ships; [there] that leviathan, which thou hast formed to play therein.
texts.psa.104.27: These all look unto thee, that thou mayest give their food in its season:
texts.psa.104.28: That thou givest unto them, they gather; thou openest thy hand, they are filled with good.
texts.psa.104.29: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; thou takest away their breath, they expire and return to their dust.
texts.psa.104.30: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created, and thou renewest the face of the earth.
texts.psa.104.31: The glory of Jehovah will endure for ever; Jehovah will rejoice in his works.
texts.psa.104.32: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
texts.psa.104.33: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live; I will sing psalms to my God while I have my being.
texts.psa.104.34: My meditation shall be pleasant unto him; I will rejoice in Jehovah.
