texts.psa.104.35: Sinners shall be consumed out of the earth, and the wicked shall be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.105.1: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; make known his acts among the peoples.
texts.psa.105.2: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him; meditate upon all his wondrous works.
texts.psa.105.3: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
texts.psa.105.4: Seek Jehovah and his strength, seek his face continually;
texts.psa.105.5: Remember his wondrous works which he hath done, his miracles and the judgments of his mouth:
texts.psa.105.6: Ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
texts.psa.105.7: He, Jehovah, is our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
texts.psa.105.8: He is ever mindful of his covenant, -- the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, --
texts.psa.105.9: Which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
texts.psa.105.10: And he confirmed it unto Jacob for a statute, unto Israel for an everlasting covenant,
texts.psa.105.11: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
texts.psa.105.12: When they were a few men in number, of small account, and strangers in it.
texts.psa.105.13: And they went from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
texts.psa.105.14: He suffered no man to oppress them, and reproved kings for their sakes,
texts.psa.105.15: [Saying,] Touch not mine anointed ones, and do my prophets no harm.
texts.psa.105.16: And he called for a famine upon the land; he broke the whole staff of bread.
texts.psa.105.17: He sent a man before them: Joseph was sold for a bondman.
texts.psa.105.18: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his soul came into irons;
texts.psa.105.19: Until the time when what he said came about: the word of Jehovah tried him.
texts.psa.105.20: The king sent and loosed him -- the ruler of peoples -- and let him go free.
texts.psa.105.21: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over all his possessions:
texts.psa.105.22: To bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.
texts.psa.105.23: And Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.24: And he made his people exceeding fruitful, and made them mightier than their oppressors.
texts.psa.105.25: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
texts.psa.105.26: He sent Moses his servant, [and] Aaron whom he had chosen:
texts.psa.105.27: They set his signs among them, and miracles in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
texts.psa.105.29: He turned their waters into blood, and caused their fish to die.
texts.psa.105.30: Their land swarmed with frogs, -- in the chambers of their kings.
texts.psa.105.31: He spoke, and there came dog-flies, [and] gnats in all their borders.
texts.psa.105.32: He gave them hail for rain, [and] flaming fire in their land;
texts.psa.105.33: And he smote their vines and their fig-trees, and broke the trees of their borders.
texts.psa.105.34: He spoke, and the locust came, and the cankerworm, even without number;
texts.psa.105.35: And they devoured every herb in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
texts.psa.105.36: And he smote every firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigour.
texts.psa.105.37: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; and there was not one feeble among their tribes.
texts.psa.105.38: Egypt rejoiced at their departure; for the fear of them had fallen upon them.
texts.psa.105.39: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light in the night.
texts.psa.105.40: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
texts.psa.105.41: He opened the rock, and waters gushed forth; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.
texts.psa.105.42: For he remembered his holy word, [and] Abraham his servant;
texts.psa.105.43: And he brought forth his people with gladness, his chosen with rejoicing;
texts.psa.105.44: And he gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the labour of the peoples:
texts.psa.105.45: That they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.106.1: Hallelujah! Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.106.2: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? [who] can shew forth all his praise?
texts.psa.106.3: Blessed are they that keep justice, [and] he that doeth righteousness at all times.
texts.psa.106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, with [thy] favour toward thy people; visit me with thy salvation:
texts.psa.106.5: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the joy of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
texts.psa.106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
texts.psa.106.7: Our fathers in Egypt considered not thy wondrous works; they remembered not the multitude of thy loving-kindnesses; but they rebelled at the sea, at the Red Sea.
texts.psa.106.8: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his might.
texts.psa.106.9: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; and he led them through the deeps as through a wilderness.
texts.psa.106.10: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated [them], and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
texts.psa.106.11: And the waters covered their oppressors: there was not one of them left.
texts.psa.106.12: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
texts.psa.106.13: They soon forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel:
texts.psa.106.14: And they lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted ùGod in the desert.
texts.psa.106.15: Then he gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
texts.psa.106.16: And they envied Moses in the camp, [and] Aaron, the saint of Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram;
texts.psa.106.18: And fire was kindled in their company; a flame burned up the wicked.
texts.psa.106.19: They made a calf in Horeb, and did homage to a molten image;
texts.psa.106.20: And they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
texts.psa.106.21: They forgot ùGod their Saviour, who had done great things in Egypt,
texts.psa.106.22: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, terrible things by the Red Sea.
texts.psa.106.23: And he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses, his chosen, stood before him in the breach, to turn away his fury, lest he should destroy [them].
texts.psa.106.24: And they despised the pleasant land; they believed not his word,
texts.psa.106.25: But murmured in their tents: they hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.26: And he lifted up his hand to them, that he would make them fall in the wilderness;
texts.psa.106.27: And that he would make their seed fall among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.
texts.psa.106.28: And they joined themselves unto Baal-Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead;
texts.psa.106.29: And they provoked [him] to anger with their doings; and a plague broke out among them.
texts.psa.106.30: Then stood up Phinehas and executed judgment, and the plague was stayed;
texts.psa.106.31: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, from generation to generation, for evermore.
texts.psa.106.32: And they moved him to wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses on their account;
texts.psa.106.33: For they provoked his spirit, so that he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.
texts.psa.106.34: They did not destroy the peoples, as Jehovah commanded them;
texts.psa.106.35: But they mingled with the nations, and learned their works;
texts.psa.106.36: And they served their idols; and they were a snare unto them:
texts.psa.106.37: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
texts.psa.106.38: And shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.
texts.psa.106.39: And they were defiled with their works, and went a-whoring in their doings.
texts.psa.106.40: Then was the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance;
texts.psa.106.41: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them:
texts.psa.106.42: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
texts.psa.106.43: Often did he deliver them; but as for them they provoked [him] by their counsel, and they were brought low by their iniquity.
texts.psa.106.44: But he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry;
texts.psa.106.45: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses;
texts.psa.106.46: And he caused them to find compassion of all those that had carried them captives.
texts.psa.106.47: Save us, Jehovah our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks unto thy holy name, [and] to triumph in thy praise.
texts.psa.106.48: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity! And let all the people say, Amen! Hallelujah!
texts.psa.107.1: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.107.2: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the oppressor,
texts.psa.107.3: And gathered out of the countries, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.
texts.psa.107.4: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way, they found no city of habitation;
texts.psa.107.5: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them:
texts.psa.107.6: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he delivered them out of their distresses,
texts.psa.107.7: And he led them forth by a right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.8: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;
texts.psa.107.9: For he hath satisfied the longing soul and filled the hungry soul with good.
texts.psa.107.10: Such as inhabit darkness and the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron,
texts.psa.107.11: Because they had rebelled against the words of ùGod, and had despised the counsel of the Most High; ...
texts.psa.107.12: And he bowed down their heart with labour; they stumbled, and there was none to help:
texts.psa.107.13: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saved them out of their distresses;
texts.psa.107.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands in sunder.
texts.psa.107.15: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;
texts.psa.107.16: For he hath broken the gates of bronze, and cut asunder the bars of iron.
texts.psa.107.17: Fools, because of their way of transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted;
texts.psa.107.18: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food, and they draw near unto the gates of death:
texts.psa.107.19: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, [and] he saveth them out of their distresses;
texts.psa.107.20: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, and delivereth them from their destructions.
texts.psa.107.21: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men,
texts.psa.107.22: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works in joyful song.
texts.psa.107.23: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters,
texts.psa.107.24: These see the works of Jehovah, and his wonders in the deep.
texts.psa.107.25: For he speaketh, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof:
texts.psa.107.26: They mount up to the heavens, they go down to the depths; their soul is melted because of trouble;
texts.psa.107.27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and they are at their wits' end:
texts.psa.107.28: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses;
texts.psa.107.29: He maketh the storm a calm, and the waves thereof are still:
texts.psa.107.30: And they rejoice because they are quiet; and he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
texts.psa.107.31: Let them give thanks unto Jehovah for his loving-kindness, and for his wondrous works to the children of men;
texts.psa.107.32: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the session of the elders.
texts.psa.107.33: He maketh rivers into a wilderness, and water-springs into dry ground;
texts.psa.107.34: A fruitful land into a plain of salt, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
texts.psa.107.35: He maketh the wilderness into a pool of water, and the dry land into water-springs;
texts.psa.107.36: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city of habitation;
texts.psa.107.37: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase;
texts.psa.107.38: And he blesseth them, so that they are multiplied greatly; and he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
texts.psa.107.39: And they are diminished and brought low, through oppression, adversity, and sorrow:
texts.psa.107.40: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste;
texts.psa.107.41: But he secureth the needy one on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like flocks.
texts.psa.107.42: The upright shall see it, and rejoice; and all unrighteousness shall stop its mouth.
texts.psa.107.43: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, and let them understand the loving-kindnesses of Jehovah.
texts.psa.108.1: {A Song, a Psalm of David.} My heart is fixed, O God: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms, even [with] my glory.
texts.psa.108.2: Awake, lute and harp: I will wake the dawn.
texts.psa.108.3: I will give thee thanks among the peoples, O Jehovah; of thee will I sing psalms among the nations:
texts.psa.108.4: For thy loving-kindness is great above the heavens, and thy truth is unto the clouds.
texts.psa.108.5: Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God, and thy glory above all the earth.
texts.psa.108.6: That thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
texts.psa.108.7: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
texts.psa.108.8: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;
texts.psa.108.9: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast my sandal; over Philistia will I shout aloud.
texts.psa.108.10: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me unto Edom?
texts.psa.108.11: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, who didst cast us off? and didst not go forth, O God, with our armies?
texts.psa.108.12: Give us help from trouble; for vain is man's deliverance.
texts.psa.108.13: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
texts.psa.109.1: {To the chief Musician. Of David. A Psalm.} O God of my praise, be not silent:
texts.psa.109.2: For the mouth of the wicked [man] and the mouth of deceit are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue,
texts.psa.109.3: And with words of hatred have they encompassed me; and they fight against me without a cause.
texts.psa.109.4: For my love they are mine adversaries; but I [give myself unto] prayer.
texts.psa.109.5: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
texts.psa.109.6: Set a wicked [man] over him, and let [the] adversary stand at his right hand;
texts.psa.109.7: When he shall be judged, let him go out guilty, and let his prayer become sin;
texts.psa.109.8: Let his days be few, let another take his office;
texts.psa.109.9: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow;
texts.psa.109.10: Let his sons be vagabonds and beg, and let them seek [their bread] far from their desolate places;
texts.psa.109.11: Let the usurer cast the net over all that he hath, and let strangers despoil his labour;
texts.psa.109.12: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him, neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children;
texts.psa.109.13: Let his posterity be cut off; in the generation following let their name be blotted out:
texts.psa.109.14: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah, and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out;
texts.psa.109.15: Let them be before Jehovah continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth:
texts.psa.109.16: Because he remembered not to shew kindness, but persecuted the afflicted and needy man, and the broken in heart, to slay him.
texts.psa.109.17: And he loved cursing; so let it come unto him. And he delighted not in blessing; and let it be far from him.
texts.psa.109.18: And he clothed himself with cursing like his vestment; so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones;
texts.psa.109.19: Let it be unto him as a garment with which he covereth himself, and for a girdle wherewith he is constantly girded.
texts.psa.109.20: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
texts.psa.109.21: But do *thou* for me, Jehovah, Lord, for thy name's sake; because thy loving-kindness is good, deliver me:
texts.psa.109.22: For I am afflicted and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
texts.psa.109.23: I am gone like a shadow when it lengtheneth; I am tossed about like the locust;
texts.psa.109.24: My knees are failing through fasting, and my flesh hath lost its fatness;
texts.psa.109.25: And I am become a reproach unto them; [when] they look upon me they shake their heads.
texts.psa.109.26: Help me, Jehovah my God; save me according to thy loving-kindness:
texts.psa.109.27: That they may know that this is thy hand; that *thou*, Jehovah, hast done it.
texts.psa.109.28: Let *them* curse, but bless *thou*; when they rise up, let them be ashamed, and let thy servant rejoice.
texts.psa.109.29: Let mine adversaries be clothed with confusion, and let them cover themselves with their shame as with a mantle.
texts.psa.109.30: I will greatly celebrate Jehovah with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
texts.psa.109.31: For he standeth at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those that judge his soul.
texts.psa.110.1: {Psalm of David.} Jehovah said unto my Lord, Sit at my right hand, until I put thine enemies [as] footstool of thy feet.
texts.psa.110.2: Jehovah shall send the sceptre of thy might out of Zion: rule in the midst of thine enemies.
texts.psa.110.3: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in holy splendour: from the womb of the morning [shall come] to thee the dew of thy youth.
texts.psa.110.4: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art priest for ever after the order of Melchisedek.
texts.psa.110.5: The Lord at thy right hand will smite through kings in the day of his anger.
texts.psa.110.6: He shall judge among the nations; he shall fill [all places] with dead bodies; he shall smite through the head over a great country.
texts.psa.110.7: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore shall he lift up the head.
texts.psa.111.1: Hallelujah! I will celebrate Jehovah with [my] whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the assembly.
texts.psa.111.2: Great are the works of Jehovah; sought out of all that delight in them.
texts.psa.111.3: His work is majesty and splendour, and his righteousness abideth for ever.
texts.psa.111.4: He hath made his wonders to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
texts.psa.111.5: He hath given meat unto them that fear him; he is ever mindful of his covenant.
texts.psa.111.6: He hath shewn his people the power of his works, to give them the heritage of the nations.
texts.psa.111.7: The works of his hands are truth and judgment; all his precepts are faithful:
texts.psa.111.8: Maintained for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.
texts.psa.111.9: He sent deliverance unto his people; he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and terrible is his name.
texts.psa.111.10: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; a good understanding have all they that do [his precepts]: his praise abideth for ever.
texts.psa.112.1: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
texts.psa.112.2: His seed shall be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
texts.psa.112.3: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house; and his righteousness abideth for ever.
texts.psa.112.4: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness; he is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
texts.psa.112.5: It is well with the man that is gracious and lendeth; he will sustain his cause in judgment.
texts.psa.112.6: For he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
texts.psa.112.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is fixed confiding in Jehovah;
texts.psa.112.8: His heart is maintained, he is not afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his oppressors.
texts.psa.112.9: He scattereth abroad, he giveth to the needy; his righteousness abideth for ever: his horn shall be exalted with honour.
texts.psa.112.10: The wicked [man] shall see [it] and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
texts.psa.113.1: Hallelujah! Praise, ye servants of Jehovah, praise the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.113.2: Blessed be the name of Jehovah, from this time forth and for evermore!
texts.psa.113.3: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, let Jehovah's name be praised.
texts.psa.113.4: Jehovah is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
texts.psa.113.5: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, who hath placed his dwelling on high;
texts.psa.113.6: Who humbleth himself to look on the heavens and on the earth?
texts.psa.113.7: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust; from the dung-hill he lifteth up the needy,
texts.psa.113.8: To set [him] among nobles, among the nobles of his people.
texts.psa.113.9: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [as] a joyful mother of sons. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.114.1: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,
texts.psa.114.2: Judah was his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
texts.psa.114.3: The sea saw it and fled, the Jordan turned back;
texts.psa.114.4: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
texts.psa.114.5: What ailed thee, thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou turnedst back?
texts.psa.114.6: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams? ye hills, like lambs?
texts.psa.114.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the +God of Jacob,
texts.psa.114.8: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
texts.psa.115.1: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth's sake.
texts.psa.115.2: Wherefore should the nations say, Where then is their God?
texts.psa.115.3: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he pleased.
texts.psa.115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:
texts.psa.115.5: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;
texts.psa.115.6: They have ears, and they hear not; a nose have they, and they smell not;
texts.psa.115.7: They have hands, and they handle not; feet have they, and they walk not; they give no sound through their throat.
texts.psa.115.8: They that make them are like unto them, -- every one that confideth in them.
texts.psa.115.9: O Israel, confide thou in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.10: House of Aaron, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.11: Ye that fear Jehovah, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.
texts.psa.115.12: Jehovah hath been mindful of us: he will bless, he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;
texts.psa.115.13: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, both the small and the great.
texts.psa.115.14: Jehovah will add unto you more, unto you and unto your children.
texts.psa.115.15: Ye are blessed of Jehovah, who made the heavens and the earth.
texts.psa.115.16: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah, but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
texts.psa.115.17: The dead praise not Jah, neither any that go down into silence;
texts.psa.115.18: But *we* will bless Jah from this time forth and for evermore. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.116.1: I love Jehovah, for he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications;
texts.psa.116.2: For he hath inclined his ear unto me, and I will call upon him during [all] my days.
texts.psa.116.3: The bands of death encompassed me, and the anguish of Sheol took hold of me; I found trouble and sorrow:
texts.psa.116.4: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: I beseech thee, Jehovah, deliver my soul.
texts.psa.116.5: Gracious is Jehovah and righteous; and our God is merciful.
texts.psa.116.6: Jehovah keepeth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
texts.psa.116.7: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
texts.psa.116.8: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, my feet from falling.
texts.psa.116.9: I will walk before Jehovah in the land of the living.
texts.psa.116.10: I believed, therefore have I spoken. As for me, I was greatly afflicted.
texts.psa.116.11: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
texts.psa.116.12: What shall I render unto Jehovah, [for] all his benefits toward me?
texts.psa.116.13: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.116.14: I will perform my vows unto Jehovah, yea, before all his people.
texts.psa.116.15: Precious in the sight of Jehovah is the death of his saints.
texts.psa.116.16: Yea, Jehovah! for I am thy servant; I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
texts.psa.116.17: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.116.18: I will perform my vows unto Jehovah, yea, before all his people,
texts.psa.116.19: In the courts of Jehovah's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.117.1: Praise Jehovah, all ye nations; laud him, all ye peoples;
texts.psa.117.2: For his loving-kindness is great toward us, and the truth of Jehovah [endureth] for ever. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.118.1: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.2: Oh let Israel say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.3: Oh let the house of Aaron say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.4: Oh let them that fear Jehovah say, that his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.118.5: I called upon Jah in distress; Jah answered me [and set me] in a large place.
texts.psa.118.6: Jehovah is for me, I will not fear; what can man do unto me?
texts.psa.118.7: Jehovah is for me among them that help me; and I shall see [my desire] upon them that hate me.
texts.psa.118.8: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in man;
texts.psa.118.9: It is better to trust in Jehovah than to put confidence in nobles.
texts.psa.118.10: All nations encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.
texts.psa.118.11: They encompassed me, yea, encompassed me; but in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.
texts.psa.118.12: They encompassed me like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Jehovah have I destroyed them.
texts.psa.118.13: Thou hast thrust hard at me that I might fall; but Jehovah helped me.
texts.psa.118.14: My strength and song is Jah, and he is become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.15: The voice of triumph and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly;
texts.psa.118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, the right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
texts.psa.118.17: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Jah.
texts.psa.118.18: Jah hath chastened me sore; but he hath not given me over unto death.
texts.psa.118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them; Jah will I praise.
texts.psa.118.20: This is the gate of Jehovah: the righteous shall enter therein.
texts.psa.118.21: I will give thee thanks, for thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.
texts.psa.118.22: [The] stone which the builders rejected hath become the head of the corner:
texts.psa.118.23: This is of Jehovah; it is wonderful in our eyes.
texts.psa.118.24: This is the day that Jehovah hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
texts.psa.118.25: Oh save, Jehovah, I beseech thee; Jehovah, I beseech thee, oh send prosperity!
texts.psa.118.26: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah. We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
texts.psa.118.27: Jehovah is ùGod, and he hath given us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, -- up to the horns of the altar.
texts.psa.118.28: Thou art my ùGod, and I will give thee thanks; my God, I will exalt thee.
texts.psa.118.29: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.119.1: ALEPH. Blessed are the perfect in the way, who walk in the law of Jehovah.
texts.psa.119.2: Blessed are they that observe his testimonies, that seek him with the whole heart;
texts.psa.119.3: Who also do no unrighteousness: they walk in his ways.
texts.psa.119.4: Thou hast enjoined thy precepts, to be kept diligently.
texts.psa.119.5: Oh that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
texts.psa.119.6: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.7: I will give thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.8: I will keep thy statutes: forsake me not utterly.
texts.psa.119.9: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his path? by taking heed according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.10: With my whole heart have I sought thee: let me not wander from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.11: Thy ùword have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against thee.
texts.psa.119.12: Blessed art thou, Jehovah! teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.13: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.14: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all wealth.
texts.psa.119.15: I will meditate upon thy precepts, and have respect unto thy paths.
texts.psa.119.16: I delight myself in thy statutes; I will not forget thy word.
texts.psa.119.17: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant [and] I shall live; and I will keep thy word.
texts.psa.119.18: Open mine eyes, and I shall behold wondrous things out of thy law.
texts.psa.119.19: I am a stranger in the land; hide not thy commandments from me.
texts.psa.119.20: My soul breaketh for longing after thy judgments at all times.
texts.psa.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, who wander from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.22: Roll off from me reproach and contempt; for I observe thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.23: Princes also did sit [and] talk together against me: thy servant doth meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.24: Thy testimonies also are my delight [and] my counsellors.
texts.psa.119.25: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.26: I have declared my ways, and thou hast answered me: teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.27: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts, and I will meditate upon thy wondrous works.
texts.psa.119.28: My soul melteth for sadness: strengthen me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.29: Remove from me the way of falsehood, and graciously grant me thy law.
texts.psa.119.30: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; thy judgments have I set [before me].
texts.psa.119.31: I cleave unto thy testimonies; Jehovah, let me not be ashamed.
texts.psa.119.32: I will run the way of thy commandments when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
texts.psa.119.33: HE. Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes, and I will observe it [unto] the end.
texts.psa.119.34: Give me understanding, and I will observe thy law; and I will keep it with [my] whole heart.
texts.psa.119.35: Make me to walk in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
texts.psa.119.36: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to gain.
texts.psa.119.37: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; quicken me in thy way.
texts.psa.119.38: Establish thy ùword unto thy servant, who is [devoted] to thy fear.
texts.psa.119.39: Turn away my reproach which I fear; for thy judgments are good.
texts.psa.119.40: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.41: VAU. And let thy loving-kindness come unto me, O Jehovah, -- thy salvation according to thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.42: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me; for I confide in thy word.
texts.psa.119.43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; because I have hoped in thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.44: Then will I keep thy law continually, for ever and ever;
texts.psa.119.45: And I will walk at liberty, for I have sought thy precepts;
texts.psa.119.46: And I will speak of thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed;
texts.psa.119.47: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved;
texts.psa.119.48: And I will lift up my hands unto thy commandments, which I have loved, and I will meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.49: ZAIN. Remember the word for thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
texts.psa.119.50: This is my comfort in mine affliction; for thy ùword hath quickened me.
texts.psa.119.51: The proud have derided me beyond measure: I have not declined from thy law.
texts.psa.119.52: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Jehovah, and have comforted myself.
texts.psa.119.53: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked who forsake thy law.
texts.psa.119.54: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
texts.psa.119.55: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, and have kept thy law.
texts.psa.119.56: This I have had, because I have observed thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.57: CHETH. My portion, O Jehovah, I have said, is to keep thy words.
texts.psa.119.58: I have sought thy favour with [my] whole heart: be gracious unto me according to thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.59: I have thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.60: I have made haste, and not delayed, to keep thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.61: The bands of the wicked have wrapped me round: I have not forgotten thy law.
texts.psa.119.62: At midnight I rise up to give thanks unto thee, because of thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.63: I am the companion of all that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.64: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy loving-kindness: teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.65: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.66: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.67: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.68: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.69: The proud have forged falsehood against me: I will observe thy precepts with [my] whole heart.
texts.psa.119.70: Their heart is as fat as grease: as for me, I delight in thy law.
texts.psa.119.71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I might learn thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.72: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
texts.psa.119.73: YOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.74: They that fear thee will see me, and rejoice; because I have hoped in thy word.
texts.psa.119.75: I know, Jehovah, that thy Judgments are righteousness, and that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.
texts.psa.119.76: Oh let thy loving-kindness be for my comfort, according to thy ùword unto thy servant.
texts.psa.119.77: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for thy law is my delight.
texts.psa.119.78: Let the proud be ashamed; for they have acted perversely towards me with falsehood: as for me, I meditate in thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.79: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that know thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.80: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, that I be not ashamed.
texts.psa.119.81: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation; I hope in thy word.
texts.psa.119.82: Mine eyes fail for thy ùword, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
texts.psa.119.83: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; I do not forget thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.84: How many shall be the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
texts.psa.119.85: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to thy law.
texts.psa.119.86: All thy commandments are faithfulness. They persecute me wrongfully: help thou me.
texts.psa.119.87: They had almost consumed me upon the earth; but as for me, I forsook not thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.88: Quicken me according to thy loving-kindness, and I will keep the testimony of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.89: LAMED. For ever, O Jehovah, thy word is settled in the heavens.
texts.psa.119.90: Thy faithfulness is from generation to generation: thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.
texts.psa.119.91: By thine ordinances they stand this day; for all things are thy servants.
texts.psa.119.92: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
texts.psa.119.93: I will never forget thy precepts; for by them thou hast quickened me.
texts.psa.119.94: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.95: The wicked have awaited me to destroy me; [but] I attend unto thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.96: I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment is exceeding broad.
texts.psa.119.97: MEM. Oh how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
texts.psa.119.98: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; for they are ever with me.
texts.psa.119.99: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for thy testimonies are my meditation.
texts.psa.119.100: I understand more than the aged, because I have observed thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.101: I have refrained my feet from every evil path, that I might keep thy word.
texts.psa.119.102: I have not departed from thy judgments; for it is thou that hast taught me.
texts.psa.119.103: How sweet are thy ùwords unto my taste! more than honey to my mouth!
texts.psa.119.104: From thy precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false path.
texts.psa.119.105: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
texts.psa.119.106: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.107: I am afflicted very much; O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.108: Accept, I beseech thee, Jehovah, the voluntary-offerings of my mouth, and teach me thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.109: My life is continually in my hand; but I do not forget thy law.
texts.psa.119.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me; but I have not wandered from thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.111: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
texts.psa.119.112: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes for ever, unto the end.
texts.psa.119.113: SAMECH. The double-minded have I hated; but thy law do I love.
texts.psa.119.114: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
texts.psa.119.115: Depart from me, ye evil-doers; and I will observe the commandments of my God.
texts.psa.119.116: Uphold me according to thy ùword, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
texts.psa.119.117: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe; and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
texts.psa.119.118: Thou hast set at nought all them that wander from thy statutes; for their deceit is falsehood.
texts.psa.119.119: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross; therefore I love thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.120: My flesh shuddereth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.121: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
texts.psa.119.122: Be surety for thy servant for good; let not the proud oppress me.
texts.psa.119.123: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the ùword of thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.124: Deal with thy servant according to thy loving-kindness, and teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.125: I am thy servant; give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.126: It is time for Jehovah to work: they have made void thy law.
texts.psa.119.127: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold, yea, above fine gold.
texts.psa.119.128: Therefore I regard all [thy] precepts concerning all things to be right: I hate every false path.
texts.psa.119.129: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore doth my soul observe them.
texts.psa.119.130: The entrance of thy words giveth light, giving understanding unto the simple.
texts.psa.119.131: I opened my mouth wide and panted; for I longed for thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.132: Turn unto me, and be gracious unto me, as thou art wont to do unto those that love thy name.
texts.psa.119.133: Establish my steps in thy ùword; and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
texts.psa.119.134: Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.135: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant, and teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.136: Mine eyes run down with streams of water, because they keep not thy law.
texts.psa.119.137: TZADE. Righteous art thou, Jehovah, and upright are thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.138: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
texts.psa.119.139: My zeal destroyeth me, because mine oppressors have forgotten thy words.
texts.psa.119.140: Thy ùword is exceeding pure, and thy servant loveth it.
texts.psa.119.141: I am little and despised: thy precepts have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.142: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is truth.
texts.psa.119.143: Trouble and anguish have taken hold upon me: thy commandments are my delights.
texts.psa.119.144: The righteousness of thy testimonies is for ever: give me understanding, and I shall live.
texts.psa.119.145: KOPH. I have called with [my] whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will observe thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.146: I call upon thee; save me, and I will keep thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.147: I anticipate the morning-dawn and I cry: I hope in thy word.
texts.psa.119.148: Mine eyes anticipate the night-watches, that I may meditate in thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.149: Hear my voice according to thy loving-kindness: O Jehovah, quicken me according to thy judgment.
texts.psa.119.150: They have drawn nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
texts.psa.119.151: Thou, Jehovah, art near, and all thy commandments are truth.
texts.psa.119.152: From thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
texts.psa.119.153: RESH. See mine affliction, and deliver me; for I have not forgotten thy law.
texts.psa.119.154: Plead my cause, and redeem me: quicken me according to thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.155: Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.156: Many are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah; quicken me according to thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.157: Many are my persecutors and mine oppressors; I have not declined from thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.158: I beheld them that deal treacherously, and was grieved; because they kept not thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.159: See how I have loved thy precepts: quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy loving-kindness.
texts.psa.119.160: The sum of thy word is truth, and every righteous judgment of thine is for ever.
texts.psa.119.161: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
texts.psa.119.162: I have joy in thy ùword, as one that findeth great spoil.
texts.psa.119.163: I hate and abhor falsehood; thy law do I love.
texts.psa.119.164: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
texts.psa.119.165: Great peace have they that love thy law, and nothing doth stumble them.
texts.psa.119.166: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and have done thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.167: My soul hath kept thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.
texts.psa.119.168: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies; for all my ways are before thee.
texts.psa.119.169: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, Jehovah: give me understanding according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.170: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy ùword.
texts.psa.119.171: My lips shall pour forth praise when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.172: My tongue shall speak aloud of thy ùword; for all thy commandments are righteousness.
texts.psa.119.173: Let thy hand be for my help; for I have chosen thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.174: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah, and thy law is my delight.
texts.psa.119.175: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
texts.psa.119.176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep: seek thy servant; for I have not forgotten thy commandments.
texts.psa.120.1: {A Song of degrees.} In my trouble I called unto Jehovah, and he answered me.
texts.psa.120.2: Jehovah, deliver my soul from the lying lip, from the deceitful tongue.
texts.psa.120.3: What shall be given unto thee, what shall be added unto thee, thou deceitful tongue?
texts.psa.120.4: Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with burning coals of broom-wood.
texts.psa.120.5: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
texts.psa.120.6: My soul hath long dwelt with them that hate peace.
texts.psa.120.7: I [am for] peace; but when I speak, *they* [are] for war.
texts.psa.121.1: {A Song of degrees.} I lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: whence shall my help come?
texts.psa.121.2: My help [cometh] from Jehovah, who made the heavens and the earth.
texts.psa.121.3: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
texts.psa.121.4: Behold, he that keepeth Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
texts.psa.121.5: Jehovah is thy keeper, Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand;
texts.psa.121.6: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
texts.psa.121.7: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; he will keep thy soul.
texts.psa.121.8: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in, from henceforth and for evermore.
texts.psa.122.1: {A Song of degrees. Of David.} I rejoiced when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Jehovah.
texts.psa.122.2: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
texts.psa.122.3: Jerusalem, which art built as a city that is compact together,
texts.psa.122.4: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Jah, a testimony to Israel, to give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.122.5: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
texts.psa.122.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
texts.psa.122.7: Peace be within thy bulwarks, prosperity within thy palaces.
texts.psa.122.8: For my brethren and companions' sakes I will say, Peace be within thee!
texts.psa.122.9: Because of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
texts.psa.123.1: {A Song of degrees.} Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
texts.psa.123.2: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress, so our eyes [are directed] to Jehovah our God, until he be gracious unto us.
texts.psa.123.3: Be gracious unto us, O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
texts.psa.123.4: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
texts.psa.124.1: {A Song of degrees. Of David.} If it had not been Jehovah who was for us -- oh let Israel say --
texts.psa.124.2: If it had not been Jehovah who was for us, when men rose up against us,
texts.psa.124.3: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us;
texts.psa.124.4: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, a torrent had gone over our soul;
texts.psa.124.5: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
texts.psa.124.6: Blessed be Jehovah, who gave us not up a prey to their teeth!
texts.psa.124.7: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
texts.psa.124.8: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, the maker of heavens and earth.
texts.psa.125.1: {A Song of degrees.} They that confide in Jehovah are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved; it abideth for ever.
texts.psa.125.2: Jerusalem! -- mountains are round about her, and Jehovah is round about his people, from henceforth and for evermore.
texts.psa.125.3: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
texts.psa.125.4: Do good, O Jehovah, unto the good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
texts.psa.125.5: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel!
texts.psa.126.1: {A Song of degrees.} When Jehovah turned the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
texts.psa.126.2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with rejoicing: then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
texts.psa.126.3: Jehovah hath done great things for us; [and] we are joyful.
texts.psa.126.4: Turn our captivity, O Jehovah, as the streams in the south.
texts.psa.126.5: They that sow in tears shall reap with rejoicing:
texts.psa.126.6: He goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for scattering; he cometh again with rejoicing, bearing his sheaves.
texts.psa.127.1: {A Song of degrees. Of Solomon.} Unless Jehovah build the house, in vain do its builders labour in it; unless Jehovah keep the city, the keeper watcheth in vain:
texts.psa.127.2: It is vain for you to rise up early, to lie down late, to eat the bread of sorrows: so to his beloved one he giveth sleep.
texts.psa.127.3: Lo, children are an inheritance from Jehovah, [and] the fruit of the womb a reward.
texts.psa.127.4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
texts.psa.127.5: Happy is the man that hath filled his quiver with them. They shall not be ashamed when they speak with enemies in the gate.
texts.psa.128.1: {A Song of degrees.} Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, that walketh in his ways.
texts.psa.128.2: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands; happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
texts.psa.128.3: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine in the inner part of thy house; thy children like olive-plants round about thy table.
texts.psa.128.4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that feareth Jehovah.
texts.psa.128.5: Jehovah will bless thee out of Zion; and mayest thou see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life,
texts.psa.128.6: And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
texts.psa.129.1: {A Song of degrees.} Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth -- oh let Israel say --
texts.psa.129.2: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth; yet they have not prevailed against me.
texts.psa.129.3: The ploughers ploughed upon my back; they made long their furrows.
texts.psa.129.4: Jehovah is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
texts.psa.129.5: Let them be ashamed and turned backward, all that hate Zion;
texts.psa.129.6: Let them be as the grass upon the house-tops, which withereth before it is plucked up,
texts.psa.129.7: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand, nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom;
texts.psa.129.8: Neither do the passers-by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; we bless you in the name of Jehovah!
texts.psa.130.1: {A Song of degrees.} Out of the depths do I call upon thee, Jehovah.
texts.psa.130.2: Lord, hear my voice; let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.
texts.psa.130.3: If thou, Jah, shouldest mark iniquities, Lord, who shall stand?
texts.psa.130.4: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
texts.psa.130.5: I wait for Jehovah; my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
texts.psa.130.6: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than the watchers [wait] for the morning, [more than] the watchers for the morning.
texts.psa.130.7: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, because with Jehovah there is loving-kindness, and with him is plenteous redemption;
texts.psa.130.8: And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
texts.psa.131.1: {A Song of degrees. Of David.} Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; neither do I exercise myself in great matters, and in things too wonderful for me.
texts.psa.131.2: Surely I have restrained and composed my soul, like a weaned child with its mother: my soul within me is as a weaned child.
texts.psa.131.3: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, from henceforth and for evermore.
texts.psa.132.1: {A Song of degrees.} Jehovah, remember for David all his affliction;
texts.psa.132.2: How he swore unto Jehovah, vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
texts.psa.132.3: I will not come into the tent of my house, I will not go up to the couch of my bed;
texts.psa.132.4: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, slumber to mine eyelids,
texts.psa.132.5: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, habitations for the Mighty One of Jacob. ...
texts.psa.132.6: Behold, we heard of it at Ephratah, we found it in the fields of the wood.
texts.psa.132.7: Let us go into his habitations, let us worship at his footstool.
texts.psa.132.8: Arise, Jehovah, into thy rest, thou and the ark of thy strength.
texts.psa.132.9: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness, and let thy saints shout for joy.
texts.psa.132.10: For thy servant David's sake, turn not away the face of thine anointed.
texts.psa.132.11: Jehovah hath sworn [in] truth unto David; he will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne;
texts.psa.132.12: If thy children keep my covenant, and my testimonies which I will teach them, their children also for evermore shall sit upon thy throne.
texts.psa.132.13: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his dwelling:
texts.psa.132.14: This is my rest for ever; here will I dwell, for I have desired it.
texts.psa.132.15: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her needy ones with bread;
texts.psa.132.16: And I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
texts.psa.132.17: There will I cause the horn of David to bud forth; I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
texts.psa.132.18: His enemies will I clothe with shame; but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
texts.psa.133.1: {A Song of degrees. Of David.} Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
texts.psa.133.2: Like the precious oil upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, upon Aaron's beard, that ran down to the hem of his garments;
texts.psa.133.3: As the dew of Hermon that descendeth on the mountains of Zion; for there hath Jehovah commanded the blessing, life for evermore.
texts.psa.134.1: {A Song of degrees.} Behold, bless Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, who by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
texts.psa.134.2: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless Jehovah.
texts.psa.134.3: Jehovah, the maker of heavens and earth, bless thee out of Zion.
texts.psa.135.1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of Jehovah; praise, ye servants of Jehovah,
texts.psa.135.2: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, in the courts of the house of our God.
texts.psa.135.3: Praise ye Jah; for Jehovah is good: sing psalms unto his name; for it is pleasant.
texts.psa.135.4: For Jah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, Israel for his own possession.
texts.psa.135.5: For *I* know that Jehovah is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
texts.psa.135.6: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, he hath done in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all deeps;
texts.psa.135.7: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; who maketh lightnings for the rain; who bringeth the wind out of his treasuries:
texts.psa.135.8: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast;
texts.psa.135.9: Who sent signs and miracles into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants;
texts.psa.135.10: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings,
texts.psa.135.11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
texts.psa.135.12: And gave their land for an inheritance, an inheritance unto Israel his people.
texts.psa.135.13: Thy name, O Jehovah, is for ever; thy memorial, O Jehovah, from generation to generation.
texts.psa.135.14: For Jehovah will judge his people, and will repent in favour of his servants.
texts.psa.135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:
texts.psa.135.16: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;
texts.psa.135.17: They have ears, and they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouth.
texts.psa.135.18: They that make them are like unto them, -- every one that confideth in them.
texts.psa.135.19: House of Israel, bless ye Jehovah; house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah;
texts.psa.135.20: House of Levi, bless ye Jehovah; ye that fear Jehovah, bless Jehovah.
texts.psa.135.21: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, who dwelleth at Jerusalem! Hallelujah!
texts.psa.136.1: Give ye thanks unto Jehovah, for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:
texts.psa.136.2: Give thanks unto the God of gods, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.3: Give thanks unto the Lord of lords, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.136.4: To him who alone doeth great wonders, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:
texts.psa.136.5: To him that by understanding made the heavens, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.6: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.7: To him that made great lights, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.8: The sun for rule over the day, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.9: The moon and stars for rule over the night, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:
texts.psa.136.10: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.11: And brought out Israel from among them, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.12: With a powerful hand and with a stretched-out arm, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.13: To him that divided the Red sea into parts, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.14: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.15: And overturned Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.16: To him that led his people through the wilderness, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.17: To him that smote great kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.18: And slew famous kings, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.19: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.20: And Og king of Bashan, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.21: And gave their land for an inheritance, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever,
texts.psa.136.22: An inheritance unto Israel his servant, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:
texts.psa.136.23: Who hath remembered us in our low estate, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;
texts.psa.136.24: And hath delivered us from our oppressors, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever:
texts.psa.136.25: Who giveth food to all flesh, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.136.26: Give ye thanks unto the ùGod of the heavens; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.
texts.psa.137.1: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down; yea, we wept when we remembered Zion.
texts.psa.137.2: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
texts.psa.137.3: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that made us wail [required] mirth, [saying,] Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.
texts.psa.137.4: How should we sing a song of Jehovah's upon a foreign soil?
texts.psa.137.5: If I forget thee, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget [its skill];
texts.psa.137.6: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to my palate: if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
texts.psa.137.7: Remember, O Jehovah, against the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, Lay [it] bare, Lay [it] bare, down to its foundation!
texts.psa.137.8: Daughter of Babylon, who art to be laid waste, happy he that rendereth unto thee that which thou hast meted out to us.
texts.psa.137.9: Happy he that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the rock.
texts.psa.138.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} I will give thee thanks with my whole heart; before the gods will I sing psalms of thee.
texts.psa.138.2: I will bow down toward the temple of thy holiness, and celebrate thy name for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth; for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
texts.psa.138.3: In the day when I called thou answeredst me; thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
texts.psa.138.4: All the kings of the earth shall celebrate thee, Jehovah, when they have heard the words of thy mouth;
texts.psa.138.5: And they shall sing in the ways of Jehovah, for great is the glory of Jehovah.
texts.psa.138.6: For Jehovah is high; but he looketh upon the lowly, and the proud he knoweth afar off.
texts.psa.138.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the anger of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
texts.psa.138.8: Jehovah will perfect what concerneth me: thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; forsake not the works of thine own hands.
texts.psa.139.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me].
texts.psa.139.2: *Thou* knowest my down-sitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off;
texts.psa.139.3: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways;
texts.psa.139.4: For there is not yet a word on my tongue, [but] lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.
texts.psa.139.5: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thy hand upon me.
texts.psa.139.6: O knowledge too wonderful for me! it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.
texts.psa.139.7: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? and whither flee from thy presence?
texts.psa.139.8: If I ascend up into the heavens thou art there; or if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou [art there];
texts.psa.139.9: [If] I take the wings of the dawn [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
texts.psa.139.10: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
texts.psa.139.11: And if I say, Surely darkness shall cover me, and the light about me be night;
texts.psa.139.12: Even darkness hideth not from thee, and the night shineth as the day: the darkness is as the light.
texts.psa.139.13: For thou hast possessed my reins; thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.
texts.psa.139.14: I will praise thee, for I am fearfully, wonderfully made. Marvellous are thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well.
texts.psa.139.15: My bones were not hidden from thee when I was made in secret, curiously wrought in the lower parts of the earth.
texts.psa.139.16: Thine eyes did see my unformed substance, and in thy book all [my members] were written; [during many] days were they fashioned, when [as yet] there was none of them.
texts.psa.139.17: But how precious are thy thoughts unto me, O ùGod! how great is the sum of them!
texts.psa.139.18: [If] I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with thee.
texts.psa.139.19: Oh that thou wouldest slay the wicked, O +God! And ye men of blood, depart from me.
texts.psa.139.20: For they speak of thee wickedly, they take [thy name] in vain, thine enemies.
texts.psa.139.21: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? and do not I loathe them that rise up against thee?
texts.psa.139.22: I hate them with perfect hatred; I account them mine enemies.
texts.psa.139.23: Search me, O ùGod, and know my heart; prove me, and know my thoughts;
texts.psa.139.24: And see if there be any grievous way in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.
texts.psa.140.1: {To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.} Free me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; preserve me from the violent man:
texts.psa.140.2: Who devise mischiefs in [their] heart; every day are they banded together for war.
texts.psa.140.3: They sharpen their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
texts.psa.140.4: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked [man], preserve me from the violent man, who devise to overthrow my steps.
texts.psa.140.5: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the way-side; they have set traps for me. Selah.
texts.psa.140.6: I have said unto Jehovah, Thou art my ùGod: give ear, O Jehovah, to the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.140.7: Jehovah, the Lord, is the strength of my salvation: thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
texts.psa.140.8: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desire of the wicked; further not his device: they would exalt themselves. Selah.
texts.psa.140.9: [As for] the head of those that encompass me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
texts.psa.140.10: Let burning coals fall on them; let them be cast into the fire; into deep waters, that they rise not up again.
texts.psa.140.11: Let not the man of [evil] tongue be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the man of violence to [his] ruin.
texts.psa.140.12: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted one, the right of the needy.
texts.psa.140.13: Yea, the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name; the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
texts.psa.141.1: {A Psalm of David.} Jehovah, I have called upon thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.
texts.psa.141.2: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense, the lifting up of my hands as the evening oblation.
texts.psa.141.3: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
texts.psa.141.4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise deeds of wickedness with men that are workers of iniquity; and let me not eat of their dainties.
texts.psa.141.5: Let the righteous smite me, it is kindness; and let him reprove me, it is an excellent oil which my head shall not refuse: for yet my prayer also is [for them] in their calamities.
texts.psa.141.6: When their judges are thrown down from the rocks, they shall hear my words, for they are sweet.
texts.psa.141.7: Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol, as when one cutteth and cleaveth [wood] upon the earth.
texts.psa.141.8: For unto thee, Jehovah, Lord, are mine eyes; in thee do I trust: leave not my soul destitute.
texts.psa.141.9: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
texts.psa.141.10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that *I* withal pass over.
texts.psa.142.1: {An instruction of David; when he was in the cave: a prayer.} I cry unto Jehovah with my voice: with my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
texts.psa.142.2: I pour out my plaint before him; I shew before him my trouble.
texts.psa.142.3: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then *thou* knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they hidden a snare for me.
texts.psa.142.4: Look on the right hand and see; there is no man that knoweth me: refuge hath failed me; no man careth for my soul.
texts.psa.142.5: I cried unto thee, Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.
texts.psa.142.6: Attend unto my cry, for I am brought very low; deliver me from my persecutors, for they are stronger than I.
texts.psa.142.7: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may celebrate thy name. The righteous shall surround me, because thou dealest bountifully with me.
texts.psa.143.1: {A Psalm of David.} Jehovah, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.143.2: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.
texts.psa.143.3: For the enemy persecuteth my soul: he hath crushed my life down to the earth; he hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
texts.psa.143.4: And my spirit is overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
texts.psa.143.5: I remember the days of old: I meditate on all thy doing; I muse on the work of thy hands.
texts.psa.143.6: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul, as a parched land, [thirsteth] after thee. Selah.
texts.psa.143.7: Answer me speedily, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, or I shall be like unto them that go down into the pit.
texts.psa.143.8: Cause me to hear thy loving-kindness in the morning, for in thee do I confide; make me to know the way wherein I should walk, for unto thee do I lift up my soul.
texts.psa.143.9: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: unto thee do I flee for refuge.
texts.psa.143.10: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: let thy good Spirit lead me in a plain country.
texts.psa.143.11: Revive me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake; in thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble;
texts.psa.143.12: And in thy loving-kindness cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that oppress my soul: for I am thy servant.
texts.psa.144.1: {[A Psalm] of David.} Blessed be Jehovah my rock, who teacheth my hands to war, my fingers to fight;
texts.psa.144.2: My mercy and my fortress, my high tower and my deliverer, my shield and he in whom I trust, who subdueth my people under me!
texts.psa.144.3: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him, the son of man, that thou takest thought of him?
texts.psa.144.4: Man is like to vanity; his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
texts.psa.144.5: Jehovah, bow thy heavens, and come down; touch the mountains, that they smoke;
texts.psa.144.6: Cast forth lightnings, and scatter them; send forth thine arrows, and discomfit them:
texts.psa.144.7: Stretch out thy hands from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of aliens,
texts.psa.144.8: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
texts.psa.144.9: O God, I will sing a new song unto thee; with the ten-stringed lute will I sing psalms unto thee:
texts.psa.144.10: Who givest salvation unto kings; who rescuest David thy servant from the hurtful sword.
texts.psa.144.11: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of aliens, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
texts.psa.144.12: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner-columns, sculptured after the fashion of a palace:
texts.psa.144.13: Our granaries full, affording all manner of store; our sheep bringing forth thousands, ten thousands in our pastures;
texts.psa.144.14: Our kine laden [with young]; no breaking in and no going forth, and no outcry in our streets.
texts.psa.144.15: Blessed the people that is in such a case! Blessed the people whose God is Jehovah!
texts.psa.145.1: {A Psalm of praise. Of David.} I will extol thee, my God, O King, and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.145.2: Every day will I bless thee, and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.145.3: Great is Jehovah, and exceedingly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
texts.psa.145.4: One generation shall laud thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
texts.psa.145.5: I will speak of the glorious splendour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
texts.psa.145.6: And they shall tell of the might of thy terrible acts; and thy great deeds will I declare.
texts.psa.145.7: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
texts.psa.145.8: Jehovah is gracious and merciful; slow to anger, and of great loving-kindness.
texts.psa.145.9: Jehovah is good to all; and his tender mercies are over all his works.
texts.psa.145.10: All thy works shall praise thee, Jehovah, and thy saints shall bless thee.
texts.psa.145.11: They shall tell of the glory of thy kingdom, and speak of thy power;
texts.psa.145.12: To make known to the children of men his mighty acts, and the glorious splendour of his kingdom.
texts.psa.145.13: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and thy dominion is throughout all generations.
texts.psa.145.14: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all that are bowed down.
texts.psa.145.15: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their food in its season.
texts.psa.145.16: Thou openest thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
texts.psa.145.17: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, and kind in all his works.
texts.psa.145.18: Jehovah is nigh unto all that call upon him, unto all that call upon him in truth.
texts.psa.145.19: He fulfilleth the desire of them that fear him; he heareth their cry, and saveth them.
texts.psa.145.20: Jehovah keepeth all that love him, and all the wicked will he destroy.
texts.psa.145.21: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
texts.psa.146.1: Hallelujah! Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
texts.psa.146.2: As long as I live will I praise Jehovah; I will sing psalms unto my God while I have my being.
texts.psa.146.3: Put not confidence in nobles, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
texts.psa.146.4: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his purposes perish.
texts.psa.146.5: Blessed is he who hath the ùGod of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Jehovah his God,
texts.psa.146.6: Who made the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that is therein; who keepeth truth for ever;
texts.psa.146.7: Who executeth judgment for the oppressed, who giveth bread to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;
texts.psa.146.8: Jehovah openeth [the eyes of] the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;
texts.psa.146.9: Jehovah preserveth the strangers; he lifteth up the fatherless and the widow; but the way of the wicked doth he subvert.
texts.psa.146.10: Jehovah will reign for ever, [even] thy God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluiah!
texts.psa.147.1: Praise ye Jah! for it is good. Sing psalms of our God; for it is pleasant: praise is comely.
texts.psa.147.2: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth the outcasts of Israel.
texts.psa.147.3: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
texts.psa.147.4: He counteth the number of the stars; he giveth names to them all.
texts.psa.147.5: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
texts.psa.147.6: Jehovah lifteth up the meek; he abaseth the wicked to the earth.
texts.psa.147.7: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; sing psalms upon the harp unto our God:
texts.psa.147.8: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains;
texts.psa.147.9: Who giveth to the cattle their food, to the young ravens which cry.
texts.psa.147.10: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse, he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man;
texts.psa.147.11: Jehovah taketh pleasure in those that fear him, in those that hope in his loving-kindness.
texts.psa.147.12: Laud Jehovah, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
texts.psa.147.13: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee;
texts.psa.147.14: He maketh peace in thy borders; he satisfieth thee with the finest of the wheat.
texts.psa.147.15: He sendeth forth his oracles to the earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
texts.psa.147.16: He giveth snow like wool, scattereth the hoar frost like ashes;
texts.psa.147.17: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
texts.psa.147.18: He sendeth his word, and melteth them; he causeth his wind to blow -- the waters flow.
texts.psa.147.19: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
texts.psa.147.20: He hath not dealt thus with any nation; and as for [his] judgments, they have not known them. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.148.1: Hallelujah! Praise Jehovah from the heavens; praise him in the heights.
texts.psa.148.2: Praise ye him, all his angels; praise ye him, all his hosts.
texts.psa.148.3: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all ye stars of light.
texts.psa.148.4: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens.
texts.psa.148.5: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, for he it is that commanded, and they were created:
texts.psa.148.6: And he established them for ever and ever; he made [for them] a statute which shall not pass.
texts.psa.148.7: Praise Jehovah from the earth, ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;
texts.psa.148.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, stormy wind fulfilling his word;
texts.psa.148.9: Mountains and all hills, fruit-trees and all cedars;
texts.psa.148.10: Beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged fowl;
texts.psa.148.11: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;
texts.psa.148.12: Both young men and maidens, old men with youths, --
texts.psa.148.13: Let them praise the name of Jehovah: for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above the earth and the heavens.
texts.psa.148.14: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, [even] of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Hallelujah!
texts.psa.149.1: Hallelujah! Sing unto Jehovah a new song; [sing] his praise in the congregation of the godly.
texts.psa.149.2: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their King.
texts.psa.149.3: Let them praise his name in the dance; let them sing psalms unto him with the tambour and harp.
texts.psa.149.4: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people; he beautifieth the meek with salvation.
texts.psa.149.5: Let the godly exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
texts.psa.149.6: Let the high praises of ùGod be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand:
