texts.psa.89.44: Hast caused [him] to cease from his brightness, And his throne to the earth hast cast down.
texts.psa.89.45: Thou hast shortened the days of his youth, Hast covered him over [with] shame. Selah.
texts.psa.89.46: Till when, O Jehovah, art Thou hidden? For ever doth Thy fury burn as fire?
texts.psa.89.47: Remember, I pray Thee, what [is] life-time? Wherefore in vain hast Thou created All the sons of men?
texts.psa.89.48: Who [is] the man that liveth, and doth not see death? He delivereth his soul from the hand of Sheol. Selah.
texts.psa.89.49: Where [are] Thy former kindnesses, O Lord. Thou hast sworn to David in Thy faithfulness,
texts.psa.89.50: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Thy servants, I have borne in my bosom all the strivings of the peoples,
texts.psa.89.51: Wherewith Thine enemies reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached The steps of Thine anointed.
texts.psa.89.52: Blessed [is] Jehovah to the age. Amen, and amen!
texts.psa.90.1: A Prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, a habitation Thou -- Thou hast been, To us -- in generation and generation,
texts.psa.90.2: Before mountains were brought forth, And Thou dost form the earth and the world, Even from age unto age Thou [art] God.
texts.psa.90.3: Thou turnest man unto a bruised thing, And sayest, Turn back, ye sons of men.
texts.psa.90.4: For a thousand years in Thine eyes [are] as yesterday, For it passeth on, yea, a watch by night.
texts.psa.90.5: Thou hast inundated them, they are asleep, In the morning as grass he changeth.
texts.psa.90.6: In the morning it flourisheth, and hath changed, At evening it is cut down, and hath withered.
texts.psa.90.7: For we were consumed in Thine anger, And in Thy fury we have been troubled.
texts.psa.90.8: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our hidden things at the light of Thy face,
texts.psa.90.9: For all our days pined away in Thy wrath, We consumed our years as a meditation.
texts.psa.90.10: Days of our years, in them [are] seventy years, And if, by reason of might, eighty years, Yet [is] their enlargement labour and vanity, For it hath been cut off hastily, and we fly away.
texts.psa.90.11: Who knoweth the power of Thine anger? And according to Thy fear -- Thy wrath?
texts.psa.90.12: To number our days aright let [us] know, And we bring the heart to wisdom.
texts.psa.90.13: Turn back, O Jehovah, till when? And repent concerning Thy servants.
texts.psa.90.14: Satisfy us at morn [with] Thy kindness, And we sing and rejoice all our days.
texts.psa.90.15: Cause us to rejoice according to the days Wherein Thou hast afflicted us, The years we have seen evil.
texts.psa.90.16: Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thine honour on their sons.
texts.psa.90.17: And let the pleasantness of Jehovah our God be upon us, And the work of our hands establish on us, Yea, the work of our hands establish it!
texts.psa.91.1: He who is dwelling In the secret place of the Most High, In the shade of the Mighty lodgeth habitually,
texts.psa.91.2: He is saying of Jehovah, `My refuge, and my bulwark, my God, I trust in Him,'
texts.psa.91.3: For He delivereth thee from the snare of a fowler, From a calamitous pestilence.
texts.psa.91.4: With His pinion He covereth thee over, And under His wings thou dost trust, A shield and buckler [is] His truth.
texts.psa.91.5: Thou art not afraid of fear by night, Of arrow that flieth by day,
texts.psa.91.6: Of pestilence in thick darkness that walketh, Of destruction that destroyeth at noon,
texts.psa.91.7: There fall at thy side a thousand, And a myriad at thy right hand, Unto thee it cometh not nigh.
texts.psa.91.8: But with thine eyes thou lookest, And the reward of the wicked thou seest,
texts.psa.91.9: (For Thou, O Jehovah, [art] my refuge,) The Most High thou madest thy habitation.
texts.psa.91.10: Evil happeneth not unto thee, And a plague cometh not near thy tent,
texts.psa.91.11: For His messengers He chargeth for thee, To keep thee in all thy ways,
texts.psa.91.12: On the hands they bear thee up, Lest thou smite against a stone thy foot.
texts.psa.91.13: On lion and asp thou treadest, Thou trampest young lion and dragon.
texts.psa.91.14: Because in Me he hath delighted, I also deliver him -- I set him on high, Because he hath known My name.
texts.psa.91.15: He doth call Me, and I answer him, I [am] with him in distress, I deliver him, and honour him.
texts.psa.91.16: With length of days I satisfy him, And I cause him to look on My salvation!
texts.psa.92.1: A Psalm. -- A Song for the sabbath-day. Good to give thanks to Jehovah, And to sing praises to Thy name, O Most High,
texts.psa.92.2: To declare in the morning Thy kindness, And Thy faithfulness in the nights.
texts.psa.92.3: On ten strings and on psaltery, On higgaion, with harp.
texts.psa.92.4: For Thou hast caused me to rejoice, O Jehovah, in Thy work, Concerning the works of Thy hands I sing.
texts.psa.92.5: How great have been Thy works, O Jehovah, Very deep have been Thy thoughts.
texts.psa.92.6: A brutish man doth not know, And a fool understandeth not this; --
texts.psa.92.7: When the wicked flourish as a herb, And blossom do all workers of iniquity -- For their being destroyed for ever and ever!
texts.psa.92.8: And Thou [art] high to the age, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.92.9: For, lo, Thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, Thine enemies, do perish, Separate themselves do all workers of iniquity.
texts.psa.92.10: And Thou exaltest as a reem my horn, I have been anointed with fresh oil.
texts.psa.92.11: And mine eye looketh on mine enemies, Of those rising up against me, The evil doers, do mine ears hear.
texts.psa.92.12: The righteous as a palm-tree flourisheth, As a cedar in Lebanon he groweth.
texts.psa.92.13: Those planted in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of our God do flourish.
texts.psa.92.14: Still they bring forth in old age, Fat and flourishing are they,
texts.psa.92.15: To declare that upright [is] Jehovah my rock, And there is no perverseness in Him!
texts.psa.93.1: Jehovah hath reigned, Excellency He hath put on, Jehovah put on strength, He girded Himself, Also -- established is the world, unmoved.
texts.psa.93.2: Established is Thy throne since then, From the age Thou [art].
texts.psa.93.3: Floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, Floods have lifted up their voice, Floods lift up their breakers.
texts.psa.93.4: Than the voices of many mighty waters, Breakers of a sea, mighty on high [is] Jehovah,
texts.psa.93.5: Thy testimonies have been very stedfast, To Thy house comely [is] holiness, O Jehovah, for length of days!
texts.psa.94.1: God of vengeance -- Jehovah! God of vengeance, shine forth.
texts.psa.94.2: Be lifted up, O Judge of the earth, Send back a recompence on the proud.
texts.psa.94.3: Till when [do] the wicked, O Jehovah? Till when do the wicked exult?
texts.psa.94.4: They utter -- they speak an old saw, All working iniquity do boast themselves.
texts.psa.94.5: Thy people, O Jehovah, they bruise, And Thine inheritance they afflict.
texts.psa.94.6: Widow and sojourner they slay, And fatherless ones they murder.
texts.psa.94.7: And they say, `Jehovah doth not see, And the God of Jacob doth not consider.'
texts.psa.94.8: Consider, ye brutish among the people, And ye foolish, when do ye act wisely?
texts.psa.94.9: He who planteth the ear doth He not hear? He who formeth the eye doth He not see?
texts.psa.94.10: He who is instructing nations, Doth He not reprove? He who is teaching man knowledge [is] Jehovah.
texts.psa.94.11: He knoweth the thoughts of man, that they [are] vanity.
texts.psa.94.12: O the happiness of the man Whom Thou instructest, O Jah, And out of Thy law teachest him,
texts.psa.94.13: To give rest to him from days of evil, While a pit is digged for the wicked.
texts.psa.94.14: For Jehovah leaveth not His people, And His inheritance forsaketh not.
texts.psa.94.15: For to righteousness judgment turneth back, And after it all the upright of heart,
texts.psa.94.16: Who riseth up for me with evil doers? Who stationeth himself for me with workers of iniquity?
texts.psa.94.17: Unless Jehovah [were] a help to me, My soul had almost inhabited silence.
texts.psa.94.18: If I have said, `My foot hath slipped,' Thy kindness, O Jehovah, supporteth me.
texts.psa.94.19: In the abundance of my thoughts within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.
texts.psa.94.20: Is a throne of mischief joined [with] Thee? A framer of perverseness by statute?
texts.psa.94.21: They decree against the soul of the righteous, And innocent blood declare wicked.
texts.psa.94.22: And Jehovah is for a high place to me, And my God [is] for a rock -- my refuge,
texts.psa.94.23: And turneth back on them their iniquity, And in their wickedness cutteth them off; Jehovah our God doth cut them off!
texts.psa.95.1: Come, we sing to Jehovah, We shout to the rock of our salvation.
texts.psa.95.2: We come before His face with thanksgiving, With psalms we shout to Him.
texts.psa.95.3: For a great God [is] Jehovah, And a great king over all gods.
texts.psa.95.4: In whose hand [are] the deep places of earth, And the strong places of hills [are] His.
texts.psa.95.5: Whose is the sea, and He made it, And His hands formed the dry land.
texts.psa.95.6: Come in, we bow ourselves, and we bend, We kneel before Jehovah our Maker.
texts.psa.95.7: For He [is] our God, and we the people of His pasture, And the flock of His hand, To-day, if to His voice ye hearken,
texts.psa.95.8: Harden not your heart as [in] Meribah, As [in] the day of Massah in the wilderness,
texts.psa.95.9: Where your fathers have tried Me, Have proved Me, yea, have seen My work.
texts.psa.95.10: Forty years I am weary of the generation, And I say, `A people erring in heart -- they! And they have not known My ways:'
texts.psa.95.11: Where I sware in Mine anger, `If they come in unto My rest -- !'
texts.psa.96.1: Sing to Jehovah a new song, Sing to Jehovah all the earth.
texts.psa.96.2: Sing to Jehovah, bless His name, Proclaim from day to day His salvation.
texts.psa.96.3: Declare among nations His honour, Among all the peoples His wonders.
texts.psa.96.4: For great [is] Jehovah, and praised greatly, Fearful He [is] over all gods.
texts.psa.96.5: For all the gods of the peoples [are] nought, And Jehovah made the heavens.
texts.psa.96.6: Honour and majesty [are] before Him, Strength and beauty in His sanctuary.
texts.psa.96.7: Ascribe to Jehovah, O families of the peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.
texts.psa.96.8: Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Lift up a present and come in to His courts.
texts.psa.96.9: Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the honour of holiness, Be afraid of His presence, all the earth.
texts.psa.96.10: Say among nations, `Jehovah hath reigned, Also -- established is the world, unmoved, He judgeth the peoples in uprightness.'
texts.psa.96.11: The heavens joy, and the earth is joyful, The sea and its fulness roar.
texts.psa.96.12: The field exulteth, and all that [is] in it, Then sing do all trees of the forest,
texts.psa.96.13: Before Jehovah, for He hath come, For He hath come to judge the earth. He judgeth the world in righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness!
texts.psa.97.1: Jehovah hath reigned, The earth is joyful, many isles rejoice.
texts.psa.97.2: Cloud and darkness [are] round about Him, Righteousness and judgment the basis of His throne.
texts.psa.97.3: Fire before Him goeth, And burneth round about His adversaries.
texts.psa.97.4: Lightened have His lightnings the world, The earth hath seen, and is pained.
texts.psa.97.5: Hills, like wax, melted before Jehovah, Before the Lord of all the earth.
texts.psa.97.6: The heavens declared His righteousness, And all the peoples have seen His honour.
texts.psa.97.7: Ashamed are all servants of a graven image, Those boasting themselves in idols, Bow yourselves to him, all ye gods.
texts.psa.97.8: Zion hath heard and rejoiceth, And daughters of Judah are joyful, Because of Thy judgments, O Jehovah.
texts.psa.97.9: For Thou, Jehovah, [art] Most High over all the earth, Greatly Thou hast been exalted over all gods.
texts.psa.97.10: Ye who love Jehovah, hate evil, He is keeping the souls of His saints, From the hand of the wicked he delivereth them.
texts.psa.97.11: Light [is] sown for the righteous, And for the upright of heart -- joy.
texts.psa.97.12: Rejoice, ye righteous, in Jehovah, And give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness!
texts.psa.98.1: A Psalm. Sing ye to Jehovah a new song, For wonders He hath done, Given salvation to Him hath His right hand and His holy arm.
texts.psa.98.2: Jehovah hath made known His salvation, Before the eyes of the nations, He hath revealed His righteousness,
texts.psa.98.3: He hath remembered His kindness, And His faithfulness to the house of Israel, All ends of earth have seen the salvation of our God.
texts.psa.98.4: Shout to Jehovah, all the earth, Break forth, and cry aloud, and sing.
texts.psa.98.5: Sing to Jehovah with harp, With harp, and voice of praise,
texts.psa.98.6: With trumpets, and voice of a cornet, Shout ye before the king Jehovah.
texts.psa.98.7: Roar doth the sea and its fulness, The world and the inhabitants in it.
texts.psa.98.8: Floods clap hand, together hills cry aloud,
texts.psa.98.9: Before Jehovah, For He hath come to judge the earth, He judgeth the world in righteousness, And the people in uprightness!
texts.psa.99.1: Jehovah hath reigned, peoples tremble, The Inhabitant of the cherubs, the earth shaketh.
texts.psa.99.2: Jehovah in Zion [is] great, And high He [is] over all the peoples.
texts.psa.99.3: They praise Thy name, `Great, and fearful, holy [it] is.'
texts.psa.99.4: And the strength of the king Hath loved judgment, Thou -- Thou hast established uprightness; Judgment and righteousness in Jacob, Thou -- Thou hast done.
texts.psa.99.5: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And bow yourselves at His footstool, holy [is] He.
texts.psa.99.6: Moses and Aaron among His priests, And Samuel among those proclaiming His name. They are calling unto Jehovah, And He doth answer them.
texts.psa.99.7: In a pillar of cloud He speaketh unto them, They have kept His testimonies, And the statute He hath given to them.
texts.psa.99.8: O Jehovah, our God, Thou hast afflicted them, A God forgiving Thou hast been to them, And taking vengeance on their actions.
texts.psa.99.9: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And bow yourselves at His holy hill, For holy [is] Jehovah our God!
texts.psa.100.1: A Psalm of Thanksgiving. Shout to Jehovah, all the earth.
texts.psa.100.2: Serve Jehovah with joy, come before him with singing.
texts.psa.100.3: Know that Jehovah He [is] God, He made us, and we are His, His people -- and the flock of His pasture.
texts.psa.100.4: Enter ye His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise, Give ye thanks to Him, bless ye His Name.
texts.psa.100.5: For good [is] Jehovah, to the age His kindness, And to generation and generation His faithfulness!
texts.psa.101.1: A Psalm of David. Kindness and judgment I sing, To Thee, O Jehovah, I sing praise.
texts.psa.101.2: I act wisely in a perfect way, When dost Thou come in unto me? I walk habitually in the integrity of my heart, In the midst of my house.
texts.psa.101.3: I set not before mine eyes a worthless thing, The work of those turning aside I have hated, It adhereth not to me.
texts.psa.101.4: A perverse heart turneth aside from me, Wickedness I know not.
texts.psa.101.5: Whoso slandereth in secret his neighbour, Him I cut off, The high of eyes and proud of heart, him I endure not.
texts.psa.101.6: Mine eyes are on the faithful of the land, To dwell with me, Whoso is walking in a perfect way, he serveth me.
texts.psa.101.7: He dwelleth not in my house who is working deceit, Whoso is speaking lies Is not established before mine eyes.
texts.psa.101.8: At morning I cut off all the wicked of the land, To cut off from the city of Jehovah All the workers of iniquity!
texts.psa.102.1: A Prayer of the afflicted when he is feeble, and before Jehovah poureth out his plaint. O Jehovah, hear my prayer, yea, my cry to Thee cometh.
texts.psa.102.2: Hide not Thou Thy face from me, In a day of mine adversity, Incline unto me Thine ear, In the day I call, haste, answer me.
texts.psa.102.3: For consumed in smoke have been my days, And my bones as a fire-brand have burned.
texts.psa.102.4: Smitten as the herb, and withered, is my heart, For I have forgotten to eat my bread.
texts.psa.102.5: From the voice of my sighing Hath my bone cleaved to my flesh.
texts.psa.102.6: I have been like to a pelican of the wilderness, I have been as an owl of the dry places.
texts.psa.102.7: I have watched, and I am As a bird alone on the roof.
texts.psa.102.8: All the day mine enemies reproached me, Those mad at me have sworn against me.
texts.psa.102.9: Because ashes as bread I have eaten, And my drink with weeping have mingled,
texts.psa.102.10: From Thine indignation and Thy wrath, For Thou hast lifted me up, And dost cast me down.
texts.psa.102.11: My days as a shadow [are] stretched out, And I -- as the herb I am withered.
texts.psa.102.12: And Thou, O Jehovah, to the age abidest, And Thy memorial to all generations.
texts.psa.102.13: Thou -- Thou risest -- Thou pitiest Zion, For the time to favour her, For the appointed time hath come.
texts.psa.102.14: For Thy servants have been pleased with her stones, And her dust they favour.
texts.psa.102.15: And nations fear the name of Jehovah, And all kings of the earth Thine honour,
texts.psa.102.16: For Jehovah hath builded Zion, He hath been seen in His honour,
texts.psa.102.17: He turned unto the prayer of the destitute, And He hath not despised their prayer.
texts.psa.102.18: This is written for a later generation, And the people created do praise Jah.
texts.psa.102.19: For He hath looked From the high place of His sanctuary. Jehovah from heaven unto earth looked attentively,
texts.psa.102.20: To hear the groan of the prisoner, To loose sons of death,
texts.psa.102.21: To declare in Zion the name of Jehovah, And His praise in Jerusalem,
texts.psa.102.22: In the peoples being gathered together, And the kingdoms -- to serve Jehovah.
texts.psa.102.23: He hath humbled in the way my power, He hath shortened my days.
texts.psa.102.24: I say, `My God, take me not up in the midst of my days,' Through all generations [are] Thine years.
texts.psa.102.25: Beforetime the earth Thou didst found, And the work of Thy hands [are] the heavens.
texts.psa.102.26: They -- They perish, and Thou remainest, And all of them as a garment become old, As clothing Thou changest them, And they are changed.
texts.psa.102.27: And Thou [art] the same, and Thine years are not finished.
texts.psa.102.28: The sons of Thy servants do continue, And their seed before Thee is established!
texts.psa.103.1: By David. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And all my inward parts -- His Holy Name.
texts.psa.103.2: Bless, O my soul, Jehovah, And forget not all His benefits,
texts.psa.103.3: Who is forgiving all thine iniquities, Who is healing all thy diseases,
texts.psa.103.4: Who is redeeming from destruction thy life, Who is crowning thee -- kindness and mercies,
texts.psa.103.5: Who is satisfying with good thy desire, Renew itself as an eagle doth thy youth.
texts.psa.103.6: Jehovah is doing righteousness and judgments For all the oppressed.
texts.psa.103.7: He maketh known His ways to Moses, To the sons of Israel His acts.
texts.psa.103.8: Merciful and gracious [is] Jehovah, Slow to anger, and abundant in mercy.
texts.psa.103.9: Not for ever doth He strive, Nor to the age doth He watch.
texts.psa.103.10: Not according to our sins hath He done to us, Nor according to our iniquities Hath He conferred benefits upon us.
texts.psa.103.11: For, as the height of the heavens [is] above the earth, His kindness hath been mighty over those fearing Him.
texts.psa.103.12: As the distance of east from west He hath put far from us our transgressions.
texts.psa.103.13: As a father hath mercy on sons, Jehovah hath mercy on those fearing Him.
texts.psa.103.14: For He hath known our frame, Remembering that we [are] dust.
texts.psa.103.15: Mortal man! as grass [are] his days, As a flower of the field so he flourisheth;
texts.psa.103.16: For a wind hath passed over it, and it is not, And its place doth not discern it any more.
texts.psa.103.17: And the kindness of Jehovah [Is] from age even unto age on those fearing Him, And His righteousness to sons' sons,
texts.psa.103.18: To those keeping His covenant, And to those remembering His precepts to do them.
texts.psa.103.19: Jehovah in the heavens Hath established His throne, And His kingdom over all hath ruled.
texts.psa.103.20: Bless Jehovah, ye His messengers, Mighty in power -- doing His word, To hearken to the voice of His Word.
texts.psa.103.21: Bless Jehovah, all ye His hosts, His ministers -- doing His pleasure.
texts.psa.103.22: Bless Jehovah, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah!
texts.psa.104.1: Bless, O my soul, Jehovah! Jehovah, my God, Thou hast been very great, Honour and majesty Thou hast put on.
texts.psa.104.2: Covering himself [with] light as a garment, Stretching out the heavens as a curtain,
texts.psa.104.3: Who is laying the beam of His upper chambers in the waters, Who is making thick clouds His chariot, Who is walking on wings of wind,
texts.psa.104.4: Making His messengers -- the winds, His ministers -- the flaming fire.
texts.psa.104.5: He hath founded earth on its bases, It is not moved to the age and for ever.
texts.psa.104.6: The abyss! as with clothing Thou hast covered it, Above hills do waters stand.
texts.psa.104.7: From Thy rebuke they flee, From the voice of Thy thunder haste away.
texts.psa.104.8: They go up hills -- they go down valleys, Unto a place Thou hast founded for them.
texts.psa.104.9: A border Thou hast set, they pass not over, They turn not back to cover the earth.
texts.psa.104.10: Who is sending forth fountains in valleys, Between hills they go on.
texts.psa.104.11: They water every beast of the field, Wild asses break their thirst.
texts.psa.104.12: By them the fowl of the heavens doth dwell, From between the branches They give forth the voice.
texts.psa.104.13: Watering hills from His upper chambers, From the fruit of Thy works is the earth satisfied.
texts.psa.104.14: Causing grass to spring up for cattle, And herb for the service of man, To bring forth bread from the earth,
texts.psa.104.15: And wine -- it rejoiceth the heart of man, To cause the face to shine from oil, And bread -- the heart of man it supporteth.
texts.psa.104.16: Satisfied [are] the trees of Jehovah, Cedars of Lebanon that He hath planted,
texts.psa.104.17: Where birds do make nests, The stork -- the firs [are] her house.
texts.psa.104.18: The high hills [are] for wild goats, Rocks [are] a refuge for conies,
texts.psa.104.19: He made the moon for seasons, The sun hath known his place of entrance.
texts.psa.104.20: Thou settest darkness, and it is night, In it doth every beast of the forest creep.
texts.psa.104.21: The young lions are roaring for prey, And to seek from God their food.
texts.psa.104.22: The sun riseth, they are gathered, And in their dens they crouch.
texts.psa.104.23: Man goeth forth to his work, And to his service -- till evening.
texts.psa.104.24: How many have been Thy works, O Jehovah, All of them in wisdom Thou hast made, Full is the earth of thy possessions.
texts.psa.104.25: This, the sea, great and broad of sides, There [are] moving things -- innumerable, Living creatures -- small with great.
texts.psa.104.26: There do ships go: leviathan, That Thou hast formed to play in it.
texts.psa.104.27: All of them unto Thee do look, To give their food in its season.
texts.psa.104.28: Thou dost give to them -- they gather, Thou dost open Thy hand -- they [are] satisfied [with] good.
texts.psa.104.29: Thou hidest Thy face -- they are troubled, Thou gatherest their spirit -- they expire, And unto their dust they turn back.
texts.psa.104.30: Thou sendest out Thy Spirit, they are created, And Thou renewest the face of the ground.
texts.psa.104.31: The honour of Jehovah is to the age, Jehovah rejoiceth in His works,
texts.psa.104.32: Who is looking to earth, and it trembleth, He cometh against hills, and they smoke.
texts.psa.104.33: I sing to Jehovah during my life, I sing praise to my God while I exist.
texts.psa.104.34: Sweet is my meditation on Him, I -- I do rejoice in Jehovah.
texts.psa.104.35: Consumed are sinners from the earth, And the wicked are no more. Bless, O my soul, Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah!
texts.psa.105.1: Give ye thanks to Jehovah -- call ye in His name, Make known among the peoples His acts.
texts.psa.105.2: Sing ye to Him -- sing praise to Him, Meditate ye on all His wonders.
texts.psa.105.3: Boast yourselves in His Holy Name, The heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoiceth.
texts.psa.105.4: Seek ye Jehovah and His strength, Seek ye His face continually.
texts.psa.105.5: Remember His wonders that He did, His signs and the judgments of His mouth.
texts.psa.105.6: O seed of Abraham, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
texts.psa.105.7: He [is] Jehovah our God, In all the earth [are] His judgments.
texts.psa.105.8: He hath remembered to the age His covenant, The word He commanded to a thousand generations,
texts.psa.105.9: That He hath made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
texts.psa.105.10: And doth establish it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel -- a covenant age-during,
texts.psa.105.11: Saying, `To thee I give the land of Canaan, The portion of your inheritance,'
texts.psa.105.12: In their being few in number, But a few, and sojourners in it.
texts.psa.105.13: And they go up and down, from nation unto nation, From a kingdom unto another people.
texts.psa.105.14: He hath not suffered any to oppress them And He reproveth for their sakes kings.
texts.psa.105.15: `Strike not against Mine anointed, And to My prophets do not evil.'
texts.psa.105.16: And He calleth a famine on the land, The whole staff of bread He hath broken.
texts.psa.105.17: He hath sent before them a man, For a servant hath Joseph been sold.
texts.psa.105.18: They have afflicted with fetters his feet, Iron hath entered his soul,
texts.psa.105.19: Till the time of the coming of His word The saying of Jehovah hath tried him.
texts.psa.105.20: The king hath sent, and looseth him, The ruler of the peoples, and draweth him out.
texts.psa.105.21: He hath made him lord of his house, And ruler over all his possessions.
texts.psa.105.22: To bind his chiefs at his pleasure, And his elders he maketh wise.
texts.psa.105.23: And Israel cometh in to Egypt, And Jacob hath sojourned in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.24: And He maketh His people very fruitful, And maketh it mightier than its adversaries.
texts.psa.105.25: He turned their heart to hate His people, To conspire against His servants.
texts.psa.105.26: He hath sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had fixed on.
texts.psa.105.27: They have set among them the matters of His signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
texts.psa.105.28: He hath sent darkness, and it is dark, And they have not provoked His word.
texts.psa.105.29: He hath turned their waters to blood, And putteth to death their fish.
texts.psa.105.30: Teemed hath their land [with] frogs, In the inner chambers of their kings.
texts.psa.105.31: He hath said, and the beetle cometh, Lice into all their border.
texts.psa.105.32: He hath made their showers hail, A flaming fire [is] in their land.
texts.psa.105.33: And He smiteth their vine and their fig, And shivereth the trees of their border.
texts.psa.105.34: He hath said, and the locust cometh, And the cankerworm -- innumerable,
texts.psa.105.35: And it consumeth every herb in their land, And it consumeth the fruit of their ground.
texts.psa.105.36: And He smiteth every first-born in their land, The first-fruit of all their strength,
texts.psa.105.37: And bringeth them out with silver and gold, And there is not in its tribes a feeble one.
texts.psa.105.38: Rejoiced hath Egypt in their going forth, For their fear had fallen upon them.
texts.psa.105.39: He hath spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to enlighten the night.
texts.psa.105.40: They have asked, and He bringeth quails, And [with] bread of heaven satisfieth them.
texts.psa.105.41: He hath opened a rock, and waters issue, They have gone on in dry places -- a river.
texts.psa.105.42: For He hath remembered His holy word, With Abraham His servant,
texts.psa.105.43: And He bringeth forth His people with joy, With singing His chosen ones.
texts.psa.105.44: And He giveth to them the lands of nations, And the labour of peoples they possess,
texts.psa.105.45: That they may observe His statutes, And His laws may keep. Praise ye Jehovah!
texts.psa.106.1: Praise ye Jah, give thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, [is] His kindness.
texts.psa.106.2: Who doth utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? Soundeth all His praise?
texts.psa.106.3: O the happiness of those keeping judgment, Doing righteousness at all times.
texts.psa.106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, With the favour of Thy people, Look after me in Thy salvation.
texts.psa.106.5: To look on the good of Thy chosen ones, To rejoice in the joy of Thy nation, To boast myself with Thine inheritance.
texts.psa.106.6: We have sinned with our fathers, We have done perversely, we have done wickedly.
texts.psa.106.7: Our fathers in Egypt, Have not considered wisely Thy wonders, They have not remembered The abundance of Thy kind acts, And provoke by the sea, at the sea of Suph.
texts.psa.106.8: And He saveth them for His name's sake, To make known His might,
texts.psa.106.9: And rebuketh the sea of Suph, and it is dried up, And causeth them to go Through depths as a wilderness.
texts.psa.106.10: And He saveth them from the hand Of him who is hating, And redeemeth them from the hand of the enemy.
texts.psa.106.11: And waters cover their adversaries, One of them hath not been left.
texts.psa.106.12: And they believe in His words, they sing His praise,
texts.psa.106.13: They have hasted -- forgotten His works, They have not waited for His counsel.
texts.psa.106.14: And they lust greatly in a wilderness, And try God in a desert.
texts.psa.106.15: And He giveth to them their request, And sendeth leanness into their soul.
texts.psa.106.16: And they are envious of Moses in the camp, Of Aaron, Jehovah's holy one.
texts.psa.106.17: Earth openeth, and swalloweth up Dathan, And covereth over the company of Abiram.
texts.psa.106.18: And fire burneth among their company, A flame setteth on fire the wicked.
texts.psa.106.19: They make a calf in Horeb, And bow themselves to a molten image,
texts.psa.106.20: And change their Honour Into the form of an ox eating herbs.
texts.psa.106.21: They have forgotten God their saviour, The doer of great things in Egypt,
texts.psa.106.22: Of wonderful things in the land of Ham, Of fearful things by the sea of Suph.
texts.psa.106.23: And He saith to destroy them, Unless Moses, His chosen one, Had stood in the breach before Him, To turn back His wrath from destroying.
texts.psa.106.24: And they kick against the desirable land, They have not given credence to His word.
texts.psa.106.25: And they murmur in their tents, They have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah.
texts.psa.106.26: And He lifteth up His hand to them, To cause them to fall in a wilderness,
texts.psa.106.27: And to cause their seed to fall among nations, And to scatter them through lands.
texts.psa.106.28: And they are coupled to Baal-Peor, And eat the sacrifices of the dead,
texts.psa.106.29: And they provoke to anger by their actions, And a plague breaketh forth upon them,
texts.psa.106.30: And Phinehas standeth, and executeth judgment, And the plague is restrained,
texts.psa.106.31: And it is reckoned to him to righteousness, To all generations -- unto the age.
texts.psa.106.32: And they cause wrath by the waters of Meribah, And it is evil to Moses for their sakes,
texts.psa.106.33: For they have provoked his spirit, And he speaketh wrongfully with his lips.
texts.psa.106.34: They have not destroyed the peoples, As Jehovah had said to them,
texts.psa.106.35: And mix themselves among nations, and learn their works,
texts.psa.106.36: And serve their idols, And they are to them for a snare.
texts.psa.106.37: And they sacrifice their sons And their daughters to destroyers,
texts.psa.106.38: And they shed innocent blood -- Blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they have sacrificed to idols of Canaan, And the land is profaned with blood.
texts.psa.106.39: And they are defiled with their works, And commit whoredom in their habitual doings.
texts.psa.106.40: And the anger of Jehovah Is kindled against His people, And He doth abominate His inheritance.
texts.psa.106.41: And giveth them into the hand of nations, And those hating them rule over them,
texts.psa.106.42: And their enemies oppress them, And they are humbled under their hand.
texts.psa.106.43: Many times He doth deliver them, And they rebel in their counsel, And they are brought low in their iniquity.
texts.psa.106.44: And He looketh on their distress When He heareth their cry,
texts.psa.106.45: And remembereth for them His covenant, And is comforted, According to the abundance of His kindness.
texts.psa.106.46: And He appointeth them for mercies Before all their captors.
texts.psa.106.47: Save us, O Jehovah our God, and gather us from the nations, To give thanks to Thy holy name, To glory in Thy praise.
texts.psa.106.48: Blessed [is] Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age even unto the age. And all the people said, `Amen, praise Jah!'
texts.psa.107.1: `Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age [is] His kindness:'
texts.psa.107.2: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say, Whom He redeemed from the hand of an adversary.
texts.psa.107.3: And from the lands hath gathered them, From east and from west, From north, and from the sea.
texts.psa.107.4: They wandered in a wilderness, in a desert by the way, A city of habitation they have not found.
texts.psa.107.5: Hungry -- yea -- thirsty, Their soul in them becometh feeble,
texts.psa.107.6: And they cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distress He delivereth them,
texts.psa.107.7: And causeth them to tread in a right way, To go unto a city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.8: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.
texts.psa.107.9: For He hath satisfied a longing soul, And a hungry soul hath filled [with] goodness.
texts.psa.107.10: Inhabitants of dark places and death-shade, Prisoners of affliction and of iron,
texts.psa.107.11: Because they changed the saying of God, And the counsel of the Most High despised.
texts.psa.107.12: And He humbleth with labour their heart, They have been feeble, and there is no helper.
texts.psa.107.13: And they cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saveth them.
texts.psa.107.14: He bringeth them out from the dark place, And death-shade, And their bands He draweth away.
texts.psa.107.15: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men.
texts.psa.107.16: For He hath broken doors of brass, And bars of iron He hath cut.
texts.psa.107.17: Fools, by means of their transgression, And by their iniquities, afflict themselves.
texts.psa.107.18: All food doth their soul abominate, And they come nigh unto the gates of death,
texts.psa.107.19: And cry unto Jehovah in their adversity, From their distresses He saveth them,
texts.psa.107.20: He sendeth His word and healeth them, And delivereth from their destructions.
texts.psa.107.21: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,
texts.psa.107.22: And they sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving, And recount His works with singing.
texts.psa.107.23: Those going down [to] the sea in ships, Doing business in many waters,
texts.psa.107.24: They have seen the works of Jehovah, And His wonders in the deep.
texts.psa.107.25: And He saith, and appointeth a tempest, And it lifteth up its billows,
texts.psa.107.26: They go up [to] the heavens, they go down [to] the depths, Their soul in evil is melted.
texts.psa.107.27: They reel to and fro, and move as a drunkard, And all their wisdom is swallowed up.
texts.psa.107.28: And they cry to Jehovah in their adversity, And from their distresses He bringeth them out.
texts.psa.107.29: He establisheth a whirlwind to a calm, And hushed are their billows.
texts.psa.107.30: And they rejoice because they are quiet, And He leadeth them to the haven of their desire.
texts.psa.107.31: They confess to Jehovah His kindness, And His wonders to the sons of men,
texts.psa.107.32: And they exalt Him in the assembly of the people, And in the seat of the elders praise Him.
texts.psa.107.33: He maketh rivers become a wilderness, And fountains of waters become dry land.
texts.psa.107.34: A fruitful land becometh a barren place, For the wickedness of its inhabitants.
texts.psa.107.35: He maketh a wilderness become a pool of water, And a dry land become fountains of waters.
texts.psa.107.36: And He causeth the hungry to dwell there, And they prepare a city of habitation.
texts.psa.107.37: And they sow fields, and plant vineyards, And they make fruits of increase.
texts.psa.107.38: And He blesseth them, and they multiply exceedingly, And their cattle He doth not diminish.
texts.psa.107.39: And they are diminished, and bow down, By restraint, evil, and sorrow.
texts.psa.107.40: He is pouring contempt upon nobles, And causeth them to wander in vacancy -- no way.
texts.psa.107.41: And setteth on high the needy from affliction, And placeth families as a flock.
texts.psa.107.42: The upright do see and rejoice, And all perversity hath shut her mouth.
texts.psa.107.43: Who [is] wise, and observeth these? They understand the kind acts of Jehovah!
texts.psa.108.1: A Song, a Psalm of David. Prepared is my heart, O God, I sing, yea, I sing praise, also my honour.
texts.psa.108.2: Awake, psaltery and harp, I awake the dawn.
texts.psa.108.3: I thank Thee among peoples, O Jehovah, And I praise Thee among the nations.
texts.psa.108.4: For great above the heavens [is] Thy kindness, And unto the clouds Thy truth.
texts.psa.108.5: Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, And above all the earth Thy honour.
texts.psa.108.6: That Thy beloved ones may be delivered, Save [with] Thy right hand, and answer us.
texts.psa.108.7: God hath spoken in His holiness: I exult, I apportion Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I measure,
texts.psa.108.8: Mine [is] Gilead, mine [is] Manasseh, And Ephraim [is] the strength of my head, Judah [is] my lawgiver,
texts.psa.108.9: Moab [is] a pot for my washing, Upon Edom I cast my shoe, Over Philistia I shout habitually.
texts.psa.108.10: Who doth bring me in to the fenced city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
texts.psa.108.11: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not out, O God, with our hosts!
texts.psa.108.12: Give to us help from adversity, And vain is the salvation of man.
texts.psa.108.13: In God we do mightily, And He doth tread down our adversaries!
texts.psa.109.1: To the Overseer. -- A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent,
texts.psa.109.2: For the mouth of wickedness, and the mouth of deceit, Against me they have opened, They have spoken with me -- A tongue of falsehood, and words of hatred!
texts.psa.109.3: They have compassed me about, And they fight me without cause.
texts.psa.109.4: For my love they oppose me, and I -- prayer!
texts.psa.109.5: And they set against me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
texts.psa.109.6: Appoint Thou over him the wicked, And an adversary standeth at his right hand.
texts.psa.109.7: In his being judged, he goeth forth wicked, And his prayer is for sin.
texts.psa.109.8: His days are few, his oversight another taketh,
texts.psa.109.9: His sons are fatherless, and his wife a widow.
texts.psa.109.10: And wander continually do his sons, Yea, they have begged, And have sought out of their dry places.
texts.psa.109.11: An exactor layeth a snare for all that he hath, And strangers spoil his labour.
texts.psa.109.12: He hath none to extend kindness, Nor is there one showing favour to his orphans.
texts.psa.109.13: His posterity is for cutting off, In another generation is their name blotted out.
texts.psa.109.14: The iniquity of his fathers Is remembered unto Jehovah, And the sin of his mother is not blotted out.
texts.psa.109.15: They are before Jehovah continually, And He cutteth off from earth their memorial.
texts.psa.109.16: Because that he hath not remembered to do kindness, And pursueth the poor man and needy, And the smitten of heart -- to slay,
texts.psa.109.17: And he loveth reviling, and it meeteth him, And he hath not delighted in blessing, And it is far from him.
texts.psa.109.18: And he putteth on reviling as his robe, And it cometh in as water into his midst, And as oil into his bones.
texts.psa.109.19: It is to him as apparel -- he covereth himself, And for a continual girdle he girdeth it on.
texts.psa.109.20: This [is] the wage of mine accusers from Jehovah, And of those speaking evil against my soul.
texts.psa.109.21: And Thou, O Jehovah Lord, Deal with me for Thy name's sake, Because Thy kindness [is] good, deliver me.
texts.psa.109.22: For I [am] poor and needy, And my heart hath been pierced in my midst.
texts.psa.109.23: As a shadow when it is stretched out I have gone, I have been driven away as a locust.
texts.psa.109.24: My knees have been feeble from fasting, And my flesh hath failed of fatness.
texts.psa.109.25: And I -- I have been a reproach to them, They see me, they shake their head.
texts.psa.109.26: Help me, O Jehovah my God, Save me, according to Thy kindness.
texts.psa.109.27: And they know that this [is] Thy hand, Thou, O Jehovah, Thou hast done it.
texts.psa.109.28: They revile, and Thou dost bless, They have risen, and are ashamed, And Thy servant doth rejoice.
texts.psa.109.29: Mine accusers put on blushing, and are covered, As an upper robe [is] their shame.
texts.psa.109.30: I thank Jehovah greatly with my mouth, And in the midst of many I praise Him,
texts.psa.109.31: For He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save from those judging his soul.
texts.psa.110.1: A Psalm of David. The affirmation of Jehovah to my Lord: `Sit at My right hand, Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.'
texts.psa.110.2: The rod of thy strength doth Jehovah send from Zion, Rule in the midst of thine enemies.
texts.psa.110.3: Thy people [are] free-will gifts in the day of Thy strength, in the honours of holiness, From the womb, from the morning, Thou hast the dew of thy youth.
texts.psa.110.4: Jehovah hath sworn, and doth not repent, `Thou [art] a priest to the age, According to the order of Melchizedek.'
texts.psa.110.5: The Lord on thy right hand smote kings In the day of His anger.
texts.psa.110.6: He doth judge among the nations, He hath completed the carcases, Hath smitten the head over the mighty earth.
texts.psa.110.7: From a brook in the way he drinketh, Therefore he doth lift up the head!
texts.psa.111.1: Praise ye Jah! I thank Jehovah with the whole heart, In the secret meeting of the upright, And of the company.
texts.psa.111.2: Great [are] the works of Jehovah, Sought out by all desiring them.
texts.psa.111.3: Honourable and majestic is His work, And His righteousness is standing for ever.
texts.psa.111.4: A memorial He hath made of His wonders, Gracious and merciful [is] Jehovah.
texts.psa.111.5: Prey He hath given to those fearing Him, He remembereth to the age His covenant.
texts.psa.111.6: The power of His works He hath declared to His people, To give to them the inheritance of nations.
texts.psa.111.7: The works of His hands [are] true and just, Stedfast [are] all His appointments.
texts.psa.111.8: They are sustained for ever to the age. They are made in truth and uprightness.
texts.psa.111.9: Redemption He hath sent to His people, He hath appointed to the age His covenant, Holy and fearful [is] His name.
texts.psa.111.10: The beginning of wisdom [is] fear of Jehovah, Good understanding have all doing them, His praise [is] standing for ever!
texts.psa.112.1: Praise ye Jah! O the happiness of one fearing Jehovah, In His commands he hath delighted greatly.
texts.psa.112.2: Mighty in the earth is his seed, The generation of the upright is blessed.
texts.psa.112.3: Wealth and riches [are] in his house, And his righteousness is standing for ever.
texts.psa.112.4: Light hath risen in darkness to the upright, Gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
texts.psa.112.5: Good [is] the man -- gracious and lending, He sustaineth his matters in judgment.
texts.psa.112.6: For -- to the age he is not moved; For a memorial age-during is the righteous.
texts.psa.112.7: Of an evil report he is not afraid, Prepared is His heart, confident in Jehovah.
texts.psa.112.8: Sustained is his heart -- he feareth not, Till that he look on his adversaries.
texts.psa.112.9: He hath scattered -- hath given to the needy, His righteousness is standing for ever, His horn is exalted with honour.
texts.psa.112.10: The wicked seeth, and hath been angry, His teeth he gnasheth, and hath melted, The desire of the wicked doth perish!
texts.psa.113.1: Praise ye Jah! Praise, ye servants of Jehovah. Praise the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.113.2: The name of Jehovah is blessed, From henceforth, and unto the age.
texts.psa.113.3: From the rising of the sun unto its going in, Praised [is] the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.113.4: High above all nations [is] Jehovah, Above the heavens [is] his honour.
texts.psa.113.5: Who [is] as Jehovah our God, He is exalting [Himself] to sit?
texts.psa.113.6: He is humbling [Himself] to look On the heavens and on the earth.
texts.psa.113.7: He is raising up from the dust the poor, From a dunghill He exalteth the needy.
texts.psa.113.8: To cause to sit with princes, With the princes of His people.
texts.psa.113.9: Causing the barren one of the house to sit, A joyful mother of sons; praise ye Jah!
texts.psa.114.1: In the going out of Israel from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a strange people,
texts.psa.114.2: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
texts.psa.114.3: The sea hath seen, and fleeth, The Jordan turneth backward.
texts.psa.114.4: The mountains have skipped as rams, Heights as sons of a flock.
texts.psa.114.5: What -- to thee, O sea, that thou fleest? O Jordan, thou turnest back!
texts.psa.114.6: O mountains, ye skip as rams! O heights, as sons of a flock!
texts.psa.114.7: From before the Lord be afraid, O earth, From before the God of Jacob,
texts.psa.114.8: He is turning the rock to a pool of waters, The flint to a fountain of waters!
texts.psa.115.1: Not to us, O Jehovah, not to us, But to Thy name give honour, For Thy kindness, for Thy truth.
texts.psa.115.2: Why do the nations say, `Where, pray, [is] their God.
texts.psa.115.3: And our God [is] in the heavens, All that He hath pleased He hath done.
texts.psa.115.4: Their idols [are] silver and gold, work of man's hands,
texts.psa.115.5: A mouth they have, and they speak not, Eyes they have, and they see not,
texts.psa.115.6: Ears they have, and they hear not, A nose they have, and they smell not,
texts.psa.115.7: Their hands, but they handle not, Their feet, and they walk not;
texts.psa.115.8: Nor do they mutter through their throat, Like them are their makers, Every one who is trusting in them.
texts.psa.115.9: O Israel, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield [is] He.'
texts.psa.115.10: O house of Aaron, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield [is] He.'
texts.psa.115.11: Ye fearing Jehovah, trust in Jehovah, `Their help and their shield [is] He.'
texts.psa.115.12: Jehovah hath remembered us, He blesseth, He blesseth the house of Israel, He blesseth the house of Aaron,
texts.psa.115.13: He blesseth those fearing Jehovah, The small with the great.
texts.psa.115.14: Jehovah addeth to you, to you, and to your sons.
texts.psa.115.15: Blessed [are] ye of Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,
texts.psa.115.16: The heavens -- the heavens [are] Jehovah's, And the earth He hath given to sons of men,
texts.psa.115.17: The dead praise not Jah, Nor any going down to silence.
texts.psa.115.18: And we, we bless Jah, From henceforth, and unto the age. Praise ye Jah!
texts.psa.116.1: I have loved, because Jehovah heareth My voice, my supplication,
texts.psa.116.2: Because He hath inclined His ear to me, And during my days I call.
texts.psa.116.3: Compassed me have cords of death, And straits of Sheol have found me, Distress and sorrow I find.
texts.psa.116.4: And in the name of Jehovah I call: I pray Thee, O Jehovah, deliver my soul,
texts.psa.116.5: Gracious [is] Jehovah, and righteous, Yea, our God [is] merciful,
texts.psa.116.6: A preserver of the simple [is] Jehovah, I was low, and to me He giveth salvation.
texts.psa.116.7: Turn back, O my soul, to thy rest, For Jehovah hath conferred benefits on thee.
texts.psa.116.8: For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, my feet from overthrowing.
texts.psa.116.9: I walk habitually before Jehovah In the lands of the living.
texts.psa.116.10: I have believed, for I speak, I -- I have been afflicted greatly.
texts.psa.116.11: I said in my haste, `Every man [is] a liar.'
texts.psa.116.12: What do I return to Jehovah? All His benefits [are] upon me.
texts.psa.116.13: The cup of salvation I lift up, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
texts.psa.116.14: My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people.
texts.psa.116.15: Precious in the eyes of Jehovah [is] the death for His saints.
texts.psa.116.16: Cause [it] to come, O Jehovah, for I [am] Thy servant. I [am] Thy servant, son of Thy handmaid, Thou hast opened my bonds.
texts.psa.116.17: To Thee I sacrifice a sacrifice of thanks, And in the name of Jehovah I call.
texts.psa.116.18: My vows to Jehovah let me complete, I pray you, before all His people,
texts.psa.116.19: In the courts of the house of Jehovah, In thy midst, O Jerusalem, praise ye Jah!
texts.psa.117.1: Praise Jehovah, all ye nations, Glorify Him, all ye peoples.
texts.psa.117.2: For mighty to us hath been His kindness, And the truth of Jehovah [is] to the age. Praise ye Jah!
texts.psa.118.1: Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age [is] His kindness.
texts.psa.118.2: I pray you, let Israel say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.
texts.psa.118.3: I pray you, let the house of Aaron say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.
texts.psa.118.4: I pray you, let those fearing Jehovah say, That, to the age [is] His kindness.
texts.psa.118.5: From the straitness I called Jah, Jah answered me in a broad place.
texts.psa.118.6: Jehovah [is] for me, I do not fear what man doth to me.
texts.psa.118.7: Jehovah [is] for me among my helpers, And I -- I look on those hating me.
texts.psa.118.8: Better to take refuge in Jehovah than to trust in man,
texts.psa.118.9: Better to take refuge in Jehovah, Than to trust in princes.
texts.psa.118.10: All nations have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
texts.psa.118.11: They have compassed me about, Yea, they have compassed me about, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
texts.psa.118.12: They compassed me about as bees, They have been extinguished as a fire of thorns, In the name of Jehovah I surely cut them off.
texts.psa.118.13: Thou hast sorely thrust me to fall, And Jehovah hath helped me.
texts.psa.118.14: My strength and song [is] Jah, And He is to me for salvation.
texts.psa.118.15: A voice of singing and salvation, [Is] in the tents of the righteous, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.
texts.psa.118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted, The right hand of Jehovah is doing valiantly.
texts.psa.118.17: I do not die, but live, And recount the works of Jah,
texts.psa.118.18: Jah hath sorely chastened me, And to death hath not given me up.
texts.psa.118.19: Open ye to me gates of righteousness, I enter into them -- I thank Jah.
texts.psa.118.20: This [is] the gate to Jehovah, The righteous enter into it.
texts.psa.118.21: I thank Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art to me for salvation.
texts.psa.118.22: A stone the builders refused Hath become head of a corner.
texts.psa.118.23: From Jehovah hath this been, It [is] wonderful in our eyes,
texts.psa.118.24: This [is] the day Jehovah hath made, We rejoice and are glad in it.
texts.psa.118.25: I beseech Thee, O Jehovah, save, I pray Thee, I beseech Thee, O Jehovah, prosper, I pray Thee.
texts.psa.118.26: Blessed [is] he who is coming In the name of Jehovah, We blessed you from the house of Jehovah,
texts.psa.118.27: God [is] Jehovah, and He giveth to us light, Direct ye the festal-sacrifice with cords, Unto the horns of the altar.
texts.psa.118.28: My God Thou [art], and I confess Thee, My God, I exalt Thee.
texts.psa.118.29: Give ye thanks to Jehovah, For good, for to the age, [is] His kindness!
texts.psa.119.1: [Aleph.] O the happiness of those perfect in the way, They are walking in the law of Jehovah,
texts.psa.119.2: O the happiness of those keeping His testimonies, With the whole heart they seek Him.
texts.psa.119.3: Yea, they have not done iniquity, In His ways they have walked.
texts.psa.119.4: Thou hast commanded us Thy precepts to keep diligently,
texts.psa.119.5: O that my ways were prepared to keep Thy statutes,
texts.psa.119.6: Then I am not ashamed In my looking unto all Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.7: I confess Thee with uprightness of heart, In my learning the judgments of Thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.8: Thy statutes I keep, leave me not utterly!
texts.psa.119.9: [Beth.] With what doth a young man purify his path? To observe -- according to Thy word.
texts.psa.119.10: With all my heart I have sought Thee, Let me not err from Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.11: In my heart I have hid Thy saying, That I sin not before Thee.
texts.psa.119.12: Blessed [art] Thou, O Jehovah, teach me Thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.13: With my lips I have recounted All the judgments of Thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.14: In the way of Thy testimonies I have joyed, As over all wealth.
texts.psa.119.15: In Thy precepts I meditate, And I behold attentively Thy paths.
texts.psa.119.16: In Thy statutes I delight myself, I do not forget Thy word.
texts.psa.119.17: [Gimel.] Confer benefits on Thy servant, I live, and I keep Thy word.
texts.psa.119.18: Uncover mine eyes, and I behold wonders out of Thy law.
texts.psa.119.19: A sojourner I [am] on earth, Hide not from me Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.20: Broken hath my soul for desire Unto Thy judgments at all times.
texts.psa.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the cursed proud, Who are erring from Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.22: Remove from me reproach and contempt, For Thy testimonies I have kept.
texts.psa.119.23: Princes also sat -- against me they spoke, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes,
texts.psa.119.24: Thy testimonies also [are] my delight, The men of my counsel!
texts.psa.119.25: [Daleth.] Cleaved to the dust hath my soul, Quicken me according to Thy word.
texts.psa.119.26: My ways I have recounted, And Thou answerest me, teach me Thy statutes,
texts.psa.119.27: The way of Thy precepts cause me to understand, And I meditate in Thy wonders.
texts.psa.119.28: My soul hath dropped from affliction, Establish me according to Thy word.
texts.psa.119.29: The way of falsehood turn aside from me And with Thy law favour me.
texts.psa.119.30: The way of faithfulness I have chosen, Thy judgments I have compared,
texts.psa.119.31: I have adhered to Thy testimonies, O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
texts.psa.119.32: The way of Thy commands I run, For Thou dost enlarge my heart!
texts.psa.119.33: [He.] Show me, O Jehovah, the way of Thy statutes, And I keep it -- [to] the end.
texts.psa.119.34: Cause me to understand, and I keep Thy law, And observe it with the whole heart.
texts.psa.119.35: Cause me to tread in the path of Thy commands, For in it I have delighted.
texts.psa.119.36: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, And not unto dishonest gain.
texts.psa.119.37: Remove mine eyes from seeing vanity, In Thy way quicken Thou me.
texts.psa.119.38: Establish to Thy servant Thy saying, That [is] concerning Thy fear.
texts.psa.119.39: Remove my reproach that I have feared, For Thy judgments [are] good.
texts.psa.119.40: Lo, I have longed for Thy precepts, In Thy righteousness quicken Thou me,
texts.psa.119.41: [Waw.] And meet me doth Thy kindness, O Jehovah, Thy salvation according to Thy saying.
texts.psa.119.42: And I answer him who is reproaching me a word, For I have trusted in Thy word.
texts.psa.119.43: And Thou takest not utterly away From my mouth the word of truth, Because for Thy judgment I have hoped.
texts.psa.119.44: And I keep Thy law continually, To the age and for ever.
texts.psa.119.45: And I walk habitually in a broad place, For Thy precepts I have sought.
texts.psa.119.46: And I speak of Thy testimonies before kings, And I am not ashamed.
texts.psa.119.47: And I delight myself in Thy commands, That I have loved,
texts.psa.119.48: And I lift up my hands unto Thy commands, That I have loved, And I do meditate on Thy statutes!
texts.psa.119.49: [Zain.] Remember the word to Thy servant, On which Thou hast caused me to hope.
texts.psa.119.50: This [is] my comfort in mine affliction, That Thy saying hath quickened me.
texts.psa.119.51: The proud have utterly scorned me, From Thy law I have not turned aside.
texts.psa.119.52: I remembered Thy judgments of old, O Jehovah, And I comfort myself.
texts.psa.119.53: Horror hath seized me, Because of the wicked forsaking Thy law.
texts.psa.119.54: Songs have been to me Thy statutes, In the house of my sojournings.
texts.psa.119.55: I have remembered in the night Thy name, O Jehovah, And I do keep Thy law.
texts.psa.119.56: This hath been to me, That Thy precepts I have kept!
texts.psa.119.57: [Cheth.] My portion [is] Jehovah; I have said -- to keep Thy words,
texts.psa.119.58: I appeased Thy face with the whole heart, Favour me according to Thy saying.
texts.psa.119.59: I have reckoned my ways, And turn back my feet unto Thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.60: I have made haste, And delayed not, to keep Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.61: Cords of the wicked have surrounded me, Thy law I have not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.62: At midnight I rise to give thanks to Thee, For the judgments of Thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.63: A companion I [am] to all who fear Thee, And to those keeping Thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.64: Of Thy kindness, O Jehovah, the earth is full, Thy statutes teach Thou me!
texts.psa.119.65: [Teth.] Good Thou didst with Thy servant, O Jehovah, According to Thy word.
texts.psa.119.66: The goodness of reason and knowledge teach me, For in Thy commands I have believed.
texts.psa.119.67: Before I am afflicted, I -- I am erring, And now Thy saying I have kept.
texts.psa.119.68: Good Thou [art], and doing good, Teach me Thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.69: Forged against me falsehood have the proud, I with the whole heart keep Thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.70: Insensate as fat hath been their heart, I -- in Thy law I have delighted.
texts.psa.119.71: Good for me that I have been afflicted, That I might learn Thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.72: Better to me [is] the law of Thy mouth Than thousands of gold and silver!
texts.psa.119.73: [Yod.] Thy hands made me and establish me, Cause me to understand, and I learn Thy commands.
texts.psa.119.74: Those fearing Thee see me and rejoice, Because for Thy word I have hoped.
texts.psa.119.75: I have known, O Jehovah, That righteous [are] Thy judgments, And [in] faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me.
texts.psa.119.76: Let, I pray Thee, Thy kindness be to comfort me, According to Thy saying to Thy servant.
texts.psa.119.77: Meet me do Thy mercies, and I live, For Thy law [is] my delight.
texts.psa.119.78: Ashamed are the proud, For [with] falsehood they dealt perversely with me. I meditate in Thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.79: Those fearing Thee turn back to me, And those knowing Thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.80: My heart is perfect in Thy statutes, So that I am not ashamed.
texts.psa.119.81: [Kaph.] Consumed for Thy salvation hath been my soul, For Thy word I have hoped.
texts.psa.119.82: Consumed have been mine eyes for Thy word, Saying, `When doth it comfort me?'
texts.psa.119.83: For I have been as a bottle in smoke, Thy statutes I have not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.84: How many [are] the days of Thy servant? When dost Thou execute Against my pursuers judgment?
texts.psa.119.85: The proud have digged for me pits, That [are] not according to Thy law.
texts.psa.119.86: All Thy commands [are] faithfulness, [With] falsehood they have pursued me, Help Thou me.
texts.psa.119.87: Almost consumed me on earth have they, And I -- I have not forsaken Thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.88: According to Thy kindness quicken Thou me, And I keep the testimony of Thy mouth!
texts.psa.119.89: [Lamed.] To the age, O Jehovah, Thy word is set up in the heavens.
texts.psa.119.90: To all generations Thy faithfulness, Thou didst establish earth, and it standeth.
texts.psa.119.91: According to Thine ordinances They have stood this day, for the whole [are] Thy servants.
texts.psa.119.92: Unless Thy law [were] my delights, Then had I perished in mine affliction.
texts.psa.119.93: To the age I forget not Thy precepts, For by them Thou hast quickened me.
texts.psa.119.94: I [am] Thine, save Thou me, For Thy precepts I have sought.
texts.psa.119.95: Thy wicked waited for me to destroy me, Thy testimonies I understand.
texts.psa.119.96: Of all perfection I have seen an end, Broad [is] Thy command -- exceedingly!
texts.psa.119.97: [Mem.] O how I have loved Thy law! All the day it [is] my meditation.
texts.psa.119.98: Than mine enemies Thy command maketh me wiser, For it [is] before me to the age.
texts.psa.119.99: Above all my teachers I have acted wisely. For Thy testimonies [are] my meditation.
texts.psa.119.100: Above elders I understand more, For Thy precepts I have kept.
texts.psa.119.101: From every evil path I restrained my feet, So that I keep Thy word.
texts.psa.119.102: From Thy judgments I turned not aside, For Thou -- Thou hast directed me.
texts.psa.119.103: How sweet to my palate hath been Thy saying, Above honey to my mouth.
texts.psa.119.104: From Thy precepts I have understanding, Therefore I have hated every false path!
texts.psa.119.105: [Nun.] A lamp to my foot [is] Thy word, And a light to my path.
texts.psa.119.106: I have sworn, and I confirm [it], To keep the judgments of Thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.107: I have been afflicted very much, O Jehovah, quicken me, according to Thy word.
texts.psa.119.108: Free-will-offerings of my mouth, Accept, I pray Thee, O Jehovah, And Thy judgments teach Thou me.
texts.psa.119.109: My soul [is] in my hand continually, And Thy law I have not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.110: The wicked have laid a snare for me, And from thy precepts I wandered not.
texts.psa.119.111: I have inherited Thy testimonies to the age, For the joy of my heart [are] they.
texts.psa.119.112: I have inclined my heart To do Thy statutes, to the age -- [to] the end!
texts.psa.119.113: [Samech.] Doubting ones I have hated, And Thy law I have loved.
texts.psa.119.114: My hiding place and my shield [art] Thou, For Thy word I have hoped.
texts.psa.119.115: Turn aside from me, ye evil-doers, And I keep the commands of my God.
texts.psa.119.116: Sustain me according to Thy saying, And I live, and Thou puttest me not to shame Because of my hope.
texts.psa.119.117: Support Thou me, and I am saved, And I look on Thy statutes continually.
texts.psa.119.118: Thou hast trodden down All going astray from Thy statutes, For falsehood [is] their deceit.
texts.psa.119.119: Dross! Thou hast caused to cease All the wicked of the earth; Therefore I have loved Thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.120: Trembled from Thy fear hath my flesh, And from Thy judgments I have been afraid!
texts.psa.119.121: [Ain.] I have done judgment and righteousness, Leave me not to mine oppressors.
texts.psa.119.122: Make sure Thy servant for good, Let not the proud oppress me.
texts.psa.119.123: Mine eyes have been consumed for Thy salvation. And for the saying of Thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.124: Do with Thy servant according to Thy kindness. And Thy statutes teach Thou me.
texts.psa.119.125: Thy servant [am] I -- cause me to understand, And I know Thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.126: Time for Jehovah to work! they have made void Thy law.
texts.psa.119.127: Therefore I have loved Thy commands Above gold -- even fine gold.
texts.psa.119.128: Therefore all my appointments I have declared wholly right, Every path of falsehood I have hated!
texts.psa.119.129: [Pe.] Wonderful [are] Thy testimonies, Therefore hath my soul kept them.
texts.psa.119.130: The opening of Thy words enlighteneth, Instructing the simple.
texts.psa.119.131: My mouth I have opened, yea, I pant, For, for Thy commands I have longed.
texts.psa.119.132: Look unto me, and favour me, As customary to those loving Thy name.
texts.psa.119.133: My steps establish by Thy saying, And any iniquity doth not rule over me.
texts.psa.119.134: Ransom me from the oppression of man, And I observe Thy precepts,
texts.psa.119.135: Thy face cause to shine on Thy servant, And teach me Thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.136: Rivulets of waters have come down mine eyes, Because they have not kept Thy law!
texts.psa.119.137: [Tzade.] Righteous [art] Thou, O Jehovah, And upright [are] Thy judgments.
texts.psa.119.138: Thou hast appointed Thy testimonies, Righteous and exceeding faithful,
texts.psa.119.139: Cut me off hath my zeal, For mine adversaries forgot Thy words.
texts.psa.119.140: Tried [is] thy saying exceedingly, And Thy servant hath loved it.
texts.psa.119.141: Small I [am], and despised, Thy precepts I have not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.142: Thy righteousness [is] righteousness to the age, And Thy law [is] truth.
texts.psa.119.143: Adversity and distress have found me, Thy commands [are] my delights.
texts.psa.119.144: The righteousness of Thy testimonies [is] to Cause me to understand, and I live!
texts.psa.119.145: [Koph.] I have called with the whole heart, Answer me, O Jehovah, Thy statutes I keep,
texts.psa.119.146: I have called Thee, save Thou me, And I do keep Thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.147: I have gone forward in the dawn, and I cry, For Thy word I have hoped.
texts.psa.119.148: Mine eyes have gone before the watches, To meditate in Thy saying.
texts.psa.119.149: My voice hear, according to Thy kindness, Jehovah, according to Thy judgment quicken me.
texts.psa.119.150: Near have been my wicked pursuers, From Thy law they have been far off.
texts.psa.119.151: Near [art] Thou, O Jehovah, And all Thy commands [are] truth.
texts.psa.119.152: Of old I have known Thy testimonies, That to the age Thou hast founded them!
texts.psa.119.153: [Resh.] See my affliction, and deliver Thou me, For Thy law I have not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.154: Plead my plea, and redeem me, According to Thy saying quicken me.
texts.psa.119.155: Far from the wicked [is] salvation, For Thy statutes they have not sought.
texts.psa.119.156: Thy mercies [are] many, O Jehovah, According to Thy judgments quicken me.
texts.psa.119.157: Many [are] my pursuers, and adversaries, From Thy testimonies I have not turned aside.
texts.psa.119.158: I have seen treacherous ones, And grieve myself, Because Thy saying they have not kept.
texts.psa.119.159: See, for thy precepts I have loved, Jehovah, According to Thy kindness quicken me.
texts.psa.119.160: The sum of Thy word [is] truth, And to the age [is] every judgment of Thy righteousness!
texts.psa.119.161: [Shin.] Princes have pursued me without cause, And because of Thy words was my heart afraid.
texts.psa.119.162: I do rejoice concerning Thy saying, As one finding abundant spoil.
texts.psa.119.163: Falsehood I have hated, yea I abominate [it], Thy law I have loved.
texts.psa.119.164: Seven [times] in a day I have praised Thee, Because of the judgments of Thy righteousness.
texts.psa.119.165: Abundant peace have those loving Thy law, And they have no stumbling-block.
texts.psa.119.166: I have waited for Thy salvation, O Jehovah, And Thy commands I have done.
texts.psa.119.167: Kept hath my soul Thy testimonies, And I do love them exceedingly.
texts.psa.119.168: I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies, For all my ways are before Thee!
texts.psa.119.169: [Taw.] My loud cry cometh near before Thee, O Jehovah; According to Thy word cause me to understand.
texts.psa.119.170: My supplication cometh in before Thee, According to Thy saying deliver Thou me.
texts.psa.119.171: My lips do utter praise, For Thou dost teach me Thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.172: My tongue doth sing of Thy saying, For all Thy commands [are] righteous.
texts.psa.119.173: Thy hand is for a help to me, For Thy commands I have chosen.
texts.psa.119.174: I have longed for Thy salvation, O Jehovah, And Thy law [is] my delight.
texts.psa.119.175: My soul liveth, and it doth praise Thee, And Thy judgments do help me.
texts.psa.119.176: I wandered as a lost sheep, seek Thy servant, For Thy precepts I have not forgotten!
texts.psa.120.1: A Song of the Ascents. Unto Jehovah in my distress I have called, And He answereth me.
texts.psa.120.2: O Jehovah, deliver my soul from a lying lip, From a deceitful tongue!
texts.psa.120.3: What doth He give to thee? And what doth He add to thee? O deceitful tongue!
texts.psa.120.4: Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with broom-coals.
texts.psa.120.5: Wo to me, for I have inhabited Mesech, I have dwelt with tents of Kedar.
texts.psa.120.6: Too much hath my soul dwelt with him who is hating peace.
texts.psa.120.7: I [am] peace, and when I speak they [are] for war!
texts.psa.121.1: A Song of the Ascents. I lift up mine eyes unto the hills, Whence doth my help come?
texts.psa.121.2: My help [is] from Jehovah, maker of heaven and earth,
texts.psa.121.3: He suffereth not thy foot to be moved, Thy preserver slumbereth not.
texts.psa.121.4: Lo, He slumbereth not, nor sleepeth, He who is preserving Israel.
texts.psa.121.5: Jehovah [is] thy preserver, Jehovah [is] thy shade on thy right hand,
texts.psa.121.6: By day the sun doth not smite thee, Nor the moon by night.
texts.psa.121.7: Jehovah preserveth thee from all evil, He doth preserve thy soul.
texts.psa.121.8: Jehovah preserveth thy going out and thy coming in, From henceforth even unto the age!
texts.psa.122.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. I have rejoiced in those saying to me, `To the house of Jehovah we go.'
texts.psa.122.2: Our feet have been standing in thy gates, O Jerusalem!
texts.psa.122.3: Jerusalem -- the builded one -- [Is] as a city that is joined to itself together.
texts.psa.122.4: For thither have tribes gone up, Tribes of Jah, companies of Israel, To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.
texts.psa.122.5: For there have sat thrones of judgment, Thrones of the house of David.
texts.psa.122.6: Ask ye the peace of Jerusalem, At rest are those loving thee.
texts.psa.122.7: Peace is in thy bulwark, rest in thy high places,
texts.psa.122.8: For the sake of my brethren and my companions, Let me speak, I pray thee, `Peace [be] in thee.'
texts.psa.122.9: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God, I seek good for thee!
texts.psa.123.1: A Song of the Ascents. Unto Thee I have lifted up mine eyes, O dweller in the heavens.
texts.psa.123.2: Lo, as eyes of men-servants [Are] unto the hand of their masters, As eyes of a maid-servant [Are] unto the hand of her mistress, So [are] our eyes unto Jehovah our God, Till that He doth favour us.
texts.psa.123.3: Favour us, O Jehovah, favour us, For greatly have we been filled with contempt,
texts.psa.123.4: Greatly hath our soul been filled With the scorning of the easy ones, With the contempt of the arrogant!
texts.psa.124.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Save [for] Jehovah -- who hath been for us, (Pray, let Israel say),
texts.psa.124.2: Save [for] Jehovah -- who hath been for us, In the rising up of man against us,
texts.psa.124.3: Then alive they had swallowed us up, In the burning of their anger against us,
texts.psa.124.4: Then the waters had overflowed us, The stream passed over our soul,
texts.psa.124.5: Then passed over our soul had the proud waters.
texts.psa.124.6: Blessed [is] Jehovah who hath not given us, A prey to their teeth.
texts.psa.124.7: Our soul as a bird hath escaped from a snare of fowlers, The snare was broken, and we have escaped.
texts.psa.124.8: Our help [is] in the name of Jehovah, Maker of the heavens and earth!
texts.psa.125.1: A Song of the Ascents. Those trusting in Jehovah [are] as Mount Zion, It is not moved -- to the age it abideth.
texts.psa.125.2: Jerusalem! mountains [are] round about her, And Jehovah [is] round about His people, From henceforth even unto the age.
texts.psa.125.3: For the rod of wickedness resteth not On the lot of the righteous, That the righteous put not forth on iniquity their hands.
texts.psa.125.4: Do good, O Jehovah, to the good, And to the upright in their hearts.
texts.psa.125.5: As to those turning [to] their crooked ways, Jehovah causeth them to go with workers of iniquity. Peace on Israel!
texts.psa.126.1: A Song of the Ascents. In Jehovah's turning back [to] the captivity of Zion, We have been as dreamers.
texts.psa.126.2: Then filled [with] laughter is our mouth, And our tongue [with] singing, Then do they say among nations, `Jehovah did great things with these.'
texts.psa.126.3: Jehovah did great things with us, We have been joyful.
texts.psa.126.4: Turn again, O Jehovah, [to] our captivity, As streams in the south.
texts.psa.126.5: Those sowing in tears, with singing do reap,
texts.psa.126.6: Whoso goeth on and weepeth, Bearing the basket of seed, Surely cometh in with singing, bearing his sheaves!
texts.psa.127.1: A Song of the Ascents, by Solomon. If Jehovah doth not build the house, In vain have its builders laboured at it, If Jehovah doth not watch a city, In vain hath a watchman waked.
texts.psa.127.2: Vain for you who are rising early, Who delay sitting, eating the bread of griefs, So He giveth to His beloved one sleep.
texts.psa.127.3: Lo, an inheritance of Jehovah [are] sons, A reward [is] the fruit of the womb.
texts.psa.127.4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty one, So [are] the sons of the young men.
texts.psa.127.5: O the happiness of the man Who hath filled his quiver with them, They are not ashamed, For they speak with enemies in the gate!
texts.psa.128.1: A Song of the Ascents. O the happiness of every one fearing Jehovah, Who is walking in His ways.
texts.psa.128.2: The labour of thy hands thou surely eatest, Happy [art] thou, and good [is] to thee.
texts.psa.128.3: Thy wife [is] as a fruitful vine in the sides of thy house, Thy sons as olive plants around thy table.
texts.psa.128.4: Lo, surely thus is the man blessed who is fearing Jehovah.
texts.psa.128.5: Jehovah doth bless thee out of Zion, Look, then, on the good of Jerusalem, All the days of thy life,
texts.psa.128.6: And see the sons of thy sons! Peace on Israel!
texts.psa.129.1: A Song of the Ascents. Often they distressed me from my youth, Pray, let Israel say:
texts.psa.129.2: Often they distressed me from my youth, Yet they have not prevailed over me.
texts.psa.129.3: Over my back have ploughers ploughed, They have made long their furrows.
texts.psa.129.4: Jehovah [is] righteous, He hath cut asunder cords of the wicked.
texts.psa.129.5: Confounded and turn backward do all hating Zion.
texts.psa.129.6: They are as grass of the roofs, That before it was drawn out withereth,
texts.psa.129.7: That hath not filled the hand of a reaper, And the bosom of a binder of sheaves.
texts.psa.129.8: And the passers by have not said, `The blessing of Jehovah [is] on you, We blessed you in the Name of Jehovah!'
texts.psa.130.1: A Song of the Ascents. From depths I have called Thee, Jehovah.
texts.psa.130.2: Lord, hearken to my voice, Thine ears are attentive to the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.130.3: If iniquities Thou dost observe, O Lord, who doth stand?
texts.psa.130.4: But with Thee [is] forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.
texts.psa.130.5: I hoped [for] Jehovah -- hoped hath my soul, And for His word I have waited.
texts.psa.130.6: My soul [is] for the Lord, More than those watching for morning, Watching for morning!
texts.psa.130.7: Israel doth wait on Jehovah, For with Jehovah [is] kindness, And abundant with Him [is] redemption.
texts.psa.130.8: And He doth redeem Israel from all his iniquities!
texts.psa.131.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Jehovah, my heart hath not been haughty, Nor have mine eyes been high, Nor have I walked in great things, And in things too wonderful for me.
texts.psa.131.2: Have I not compared, and kept silent my soul, As a weaned one by its mother? As a weaned one by me [is] my soul.
texts.psa.131.3: Israel doth wait on Jehovah, From henceforth, and unto the age!
texts.psa.132.1: A Song of the Ascents. Remember, Jehovah, for David, all his afflictions.
texts.psa.132.2: Who hath sworn to Jehovah. He hath vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
texts.psa.132.3: `If I enter into the tent of my house, If I go up on the couch of my bed,
texts.psa.132.4: If I give sleep to mine eyes, To mine eyelids -- slumber,
texts.psa.132.5: Till I do find a place for Jehovah, Tabernacles for the Mighty One of Jacob.
texts.psa.132.6: `Lo, we have heard it in Ephratah, We have found it in the fields of the forest.
texts.psa.132.7: We come in to His tabernacles, We bow ourselves at His footstool.
texts.psa.132.8: Arise, O Jehovah, to Thy rest, Thou, and the ark of Thy strength,
texts.psa.132.9: Thy priests do put on righteousness, And Thy pious ones cry aloud.
texts.psa.132.10: For the sake of David Thy servant, Turn not back the face of Thine anointed.
texts.psa.132.11: Jehovah hath sworn truth to David, He turneth not back from it: Of the fruit of thy body, I set on the throne for thee.
texts.psa.132.12: If thy sons keep My covenant, And My testimonies that I teach them, Their sons also for ever and ever, Do sit on the throne for thee.
texts.psa.132.13: For Jehovah hath fixed on Zion, He hath desired [it] for a seat to Himself,
texts.psa.132.14: This [is] My rest for ever and ever, Here do I sit, for I have desired it.
texts.psa.132.15: Her provision I greatly bless, Her needy ones I satisfy [with] bread,
texts.psa.132.16: And her priests I clothe [with] salvation, And her pious ones do sing aloud.
texts.psa.132.17: There I cause to spring up a horn for David, I have arranged a lamp for Mine anointed.
texts.psa.132.18: His enemies I do clothe [with] shame, And upon him doth his crown flourish!
texts.psa.133.1: A Song of the Ascents, by David. Lo, how good and how pleasant The dwelling of brethren -- even together!
texts.psa.133.2: As the good oil on the head, Coming down on the beard, the beard of Aaron, That cometh down on the skirt of his robes,
texts.psa.133.3: As dew of Hermon -- That cometh down on hills of Zion, For there Jehovah commanded the blessing -- Life unto the age!
texts.psa.134.1: A Song of the Ascents. Lo, bless Jehovah, all servants of Jehovah, Who are standing in the house of Jehovah by night.
texts.psa.134.2: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
texts.psa.134.3: Jehovah doth bless thee out of Zion, The maker of the heavens and earth!
texts.psa.135.1: Praise ye Jah! Praise ye the name of Jehovah, Praise, ye servants of Jehovah,
texts.psa.135.2: Who are standing in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.
texts.psa.135.3: Praise ye Jah! for Jehovah [is] good, Sing praise to His name, for [it is] pleasant.
texts.psa.135.4: For Jacob hath Jah chosen for Himself, Israel for His peculiar treasure.
