texts.psa.120.6: Mucho se detiene mi alma con los que aborrecen la paz.
texts.psa.120.7: Yo soy pacífico; y cuando hablo, ellos guerrean.
texts.psa.121.1: Canción de las gradas. Alzaré mis ojos a los montes de donde vendrá mi socorro.
texts.psa.121.2: Mi socorro es de parte de Jehová; que hizo los cielos y la tierra.
texts.psa.121.3: No dará tu pie al resbaladero: ni se dormirá el que te guarda.
texts.psa.121.4: He aquí, no se adormecerá, ni dormirá el que guarda a Israel.
texts.psa.121.5: Jehová será tu guardador: Jehová será tu sombra sobre tu mano derecha.
texts.psa.121.6: De día el sol no te fatigará, ni la luna de noche.
texts.psa.121.7: Jehová te guardará de todo mal; él guardará a tu alma.
texts.psa.121.8: Jehová guardará tu salida, y tu entrada, desde ahora y hasta siempre.
texts.psa.122.1: Canción de las gradas. De David. Yo me alegré con los que me decían: A la casa de Jehová iremos.
texts.psa.122.2: Nuestros pies estuvieron en tus puertas, o! Jerusalem.
texts.psa.122.3: Jerusalem, la que es edificada como una ciudad que está unida consigo a una.
texts.psa.122.4: Porque allá subieron las tribus, las tribus de Jehová, el testimonio a Israel, para alabar el nombre de Jehová.
texts.psa.122.5: Porque allá están las sillas del juicio: las sillas de la casa de David.
texts.psa.122.6: Demandád la paz de Jerusalem: sean pacificados los que te aman.
texts.psa.122.7: Haya paz en tu antemuro, descanso en tus palacios.
texts.psa.122.8: A causa de mis hermanos y mis compañeros hablaré ahora paz de ti.
texts.psa.122.9: A causa de la casa de Jehová nuestro Dios buscaré bien para ti.
texts.psa.123.1: Canción de las gradas. A ti alcé mis ojos, el que habitas en los cielos.
texts.psa.123.2: He aquí, como los ojos de los siervos miran a la mano de sus señores: como los ojos de la sierva a la mano de su señora, así nuestros ojos miran a Jehová nuestro Dios: hasta que haya misericordia de nosotros.
texts.psa.123.3: Ten misericordia de nosotros: o! Jehová, ten misericordia de nosotros; porque estamos muy hartos de menosprecio.
texts.psa.123.4: Muy harta está nuestra alma del escarnio de los sosegados: del menosprecio de los soberbios.
texts.psa.124.1: Canción de las gradas. De David. A no haber estado Jehová por nosotros, díga lo ahora Israel:
texts.psa.124.2: A no haber estado Jehová por nosotros, cuando se levantaron contra nosotros los hombres;
texts.psa.124.3: Vivos nos tragaran entonces: cuando se encendió su furor en nosotros:
texts.psa.124.4: Entonces las aguas inundaran sobre nosotros: el arroyo pasara sobre nuestra alma.
texts.psa.124.5: Entonces pasaran sobre nuestra alma las aguas soberbias.
texts.psa.124.6: Bendito Jehová que no nos dio por presa a sus dientes.
texts.psa.124.7: Nuestra alma, como ave, escapó del lazo de los cazadores: el lazo se quebró, y nosotros escapamos.
texts.psa.124.8: Nuestro socorro fue en el nombre de Jehová, que hizo el cielo y la tierra.
texts.psa.125.1: Canción de las gradas. Los que confían en Jehová, son como el monte de Sión, que no deslizará: para siempre estará.
texts.psa.125.2: Jerusalem, montes al rededor de ella, y Jehová al rededor de su pueblo, desde ahora y para siempre.
texts.psa.125.3: Porque no reposará la vara de la impiedad sobre la suerte de los justos; porque no extiendan los justos sus manos a la iniquidad.
texts.psa.125.4: ¶ Haz bien, o! Jehová, a los buenos, y a los rectos en sus corazones.
texts.psa.125.5: Y a los que se apartan tras sus perversidades, Jehová les llevará con los que obran iniquidad; y paz será sobre Israel.
texts.psa.126.1: Canción de las gradas. Cuando Jehová hiciere tornar los cautivos de Sión, seremos como los que sueñan.
texts.psa.126.2: Entonces nuestra boca se henchirá de risa, y nuestra lengua de alabanza: entonces dirán entre los Gentiles: Grandes cosas ha hecho Jehová con estos.
texts.psa.126.3: Grandes cosas ha hecho Jehová con nosotros: seremos alegres.
texts.psa.126.4: Haz volver, o! Jehová, nuestros cautivos, como los arroyos en el austro.
texts.psa.126.5: Los que sembraron con lágrimas, con regocijos segarán.
texts.psa.126.6: Irá yendo y llorando el que lleva la preciosa simiente: mas viniendo, vendrá con regocijo trayendo sus gavillas.
texts.psa.127.1: Canción de las gradas: para Salomón. Si Jehová no edificare la casa, en vano trabajan los que la edifican: Si Jehová no guardare la ciudad, en vano vela la guarda.
texts.psa.127.2: Por demás os es el madrugar a levantaros, el veniros tarde a reposar, el comer pan de dolores: así dará a su amado el sueño.
texts.psa.127.3: ¶ He aquí, heredad de Jehová son los hijos: cosa de estima el fruto de vientre.
texts.psa.127.4: Como saetas en mano del valiente, así son los hijos de las juventudes.
texts.psa.127.5: Bienaventurado el varón que hinchió su aljaba de ellos: no será avergonzado, cuando hablare con los enemigos en la puerta.
texts.psa.128.1: Canción de las gradas. Bienaventurado todo aquel que teme a Jehová, que anda en sus caminos.
texts.psa.128.2: Cuando comieres el trabajo de tus manos, bienaventurado tú, y bien habrás.
texts.psa.128.3: Tú mujer será coma la parra, que lleva fruto a los lados de tu casa: tus hijos, como plantas de olivas, al rededor de tu mesa.
texts.psa.128.4: He aquí que así será bendito el varón que teme a Jehová.
texts.psa.128.5: Bendígate Jehová desde Sión; y veas el bien de Jerusalem todos los días de tu vida.
texts.psa.128.6: Y veas a los hijos de tus hijos, la paz sobre Israel.
texts.psa.129.1: Canción de las gradas. Mucho me han angustiado desde mi juventud, díga lo ahora Israel;
texts.psa.129.2: Mucho me han angustiado desde mi juventud: mas no prevalecieron contra mí.
texts.psa.129.3: Sobre mis espaldas araron gañanes: hicieron luengos surcos:
texts.psa.129.4: Mas Jehová justo, cortó las coyundas de los impíos.
texts.psa.129.5: Serán avergonzados, y vueltos atrás, todos los que aborrecen a Sión.
texts.psa.129.6: Serán como la yerba de los tejados: que antes que salga, se seca;
texts.psa.129.7: De la cual no hinchió su mano segador; ni su brazo el que hace gavillas.
texts.psa.129.8: Ni dijeron los que pasaron: Bendición de Jehová sea sobre vosotros: os bendecimos en nombre de Jehová.
texts.psa.130.1: Canción de las gradas. De los profundos te llamo, o! Jehová.
texts.psa.130.2: Señor, oye mi voz. Sean tus orejas atentas a la voz de mi oración.
texts.psa.130.3: Jehová, si mirares a los pecados, Señor ¿quién persistirá?
texts.psa.130.4: Por lo cual hay perdón acerca de ti: para que seas temido.
texts.psa.130.5: Yo esperé a Jehová, mi alma esperó: a su palabra he esperado.
texts.psa.130.6: Mi alma esperó a Jehová, más que las guardas esperan a la mañana: las guardas a la mañana.
texts.psa.130.7: Espere Israel a Jehová, porque con Jehová está la misericordia; y abundante redención cerca de él.
texts.psa.130.8: Y él redimirá a Israel de todos sus pecados.
texts.psa.131.1: Canción de las gradas. De David. Jehová, no se ensoberbeció mi corazón, ni mis ojos se enaltecieron: ni anduve en grandezas, ni en cosas maravillosas más de lo que me pertenecía.
texts.psa.131.2: Si no puse, e hice callar mi alma, sea yo como el destetado de su madre, como el destetado de mi vida.
texts.psa.131.3: Espera, o! Israel, a Jehová desde ahora y hasta siempre.
texts.psa.132.1: Canción de las gradas. Acuérdate, o! Jehová, de David, de toda su aflicción:
texts.psa.132.2: Que juró a Jehová, prometió al fuerte de Jacob:
texts.psa.132.3: No entraré en la morada de mi casa: no subiré sobre el lecho de mi estrado:
texts.psa.132.4: No daré sueño a mis ojos, ni a mis párpados adormecimiento,
texts.psa.132.5: Hasta que halle lugar para Jehová, moradas para el fuerte de Jacob.
texts.psa.132.6: He aquí, en Efrata oímos de ella: hallámosla en los campos del bosque.
texts.psa.132.7: Entraremos en sus tiendas: encorvarnos hemos al estrado de sus pies.
texts.psa.132.8: Levántate, o! Jehová, a tu reposo, tú, y el arca de tu fortaleza.
texts.psa.132.9: Tus sacerdotes vistan justicia; y tus piadosos se regocijen.
texts.psa.132.10: Por amor de David tu siervo no vuelvas de tu ungido el rostro.
texts.psa.132.11: Juró Jehová verdad a David, no se apartará de ella: de fruto de tu vientre pondré sobre tu trono.
texts.psa.132.12: Si tus hijos guardaren mi alianza, y mi testimonio que yo les enseñaré: sus hijos también se asentarán sobre tu trono para siempre.
texts.psa.132.13: Porque Jehová ha elegido a Sión: la codició por habitación para sí.
texts.psa.132.14: Este será mi reposo para siempre: aquí habitaré, porque la he codiciado.
texts.psa.132.15: A su mantenimiento daré bendición: sus pobres hartaré de pan.
texts.psa.132.16: Y a sus sacerdotes vestiré de salud; y sus piadosos exultarán de gozo.
texts.psa.132.17: Allí haré reverdecer el cuerno de David: yo he aparejado lámpara a mi ungido.
texts.psa.132.18: A sus enemigos vestiré de confusión; y sobre él florecerá su corona.
texts.psa.133.1: Canción de las gradas. De David. ¡Mirád, cuán bueno, y cuán suave es habitar los hermanos también en uno!
texts.psa.133.2: Como el buen óleo sobre la cabeza, que desciende sobre la barba, la barba de Aarón, que desciende sobre el borde de sus vestiduras:
texts.psa.133.3: Como el rocío de Hermón, que desciende sobre los montes de Sión. Porque allí envía Jehová bendición, y vida eterna.
texts.psa.134.1: Canción de las gradas. Mirád, bendecíd a Jehová todos los siervos de Jehová, los que estáis en la casa de Jehová, en las noches:
texts.psa.134.2: Alzád vuestras manos al santuario, y bendecíd a Jehová.
texts.psa.134.3: Bendígate Jehová desde Sión, el que hizo los cielos y la tierra.
texts.psa.135.1: Alelu- Jah. Alabád el nombre de Jehová, alabád siervos de Jehová.
texts.psa.135.2: Los que estáis en la casa de Jehová, en los patios de la casa de nuestros Dios.
texts.psa.135.3: Alabád a Jehová, porque es bueno Jehová: cantád salmos a su nombre, porque es suave.
texts.psa.135.4: Porque Jehová ha escogido a Jacob para sí, a Israel por su posesión.
texts.psa.135.5: Porque yo sé que Jehová es grande, y el Señor nuestro mayor que todos los dioses.
texts.psa.135.6: Todo lo que quiso Jehová, hizo en los cielos y en la tierra, en las mares, y en todos los abismos.
texts.psa.135.7: El que hace subir las nubes del cabo de la tierra: hizo los relámpagos para la lluvia; el que saca los vientos de sus tesoros.
texts.psa.135.8: El que hirió a los primogénitos de Egipto desde el hombre hasta la bestia.
texts.psa.135.9: Envió señales y prodigios en medio de ti, o! Egipto: en Faraón, y en todos sus siervos.
texts.psa.135.10: El que hirió a muchas naciones; y mató a reyes poderosos:
texts.psa.135.11: A Sejón rey Amorreo, y a Og rey de Basán, y a todos los reinos de Canaán.
texts.psa.135.12: Y dio la tierra de ellos en heredad: en heredad a Israel su pueblo.
texts.psa.135.13: Jehová, tu nombre es eterno: Jehová, tu memoria para generación y generación.
texts.psa.135.14: Porque Jehová juzgará a su pueblo; y sobre sus siervos se arrepentirá.
texts.psa.135.15: Los ídolos de los Gentiles son plata y oro: obra de manos de hombre.
texts.psa.135.16: Tienen boca, y no hablan: tienen ojos y no ven.
texts.psa.135.17: Tienen orejas y no escuchan; tampoco hay espíritu en sus bocas.
texts.psa.135.18: Como ellos sean los que los hacen; y todos los que en ellos confían.
texts.psa.135.19: Casa de Israel bendecíd a Jehová: Casa de Aarón bendecíd a Jehová:
texts.psa.135.20: Casa de Leví bendecíd a Jehová: los que teméis a Jehová, bendecíd a Jehová.
texts.psa.135.21: Bendito Jehová de Sión, el que mora en Jerusalem. Alelu- Jah.
texts.psa.136.1: Alabád a Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.2: Alabád al Dios de dioses; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.3: Alabád al Señor de señores; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.4: Al que solo hace grandes maravillas; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.5: Al que hizo los cielos con entendimiento; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.6: Al que tendió la tierra sobre las aguas; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.7: Al que hizo los grandes luminares; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.8: El sol para que dominase en el día; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.9: La luna y las estrellas para que dominasen en la noche; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.10: ¶ Al que hirió a Egipto con sus primogénitos; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.11: Al que sacó a Israel de en medio de ellos; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.12: Con mano fuerte, y brazo extendido; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.13: Al que partió al mar Bermejo en partes; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.14: E hizo pasar a Israel por medio de él; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.15: Y sacudió a Faraón y a su ejército en el mar Bermejo; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.16: Al que pastoreó a su pueblo por el desierto; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.17: Al que hirió a grandes reyes; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.18: Y mató a reyes poderosos; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.19: A Sejón rey Amorreo; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.20: Y a Og rey de Basán; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.21: Y dio la tierra de ellos en heredad; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.22: En heredad a Israel su siervo; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.23: ¶ El que en nuestro abatimiento se acordó de nosotros; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.24: Y nos rescató de nuestros enemigos; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.25: El que da mantenimiento a toda carne; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.136.26: Alabád al Dios de los cielos; porque para siempre es su misericordia.
texts.psa.137.1: Junto a los ríos de Babilonia, allí nos sentámos: también llorámos acordándonos de Sión.
texts.psa.137.2: Sobre los sauces que están en medio de ella colgamos nuestras arpas.
texts.psa.137.3: Cuando nos pedían allí, los que nos cautivaron, las palabras de la canción, colgadas nuestras arpas de alegría: Cantádnos de las canciones de Sión.
texts.psa.137.4: ¿Cómo cantaremos canción de Jehová en tierra de extraños?
texts.psa.137.5: Si me olvidare de ti, o! Jerusalem, mi diestra sea olvidada.
texts.psa.137.6: Mi lengua se pegue a mi paladar, si no me acordare de ti: si no hiciere subir a Jerusalem en el principio de mi alegría.
texts.psa.137.7: Acuérdate, o! Jehová, de los hijos de Edom en el día de Jerusalem; que decían: Descubríd, descubríd en ella hasta los cimientos.
texts.psa.137.8: Hija de Babilonia destruida, bienaventurado el que te pagará tu pago, que nos pagaste a nosotros.
texts.psa.137.9: Bienaventurado el que tomará, y estrellará tus niños contra las piedras.
texts.psa.138.1: Salmo de David. Alabarte he con todo mi corazón: delante de los dioses te cantaré salmos.
texts.psa.138.2: Encorvarme he al templo de tu santidad, y alabaré tu nombre sobre tu misericordia y tu verdad; porque has hecho magnífico tu nombre, y tu palabra sobre todas las cosas.
texts.psa.138.3: El día que te llamé, me respondiste, esforzásteme, y diste en mi alma fortaleza.
texts.psa.138.4: Confesarte han, o! Jehová, todos los reyes de la tierra; porque oyeron las palabras de tu boca.
texts.psa.138.5: Y cantarán en los caminos de Jehová: que la gloria de Jehová es grande.
texts.psa.138.6: Porque el alto Jehová mira al humilde, y al altivo conoce de lejos.
texts.psa.138.7: Si anduviere por medio de la angustia, me vivificarás: contra la ira de mis enemigos extenderás tu mano, y tu diestra me salvará.
texts.psa.138.8: Jehová cumplirá por mí, Jehová, tu misericordia es para siempre; no dejarás la obra de tus manos.
texts.psa.139.1: Al Vencedor: Salmo de David. Jehová, tú me has examinado, y conocido.
texts.psa.139.2: Tú has conocido mi sentarme y mi levantarme, has entendido desde lejos mis pensamientos.
texts.psa.139.3: Mi senda, y mi acostarme has rodeado; y todos mis caminos has conocido.
texts.psa.139.4: Porque aun no está la palabra en mi lengua, y, he aquí, Jehová, tú la supiste toda.
texts.psa.139.5: Detrás y delante tú me formaste; y pusiste sobre mí tu mano.
texts.psa.139.6: Más maravillosa es la ciencia que mi capacidad: alta es, no puedo comprenderla.
texts.psa.139.7: ¿A dónde me iré de tu Espíritu? ¿y a dónde huiré de delante de ti?
texts.psa.139.8: Si subiere a los cielos, allí estás tú; y si hiciere mi estrado en el infierno, héte allí.
texts.psa.139.9: Si tomare las alas del alba, y habitare en el cabo de la mar,
texts.psa.139.10: Aun allí me guiará tu mano; y me trabará tu diestra.
texts.psa.139.11: Si dijere: Ciertamente las tinieblas me encubrirán: aun la noche resplandecerá por causa de mí.
texts.psa.139.12: Aun las tinieblas no encubren nada de ti; y la noche resplandece como el día: las tinieblas son como la luz.
texts.psa.139.13: Porque tú poseiste mis riñones; cubrísteme en el vientre de mi madre.
texts.psa.139.14: Confesarte he, porque terribles y maravillosas son tus obras: estoy maravillado, y mi alma lo conoce en gran manera.
texts.psa.139.15: No fue encubierto mi cuerpo de ti, aunque yo fui hecho en secreto: fue entretejido en los profundos de la tierra.
texts.psa.139.16: Mi imperfección vieron tus ojos; y en tu libro estaban todas aquellas cosas escritas, que fueron entonces formadas, sin faltar una de ellas.
texts.psa.139.17: Así que ¡cuán preciosos me son tus pensamientos, o! Dios! ¡Cuán multiplicadas son sus cuentas!
texts.psa.139.18: Si las cuento, multiplícanse más que la arena: despierto, y aun estoy contigo.
texts.psa.139.19: ¶ Si matases, o! Dios, al impío; y los varones de sangres se quitasen de mí;
texts.psa.139.20: Que te dicen blasfemias: ensoberbécense en vano tus enemigos.
texts.psa.139.21: ¿No tuve en odio, o! Jehová, a los que te aborrecieron? ¿y peleo contra tus enemigos?
texts.psa.139.22: De entero odio los aborrecí: túvelos por enemigos.
texts.psa.139.23: ¶ Examíname, o! Dios, y conoce mi corazón: pruébame, y conoce mis pensamientos.
texts.psa.139.24: Y ve si hay en mí camino de perversidad; y guíame en el camino del mundo.
texts.psa.140.1: Al Vencedor: Salmo de David. Escápame, o! Jehová, de hombre malo: de varón de iniquidades guárdame:
texts.psa.140.2: Que pensaron males en el corazón: cada día juntaron contiendas.
texts.psa.140.3: Aguzaron su lengua como la serpiente: veneno de áspid hay debajo de sus labios. Selah.
texts.psa.140.4: Guárdame, o! Jehová, de manos de impío, de varón de injurias guárdame: que han pensado de rempujar mis pasos.
texts.psa.140.5: Soberbios me han escondido lazo y cuerdas: han tendido red: en el lugar de la senda me han puesto lazos. Selah.
texts.psa.140.6: He dicho a Jehová: Dios mío eres tú: escucha, o! Jehová, la voz de mis ruegos.
texts.psa.140.7: Jehová, Señor, fortaleza de mi salud, cubre mi cabeza el día de las armas.
texts.psa.140.8: No des, o! Jehová, al impío sus deseos: no saques en efecto su pensamiento, y se ensoberbezcan. Selah.
texts.psa.140.9: La cabeza de los que me cercan, la perversidad de sus labios la cubra.
texts.psa.140.10: Caigan sobre ellos brasas: en el fuego les haga Dios caer: en profundos hoyos, de donde no salgan.
texts.psa.140.11: El varón de lengua no sea firme en la tierra: al varón de injuria cace el mal para rempujones.
texts.psa.140.12: Yo sé que hará Jehová el juicio del afligido, el juicio de los menesterosos.
texts.psa.140.13: Ciertamente los justos alabarán tu nombre: los rectos estarán en tu presencia.
texts.psa.141.1: Salmo de David. Jehová, a ti he llamado, apresúrate a mí: escucha mi voz, cuando te llamare.
texts.psa.141.2: Sea enderezada mi oración delante de ti como un perfume: el don de mis manos como un presente de la tarde.
texts.psa.141.3: Pon, o! Jehová, guarda a mi boca: guarda la puerta de mis labios.
texts.psa.141.4: No inclines mi corazón a cosa mala: a hacer obras con impiedad con los varones que obran iniquidad; y no coma yo de sus delicias.
texts.psa.141.5: Hiérame el justo con misericordia, y repréndame; y aceite de cabeza no unte mi cabeza: porque aun también mi oración será contra sus males.
texts.psa.141.6: Sean derribados en lugares peñascosos sus jueces; y oigan mis palabras que son suaves.
texts.psa.141.7: Como quien parte e hiende leños en tierra, son esparcidos nuestros huesos a la boca de la sepultura:
texts.psa.141.8: Por tanto a ti, o! Jehová, Señor, miran mis ojos, en ti he confiado: no tengas en poco a mi alma.
texts.psa.141.9: ¶ Guárdame de las manos del lazo que me han tendido; y de los lazos de los que obran iniquidad.
texts.psa.141.10: Caigan los impíos a una en sus redes, mientras yo pasaré para siempre.
texts.psa.142.1: Masquil de David, cuando estaba en la cueva: Oración. Con mi voz clamaré a Jehová: con mi voz pediré misericordia a Jehová.
texts.psa.142.2: Delante de él derramaré mi querella: delante de él denunciaré mi angustia.
texts.psa.142.3: Cuando mi espíritu se angustiaba dentro de mí, tu conociste mi senda: en el camino en que andaba, me escondieron lazo.
texts.psa.142.4: Consideraba hacia mi mano derecha y miraba, y no había quien me conociese: no tuve refugio, no había quien volviese por mi vida.
texts.psa.142.5: Clamé a ti, o! Jehová; dije: Tú eres mi esperanza, y mi porción en la tierra de los vivientes.
texts.psa.142.6: Escucha mi clamor, que estoy afligido mucho: escápame de los que me persiguen; porque son más fuertes que yo.
texts.psa.142.7: Saca mi alma de la cárcel, para que alabe tu nombre: conmigo se coronarán los justos, cuando me hubieres hecho bien.
texts.psa.143.1: Salmo de David. Jehová, oye mi oración, escucha mis ruegos por tu verdad: respóndeme por tu justicia.
texts.psa.143.2: Y no entres en juicio con tu siervo; porque no se justificará delante de ti ningún viviente.
texts.psa.143.3: Porque ha perseguido el enemigo mi alma: ha quebrantado a tierra mi vida: me ha hecho habitar en tinieblas como los ya muertos.
texts.psa.143.4: Y mi espíritu se angustió dentro de mí: mi corazón se pasmó.
texts.psa.143.5: Acordéme de los días antiguos: meditaba en todas tus obras: meditaba en las obras de tus manos.
texts.psa.143.6: Extendí mis manos a ti: mi alma, como la tierra sedienta, a ti. Selah.
texts.psa.143.7: Respóndeme presto, o! Jehová, que desmaya mi espíritu: no escondas de mí tu rostro, y sea semejante a los que descienden a la sepultura.
texts.psa.143.8: Házme oír por la mañana tu misericordia, porque en ti he confiado: házme saber el camino por donde ande, porque a ti he alzado mi alma.
texts.psa.143.9: Escápame de mis enemigos, o! Jehová: a ti me acojo.
texts.psa.143.10: Enséñame a hacer tu voluntad, porque tú eres mi Dios. Tu buen Espíritu me guie a tierra de rectitud.
texts.psa.143.11: Por tu nombre, o! Jehová, me vivificarás; por tu justicia sacarás mi alma de angustia.
texts.psa.143.12: Y por tu misericordia disiparás mis enemigos, y destruirás todos los adversarios de mi alma; porque yo soy tu siervo.
texts.psa.144.1: Salmo de David. Bendito Jehová mi roca, que enseña mis manos a la batalla, y mis dedos a la guerra.
texts.psa.144.2: Misericordia mía, y mi castillo: altura mía, y mi libertador: escudo mío en quien he confiado: el que allana mi pueblo delante de mí.
texts.psa.144.3: O! Jehová, ¿qué es el hombre, que te haces familiar a él? ¿el hijo del hombre, para que le estimes?
texts.psa.144.4: El hombre es semejante a la vanidad: sus días son como la sombra que pasa.
texts.psa.144.5: ¶ O! Jehová, inclina tus cielos y desciende: toca los montes, y humeen.
texts.psa.144.6: Relampaguea relámpagos, y disípalos; envía tus saetas, y contúrbalos.
texts.psa.144.7: Envía tu mano desde lo alto: redímeme, y escápame de las muchas aguas: de la mano de los hijos extraños.
texts.psa.144.8: Cuya boca habla vanidad; y su diestra es diestra de mentira.
texts.psa.144.9: O! Dios, a ti cantaré canción nueva: con salterio, con decacordio cantaré a ti.
texts.psa.144.10: El que da salud a los reyes: el que redime a David su siervo de perniciosa espada.
texts.psa.144.11: Redímeme, y escápame de mano de los hijos extraños: cuya boca habla vanidad, y su diestra es diestra de mentira.
texts.psa.144.12: ¶ Que nuestros hijos sean como plantas crecidas en su juventud: nuestras hijas como las esquinas labradas a manera del palacio:
texts.psa.144.13: Nuestros rincones llenos, proveidos de toda suerte de grano: nuestros ganados que paran a millares, y a diez millares en nuestras plazas.
texts.psa.144.14: Nuestros bueyes cargados de carnes, no haya portillo, ni quien salga, ni quien dé grita en nuestras calles.
texts.psa.144.15: Bienaventurado el pueblo que tiene esto: bienaventurado el pueblo, cuyo Dios es Jehová.
texts.psa.145.1: Alabanza de David. Ensalzarte he, mi Dios y Rey; y bendeciré a tu nombre por el siglo y para siempre.
texts.psa.145.2: Cada día te bendeciré; y alabaré tu nombre por el siglo y para siempre.
texts.psa.145.3: Grande es Jehová, y digno de alabanza en gran manera; y su grandeza no puede ser comprendida.
texts.psa.145.4: Generación a generación enarrará tus obras; y anunciarán tus valentías.
texts.psa.145.5: La hermosura de la gloria de tu magnificencia, y tus hechos maravillosos hablaré.
texts.psa.145.6: Y la terribilidad de tus valentías dirán; y tu grandeza recontaré.
texts.psa.145.7: La memoria de la muchedumbre de tu bondad rebosarán; y tu justicia cantarán.
texts.psa.145.8: Clemente y misericordioso es Jehová: luengo de iras, y grande en misericordia.
texts.psa.145.9: Bueno es Jehová para con todos; y sus misericordias, sobre todas sus obras.
texts.psa.145.10: Alábente, o! Jehová, todas tus obras; y tus misericordiosos te bendigan.
texts.psa.145.11: La gloria de tu reino digan; y hablen de tu fortaleza:
texts.psa.145.12: Para notificar a los hijos de Adam sus valentías; y la gloria de la magnificencia de su reino.
texts.psa.145.13: Tu reino es reino de todos los siglos; y tu señorío en toda generación y generación.
texts.psa.145.14: Sostiene Jehová a todos los que caen; y levanta a todos los oprimidos.
texts.psa.145.15: Los ojos de todas las cosas esperan a ti; y tú les das su comida en su tiempo.
texts.psa.145.16: Abres tu mano, y hartas de voluntad a todo viviente.
texts.psa.145.17: Justo es Jehová en todos sus caminos, y misericordioso en todas sus obras.
texts.psa.145.18: Cercano está Jehová a todos los que le invocan: a todos los que le invocan con verdad.
texts.psa.145.19: La voluntad de los que le temen, hará; y su clamor oirá, y los salvará.
texts.psa.145.20: Jehová guarda a todos los que le aman; y a todos los impíos destruirá.
texts.psa.145.21: La alabanza de Jehová hablará mi boca; y bendiga toda carne su santo nombre, por el siglo y para siempre.
texts.psa.146.1: Alelu- Jah. Alaba, o! alma mía, a Jehová.
texts.psa.146.2: Alabaré a Jehová en mi vida: diré salmos a mi Dios mientras viviere.
texts.psa.146.3: No confiéis en los príncipes, ni en hijo de hombre; porque no hay en él salud.
texts.psa.146.4: Saldrá su espíritu, volverse ha el hombre en su tierra: en aquel día perecerán sus pensamientos.
texts.psa.146.5: ¶ Bienaventurado aquel cuyo ayudador es el Dios de Jacob: cuya esperanza es en Jehová su Dios.
texts.psa.146.6: El que hizo los cielos y la tierra: la mar, y todo lo que en ello está: el que guarda verdad para siempre:
texts.psa.146.7: El que hace derecho a los agraviados, el que da pan a los hambrientos: Jehová el que suelta a los aprisionados:
texts.psa.146.8: Jehová es el que abre los ojos a los ciegos: Jehová el que ama a los justos:
texts.psa.146.9: Jehová el que guarda a los extranjeros: al huérfano y a la viuda levanta; y el camino de los impíos trastorna.
texts.psa.146.10: Reinará Jehová para siempre: tu Dios, o! Sión, por generación y generación. Alelu- Jah.
texts.psa.147.1: Alabád a Jehová; porque es bueno cantar salmos a nuestro Dios; porque suave y hermosa es la alabanza.
texts.psa.147.2: El que edifica a Jerusalem, Jehová: los echados de Israel recogerá.
texts.psa.147.3: El que sana a los quebrantados de corazón; y el que liga sus dolores.
texts.psa.147.4: El que cuenta el número de las estrellas, y a todas ellas llama por sus nombres.
texts.psa.147.5: Grande es el Señor nuestro, y de mucho poder; y de su entendimiento no hay número.
texts.psa.147.6: El que ensalza a los humildes, Jehová: el que humilla a los impíos hasta la tierra.
texts.psa.147.7: Cantád a Jehová con alabanza: cantád a nuestro Dios con arpa.
texts.psa.147.8: El que cubre los cielos de nubes; el que apareja la lluvia para la tierra: el que hace a los montes producir yerba.
texts.psa.147.9: El que da a la bestia su mantenimiento: a los hijos de los cuervos que claman a él.
texts.psa.147.10: No toma contentamiento en la fortaleza del caballo: ni se deleita con las piernas del varón.
texts.psa.147.11: Ama Jehová a los que le temen: a los que esperan en su misericordia.
texts.psa.147.12: Alaba, Jerusalem, a Jehová: alaba, Sión, a tu Dios.
texts.psa.147.13: Porque fortificó los cerrojos de tus puertas: bendijo a tus hijos dentro de ti.
texts.psa.147.14: El que pone por tu término la paz; y de grosura de trigo te hará hartar.
texts.psa.147.15: El que envía su palabra a la tierra; y muy presto corre su palabra.
texts.psa.147.16: El que da la nieve como lana: derrama la helada como ceniza.
texts.psa.147.17: El que echa su hielo como en pedazos; ¿delante de su frío quién estará?
texts.psa.147.18: Enviará su palabra, y desleirlos ha: soplará su viento, gotearán las aguas.
texts.psa.147.19: El que denuncia sus palabras a Jacob, sus estatutos y sus juicios a Israel.
texts.psa.147.20: No ha hecho esto con toda nación; y sus juicios no los conocieron. Alelu- Jah.
texts.psa.148.1: Alelu- Jah. Alabád a Jehová desde los cielos: alabádle en las alturas.
texts.psa.148.2: Alabádle todos sus ángeles: alabádle todos sus ejércitos.
texts.psa.148.3: Alabádle el sol y la luna: alabádle todas las estrellas de luz.
texts.psa.148.4: Alabádle los cielos de los cielos; y las aguas que están sobre los cielos.
texts.psa.148.5: Alaben el nombre de Jehová; porque él mandó, y fueron creadas.
texts.psa.148.6: Y las hizo ser para siempre, por el siglo: púso les ley que no será quebrantada.
texts.psa.148.7: Alabád a Jehová, de la tierra, los dragones y todos los abismos.
texts.psa.148.8: El fuego, y el granizo; la nieve y el vapor: el viento de tempestad que hace su palabra:
texts.psa.148.9: Los montes, y todos los collados: el árbol de fruto, y todos los cedros:
texts.psa.148.10: La bestia, y todo animal: lo que va arrastrando, y el ave de alas.
texts.psa.148.11: Los reyes de la tierra, y todos los pueblos: los príncipes, y todos los jueces de la tierra.
texts.psa.148.12: Los mancebos, y también las doncellas: los viejos con los mozos.
texts.psa.148.13: Alaben el nombre de Jehová; porque su nombre de él solo es ensalzado: su gloria es sobre tierra y cielos.
texts.psa.148.14: El ensalzó el cuerno de su pueblo: aláben le todos sus misericordiosos: los hijos de Israel, el pueblo a él cercano. Alelu- Jah.
texts.psa.149.1: Alelu- Jah. Cantád a Jehová canción nueva: su alabanza sea en la congregación de los misericordiosos.
texts.psa.149.2: Alégrese Israel con su hacedor: los hijos de Sión se regocijen con su Rey.
texts.psa.149.3: Alaben su nombre con corro: con adufe y arpa canten a él.
texts.psa.149.4: Porque Jehová toma contentamiento con su pueblo: hermoseará a los humildes con salud.
texts.psa.149.5: Regocijarse han los piadosos con gloria: cantarán sobre sus camas.
texts.psa.149.6: Ensalzamientos de Dios estarán en sus gargantas; y espadas de dos filos en sus manos:
texts.psa.149.7: Para hacer venganza de los Gentiles: castigos en los pueblos.
texts.psa.149.8: Para aprisionar a sus reyes en grillos; y a sus nobles en cadenas de hierro.
texts.psa.149.9: Para hacer en ellos el juicio escrito: esta será la gloria de todos sus piadosos. Alelu- Jah.
texts.psa.150.1: Alelu- Jah. Alabád a Dios en su santuario: alabádle en el extendimiento de su fortaleza.
texts.psa.150.2: Alabádle en sus valentías: alabádle conforme a la muchedumbre de su grandeza.
texts.psa.150.3: Alabádle a son de bocina: alabádle con salterio y arpa.
texts.psa.150.4: Alabádle con adufe y flauta: alabádle con cuerdas y órgano.
texts.psa.150.5: Alabádle con címbalos resonantes: alabádle con címbalos de jubilación.
texts.psa.150.6: Todo espíritu alabe a Jehová. Alelu- Jah.

texts.psa.1.1: How happy the man, who hath not walked in the counsel of the lawless,—and, in the way of sinners, hath not stood, and, in the seat of scoffers, hath not sat;
texts.psa.1.2: But, in the law of Yahweh, is his delight,—and, in his law, doth he talk with himself day and night.
texts.psa.1.3: So doth he become like a tree planted by streams of waters,—that yieldeth, its fruit, in its season, whose leaf, also doth not wither, and, whatsoever he doeth, prospereth.
texts.psa.1.4: Not so, the lawless,—but as chaff which is driven about by the wind:
texts.psa.1.5: For this cause, shall the lawless not stand in the judgment,—nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
texts.psa.1.6: For Yahweh doth acknowledge the way of the righteous; but, the way of the lawless, shall vanish.
texts.psa.2.1: Wherefore have nations assembled in tumult? Or should, peoples, mutter an empty thing?
texts.psa.2.2: The kings of earth take their station, and, grave men, have met by appointment together,—against Yahweh, and against his Anointed One [saying]:
texts.psa.2.3: Let us break asunder their bonds,—and cast from us their cords!
texts.psa.2.4: He that sitteth in the heavens, will laugh,—My Lord, will mock at them:
texts.psa.2.5: Then, will he speak unto them in his anger, and, in his wrath, confound them:
texts.psa.2.6: Yet, I, have installed my king,—on Zion my holy mountain.
texts.psa.2.7: Let me tell of a decree,—Yahweh, hath said unto me, My son, thou art, I, to-day, have begotten thee:
texts.psa.2.8: Ask of me, and let me give nations as thine inheritance, and, as thy possession, the ends of the earth:
texts.psa.2.9: Thou shalt shepherd them with a sceptre of iron,—as a potter’s vessel, shalt thou dash them in pieces.
texts.psa.2.10: Now, therefore, ye kings, show your prudence, Be admonished, ye judges of earth:
texts.psa.2.11: Serve Yahweh with reverence, and exult with trembling:
texts.psa.2.12: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish by the way, for soon might be kindled his anger,—How happy are all who seek refuge in him!
texts.psa.3.1: Yahweh! how have mine adversaries multiplied, Multitudes, are rising against me;
texts.psa.3.2: Multitudes, are saying of my soul,—No salvation for him in God. [Selah.]
texts.psa.3.3: But, thou, Yahweh, art a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
texts.psa.3.4: With my voice—unto Yahweh, do I cry, and he hath answered me out of his holy mountain. [Selah.]
texts.psa.3.5: I, laid me down and slept,—I awoke, Surely, Yahweh, sustaineth me!
texts.psa.3.6: I will not be afraid of myriads of people, who, round about, have set themselves against me.
texts.psa.3.7: Rise! Yahweh, Save me, my God. Surely thou hast smitten all my foes on the cheekbone, The teeth of the lawless, hast thou broken.
texts.psa.3.8: To Yahweh, belongeth Salvation! Upon thy people, be thy blessing. [Selah.]
texts.psa.4.1: When I cry, answer me, O mine own righteous God, In a strait place, thou hast made room for me, Show me favour, and hear my prayer.
texts.psa.4.2: Ye sons of the great! how long, turning my glory to contempt, will ye love emptiness, will ye seek falsehood? [Selah.]
texts.psa.4.3: Know ye, then, that Yahweh hath set apart the man of lovingkindness for himself: Yahweh, will hear, when I cry to him.
texts.psa.4.4: Be deeply moved, but do not sin,—Ponder in your own heart upon your bed, and be silent. [Selah.]
texts.psa.4.5: Sacrifice the sacrifices of righteousness; and put your trust in Yahweh.
texts.psa.4.6: Multitudes, are saying, Who will show us prosperity? Lift thou upon us the light of thy countenance, O Yahweh.
texts.psa.4.7: Thou hast put gladness in my heart,—beyond the season when, their corn and their new wine, have increased.
texts.psa.4.8: In peace, will I lay me down and at once sleep; for, thou, Yahweh alone, wilt cause me, in security, to dwell.
texts.psa.5.1: To my words, give ear, O Yahweh, Understand thou my softly murmured prayer:
texts.psa.5.2: Attend to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for, unto thee, do I pray.
texts.psa.5.3: O Yahweh! in the morning, shalt thou hear my voice, In the morning, will I set in order unto thee, and keep watch;
texts.psa.5.4: For, not a GOD finding pleasure in lawlessness, art thou, and wrong can be no guest of thine:
texts.psa.5.5: Boasters, shall not station themselves, before thine eyes,—Thou hatest all workers of iniquity:
texts.psa.5.6: Thou wilt destroy them who speak falsehood,—The man of bloodshed and of deceit, Yahweh abhorreth.
texts.psa.5.7: But, I, in the abounding of thy lovingkindness, will enter thy house, I will bow down towards thy holy temple, in reverence of thee:
texts.psa.5.8: O Yahweh! lead me in thy righteousness, because of mine adversaries, Make even, before me, thy way:
texts.psa.5.9: For in his mouth is nothing worthy of trust, Their inward purpose, is engulphing ruin,—An opened sepulchre, is their throat, With their tongue, speak they smooth things.
texts.psa.5.10: Declare them guilty, O God, Let them fall by their own counsels,—Into the throng of their own transgressions, thrust them down, For they have rebelled against thee:—
texts.psa.5.11: That all may rejoice who seek refuge in thee, to times age-abiding, may shout in triumph, that thou wilt protect them, and they may leap for joy in thee who are lovers of thy Name.
texts.psa.5.12: For, thou, wilt bless the righteous man, O Yahweh, As with an all-covering shield—with good pleasure, wilt thou encompass him.
texts.psa.6.1: O Yahweh! do not, in thine anger, correct me, nor, in thy wrath, chastise me.
texts.psa.6.2: Show me favour, O Yahweh, for languishing am I: Heal me, O Yahweh,—for dismayed are my bones:
texts.psa.6.3: Yea, my soul, is dismayed greatly, Thou, then, O Yahweh—how long?
texts.psa.6.4: Return, O Yahweh, deliver my soul, Save me, for the sake of thy lovingkindness;
texts.psa.6.5: For, in death, is no remembrance of thee,—In hades, who shall give thanks unto thee?
texts.psa.6.6: I am weary with my sighing, I flood, through the whole night, my couch,—With my tears, I cause, my bed, to dissolve:
texts.psa.6.7: My face, is all sunken with sorrow,—it hath aged, because of all mine adversaries.
texts.psa.6.8: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity, for Yahweh hath heard the voice of my weeping:
texts.psa.6.9: Yahweh, hath heard my supplication, Yahweh, will receive, my prayer.
texts.psa.6.10: Let all my foes, turn pale and be greatly dismayed, Again let them turn pale in a moment.
texts.psa.7.1: O Yahweh my God, in thee, have I sought refuge,—Save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me:
texts.psa.7.2: Lest one tear, as a lion, my soul,—and there be no deliverer to rescue.
texts.psa.7.3: O Yahweh my God, If I have done this, If there hath been perversity in my hands:
texts.psa.7.4: If I have requited my friend with wrong,—or have oppressed mine adversary without need,
texts.psa.7.5: Let an enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it, that he may tread down, to the earth, my life,—and, mine honour—in the dust, he may cause to dwell. [Selah.]
texts.psa.7.6: Rise! Yahweh! in thine anger, Lift thyself up, because of the haughty outbursts of mine adversaries, Stir up for me the justice thou hast commanded:
texts.psa.7.7: When, the assembly of peoples, gather round thee, then, above it—on high, do thou return!
texts.psa.7.8: Yahweh, will judge the peoples,—Do me justice, O Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity upon me,
texts.psa.7.9: Let the wrong of the lawless, I pray thee, come to an end, and establish thou him that is righteous,—for, a trier of hearts and reins, is God the righteous one.
texts.psa.7.10: My shield, is held by God, who is ready to save the upright in heart:
texts.psa.7.11: A God to vindicate the righteous,—And yet a God to be indignant throughout every day.
texts.psa.7.12: If he turn not, his sword, will he whet,—his bow, hath he bent, and made ready:
texts.psa.7.13: But, for himself, hath he made ready the weapons so deadly, His arrows, he, so fiery, would make:
texts.psa.7.14: Lo! he gendereth trouble, and conceiveth mischief, but giveth birth to a disappointment:
texts.psa.7.15: A pit, he cut out, and digged it, and then fell into the ditch he had made:
texts.psa.7.16: His mischief, turneth back, on his own head,—and, on his own crown, his violence, descendeth.
texts.psa.7.17: I will praise Yahweh according to his righteousness,—and will praise in song the Name of Yahweh Most High.
texts.psa.8.1: O Yahweh, our Lord! How majestic is thy Name, in all the earth, Who hast set thy splendour upon the heavens.
texts.psa.8.2: Out of the mouth of children and sucklings, hast thou laid a foundation of strength,—because of thine adversaries, to make foe and avenger be still.
texts.psa.8.3: When I view thy heavens, the work, of thy fingers, moon and stars, which thou hast established,
texts.psa.8.4: What was weak man, that thou shouldst make mention of him? or the son of the earthborn, that thou shouldst set him in charge?
texts.psa.8.5: That thou shouldst make him little less than messengers of God, with glory and honour, shouldst crown him?
texts.psa.8.6: Shouldst give him dominion over the works of thy hands,—All things, shouldst have put under his feet:
texts.psa.8.7: Sheep and oxen, all of them,—yea even the beasts of the field;
texts.psa.8.8: The bird of the heavens, and the fishes of the sea,— the passer-by on the paths of the seas?
texts.psa.8.9: O Yahweh, our Lord! How majestic is thy Name, in all the earth.
texts.psa.9.1: I will praise Yahweh with all my heart, I will recount all thy wonderful doings:
texts.psa.9.2: I will rejoice and exult in thee, I will praise in song, thy Name, O most High.
texts.psa.9.3: When mine enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished from before thee;
texts.psa.9.4: For thou hast executed my right and my cause, Thou hast sat on the throne, judging righteously:
texts.psa.9.5: Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the lawless one, Their name, hast thou wiped out, to times age-abiding and beyond.
texts.psa.9.6: O enemy! complete are the desolations, evermore,—even cities, hast thou uprooted, The memory of, them, hath perished.
texts.psa.9.7: But, Yahweh, unto times age-abiding, will sit, Ready for judgment, is his throne;
texts.psa.9.8: And, he, will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to peoples, in uprightness.
texts.psa.9.9: Thus be Yahweh a refuge for the crushed one, a refuge for times of destitution:
texts.psa.9.10: Thus let them who know thy Name, put confidence in thee, that thou hast not forsaken the searchers for thee, O Yahweh.
texts.psa.9.11: Sing ye praise to Yahweh, who is seated in Zion, Tell among the peoples his doings.
texts.psa.9.12: When he was making inquisition for blood, of them, had he remembrance, he forgat not the outcry of the oppressed.
texts.psa.9.13: Show me favour, O Yahweh! Behold my humiliation due to them who hate me, Lift me on high out of the gates of death;
texts.psa.9.14: That I may recount all thy praises, In the gates of the daughter of Zion, may exult in thy salvation.
texts.psa.9.15: The nations, have sunk, in the pit they had made, In the net which they had hidden, is caught their own foot.
texts.psa.9.16: To be known is Yahweh, by the sentence he hath executed, By the doing of his own hands, is he about to strike down the lawless one. [Resounding music. Selah.]
texts.psa.9.17: The lawless, shall return, to hades, all nations forgetful of God.
texts.psa.9.18: For, not always, shall the needy, be forgotten,—[nor,] the hope of the oppressed, perish for ever.
texts.psa.9.19: Rise! Yahweh! let man not prevail, let the nations be judged before thee.
texts.psa.9.20: Appoint, O Yahweh, a terror for them,—Let the nations know [that] they are men. [Selah.]
texts.psa.10.1: Wherefore, O Yahweh, shouldst thou stand afar off? [Wherefore] hide thyself, in times of destitution?
texts.psa.10.2: In the pride of the lawless one, he hotly pursueth the poor, let them be caught in the plots which they have devised!
texts.psa.10.3: For the lawless one hath boasted over the longing of his soul, and, the robber, hath blasphemed Yahweh.
texts.psa.10.4: The lawless one, in the loftiness of his countenance, will not enquire, God is not in any of his plots:
texts.psa.10.5: His ways are firm at all times, On high, are thy righteous regulations, out of his sight, As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them:
texts.psa.10.6: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be shaken,—From generation to generation, shall I be in no misfortune.
texts.psa.10.7: With cursing, his mouth is full, and with deceptions and oppression, Under his tongue, are trouble and mischief:
texts.psa.10.8: He abideth in the lurking-place of villages, In the hiding-places, he murdereth the innocent,—His eyes, for the unfortunate, are on the watch:
texts.psa.10.9: He lieth in wait in a hiding-place, like a lion in his covert, He lieth in wait to catch the humbled, He catcheth the humbled, by drawing him into his net:
texts.psa.10.10: He croucheth, he lieth down, then falleth he with his strong claws upon the unfortunate.
texts.psa.10.11: He hath said in his heart, GOD hath forgotten,—He hath veiled his face, Oh he hath never seen!
texts.psa.10.12: Arise! Yahweh! O GOD! raise thy hand,—Do not forget the patient!
texts.psa.10.13: Wherefore hath the lawless one blasphemed God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it]!
texts.psa.10.14: Thou hast seen! For, thou, mischief and misery, dost discern, to requite with thine own hand, Unto thee, doth, the unfortunate one, give himself up, To the fatherless, thou thyself, hast become a helper.
texts.psa.10.15: Shatter thou the arm of the lawless one, And, as for the wrongful, wilt thou not enquire for his lawlessness—wilt thou not find [it]?
texts.psa.10.16: Yahweh, is king, to times age-abiding and beyond, The nations have perished out of his land.
texts.psa.10.17: The longing of the patient, thou hast heard, O Yahweh, Thou wilt establish their heart, Thou wilt make attentive thine ear:
texts.psa.10.18: To vindicate the fatherless and the crushed, A man of the earth, shall, no further, cause terror!
texts.psa.11.1: In Yahweh, have I sought refuge. How can ye say to my soul, Flee to a mountain like a little bird;
texts.psa.11.2: For lo! the lawless, bend the bow They have fixed their arrow upon the string, To shoot in the darkness at the upright in heart:
texts.psa.11.3: When the pillars are overthrown, What could, a righteous man, do?
texts.psa.11.4: Yahweh, is in his holy temple As for Yahweh, in the heavens, is his throne, His eyes, behold—His eyelashes test the sons of men.
texts.psa.11.5: Yahweh, putteth, the righteous, to the test,—But the lawless one and the lover of violence, his soul doth hate.
texts.psa.11.6: He will rain upon the lawless live-coals, Fire and brimstone and a burning wind, are the portion of their cup.
texts.psa.11.7: For righteous is Yahweh Righteousness, he loveth, the upright, shall behold his face.
texts.psa.12.1: O save Yahweh, for the man of lovingkindness, is no more, for the faithful, have vanished, from among the sons of men.
texts.psa.12.2: Deception, speak they, every one with his neighbour,—with lips uttering smooth things—with a heart and a heart, do they speak.
texts.psa.12.3: May Yahweh cut off All the lips that utter smooth things,—the tongue that speaketh swelling words;
texts.psa.12.4: Them who say—With our tongue, will we prevail, our lips, are our own, who is our master?
texts.psa.12.5: Because of violence done to the poor, because of the crying of the needy, Now, will I arise! O may Yahweh say,—I will place [him] in safety—let him puff at him!
texts.psa.12.6: The words of Yahweh, are words, that are pure, silver refined in a crucible of earth, purified seven times!
texts.psa.12.7: Thou, O Yahweh, wilt keep them,—Thou wilt guard him, from this generation unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.12.8: On every side, the lawless, march about,—when worthlessness is exalted by the sons of men.
texts.psa.13.1: How long, O Yahweh, wilt thou wholly forget me? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
texts.psa.13.2: How long shall I lay up cares within my soul, sorrow in my heart, day by day? How long shall mine enemy lift himself up over me?
texts.psa.13.3: Have regard! answer me O Yahweh my God,—Light up mine eyes, lest I sleep on into death:
texts.psa.13.4: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed over him! and, mine adversaries, exult, that I totter.
texts.psa.13.5: But, I, in thy lovingkindness, have put my trust, My heart shall exult in thy salvation:
texts.psa.13.6: I will sing to Yahweh, for he hath dealt beautifully with me.
texts.psa.14.1: The impious hath said in his heart—There is no God! They have acted corruptly, they have done an abominable deed, there is none that doeth good.
texts.psa.14.2: Yahweh, out of the heavens, looked down over the sons of men,—to see whether there was one that showed wisdom, enquiring after God:—
texts.psa.14.3: The whole, have turned aside, Together have they become tainted,—There is none that doeth good, not so much as, one!
texts.psa.14.4: Are all the workers of iniquity, without knowledge? devouring my people [as] they devour food! Upon Yahweh, have they not called.
texts.psa.14.5: There have they been in great dread, because, God, is in the circle of the righteous man.
texts.psa.14.6: The purpose of the poor, ye would put to shame, because, Yahweh, is his refuge.
texts.psa.14.7: Oh that, out of Zion, were granted the salvation of Israel! When Yahweh bringeth back the captives of his people, Jacob, shall exult, Israel, be glad.
texts.psa.15.1: O Yahweh! Who shall be a guest in thy tent? Who shall abide in thy holy mountain?
texts.psa.15.2: He that walketh without blame, and doeth what is right, and speaketh truth with his heart;
texts.psa.15.3: Hath not carried slander on his tongue, hath not done his friend a wrong, nor, a reproach, taken up against his neighbour;
texts.psa.15.4: Despised in his sight, is the reprobate, but, them who revere Yahweh, he doth honour, he hath sworn to his neighbour, and will not change;
texts.psa.15.5: His silver, hath he not put out on interest, nor, a bribe against the innocent, hath he taken. He that doeth these things, shall not be shaken unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.16.1: Preserve me, O GOD, for I have sought refuge in thee.
texts.psa.16.2: Thou hast said unto Yahweh, My Lord, art thou! My goodness, mounteth not unto thee.
texts.psa.16.3: It belongeth unto the holy ones, whom, in his own land, Yahweh, ennobleth, In whom is all his delight
texts.psa.16.4: They multiply their idols—another, have they purchased! I will not pour out their drink-offerings of blood, nor will I take up their names on my lips.
texts.psa.16.5: Yahweh, is mine allotted portion and my cup, Thou, art maintaining my lot.
texts.psa.16.6: The lines, have fallen unto me, in pleasant places, Verily an inheritance that delighteth me.
texts.psa.16.7: I will bless Yahweh, who hath counselled me,—Surely, by night, shall mine impulses admonish me.
texts.psa.16.8: I have set Yahweh before me continually, because he is on my right hand, I shall not be shaken!
texts.psa.16.9: Therefore, hath my heart rejoiced, and mine honour exulted, Yea, my flesh, shall settle down securely;
texts.psa.16.10: For thou wilt not abandon my soul to hades, neither wilt thou suffer thy man of lovingkindness, to see corruption:
texts.psa.16.11: Thou wilt cause me to know, the path of life,—Fulness of joys before thee, Pleasures at thy right hand evermore.
texts.psa.17.1: Hear, O Yahweh, the right, Attend to my loud cry, Give ear unto my prayer, on lips that would not deceive:
texts.psa.17.2: From before thee, let my sentence come forth, Thine eyes, behold with equity.
texts.psa.17.3: Thou hast tested my heart, hast made inspection by night, hast refined me until thou couldst find nothing, Had I devised evil, my mouth should not have transgressed:
texts.psa.17.4: As for the workings of men, By the word of thy lips, have, I, taken heed of the paths of the violent one.
texts.psa.17.5: Thou hast held fast my goings on to thy ways, My footsteps have not been shaken:
texts.psa.17.6: I, have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O GOD,—Incline thine ear unto me, Hear thou my speech:
texts.psa.17.7: Let thy lovingkindness be distinguished, thou Saviour of such as seek refuge from them who lift themselves up against thy right hand.
texts.psa.17.8: Guard me, as the pupil of the eye,—Under the shadow of thy wings, wilt thou hide me:
texts.psa.17.9: From the face of lawless ones who have treated me with violence, the foes of my soul, who come round against me:
texts.psa.17.10: Their own fat [heart], have they shut up,—With their mouth, have they spoken proudly.
texts.psa.17.11: As for our own goings, now, have they surrounded us,—Their eyes, they fix, bending to the earth:
texts.psa.17.12: His likeness, is as a lion, that longeth to rend, and as a young lion, lurking in secret places.
texts.psa.17.13: Rise, Yahweh! Confront his face, Bring him down, Deliver my soul from the lawless one [who is] thy sword:
texts.psa.17.14: From men [who are] thy hand, O Yahweh, From the men of this age, whose portion, is among the living, and, with thy treasure, thou fillest their bosom,—They must be satisfied with sons, And must leave their abundance to their children:—
texts.psa.17.15: I, in righteousness, shall behold thy face, Shall be satisfied when awakened by a vision of thee.
texts.psa.18.1: I will love thee, O Yahweh my strength!
texts.psa.18.2: Yahweh, was my mountain crag and my stronghold, and my deliverer: My GOD, was my rock, I sought refuge in him, My shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower.
texts.psa.18.3: As one worthy to be praised, called I on Yahweh,—And, from my foes, was I saved.
texts.psa.18.4: The meshes of death encompassed me, The torrents of perdition, made me afraid;
texts.psa.18.5: The meshes of hades, had surrounded me, The snares of death, had confronted me,
texts.psa.18.6: In my distress, called I on Yahweh, And, unto my God, made outcry for help, He heard, out of his temple, my voice, And my outcry for help came before him—entered into his ears!
texts.psa.18.7: Then did the earth shake and quake, Even, the foundations of the mountains, were deeply moved, Yea they did shake, because he was angry.
texts.psa.18.8: There went up smoke in his nostrils, and, a fire out of his mouth, devoured, Live coals, were kindled from it:
texts.psa.18.9: Then he stretched out the heaven, and came down,—and, thick gloom, was under his feet;
texts.psa.18.10: Then he rode on a cherub, and flew, and darted on the wings of the wind;
texts.psa.18.11: Made darkness his hiding-place, Round about him—his pavilion, Darkness of waters, clouds of vapours.
texts.psa.18.12: Out of the brightness before him, his clouds rolled along, hail, and live coals of fire.
texts.psa.18.13: Then did Yahweh thunder in the heavens, and the Highest uttered his voice,—hail, and live coals of fire.
texts.psa.18.14: And he sent forth his arrows and scattered them, yea, lightnings, he shot out, and confused them.
texts.psa.18.15: Then appeared the channels of waters, were uncovered the foundations of the world,—At thy rebuke O Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
texts.psa.18.16: He sent from on high, he took me,—he drew me out of many waters.
texts.psa.18.17: He rescued me from my foe, in his might, and from them who hated me, because they were too strong for me:
texts.psa.18.18: They confronted me, in the day of my necessity, Then became Yahweh my stay:
texts.psa.18.19: And brought me out, into a large place, he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
texts.psa.18.20: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands, he repaid me;
texts.psa.18.21: For I had kept the ways of Yahweh, and not broken away from my God;
texts.psa.18.22: For, all his regulations, were before me, and, his statutes, did I not put from me:
texts.psa.18.23: So became I blameless with him, and kept myself from mine iniquity.
texts.psa.18.24: Yahweh therefore repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the pureness of my hands, before his eyes.
texts.psa.18.25: With the loving, thou didst show thyself loving,—With the blameless man, thou didst show thyself blameless;
texts.psa.18.26: With the pure, thou didst show thyself pure, But, with the perverse, thou didst show thyself ready to contend.
texts.psa.18.27: For, as for thee, an oppressed people, thou didst save, but, looks that were lofty, layedst thou low;
texts.psa.18.28: For, thou, didst light up my lamp, Yahweh my God, enlightened my darkness;
texts.psa.18.29: For, by thee, I ran through a troop, and, by my God, I leapt over a wall.
texts.psa.18.30: As for GOD, blameless is his way, The speech of Yahweh hath been proved, A shield, he is to all who seek refuge in him.
texts.psa.18.31: For who is a GOD, save Yahweh? And who is a Rock, save our God?
texts.psa.18.32: The GOD who girded me with strength, and set forth, as blameless, my way:
texts.psa.18.33: Planting my feet like hinds’ [feet], yea, on my high places, he caused me to stand:
texts.psa.18.34: Teaching my hands to war,—so that a bow of bronze was bent by mine arms.
texts.psa.18.35: Thus didst thou grant me, as a shield, thy salvation,—and, thy right hand, sustained me, and, thy condescension, made me great.
texts.psa.18.36: Thou didst widen my stepping-places under me, so that, mine ankles, faltered not.
texts.psa.18.37: I pursued my foes, and overtook them, and returned not, till they were consumed:
texts.psa.18.38: I crushed them, and they were unable to rise, They fell under my feet.
texts.psa.18.39: Thus didst thou gird me with strength, for the battle, Thou subduedst mine assailants under me.
texts.psa.18.40: As for my foes, thou didst give me their neck, and, as for them who hated me, I destroyed them.
texts.psa.18.41: They cried out, but there was none to save, unto Yahweh, but he answered them not.
texts.psa.18.42: Then did I beat them in pieces, like dust on the face of the wind. Like the mire in the lanes, did I scatter them.
texts.psa.18.43: Thus didst thou rescue me from the contentions of a people,—didst appoint me to be the head of nations, A people I had not known, served me:
texts.psa.18.44: At the hearing of the ear, they submitted to me, the sons of the foreigner, came cringing unto me:
texts.psa.18.45: The sons of the foreigner, lost heart, and came quaking out of their fortresses.
texts.psa.18.46: Yahweh liveth and, blessed, be my Rock, yea, exalted, be the God of my salvation:
texts.psa.18.47: The GOD, who hath avenged me,—and subjugated peoples under me:
texts.psa.18.48: Who hath delivered me from my foes,—Yea, from mine assailants, hast thou set me on high, From the man of violence, hast thou rescued me.
texts.psa.18.49: For this cause, will I praise thee among the nations, O Yahweh, and, to thy Name, will I sweep the strings:—
texts.psa.18.50: Who hath made great the victories of his King,—and shown lovingkindness to his Anointed One, To David and to his Seed, Unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.19.1: The heavens, are telling the glory of GOD, And, the work of his hands, the expanse is declaring;
texts.psa.19.2: Day, unto day, doth pour forth speech, and, night, unto night, doth breathe out knowledge.
texts.psa.19.3: There is no speech, and there are no words,—Unheard is their voice!
texts.psa.19.4: [Yet] through all the earth, hath gone forth their voice,—and, to the end of the world, their sayings,—For the sun, hath he set up a tent therein;
texts.psa.19.5: And, he, is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, he rejoiceth as a hero to run a race:
texts.psa.19.6: From one end of the heavens, is his going forth, and, his circuit, to the other end thereof—and, nothing, is hid from his glowing heat.
texts.psa.19.7: The, law of Yahweh, is complete, Bringing back the soul, The, testimony of Yahweh, is confirmed, Making wise the simple;
texts.psa.19.8: The precepts of Yahweh, are right, Rejoicing the heart, The, commandment of Yahweh, is pure, Enlightening the eyes;
texts.psa.19.9: The, reverence of Yahweh, is clean, Enduring evermore,—The, decisions of Yahweh, are faithful, They are righteous, altogether:
texts.psa.19.10: More desirable, than gold, yea than much fine gold, Sweeter, also than honey, or than droppings from the comb.
texts.psa.19.11: Even thine own servant, taketh warning by them, In the keeping of them, great is the reward.
texts.psa.19.12: Mistakes, who perceiveth? From things that are hidden, acquit me:
texts.psa.19.13: Even from the presumptuous, keep back thy servant, May they not have dominion over me, Then, shall I be blameless, and shall be acquitted from great transgression:
texts.psa.19.14: The words of my mouth, and the soft utterance of my heart, shall come with acceptance, before thee, O Yahweh, my Rock and my Redeemer!
texts.psa.20.1: Yahweh answer thee, in the day of distress, The Name of the God of Jacob give thee safety;
texts.psa.20.2: Send thy help out of the sanctuary, and, out of Zion, sustain thee;
texts.psa.20.3: Remember every present of thine, and, thine ascending-sacrifice, esteem. [Selah.]
texts.psa.20.4: Give thee according to thy heart, and, all thy purposes, fulfil.
texts.psa.20.5: We will shout aloud in thy salvation, and, in the Name of our God, shall we become great, Yahweh fulfil all thy petitions.
texts.psa.20.6: Now, do I know that Yahweh, hath saved, his Anointed One,—He answereth him out of his holy heavens, by the mighty saving deeds of his own right hand.
texts.psa.20.7: These, by chariots, and, those, by horses, but, we, by the Name of Yahweh our God, will prevail.
texts.psa.20.8: They, have bowed down and fallen, but, we, have arisen, and stand upright.
texts.psa.20.9: Yahweh, hath saved the king. Answer us, then, on the day when we call.
texts.psa.21.1: O Yahweh, in thy strength, will the king rejoice, and, in thy salvation, how greatly will he exult!
texts.psa.21.2: The longing of his heart, hast thou given him, and, the request of his lips, hast thou not withheld. [Selah.]
texts.psa.21.3: For thou wilt come to meet him, with the blessings of goodness, Thou wilt set on his head, a crown of pure gold.
texts.psa.21.4: Life, he asked of thee, Thou hast given it him, length of days, to times age-abiding and beyond.
texts.psa.21.5: Great is his glory, in thy salvation, Honour and majesty, wilt thou lay upon him;
texts.psa.21.6: For thou wilt appoint him blessings evermore, wilt cheer him with joy by thy countenance;
texts.psa.21.7: For, the king, is trusting in Yahweh, and, in the lovingkindness of the Highest, shall he not be shaken.
texts.psa.21.8: Thy hand, will find out, all thy foes, Thine own right hand, will find out them who hate thee.
texts.psa.21.9: Thou wilt make them like a furnace of fire, at the time of thy presence,—Yahweh, in his anger, will swallow them up, and there shall consume them a fire:
texts.psa.21.10: Their fruit—out of the earth, wilt thou destroy, and their seed, from among the sons of men;
texts.psa.21.11: For they have held out, against thee, a wicked thing, They have devised a scheme they cannot accomplish.
texts.psa.21.12: For thou wilt cause them to turn their back, Upon thy bow-strings, wilt thou make ready against their face.
texts.psa.21.13: Be exalted, O Yahweh, in thy strength! With song and with string will we sound forth thy power.
texts.psa.22.1: My GOD, my GOD, why hast thou forsaken me? Far from saving me, The words of my loud lamentation?
texts.psa.22.2: My God! I keep crying—By day, and thou dost not answer, and, By night, and there is no rest for me.
texts.psa.22.3: But, thou, art holy, Who inhabitest the praises of Israel.
texts.psa.22.4: In thee, trusted our fathers, They trusted, and thou didst deliver them;
texts.psa.22.5: Unto thee, made they outcry, and escaped, In thee, they trusted, and had not turned pale.
texts.psa.22.6: But, I, am a worm and no one, a reproach of men, and despised of a people;
texts.psa.22.7: All that see me, laugh at me,—They open wide the mouth, They shake the head:—
texts.psa.22.8: He should trust in Yahweh—let him deliver him,—Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.
texts.psa.22.9: For, thou, art he that severed me from the womb, he that caused me to trust, upon the breasts of my mother;
texts.psa.22.10: Upon thee, was I cast from the time I was born, From the womb of my mother, my GOD, hast thou been.
texts.psa.22.11: Be not far from me, for, distress, is near, For there is none to help.
texts.psa.22.12: Many bulls have surrounded me, Strong oxen of Bashan, have enclosed me;
texts.psa.22.13: They have opened wide against me their mouth, A lion rending and roaring.
texts.psa.22.14: Like water, am I poured out, and, put out of joint, are all my bones,—My heart, hath become, like wax, it is melted in the midst of my body;
texts.psa.22.15: Dried as a potsherd, is my strength, And, my tongue, is made to cleave to my gums, And, in the dust of death, wilt thou lay me.
texts.psa.22.16: For dogs have surrounded me,—An assembly of evil doers, have encircled me, They have pierced my hands and my feet,
texts.psa.22.17: I may tell all my bones, They, look for—they behold me!
texts.psa.22.18: They part my garments among them, and, for my vestment, they cast lots.
texts.psa.22.19: But, thou, O Yahweh, be not far off, O my help! to aid me, make haste;
texts.psa.22.20: Rescue, from the sword, my life, from the power of the dog, my solitary self:
texts.psa.22.21: Save me from the mouth of the lion,—Yea, from the horns of wild beasts, hast thou delivered me.
texts.psa.22.22: I will declare thy Name unto my brethren,—In the midst of the convocation, will I praise thee.
texts.psa.22.23: Ye that revere Yahweh, praise him, All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him, And, stand in awe of him, all ye seed of Israel.
texts.psa.22.24: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the humbling of the patient one, neither hath he hid his face from him, but, when he cried for help unto him, he heard.
texts.psa.22.25: Of thee, is my praise in the great convocation, My vows, will I pay, before them who revere him.
texts.psa.22.26: The patient wronged-ones shall eat and be satisfied, They shall praise Yahweh, who are seekers of him, Let your heart live for aye.
texts.psa.22.27: All the ends of the earth, will remember and turn to Yahweh, Yea all the families of the nations, will bow themselves down before thee,
texts.psa.22.28: For, to Yahweh, belongeth the kingdom, And One to Rule over the nations.
texts.psa.22.29: All the great ones of the earth, shall eat and bow down, Before him shall kneel, all that go down to the dust, Even he who had not kept alive, his own soul!
texts.psa.22.30: My seed, shall serve him, It shall be recounted, of the Lord, to a generation that shall come:
texts.psa.22.31: That his righteousness may be declared to a people to be born, That he wrought with effect!
texts.psa.23.1: Yahweh, is my shepherd—I shall not want:
texts.psa.23.2: In pastures of tender grass, he maketh me lie down, Unto restful waters, he leadeth me;
texts.psa.23.3: My life, he restoreth, He guideth me in right paths, for the sake of his Name.
texts.psa.23.4: Yea, though I walk through a valley death-shadowed, I will fear no harm, for, thou, art with me, Thy rod and thy staff, they, comfort me.
texts.psa.23.5: Thou spreadest before me a table, in face of mine adversaries, Thou hast anointed, with oil, my head, My cup, hath run over.
texts.psa.23.6: Surely, goodness and lovingkindness, will pursue me, all the days of my life, and I shall dwell in the house of Yahweh, evermore.
texts.psa.24.1: To Yahweh, belongeth, The earth and the fulness thereof, The world, and they who dwell therein;
texts.psa.24.2: For, he, upon the seas, hath founded it, and upon the currents, doth make it firm.
texts.psa.24.3: Who shall ascend the mountain of Yahweh? And who shall stand in his holy place?
texts.psa.24.4: The clean of hands, and pure of heart,—who hath not uplifted, to falsehood, his soul, nor sworn deceitfully,
texts.psa.24.5: Shall bear away a blessing from Yahweh, and righteousness, from his delivering God.
texts.psa.24.6: This, is the generation of them who inquire of him, who seek thy face, O God of Jacob. [Selah.]
texts.psa.24.7: Lift up, O ye gates, your heads, and lift yourselves up, ye age-abiding doors, That the king of glory may come in.
texts.psa.24.8: Who is the king of glory? Yahweh, strong and mighty, Yahweh, mighty in war.
texts.psa.24.9: Lift up, O ye gates, your heads, yea lift [them] up, ye age-abiding doors, That the king of glory may come in.
texts.psa.24.10: Who then is the king of glory? Yahweh of hosts, He, is the king of glory. [Selah.]
texts.psa.25.1: Unto thee, O Yahweh, my soul, would I lift:
texts.psa.25.2: O my God, in thee, have I put my trust, Let me not be put to shame, Let not my foe exult over me:
texts.psa.25.3: Yea let, none who wait for thee, be put to shame, Let them be put to shame who act covertly without cause!
texts.psa.25.4: Thy ways, O Yahweh, let me know, Thy paths, teach thou me:
texts.psa.25.5: Guide me into thy truth and teach me, for, thou, art my delivering God, For thee, have I waited all the day:
texts.psa.25.6: Remember thy compassions, O Yahweh, and thy lovingkindnesses, For, from age-past times, have they been.
texts.psa.25.7: The sins of my youth, and my transgressions, do not thou call to mind,—According to thine own lovingkindness, remember thou me, for the sake of thine own goodness, O Yahweh.
texts.psa.25.8: Good and upright, is Yahweh, For this cause, will he direct sinners into the way.
texts.psa.25.9: May he guide patient wronged-ones to be righted, and teach such oppressed-ones his way.
texts.psa.25.10: All the paths of Yahweh, are lovingkindness and faithfulness, to such as keep his covenant, and his testimonies.
texts.psa.25.11: For the sake of thy Name, O Yahweh, Therefore wilt thou pardon mine iniquity, for great it is.
texts.psa.25.12: Who then is the man that revereth Yahweh? Let him direct him into the way he should choose.
texts.psa.25.13: His soul, with prosperity, shall tarry, and, his seed, shall possess the land.
texts.psa.25.14: Intimacy with Yahweh, have they who revere him, His covenant also, he letteth them know.
texts.psa.25.15: Mine eyes, are continually unto Yahweh,—for, he, bringeth, out of the net, my feet.
texts.psa.25.16: Turn thou unto me, and show me favour, for, alone and oppressed, I am.
texts.psa.25.17: The distresses of my heart, hath he relieved,—and, out of my straits, brought me forth.
texts.psa.25.18: Behold my humiliation and my pain, and take away all my sins.
texts.psa.25.19: Behold my foes, for they abound,—and, with the hatred of violence, do they hate me.
texts.psa.25.20: Oh keep my soul, and rescue me, Let me not be put to shame, for I have sought refuge in thee.
texts.psa.25.21: Let, blamelessness and uprightness, watch over me, because I have waited for thee.
texts.psa.25.22: Redeem Israel, O God,—out of all his distresses.
texts.psa.26.1: Do me justice, O Yahweh, For, I, in my blamelessness, have walked, and, in Yahweh, have I trusted, I will not waver.
texts.psa.26.2: Try me, O Yahweh, and prove me, Test my reins and my heart:—
texts.psa.26.3: For, thy lovingkindness, hath been before mine eyes, and I have walked to and fro in thy faithfulness;
texts.psa.26.4: I have not sat with men of deceit, nor, with dissemblers, would I enter;
texts.psa.26.5: I have hated the convocation of evil-doers, and, with lawless men, would I not sit;
texts.psa.26.6: I will bathe, in pureness, my hands,—so will I go in procession around thine altar, O Yahweh;
texts.psa.26.7: To sound aloud a song, and to recount all thy wonderful doings.
texts.psa.26.8: O Yahweh, I have loved the asylum of thy house, even the place of the habitation of thy glory!
texts.psa.26.9: Do not remove, with sinners, my soul, nor, with men of bloodshed, my life;
texts.psa.26.10: In whose hands is a plot, and, their right hand, is filled with a bribe.
texts.psa.26.11: But, I, in my blamelessness, will walk, Redeem me and show me favour.
texts.psa.26.12: My foot standeth in a level place, In the convocations, will I bless Yahweh.
texts.psa.27.1: Yahweh, is my light and my salvation, Of whom shall I be afraid? Yahweh, is the refuge of my life, Of whom shall I be in dread?
texts.psa.27.2: When there drew near against me evil-doers to devour my flesh, mine adversaries, and mine enemies—mine!—they, stumbled and fell!
texts.psa.27.3: Though there pitch against me—a camp, my heart shall not fear,—Though there come up against me—a battle, still, am I confident.
texts.psa.27.4: One thing, have I asked of Yahweh, That, will I seek to secure,—That I may dwell in the house of Yahweh, all the days of my life, To view the delightfulness of Yahweh, And to contemplate in his temple.
texts.psa.27.5: For he will hide me in his pavilion, in the day of calamity,—He will conceal me, in the secrecy of his tent, Within a rock, will he set me on high.
texts.psa.27.6: Now, therefore, shall my head be raised high above my foes round about me, and I will sacrifice in his tent the sacrifices of triumphant joy, I will sing and touch the strings, to Yahweh.
texts.psa.27.7: Hear, O Yahweh, With my voice, do I cry, Oh then show me favour and answer me.
texts.psa.27.8: To thee, said my heart—[When thou saidst] Seek ye my face—Thy face, O Yahweh, will I seek!
texts.psa.27.9: Do not hide thy face from me, Do not repulse, in thine anger, thine own servant,—My help, thou hast been, Do not send me away nor forsake me, O my saving God!
texts.psa.27.10: When, my own father and mother, had forsaken me, Then, Yahweh, took me up!
texts.psa.27.11: Point out to me, O Yahweh, thy way,—And guide me in a level path, because of mine adversaries.
texts.psa.27.12: Do not give me up unto the desire of mine adversaries, for there have risen up against me witnesses that are false, and he that fanneth up violence.
texts.psa.27.13: I believe that I shall see—The goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living,
texts.psa.27.14: Wait thou for Yahweh,—Be strong, and let thy heart be bold, Wait, then, for Yahweh!
texts.psa.28.1: Unto thee, O Yahweh, do I cry, O my Rock! do not turn in silence from me,—lest, if thou turn from me in silence, I be like them who go down into the pit.
texts.psa.28.2: Hear the voice of my supplication, when I cry to thee for help, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy shrine.
texts.psa.28.3: Do not drag me away—with the lawless, or with the workers of iniquity,—who speak peaceably with their neighbours, but, wrong, is in their heart.
texts.psa.28.4: Give them, according to their deed, and, according to the wrong of their practices,—According to the work of their own hands, give thou unto them, Bring back their own dealing to themselves.
texts.psa.28.5: Because they heed not The Deeds of Yahweh, or the Work of his hands, he will pull them down, and not build them.
texts.psa.28.6: Blessed be Yahweh, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplication.
texts.psa.28.7: Yahweh, is my strength and my shield, In him, hath trusted my heart, and I have found help,—Therefore hath my heart danced for joy, and, with my song, do I praise him.
texts.psa.28.8: Yahweh, is strength to his people,—And, the all-saving refuge of his Anointed One, is he!
texts.psa.28.9: Oh save thy people, and bless thine inheritance, Tend them also, and carry them, Unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.29.1: Give to Yahweh, ye sons of the mighty,—Give to Yahweh, [both] glory and strength:
texts.psa.29.2: Give to Yahweh, the glory of his Name, Bow down to Yahweh, in the adornment of holiness.
texts.psa.29.3: The voice of Yahweh, is upon the waters,—The GOD of glory, hath thundered, Yahweh, is upon mighty waters;
texts.psa.29.4: The voice of Yahweh, is with power, The voice of Yahweh, is with majesty;
texts.psa.29.5: The voice of Yahweh, is breaking cedars, Now hath Yahweh, broken down, the cedars of Lebanon!
texts.psa.29.6: And hath made them leap like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion, like the bull-calf of wild-oxen;
texts.psa.29.7: The voice of Yahweh, is cleaving out flames of fire;
texts.psa.29.8: The voice of Yahweh, bringeth birth-pains upon the wilderness; Yahweh bringeth birth-pains upon the wilderness of Kadesh!
texts.psa.29.9: The voice of Yahweh, causeth the gazelles to bring forth, and hath stript forests; and, in his own temple, every one there, is saying, Glory!
texts.psa.29.10: Yahweh, at the Flood, was seated, And Yahweh hath taken his seat, as king, unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.29.11: Yahweh, will give, strength to his people,—Yahweh, will bless his people with prosperity.
texts.psa.30.1: I will extol thee, O Yahweh, for thou hast drawn me up,—and not suffered my foes to rejoice over me.
texts.psa.30.2: O Yahweh, my God, I cried for help unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
texts.psa.30.3: O Yahweh! thou hast lifted, out of hades, my soul, Thou hast brought me back to life, from among those who were going down to the pit.
texts.psa.30.4: Sweep the strings to Yahweh, ye his men of lovingkindness, and give ye praise at the mention of his holiness.
texts.psa.30.5: For there is, a Moment, in his anger, a Life-time, in his good-pleasure, In the evening, cometh Weeping to lodge, But, by the morning,’tis a Shout of Triumph!
texts.psa.30.6: But, I, said, in my tranquility, I shall not be shaken to times age-abiding!
texts.psa.30.7: O Yahweh, in thy good-pleasure, hadst thou caused my mountain to stand, strong,—Thou didst hide thy face—I was dismayed!
texts.psa.30.8: Unto thee, O Yahweh, do I cry,—and, unto My Lord, do I make supplication:
texts.psa.30.9: What profit in my blood? in my going down into the pit? Can dust praise thee? Can it declare thy faithfulness?
texts.psa.30.10: Hear, O Yahweh, and show me favour, O Yahweh! become thou a helper unto me.
texts.psa.30.11: Thou hast turned my lamentation, into a dance for me,—Thou hast torn off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness:
texts.psa.30.12: To the end that mine honour should make melody unto thee, and not be silent. O Yahweh, my God! Unto times age-abiding, will I praise thee.
texts.psa.31.1: In thee, O Yahweh, have I sought refuge, Let me not be ashamed to times age-abiding, In thy righteousness, deliver me:
texts.psa.31.2: Incline unto me, thine ear, Speedily rescue me,—Become to me a Rock of refuge, a Place of security, For saving me.
texts.psa.31.3: Because, my mountain crag and my stronghold, thou art, Therefore, for the sake of thine own Name, wilt thou lead me and guide me?
texts.psa.31.4: Wilt thou bring me forth, out of the net which they have hidden for me? For, thou, art my refuge.
texts.psa.31.5: Into thy hand, do I commit my spirit—Thou hast ransomed me, O Yahweh, GOD most faithful.
texts.psa.31.6: I hate such as give heed to false vanities, I, then, in Yahweh, have set my hope.
texts.psa.31.7: I will indeed exult and rejoice, in thy lovingkindness,—In that thou hast looked upon my humiliation, thou hast taken note that in distresses was my life;
texts.psa.31.8: And hast not shut me up in the hand of the foe, Thou hast given standing, in a roomy place, unto my feet.
texts.psa.31.9: Show me favour, O Yahweh, for in distress am I,—Wasted with vexation, is mine eye—my soul and my body;
