texts.psa.107.28: Then make they outcry to Yahweh in their peril, and, out of their distresses, he bringeth them forth,
texts.psa.107.29: He calmeth the storm to a whisper, and silent are their rolling waves:
texts.psa.107.30: Then are they glad, because they are hushed, And he guideth them unto their desired haven.
texts.psa.107.31: Let them give thanks to Yahweh for his lovingkindness, and for his wonderful dealings with the sons of men!
texts.psa.107.32: Yea let them extol him in the convocation of the people, and, in the seated company of elders, let them praise him.
texts.psa.107.33: He turneth Rivers into a desert, and, Springs of Water, into thirsty ground,
texts.psa.107.34: A Land of Fruit, into a waste of salt, For the wickedness of them who dwell therein.
texts.psa.107.35: He turneth A Desert, into a pool of water, and, A Parched Land into springs of water;
texts.psa.107.36: And hath caused the famished to dwell there, And they have built them a city to dwell in;
texts.psa.107.37: And have sown fields, and planted vineyards, and made them fruits of increase:
texts.psa.107.38: Thus hath he blessed them, and they have multiplied greatly, And, their cattle, he maketh not few.
texts.psa.107.39: So have they become few and been brought low, By oppression, misfortune, and sorrow;
texts.psa.107.40: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste;
texts.psa.107.41: But he hath set the needy on high from affliction, and made families, like a flock:—
texts.psa.107.42: The upright seeth and is glad, And, all perverseness, hath closed her mouth.
texts.psa.107.43: Who is wise? then let him observe these things! and diligently consider the lovingkindness of Yahweh.
texts.psa.108.1: Fixed, is my heart, O God, I will sing and touch the strings, even mine honour.
texts.psa.108.2: Awake, O harp and lyre, I will awaken the dawn!
texts.psa.108.3: I will thank thee among the peoples, O Yahweh, and will sing praise unto thee, among the tribes of men.
texts.psa.108.4: For, great, above the heavens, is thy lovingkindness, and, as far as the skies, thy faithfulness.
texts.psa.108.5: Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God, And, above all the earth, be thy glory.
texts.psa.108.6: To the end thy beloved ones may be delivered, Oh save thou with thy right hand and answer me!
texts.psa.108.7: God, hath spoken in his holiness, I will exult! I will apportion Shechem! And, the Vale of Succoth, will I measure out;
texts.psa.108.8: Mine, is Gilead—mine, Manasseh, but, Ephraim, is the defence of my head, Judah, is my commander’s staff;
texts.psa.108.9: Moab, is my wash-bowl, Upon Edom, will I throw my shoe, Over Philistia, raise a shout of triumph.
texts.psa.108.10: Who will conduct me to a fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?
texts.psa.108.11: Hast not thou, O God, rejected us? and wilt not go forth, O God, with our hosts.
texts.psa.108.12: Grant us help out of distress, for, vain, is the deliverance of man:
texts.psa.108.13: In God, shall we do valiantly, He himself, therefore, shall tread down our adversaries.
texts.psa.109.1: O God of my praise, do not be silent;
texts.psa.109.2: For, the mouth of the lawless one and the mouth of the deceiver, against me, are open, They have spoken to me with false tongue;
texts.psa.109.3: And, with words of hatred, have they surrounded me, and have made war upon me without cause:
texts.psa.109.4: For my love, they have been accusing me, while, I, was at prayer:
texts.psa.109.5: Yea they have returned unto me—Evil for good; and, Hatred for my love.
texts.psa.109.6: Set in charge over him, one who is lawless, and let, an accuser, stand at his right hand;
texts.psa.109.7: When he is judged, let him go out condemned, and let, his own petition, become a sin;
texts.psa.109.8: Let his days become few, his overseership, let another take;
texts.psa.109.9: Let his children become fatherless, and his wife a widow;
texts.psa.109.10: Let his children, wander about, and beg, Let them be driven out of their ruins;
texts.psa.109.11: Let the creditor take aim at all that he hath, and let strangers prey on the fruit of his toil;
texts.psa.109.12: Let him have no one to continue lovingkindness, and there be none to favour his fatherless children;
texts.psa.109.13: Let his posterity be for cutting off, In another generation, let their name be wiped out;
texts.psa.109.14: Remembered be the iniquity of his fathers against Yahweh, and, the sin of his mother, let it not be wiped out;
texts.psa.109.15: Let them be before Yahweh continually, and let the memory of them, be cut off out of the earth.
texts.psa.109.16: Because that he remembered not to show lovingkindness, but pursued the man that was oppressed and needy, that, the downhearted, he might slay.
texts.psa.109.17: Because he loved cursing, May it have come upon him, Because he delighted not in blessing, May it have kept far from him;
texts.psa.109.18: Because he clothed himself in cursing as his outer garment, therefore may it have entered like water into his inward part, and like oil into his bones;
texts.psa.109.19: Be it his, as a garment he shall wrap round him, and for a girdle he shall, at all times, gird on:
texts.psa.109.20: This, be the reward of mine accusers, from Yahweh, even of them who are speaking wrongfully against my life.
texts.psa.109.21: But, thou, Yahweh, Adonay, deal effectually with me, for the sake of thy Name, Since good is thy lovingkindness, O rescue me;
texts.psa.109.22: For, oppressed and needy, I am, and, my heart, is wounded within me.
texts.psa.109.23: As a shadow when it stretcheth out, I am gone, I am shaken off like the locust;
texts.psa.109.24: My knees, tremble from fasting, and, my flesh, faileth of fatness:
texts.psa.109.25: So, I, am become a reproach for them, They see me, they shake their head.
texts.psa.109.26: Help me! O Yahweh my God, Save me, according to thy lovingkindness:
texts.psa.109.27: That they may know that, Thine own hand, this is, Thou, Yahweh, hast done it.
texts.psa.109.28: They, may curse if, thou, wilt bless,—Mine assailants, shall be ashamed, but, thy servant, shall rejoice;
texts.psa.109.29: Mine accusers shall be clothed with confusion, and shall wrap about them, like a cloak, their own shame.
texts.psa.109.30: I will thank Yahweh loudly with my mouth, Yea, in the midst of multitudes, will I praise him;
texts.psa.109.31: Because he standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save, from them who would pass sentence on his life.
texts.psa.110.1: The declaration of Yahweh to my Lord—Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
texts.psa.110.2: Thy sceptre of strength, will Yahweh extend out of Zion, Tread thou down, in the midst of thy foes.
texts.psa.110.3: Thy people, will freely offer themselves, in the day of thine army,—in the splendours of holiness, out of the womb of the dawn, To thee, [shall spring forth] the dew of thy youth.
texts.psa.110.4: Yahweh, hath sworn—and will not repent, Thou, [shalt be] a priest unto times age-abiding, after the manner of Melchizedek.
texts.psa.110.5: My Lord, on thy right hand,—hath shattered—in the day of his anger—kings;
texts.psa.110.6: He will judge among the nations—full of dead bodies! He hath shattered the head over a land far extended:
texts.psa.110.7: Of the torrent in the way, will he drink;—For this cause, will he lift up [his] head.
texts.psa.111.1: Praise ye Yah! I will give thanks unto Yahweh, with a whole heart, in the circle of the upright and the assembly.
texts.psa.111.2: Great are the works of Yahweh, sought out, by all who find pleasure therein.
texts.psa.111.3: Honourable and majestic, is his doing, and, his righteousness, standeth for aye.
texts.psa.111.4: A memorial, hath he made by his wonders, Gracious and compassionate, is Yahweh.
texts.psa.111.5: Food, hath he given to them who revere him, He will remember, age-abidingly, his covenant.
texts.psa.111.6: The might of his works, hath he declared to his people, that he may give them the inheritance of the nations.
texts.psa.111.7: The works of his hands, are faithful and just, Firm are all his precepts;
texts.psa.111.8: Upheld to futurity, to times age-abiding, done in faithfulness and equity.
texts.psa.111.9: Ransom, hath he sent to his people, He hath commanded, to times age-abiding, his covenant, Holy and reverend, is his Name.
texts.psa.111.10: The beginning of wisdom, is the reverence of Yahweh, Good discretion, have all that do them, His praise, endureth for aye.
texts.psa.112.1: Praise ye Yah! How happy is the man who revereth Yahweh, In his commandments, delighteth he greatly;
texts.psa.112.2: Mighty in the earth, shall be his seed, The generation of the upright, shall be blessed;
texts.psa.112.3: Wealth and riches, shall be in his house, and, his righteousness, standeth for aye.
texts.psa.112.4: Risen—in darkness, is light to the upright, The gracious and compassionate and righteous.
texts.psa.112.5: Well for a man showing favour and lending! He shall sustain his affairs with justice.
texts.psa.112.6: Surely, unto times age-abiding, shall he not be shaken, In remembrance, age-abiding, shall the righteous one remain;
texts.psa.112.7: Of evil tidings, shall he not be afraid, Established is his heart, led to trust in Yahweh;
texts.psa.112.8: Upheld is his heart, he shall not be afraid, until that he gazeth on his foes.
texts.psa.112.9: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy, His righteousness, standeth for aye, His horn, shall be exalted in honour.
texts.psa.112.10: The lawless one, shall see, and be indignant, his teeth, will he gnash and melt away, The craving of the lawless, shall vanish.
texts.psa.113.1: Praise ye Yah! Praise, O ye servants of Yahweh, Praise the Name of Yahweh;
texts.psa.113.2: Be the Name of Yahweh blessed, henceforth, even to times age-abiding.
texts.psa.113.3: From the rising of the sun unto the going in thereof, Worthy to be praised, is the Name of Yahweh:
texts.psa.113.4: High above all nations, is Yahweh, Above the heavens, his glory.
texts.psa.113.5: Who is like Yahweh our God? that goeth on high to dwell,
texts.psa.113.6: That cometh down low to look, through the heavens and through the earth;
texts.psa.113.7: That raiseth, out of the dust, the poor, From the dunghill, uplifteth the needy;
texts.psa.113.8: To give a seat with nobles, with the nobles of his people!
texts.psa.113.9: Causing the barren woman to dwell in a household, A mother of sons in her joy! Praise ye Yah.
texts.psa.114.1: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from among a people of strange tongue,
texts.psa.114.2: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his realm:
texts.psa.114.3: The sea, beheld, and fled, The Jordan, turned back;
texts.psa.114.4: The mountains, started like rams, The hills like the young of the flock?
texts.psa.114.5: What aileth thee, O sea, that thou fleest? O Jordan, that thou turnest back?
texts.psa.114.6: Ye mountains, that ye start like rams? Ye hills, like the young of the flock?
texts.psa.114.7: Before the Lord, be in anguish, O earth, Before the GOD of Jacob:
texts.psa.114.8: Who turneth The Rock into a pool of water, The Flint into springs of water.
texts.psa.115.1: Not unto us, O Yahweh, not unto us,—but, unto thine own Name, give glory, concerning thy lovingkindness, concerning thy faithfulness.
texts.psa.115.2: Wherefore should the nations say, Pray where is their God?
texts.psa.115.3: When, our God, is in the heavens, Whatsoever he pleased, hath he done.
texts.psa.115.4: Their idols, are silver and gold, the works of the hands of men,—
texts.psa.115.5: A mouth, have they, but they speak not, Eyes, have they, but they see not;
texts.psa.115.6: Ears, have they, but they hear not, A nose, have they, but they smell not:
texts.psa.115.7: Their hands! but they feel not Their feet! but they walk not, No sound make they in their throat.
texts.psa.115.8: Like unto them, shall be they who make them, Every one who trusteth in them.
texts.psa.115.9: O Israel! trust thou in Yahweh, Their help and their shield, is he!
texts.psa.115.10: O house of Aaron! trust ye in Yahweh, Their help and their shield, is he!
texts.psa.115.11: Ye that revere Yahweh! trust in Yahweh, Their help and their shield, is he!
texts.psa.115.12: Yahweh, hath remembered us, he will bless—He will bless the house of Israel, He will bless the house of Aaron;
texts.psa.115.13: He will bless them who revere Yahweh, the small with the great.
texts.psa.115.14: Yahweh multiply you, You, and your children.
texts.psa.115.15: Blessed are ye of Yahweh, who made the heavens and the earth:
texts.psa.115.16: As for the heavens, the heavens, belong to Yahweh, but the earth, hath he given to the sons of men.
texts.psa.115.17: The dead, cannot praise Yah, nor any that go down into silence;
texts.psa.115.18: But, we, will bless Yah, from henceforth even unto times age-abiding. Praise ye Yah.
texts.psa.116.1: I love Yahweh—because he heareth my voice, my supplications;
texts.psa.116.2: Because he hath bowed down his ear unto me, therefore, throughout my days, will I call.
texts.psa.116.3: The meshes of death encompassed me, and the distresses of hades, came upon me, Peril and sorrow, I found;
texts.psa.116.4: But, on the Name of Yahweh, I called—I beseech thee, Yahweh, deliver my soul.
texts.psa.116.5: Gracious is Yahweh and righteous, and, our God, is full of compassion.
texts.psa.116.6: Yahweh, preserveth the simple, I was brought low, when, to me, he granted salvation.
texts.psa.116.7: Return, O my soul, to thy rest, For, Yahweh, hath dealt bountifully with thee.
texts.psa.116.8: For thou hast rescued my soul from death,—mine eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
texts.psa.116.9: I will walk to and fro before Yahweh, in the lands of life.
texts.psa.116.10: I believed that I should speak, I, was greatly depressed.
texts.psa.116.11: I, said in mine alarm, All men, are false!
texts.psa.116.12: How shall I give back to Yahweh, All his benefits unto me?
texts.psa.116.13: The cup of salvation, will I lift, and, on the Name of Yahweh, will I call:
texts.psa.116.14: My vows—to Yahweh, will I pay, Might it be in presence of all his people!
texts.psa.116.15: Costly in the eyes of Yahweh, is, death, for his men of lovingkindness.
texts.psa.116.16: I beseech thee, O Yahweh—for, I, am thy servant,—I, am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid, Thou hast loosened my bonds.
texts.psa.116.17: To thee, will I sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and, on the Name of Yahweh, will I call:
texts.psa.116.18: My vows—to Yahweh, will I pay, Might it be in the presence of all his people;—
texts.psa.116.19: In the courts of the house of Yahweh, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.117.1: Praise Yahweh, all ye nations, Laud him, all ye tribes of men;
texts.psa.117.2: For his lovingkindness, hath prevailed over us, and, the faithfulness of Yahweh, is to times age-abiding. Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.118.1: Give ye thanks to Yahweh—For he is good, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.118.2: I pray you! let Israel, say, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.118.3: I pray you! let the house of Aaron, say, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.118.4: I pray you! let them who revere Yahweh, say, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.118.5: Out of a strait, called I on Yah, He answered me with enlargement.
texts.psa.118.6: Yahweh, is on my side, I will not fear, What can man, do unto me?
texts.psa.118.7: Yahweh, is on my side, with them who help me, I, therefore shall gaze upon them who hate me.
texts.psa.118.8: It is, better to seek refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man:
texts.psa.118.9: It is, better to seek refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in nobles.
texts.psa.118.10: All nations, have compassed me about, In the Name of Yahweh, surely I will make them be circumcised;
texts.psa.118.11: They have compassed me about—yea compassed me about, In the Name of Yahweh, surely I will make them be circumcised;
texts.psa.118.12: They have compassed me about like wax bees, they have blazed up like the fire of thorns, In the Name of Yahweh, surely I will make them be circumcised.
texts.psa.118.13: Thou didst, thrust sore, at me that I might fall, But, Yahweh, hath helped me.
texts.psa.118.14: My might and melody, is Yah, and he hath become mine by salvation.
texts.psa.118.15: The voice of shouting and salvation, is in the tents of the righteous, The right hand of Yahweh, is doing valiantly:
texts.psa.118.16: The right hand of Yahweh, is exalted, The right hand of Yahweh, is doing valiantly.
texts.psa.118.17: I shall not die, but live, That I may recount the doings of Yah.
texts.psa.118.18: Yah, chastened me sore, But, unto death, did not deliver me.
texts.psa.118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, I will enter therein, I will give thanks unto Yah.
texts.psa.118.20: This, is the gate for Yahweh, Such as are righteous, shall enter therein.
texts.psa.118.21: I will thank thee, because thou hast answered me, And hast become mine, by salvation.
texts.psa.118.22: A stone the builders refused, hath become the head of the corner:
texts.psa.118.23: From Yahweh, hath this come to pass, The same, is marvellous in our eyes.
texts.psa.118.24: This is the day, which Yahweh hath made, We will exult, and be glad therein.
texts.psa.118.25: Ah now, Yahweh, do save, we beseech thee, Ah now, Yahweh, do send success, we beseech thee!
texts.psa.118.26: Blessed be he that entereth, In the Name of Yahweh, we have blessed you, out of the house of Yahweh.
texts.psa.118.27: Yahweh is GOD, and hath shed on us light,—Bind ye the festal sacrifice with cords, Up to the horns of the altar.
texts.psa.118.28: My GOD, thou art, and I will thank thee,—My Elohim, I will exalt thee.
texts.psa.118.29: Give ye thanks to Yahweh—For he is good, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.119.1: [ALEPH.] How happy the men of blameless life, who walk in the law of Yahweh.
texts.psa.119.2: How happy they who observe his testimonies, with a whole heart, they seek him.
texts.psa.119.3: Yea, they have not wrought perversity, In his ways, have they walked.
texts.psa.119.4: Thou, hast commanded thy precepts, that they should be diligently kept.
texts.psa.119.5: Oh would that my ways might be settled! that I might keep thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.6: Then, shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.7: I will thank thee with uprightness of heart, when I have learned thy righteous regulations.
texts.psa.119.8: Thy statutes, will I keep, Do not thou forsake me utterly.
texts.psa.119.9: [BETH.] Wherewithal can a young man keep pure his way? By taking heed, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.10: With all my heart, have I sought thee, Suffer me not to be led astray from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.11: In my heart, have I treasured what thou hast said, to the end I may not sin against thee.
texts.psa.119.12: Blessed art thou, O Yahweh—Teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.13: With my lips, have I recounted All the regulations of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.14: In the way of thy testimonies, have I rejoiced, Like as over all riches.
texts.psa.119.15: In thy precepts, will I meditate, that I may discern thy paths.
texts.psa.119.16: In thy statutes, will I find my dear delight, I will not forget thy word.
texts.psa.119.17: [GIMEL.] Bestow thy bounties upon thy servant—let me live, That I may observe thy word.
texts.psa.119.18: Unveil thou mine eyes, that I may discern Wondrous things out of thy law.
texts.psa.119.19: A sojourner, am, I, in the earth, Do not hide from me, thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.20: My soul is crushed with longing for thy just decisions at all times.
texts.psa.119.21: Thou hast rebuked the proud as accursed, who stray from thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.22: Roll from off me, reproach and contempt, For, thy testimonies, have I observed.
texts.psa.119.23: Even rulers have taken their seat, against me, have talked, Thy servant, will still meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.24: Yea, thy testimonies, are my dear delight, My counsellors.
texts.psa.119.25: [DALETH.] My soul, cleaveth to the dust, Give me life, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.26: My ways, I recounted, and thou didst answer me, Teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.27: The way of thy precepts, cause thou me to understand, and I will indeed meditate in thy wonders.
texts.psa.119.28: My soul weepeth itself away, for grief, Confirm thou me, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.29: The way of falsehood, take thou from me, and, with thy law, O favour me.
texts.psa.119.30: The way of faithfulness, have I chosen, Thy regulations, have I deemed right.
texts.psa.119.31: I have kept close to thy testimonies, O Yahweh! do not put me to shame.
texts.psa.119.32: The way of thy commandments, will I run, for thou wilt enlarge my heart.
texts.psa.119.33: [HE.] Point out to me, O Yahweh, the way of thy statutes, that I may observe it unto the end.
texts.psa.119.34: Give me understanding, that I may observe thy law, that I may keep it with a whole heart.
texts.psa.119.35: Guide me in the path of thy commandments, for, therein, do I find pleasure.
texts.psa.119.36: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not unto unjust gain.
texts.psa.119.37: Turn away mine eyes, from beholding vanity, In thy way, give me life.
texts.psa.119.38: Establish, unto thy servant, thy word, which pertaineth to the reverence of thee.
texts.psa.119.39: Cause to pass away my reproach, that I have feared, for, thy regulations, are good.
texts.psa.119.40: Lo! I have longed for thy precepts, In thy righteousness, give me life.
texts.psa.119.41: [WAW.] And let thy lovingkindness reach me, O Yahweh, thy salvation, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.42: So shall I have something to answer him that reproacheth me, That I have trusted in thy word.
texts.psa.119.43: And do not snatch away from my mouth the word of truth in any wise, because, for thy regulation, have I waited.
texts.psa.119.44: That I may keep thy law continually, to times age-abiding and beyond.
texts.psa.119.45: That I may walk to and fro in a large place, because, thy precepts, have I sought.
texts.psa.119.46: That I may speak of thy testimonies before kings, and not be ashamed.
texts.psa.119.47: That I may find dear delight in thy commandments, which I have loved.
texts.psa.119.48: That I may lift up my hands unto thy commandments, which I have loved, and may meditate in thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.49: [ZAYIN.] Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
texts.psa.119.50: This, is my comfort in mine affliction, that, thy word, hath given me life.
texts.psa.119.51: Insolent men, have derided me exceedingly, From thy law, have I not swerved.
texts.psa.119.52: I have remembered thy regulations, [which have come down] from age-past times, O Yahweh, and have consoled myself.
texts.psa.119.53: A raging heat, hath seized me, by reason of the lawless, who forsake thy law.
texts.psa.119.54: Songs, have thy statutes become to me, in my house of sojourn.
texts.psa.119.55: I have remembered, in the night, thy Name, O Yahweh, and have kept thy law.
texts.psa.119.56: This, have I had, because, thy precepts, have I observed.
texts.psa.119.57: [HETH.] My portion, is Yahweh, I have promised that I would keep thy words.
texts.psa.119.58: I have sought the smile of thy face with all my heart, Show me favour, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.59: I have thought upon my ways, and have turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.60: I have hastened, and not delayed, to keep thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.61: The meshes of the lawless, have surrounded me, Thy law, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.62: At midnight, I arise to give thanks unto thee, For thy righteous regulations.
texts.psa.119.63: Companion, am I, to all who revere thee, and to them who keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.64: Of thy lovingkindness, O Yahweh, the earth, is full, Thy statutes, teach thou me.
texts.psa.119.65: [TETH.] Well, hast thou dealt with thy servant, O Yahweh, according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.66: Good judgment and knowledge, teach thou me, For, in thy commandments, have I trusted.
texts.psa.119.67: Before I was afflicted, I myself was going astray, but, now, thy word, have I kept.
texts.psa.119.68: Good, thou art, and doing good, Teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.69: Insolent men have plastered falsehood over me, I, with a whole heart, will observe thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.70: Gross, like fat, is their heart, I, in thy law, have found dear delight.
texts.psa.119.71: It is, well for me, that I was afflicted, That I might learn thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.72: Better to me, is the law of thy mouth, than thousands of gold and silver.
texts.psa.119.73: [YODH.] Thine own hands, have made me, and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
texts.psa.119.74: They who revere thee, shall see me and rejoice, that, for thy word, I waited.
texts.psa.119.75: I know, O Yahweh, that righteous are thy regulations, and, in faithfulness, didst thou afflict me.
texts.psa.119.76: Let thy lovingkindness, I beseech thee, serve to comfort me, according to thy word to thy servant.
texts.psa.119.77: Let thy compassions reach me, that I may live, for, thy law, is my dear delight.
texts.psa.119.78: Let insolent men, be ashamed, because, by means of falsehood, they have dealt with me perversely, I, will meditate in thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.79: Let them who revere thee, turn unto me, even they who know thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.80: Let my heart be thorough in thy statutes, that I may not be ashamed.
texts.psa.119.81: [KAPH.] My soul, hath languished for thy salvation, For thy word, have I hoped.
texts.psa.119.82: Mine eyes have failed for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
texts.psa.119.83: Though I have been like a wine-skin in the smoke, thy statutes, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.84: How few are the days of thy servant! When wilt thou execute sentence on my persecutors?
texts.psa.119.85: Insolent men digged for me pits, men who are not according to thy law.
texts.psa.119.86: All thy commandments, are faithful, With falsehood, have they persecuted me, O help me!
texts.psa.119.87: A little more, and they had consumed me in the earth, but, I, forsake not thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.88: According to thy lovingkindness, give thou me life, so will I keep the testimonies of thy mouth.
texts.psa.119.89: [LAMED.] Age-abidingly, O Yahweh, hath thy word been set up in the heavens.
texts.psa.119.90: To generation after generation, is thy faithfulness, Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.
texts.psa.119.91: By thy regulations, do they stand to-day, for, all, are thy servants.
texts.psa.119.92: Had not thy law been my dear delight, then, had I perished in mine affliction.
texts.psa.119.93: Unto times age-abiding, will I not forget thy precepts, For, by them, hast thou given me life.
texts.psa.119.94: Thine, am I,—oh save me! For, thy precepts, have I sought.
texts.psa.119.95: For me, have the lawless waited, to destroy me, Thy testimonies, will I diligently consider.
texts.psa.119.96: To all perfection, have I seen an end, Broad is thy commandment, exceedingly.
texts.psa.119.97: [MEM.] Oh how I love thy law! All the day, is it my meditation.
texts.psa.119.98: Beyond mine enemies, will thy commandment make me wise, for, age-abidingly, shall it be mine.
texts.psa.119.99: Beyond all my teachers, have I shown discretion, for, thy testimonies, are my meditation.
texts.psa.119.100: Beyond the elders, will I show understanding, for, thy precepts, have I observed.
texts.psa.119.101: From every way of wickedness, have I withheld my feet, that I might keep thy word.
texts.psa.119.102: From thy regulations, have I not turned aside, for, thou, hast directed me.
texts.psa.119.103: How smooth to my palate is thy speech, More than honey, to my mouth.
texts.psa.119.104: Out of thy precepts, will I get understanding, For this cause, do I hate every false way.
texts.psa.119.105: [NUN.] A lamp to my feet, is thy word, and a light to my path.
texts.psa.119.106: I sware, and have fulfilled, To keep thy righteous regulations.
texts.psa.119.107: I have been afflicted exceedingly,—O Yahweh, give me life according to thy word.
texts.psa.119.108: The freewill offerings of my mouth, accept, I pray thee, O Yahweh, And, thy regulations, teach thou me.
texts.psa.119.109: My life, is in my hand continually, Yet, thy law, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.110: The lawless have set a snare for me, Yet, from thy precepts, have I not strayed.
texts.psa.119.111: As an inheritance have I taken thy testimonies unto times age-abiding, for, the joy of my heart, they are.
texts.psa.119.112: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes, Age-abidingly, to the end.
texts.psa.119.113: [SAMECH.] Half-hearted ones, do I hate, but, thy law, do I love.
texts.psa.119.114: My hiding-place and my buckler, thou art, For thy word, have I waited.
texts.psa.119.115: Depart from me, ye evil-doers,—that I may observe the commandments of my God.
texts.psa.119.116: Uphold me according to thy word, that I may live, and do not shame me out of my hope!
texts.psa.119.117: Sustain me, that I may be saved, and may find dear delight in thy statutes continually.
texts.psa.119.118: Thou hast made light of all who stray from thy statutes, for their fraud is, falsehood.
texts.psa.119.119: Dross, have I accounted all the lawless of the earth, therefore do I love thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.120: My flesh, bristled up from dread of thee, and, of thy regulations, stand I in fear.
texts.psa.119.121: [AYIN.] I have done justice and righteousness,—Do not leave me to mine oppressors.
texts.psa.119.122: Be thou surety for thy servant for good, Let not insolent men oppress me.
texts.psa.119.123: Mine eyes, have become dim for thy salvation, and for thy righteous word.
texts.psa.119.124: Deal with thy servant according to thy lovingkindness, and, thy statutes, teach thou me.
texts.psa.119.125: Thy servant, I am—give me understanding, so shall I get to know thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.126: It is time that Yahweh should work, They have frustrated thy law!
texts.psa.119.127: For this cause, do I love thy commandments, More than gold, yea than fine gold!
texts.psa.119.128: For this cause, all thy precepts concerning all things, I deem right, Every way of falsehood, I hate.
texts.psa.119.129: [PE.] Wonderful are thy testimonies, For this cause, hath my soul observed them.
texts.psa.119.130: The opening of thy words, sheddeth light, Giving understanding to the simple.
texts.psa.119.131: My mouth, have I opened wide, and panted, because, for thy commandments, have I longed.
texts.psa.119.132: Turn thyself unto me, and show me favour,—As is befitting, to the lovers of thy Name.
texts.psa.119.133: My steps, direct thou by thy word, and let no iniquity, have dominion over me.
texts.psa.119.134: Set me free from the oppression of man, so will I keep thy precepts.
texts.psa.119.135: Thy face, light thou up on thy servant, and teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.136: Streams of water, have run down mine eyes, because men have not kept thy law.
texts.psa.119.137: [ZADHE.] Righteous art thou, O Yahweh,—and, equitable, are thy regulations.
texts.psa.119.138: Thou hast righteously commanded thy testimonies, yea in great faithfulness.
texts.psa.119.139: My zeal, hath put an end to me, for mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.
texts.psa.119.140: Refined is thy word, to the uttermost, and, thy servant loveth it.
texts.psa.119.141: Small, am I, and despised, Thy precepts, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.142: Thy righteousness, is righteous to times age-abiding, and, thy law, is truth.
texts.psa.119.143: Straitness and distress, have befallen me, Thy commandments, are my dear delights.
texts.psa.119.144: Righteous are thy testimonies, unto times age-abiding, Give me understanding, that I may live.
texts.psa.119.145: [KOPH.] I have cried out with all my heart, answer me, O Yahweh; Thy statutes, will I observe.
texts.psa.119.146: I have cried out unto thee, oh save me, That I may keep thy testimonies.
texts.psa.119.147: I forestalled the twilight, and cried for help, For thy word, I waited.
texts.psa.119.148: Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, To meditate in thy word.
texts.psa.119.149: My voice, O hear, according to thy lovingkindness, O Yahweh! according to thy wont, give me life.
texts.psa.119.150: They have drawn near, who pursue villainy, From thy law, have they gone far away.
texts.psa.119.151: Near art thou, O Yahweh, and, all thy commandments, are truth.
texts.psa.119.152: Long, have I known, from thy testimonies, That, to times age-abiding, thou didst establish them.
texts.psa.119.153: [RESH.] Behold mine affliction, and rescue me, For, thy law, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.119.154: Plead my cause, and redeem me, By thy word, give me life
texts.psa.119.155: Far from the lawless, is salvation, For, thy statutes, have they not sought.
texts.psa.119.156: Thy compassions, are great, O Yahweh, According to thy regulations, give me life.
texts.psa.119.157: Many, are my persecutors and mine adversaries, From thy testimonies, have I not swerved.
texts.psa.119.158: I have seen traitors, and felt loathing, Because, thy word, they kept not.
texts.psa.119.159: See thou that, thy precepts, I have loved, O Yahweh, according to thy lovingkindness, give me life.
texts.psa.119.160: The sum of thy word, is truth, and, age-abiding, is every one of thy righteous regulations.
texts.psa.119.161: [SHIN.] Rulers, have persecuted me, without cause, But, of thy word, hath my heart stood in awe.
texts.psa.119.162: Joyful am I over thy word, Like the finder of spoil in abundance.
texts.psa.119.163: Falsehood, I hate and abhor, Thy law, do I love.
texts.psa.119.164: Seven times in the day, have I praised thee, For thy righteous regulations.
texts.psa.119.165: Blessing in abundance, have the lovers of thy law, and nothing to make them stumble.
texts.psa.119.166: I have looked for thy salvation, O Yahweh, and, thy commandments, have I done.
texts.psa.119.167: My soul hath kept thy testimonies, yea I have loved them greatly.
texts.psa.119.168: I have kept thy precepts, and thy testimonies, For, all my ways, are before thee.
texts.psa.119.169: [TAU] Let my shouting come near before thee, O Yahweh, According to thy word, give me understanding.
texts.psa.119.170: Let my supplication come in before thee, According to thy word, deliver me.
texts.psa.119.171: My lips, shall pour out, praise, When thou shalt teach me thy statutes.
texts.psa.119.172: My tongue, shall respond, with thy word, For, all thy commandments, are righteous.
texts.psa.119.173: Be thy hand ready to help me, For, thy statutes, have I chosen.
texts.psa.119.174: I have longed for thy salvation, O Yahweh, and, thy law, is my dear delight.
texts.psa.119.175: Let my soul live, that it may praise thee, So shall thy regulation help me.
texts.psa.119.176: I have strayed like a wandering sheep, O seek thy servant, For, thy commandments, have I not forgotten.
texts.psa.120.1: Unto Yahweh, in the distress that befell me, I cried—and he answered me.
texts.psa.120.2: O Yahweh! rescue thou my soul—from the false lip, from the deceitful tongue.
texts.psa.120.3: What shall be given to thee, and what shall be added to thee, thou deceitful tongue?
texts.psa.120.4: The arrows of the hero sharpened, with burning coals of broom.
texts.psa.120.5: Woe is me, That I sojourn in Meshek,—That I abide near the tents of Kedar!
texts.psa.120.6: Long, hath my soul had her dwelling with him that hateth peace:
texts.psa.120.7: I, am for peace, and verily I speak, They, are for war!
texts.psa.121.1: I will lift up mine eyes, unto the mountains, From whence cometh my help!
texts.psa.121.2: My help, is from Yahweh, who made heavens and earth.
texts.psa.121.3: May he not suffer thy foot, to slip, May thy keeper, not slumber!
texts.psa.121.4: Lo! neither will slumber nor sleep, The keeper of Israel.
texts.psa.121.5: Yahweh, is thy keeper, Yahweh, is thy shade, on thy right hand:
texts.psa.121.6: By day, the sun, shall not smite, nor, the moon, by night.
texts.psa.121.7: Yahweh, will keep thee from all harm, He will keep thy life.
texts.psa.121.8: Yahweh, will keep thy going out and thy coming in, from henceforth, even unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.122.1: I was glad, when they were saying unto me, Unto the house of Yahweh, let us go!
texts.psa.122.2: Standing are our feet, within thy gates, O Jerusalem!
texts.psa.122.3: Jerusalem! that hath been builded, A true city, all joined together as one:
texts.psa.122.4: Whither have come up the tribes, The tribes of Yah, A testimony to Israel, To give thanks unto the Name of Yahweh:
texts.psa.122.5: For there are set—Thrones for justice, Thrones for the house David.
texts.psa.122.6: Ask ye for the peace of Jerusalem, They shall prosper, who love thee!
texts.psa.122.7: Peace be within thy walls, prosperity within thy palaces:
texts.psa.122.8: For the sake of my brethren and friends, Oh, might I speak [saying], Peace be within thee!
texts.psa.122.9: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, will I seek blessing for thee.
texts.psa.123.1: Unto thee, have I lifted up mine eyes, O thou who art enthroned in the heavens.
texts.psa.123.2: Lo! as the eyes of men-servants are unto the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maid-servant, unto the hand of her mistress, so, are our eyes, unto Yahweh our God, until that he show us favour.
texts.psa.123.3: Show us favour, O Yahweh, show us favour, for, exceedingly, are we sated with contempt:
texts.psa.123.4: Exceeding sated therewith, is our soul,—The scorn of the careless, The contempt of the proud.
texts.psa.124.1: If it had not been, Yahweh, who was on our side, oh might Israel say:
texts.psa.124.2: If it had not been, Yahweh, who was on our side, when men rose up against us,
texts.psa.124.3: Then, alive, had they swallowed us up, in the glow of their anger against us;
texts.psa.124.4: Then, the waters, had whelmed us, the torrent, gone over our soul;
texts.psa.124.5: Then, had gone over our soul the waters so proud!
texts.psa.124.6: Blessed, be Yahweh, who gave us not as prey to their teeth.
texts.psa.124.7: Our soul, as a bird, hath escaped from the snare of the fowlers, The snare, is broken, and, we, are escaped:
texts.psa.124.8: Our help, is in the Name of Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.125.1: They who trust in Yahweh, [are] like Mount Zion, which shall not be shaken, Age-abidingly, shall it remain.
texts.psa.125.2: Jerusalem! mountains, are round about her; and Yahweh, is round about his people, from henceforth even unto times age-abiding.
texts.psa.125.3: For the sceptre of lawlessness shall not remain over the allotment of the righteous,—lest the righteous put forth—unto perversity—their hands.
texts.psa.125.4: Do good, O Yahweh, unto such as are good, even unto such as are upright in their hearts.
texts.psa.125.5: As for them who turn aside unto their crooked ways, Yahweh, will lead them forth, with the workers of iniquity, Prosperity on Israel!
texts.psa.126.1: When Yahweh brought back the captives of Zion, we were like them who dream:
texts.psa.126.2: Then, was our mouth, filled with laughter, and our tongue with a shout of triumph,—Then, said they among the nations, Yahweh, hath done great things, with these!
texts.psa.126.3: Yahweh, hath done great things with us, we are full of joy!
texts.psa.126.4: Bring thou back, O Yahweh, our captives, like channels in the South.
texts.psa.126.5: They who are sowing with tears, with shouting, shall reap:
texts.psa.126.6: He that, doth indeed go forth, and weep, bearing seed enough to trail along, doth, surely come in, with shouting, bringing his sheaves.
texts.psa.127.1: If, Yahweh, build not the house, in vain, have the builders of it toiled thereon, If, Yahweh, watch not the city, in vain, hath the watchman kept awake:
texts.psa.127.2: Vain for you,—to be early in rising, to be late in lying down, to be eating the bread of wearisome toil, So, would he give his beloved one sleep.
texts.psa.127.3: Lo! an inheritance from Yahweh, are children, A reward, the fruit of the womb:
texts.psa.127.4: As arrows in the hand of a warrior, so, are the children of young men.
texts.psa.127.5: How happy the man who hath filled his quiver with them! They will not be ashamed, but will speak with enemies in the gate.
texts.psa.128.1: How happy is every one that revereth Yahweh, who walketh in his ways!
texts.psa.128.2: The labour of thine own hands, surely thou shalt eat. How happy thou, and well for thine!
texts.psa.128.3: Thy wife, like a fruitful vine, within the recesses of thy house,—Thy children, like plantings of olive-trees, round about thy table.
texts.psa.128.4: Lo! thus, shall be blessed the man who revereth Yahweh.
texts.psa.128.5: Yahweh will bless thee, out of Zion,—and behold thou the welfare of Jerusalem, all the days of thy life!
texts.psa.128.6: And behold thou thy children’s children,—Prosperity on Israel!
texts.psa.129.1: Many a time, have they harassed me from my youth, well may Israel say:
texts.psa.129.2: Many a time, have they harassed me from youth, yet have they not prevailed against me.
texts.psa.129.3: Upon my back, have ploughmen ploughed, They have lengthened their furrow!
texts.psa.129.4: Yahweh, is righteous, He hath cut asunder the cords of the lawless.
texts.psa.129.5: Let all who hate Zion, be ashamed and shrink back:
texts.psa.129.6: Let them become like the grass of housetops, which, before it is pulled up, hath withered;
texts.psa.129.7: Wherewith no reaper, hath filled his hand, nor binder, his bosom:
texts.psa.129.8: Neither have the passers-by ever said, The blessing of Yahweh, be unto you,—We have blessed you in the Name of Yahweh.
texts.psa.130.1: Out of the depths, have I cried unto thee, O Yahweh.
texts.psa.130.2: O My Lord! hearken thou unto my voice,—Let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications,
texts.psa.130.3: If, iniquities, thou shouldest mark, O Yah, O My Lord, who could stand?
texts.psa.130.4: But, with thee, is forgiveness, that thou mayest be revered.
texts.psa.130.5: I have waited for Yahweh, My soul hath waited for his word;
texts.psa.130.6: I have hoped, O my soul, for My Lord, more than they who watch for the morning, who watch for the morning.
texts.psa.130.7: Wait, O Israel, for Yahweh,—for, with Yahweh, is lovingkindness, and there aboundeth with him—redemption.
texts.psa.130.8: He, therefore, will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
texts.psa.131.1: O Yahweh, my heart, is not haughty, nor are mine eyes, lofty, neither have I moved among great matters, or among affairs too wonderful for me.
texts.psa.131.2: Surely I have soothed and silenced my soul,—like a weaned child, concerning his mother, like a weaned child, concerning myself—mine own soul.
texts.psa.131.3: Wait, O Israel, for Yahweh, from this time forth, even to times age-abiding.
texts.psa.132.1: Remember, O Yahweh, unto David, all his humiliations!
texts.psa.132.2: What he Sware to Yahweh,—Vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
texts.psa.132.3: Surely I will not enter the home of my own house, nor ascend my curtained couch;
texts.psa.132.4: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, nor, to mine eye-lashes, slumber:
texts.psa.132.5: Until I find a place for Yahweh, habitations for the Mighty One of Jacob.
texts.psa.132.6: Lo! we heard of it at Ephrathah, we found it in the fields of the wood.
texts.psa.132.7: We would enter his habitations, we would bow down at his footstool.
texts.psa.132.8: Arise! O Yahweh, unto thy place of rest, Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
texts.psa.132.9: Thy priests, let them be clothed with righteousness, Thy men of lovingkindness, let them shout for joy!
texts.psa.132.10: For the sake of David thy servant, do not turn away the face of thine Anointed One.
texts.psa.132.11: Yahweh hath sworn unto David, in faithfulness, will he not turn from it,—Of the fruit of thy body, will I seat on thy throne.
texts.psa.132.12: If thy sons keep my covenant, and my testimony which I will teach them, even their sons, unto futurity, shall sit on thy throne.
texts.psa.132.13: For Yahweh hath chosen Zion,—He hath desired it as a dwelling for himself:
texts.psa.132.14: This, is my place of rest unto futurity, Here, will I dwell, for I have desired it;
texts.psa.132.15: Her provision, will I abundantly bless, Her needy ones, will I satisfy with bread;
texts.psa.132.16: And, her priests, will I clothe with salvation, and, her men of lovingkindness, shall, shout aloud, for joy;
texts.psa.132.17: There, will I cause to bud a horn to David, I have prepared a lamp for mine Anointed One;
texts.psa.132.18: His enemies, will I clothe with shame, but, upon himself, shall his crown be resplendent.
texts.psa.133.1: Lo! how good and how delightful, for brethren, to dwell together even as one.
texts.psa.133.2: Like the precious oil upon the head, descending upon the beard; the beard of Aaron,—which descended unto the opening of his robe:
texts.psa.133.3: Like the dew of Hermon, which descended upon the mountains of Zion,—for, there, did Yahweh command the blessing, Life, unto times age-abiding?
texts.psa.134.1: Lo! bless Yahweh, all ye servants of Yahweh, who stand in the house of Yahweh, by night:
texts.psa.134.2: Lift up your hand in holiness, and bless Yahweh.
texts.psa.134.3: May Yahweh, bless thee, out of Zion, even he that made heaven and earth.
texts.psa.135.1: Praise ye Yah, Praise ye the Name of Yahweh, Praise, O ye servants of Yahweh;
texts.psa.135.2: Who stand In the house of Yahweh, In the courts of the house of our God.
texts.psa.135.3: Praise ye Yah, For good is Yahweh, Sing praises to his Name, For it is full of delight;
texts.psa.135.4: For, Jacob, hath Yah chosen for himself, Israel, for his own treasure.
texts.psa.135.5: For, I, know that great is Yahweh, yea, our Lord, is beyond all gods.
texts.psa.135.6: Whatsoever Yahweh hath pleased, he hath done,—in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas, and all resounding deeps:
texts.psa.135.7: Causing vapours to ascend from the end of the earth,—Lightnings for the rain, hath he made, bringing forth wind out of his treasuries.
texts.psa.135.8: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man, and of beast;
texts.psa.135.9: Sent signs and wonders into thy midst, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
texts.psa.135.10: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings:
texts.psa.135.11: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
texts.psa.135.12: And gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.
texts.psa.135.13: O Yahweh! thy Name, is age-abiding,—O Yahweh! thy memorial, is to generation after generation.
texts.psa.135.14: For Yahweh will vindicate his people,—and, on his servants, have compassion.
texts.psa.135.15: The idols of the nations, are silver and gold, the work of the hands of men:
texts.psa.135.16: A mouth, have they, but they speak not, Eyes, have they, but they see not;
texts.psa.135.17: Ears, have they, but they hear not, Nose,—there is no breath in their mouth.
texts.psa.135.18: Like unto them, shall be they who make them, every one who trusteth in them.
texts.psa.135.19: O house of Israel! bless Yahweh, O house of Aaron! bless Yahweh;
texts.psa.135.20: O house of Levi! bless Yahweh, Ye that revere Yahweh! bless Yahweh.
texts.psa.135.21: Blessed be Yahweh out of Zion, Who inhabiteth Jerusalem, Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.136.1: Give ye thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.2: Give ye thanks to the God of gods, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.3: Give ye thanks to the Lord of lords, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.4: To him that doeth great wonders, by himself alone, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.5: To him that made the heavens with understanding, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.6: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.7: To him that made great lights, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.8: The sun to rule the day, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.9: The moon and stars to rule the night, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.10: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.11: And brought forth Israel out of their midst, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.12: With a firm hand, and a stretched-out arm, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.13: To him that divided the Red Sea into division, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.14: And caused Israel to pass through the midst thereof, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.15: And shook off Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.16: To him that led his people through the desert, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.17: To him that smote great kings, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.18: And slew majestic kings, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.19: Even Sihon, king of the Amorites, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.20: Also Og, king of Bashan, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.21: And gave their land for an inheritance, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.22: An inheritance to Israel his servant, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.23: Who in our low estate, remembered us, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.24: And freed us with force from our adversaries, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.25: Who giveth food to all flesh, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.136.26: Give ye thanks unto the GOD of the heavens, For, age-abiding, is his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.137.1: By the rivers of Babylon, there, we sat down, yea we wept—when we remembered Zion:
texts.psa.137.2: Upon the willows—in the midst thereof, hanged we our lyres:
texts.psa.137.3: For, there, our captors asked of us words of song, and our plunderers—gladness,—Sing us of the songs of Zion!
texts.psa.137.4: How shall we sing the song of Yahweh, on a foreign soil?
texts.psa.137.5: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right-hand forget:
texts.psa.137.6: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember thee! if I do not lift up Jerusalem above the head of mine own gladness.
texts.psa.137.7: Remember, O Yahweh, against the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem,—how they continued to say—Overthrow! Overthrow! unto the foundation within it.
texts.psa.137.8: O ruined daughter of Babylon,—how happy the man who shall repay thee thy dealing, wherewith thou didst deal with us!
texts.psa.137.9: How happy the man who shall snatch away and dash thy children against the crag.
texts.psa.138.1: I will give thee thanks with all my heart, Before the messengers of God, will I praise thee in song:
texts.psa.138.2: I will bow down towards thy holy temple, and thank thy Name, for thy lovingkindness and for thy faithfulness, For thou hast magnified, above all thy Name, thy word!
texts.psa.138.3: In the day I cried unto thee, then didst thou answer me, and didst excite me, in my soul, mightily.
texts.psa.138.4: All the kings of the earth, will thank thee, O Yahweh, when they have heard the sayings of thy mouth;
texts.psa.138.5: And they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, That great is the glory of Yahweh:
texts.psa.138.6: Though lofty is Yahweh, yet, the lowly, he regardeth, but, the haughty—afar off, doth he acknowledge.
texts.psa.138.7: Though I walk in the midst of distress, thou wilt give me life,—Because of the anger of my foes, thou wilt thrust forth thy hand, and thy right hand, will save me:
texts.psa.138.8: Yahweh, will carry through my cause,—O Yahweh! thy lovingkindness, is age-abiding, The works of thine own hands, do not thou desert.
texts.psa.139.1: O Yahweh! thou hast searched me, and observed:
texts.psa.139.2: Thou, hast observed my downsitting and mine uprising, Thou hast given heed to my desire, from afar:
texts.psa.139.3: My path and my couch, hast thou examined, and, all my ways, thou well knowest.
texts.psa.139.4: Surely there hath not been a word on my tongue, [but] behold! O Yahweh, thou hast observed it on every side.
texts.psa.139.5: Behind and before, hast thou shut me in, and hast laid upon me thy hand:—
texts.psa.139.6: Knowledge, too wonderful, for me! high, I cannot attain to it!
texts.psa.139.7: Whither can I go from thy spirit? or whither, from thy face, can I flee?
texts.psa.139.8: If I ascend the heavens, there, thou art! If I spread out hades as my couch, behold thee!
texts.psa.139.9: If I mount the wings of the dawn, settle down in the region beyond the sea,
texts.psa.139.10: Even there, thy hand shall lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
texts.psa.139.11: If I say, Surely, darkness, shall cover me! then, night, is light about me.
texts.psa.139.12: Even darkness, will not conceal from thee,—but, night, like day, will shine, So is the darkness, as the light!
texts.psa.139.13: For, thou, didst possess thyself of my reins, thou didst weave me together in the womb of my mother.
texts.psa.139.14: I thank thee, in that fearfully was my being distinguished, Wonderful are thy works, and, mine own soul, is observing [them] intently!
texts.psa.139.15: My substance was not hid from thee,—when I was made in secret, when I was skilfully figured in the lower parts of the earth.
texts.psa.139.16: Mine unfinished substance, thine eyes beheld, and, in thy book, all the parts thereof were written,—the days they should be fashioned! while yet there was not one among them.
texts.psa.139.17: To me, then, how precious have thy desires become, O GOD! How numerous, the heads of them!
texts.psa.139.18: I would recount them! Beyond the sands, they multiply, I rouse myself—and am still with thee.
texts.psa.139.19: Wilt thou not, O GOD, slay the lawless one? Therefore, ye men of bloodshed, depart from me!
texts.psa.139.20: For they speak of thee wickedly, Thy foes lift up [their hand] unto falsehood.
texts.psa.139.21: Do I not hate, them who hate thee, O Yahweh? And loathe, them who rise up against thee?
texts.psa.139.22: With completeness of hatred, I hate them, As enemies, have they become to me.
texts.psa.139.23: Search me, O GOD, and observe my heart, Try me, and observe my cares;
texts.psa.139.24: And see if there be any idol-way in me, and lead me in a way age-abiding.
texts.psa.140.1: Rescue me, O Yahweh, from the men of mischief, From the men of violence, wilt thou preserve me:
texts.psa.140.2: Who have devised mischiefs in their [heart], Every day, do they stir up wars:
texts.psa.140.3: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent,—The poison of the asp, is under their lips. [Selah.]
texts.psa.140.4: Keep me, O Yahweh, from the hands of the lawless one, From the man of violence, wilt thou preserve me,—who have devised, to thrust at my steps:
texts.psa.140.5: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and, cords, have they spread as a net beside the track, Snares, have they set for me. [Selah.]
texts.psa.140.6: I have said unto Yahweh, My GOD, thou art! Give ear, O Yahweh, unto the voice of my supplications.
texts.psa.140.7: O Yahweh, My Lord, my saving strength, thou hast screened my head in the day of battle.
texts.psa.140.8: Do not grant, O Yahweh, the desires of the lawless one, his device, do not promote, They would exalt themselves. [Selah.]
texts.psa.140.9: As for the head of them who surround me, Let the mischief of their lips cover them:
texts.psa.140.10: May there be dropped on them live coals,—Into the fire, may they be let fall, into watery pits [from which] they shall not rise.
texts.psa.140.11: As for the slanderer, let him not be established in the earth,—As for the man of wrongful violence, let misfortune hunt him with thrust upon thrust.
texts.psa.140.12: I know that Yahweh will execute, the right of the oppressed one, the vindication of the needy.
texts.psa.140.13: Surely, the righteous, shall give thanks to thy Name, the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
texts.psa.141.1: O Yahweh, I have cried unto thee, Make thou haste to me, Give ear unto my voice, when I cry to thee.
texts.psa.141.2: Let my prayer be set in order like incense before thee,—the lifting up of my hands, as the evening gift.
texts.psa.141.3: Set thou, O Yahweh, a watch at my mouth, Keep thou guard over the door of my lips.
texts.psa.141.4: Let not my heart incline to a matter of wrong, that I should busy myself with practices in lawlessness, with men working iniquity, and let me not eat of their dainties.
texts.psa.141.5: Let a righteous man smite me—a lovingkindness, that he should correct me, an oil for the head [which] let not my head refuse! For, yet, even my prayer, shall be in their calamities.
texts.psa.141.6: Their judges, have been hurled down by a crag, Now have men heard my sayings, for they have become sweet.
texts.psa.141.7: As when one plougheth and furroweth the earth, Scattered about, are our bones at the mouth of hades!
texts.psa.141.8: Surely, unto thee, O Yahweh, My Lord, are mine eyes, In thee, have I sought refuge, Do not pour out my life.
texts.psa.141.9: Keep me out of the clutches of the trap they have set for me, and the snares of the workers of iniquity.
texts.psa.141.10: They who are lawless, shall fall into the nooses thereof, while, I, at the same time, pass on.
texts.psa.142.1: With my voice—to Yahweh, make I outcry, With my voice—to Yahweh, make I supplication:
texts.psa.142.2: I pour out before him my complaint, My distress—before him, I tell.
texts.psa.142.3: When my spirit fainted concerning myself, then, thou, didst take note of my path,—In the course which I was about to take, they had hidden a snare for me.
texts.psa.142.4: Look to the right hand and see, that there is none that, for me, hath regard,—Escape is lost to me, There is no one to care for my life.
texts.psa.142.5: I have made outcry unto thee, O Yahweh,—I have said, Thou, art my refuge, my portion, in the land of the living.
texts.psa.142.6: Attend thou unto my loud cry, for I am brought very low,—Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are stronger than I.
texts.psa.142.7: O bring forth, out of prison, my soul, That I may give thanks unto thy Name,—About me, let the righteous gather round, for thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
texts.psa.143.1: O Yahweh, hear my prayer, Give ear to my supplications, In thy faithfulness, answer me, in thy righteousness.
texts.psa.143.2: Do not then enter into judgment with thy servant, for no one living, can appear just before thee.
texts.psa.143.3: For an enemy hath pursued my soul, hath crushed, to the earth, my life, hath made me dwell in dark places, like the ancient dead.
texts.psa.143.4: Therefore hath my spirit, fainted concerning myself, Within me, hath, my heart, been confounded.
texts.psa.143.5: I have remembered the days of aforetime, I have talked with myself of every deed of thine, Of the work of thy hands, I would speak:
texts.psa.143.6: I have spread out my hands unto thee, My soul, is as a thirsty land, for thee. [Selah.]
texts.psa.143.7: Speedily answer me, O Yahweh, My spirit faileth,—Do not hide thy face from me, or I shall be made like unto them who go down into the pit.
texts.psa.143.8: Let me hear, in the morning, thy lovingkindness, for, in thee, have, I trusted,—Let me know the way in which I should walk, for, unto thee, have I uplifted my soul.
texts.psa.143.9: Rescue me from my foes, O Yahweh, Unto thee, have I come seeking refuge.
texts.psa.143.10: Teach me to do thy good pleasure, for, thou, art my God,—Thy spirit, is good, thou wilt set me down to rest in a level land.
texts.psa.143.11: For the sake of thy Name, O Yahweh, wilt thou give unto me life, In thy righteousness, wilt thou bring forth, out of distress, my soul;
texts.psa.143.12: And, in thy lovingkindness, wilt thou exterminate my foes,—and destroy all the adversaries of my soul, because, I, am thy servant.
texts.psa.144.1: Blessed be Yahweh, my Rock, who teacheth my hands to war, my fingers to fight:
texts.psa.144.2: My lovingkindness and my stronghold, my high tower and my deliverer—mine! My buckler, and he in whom I have sought refuge,—He that subdueth my people under me.
texts.psa.144.3: O Yahweh! what is the earthborn, And yet thou hast acknowledged him,—the son of a mortal, And yet thou hast taken account of him:
texts.psa.144.4: The earthborn, resembleth, a vapour, his days, are like a passing shadow.
texts.psa.144.5: O Yahweh! bow thy heavens and come down, Touch the mountains, that they smoke:
texts.psa.144.6: Flash forth lightning, that thou mayest scatter them, Send out thine arrows, that thou mayest confound them:
texts.psa.144.7: Put forth thy hands from on high:—Snatch me away and rescue me out of mighty waters, out of the hand of the sons of the alien,
texts.psa.144.8: Whose mouth, hath spoken deceit, and, whose right hand, is a right hand of falsehood.
texts.psa.144.9: O God! a new song, will I sing unto thee,—On a harp of ten strings, will I make music to thee:
texts.psa.144.10: Who giveth victory unto kings—Who snatcheth away David his servant, from the calamitous sword.
texts.psa.144.11: Snatch me away and rescue me out of he hand of the sons of the alien,—whose mouth hath spoken deceit, and, whose right hand, is a right hand of falsehood:—
texts.psa.144.12: That, our sons, may be like plants well grown while yet young,—Our daughters, like corner pillars,—carved, in the construction of a palace:
texts.psa.144.13: Our garners, full, pouring out from one kind to another; Our flocks, multiplying by thousands—by myriads, in our open fields:
texts.psa.144.14: Our oxen, well-laden; no breaking in and no departing,—and no loud lament in our places of concourse:—
texts.psa.144.15: How happy the people that is in such a case! How happy the people that hath Yahweh for its God!
texts.psa.145.1: I will extol thee, my God, O King, and will bless thy Name, to times age-abiding and beyond:
texts.psa.145.2: Every day, will I bless thee, and praise thy Name, to times age-abiding and beyond.
texts.psa.145.3: Great is Yahweh—and worthy to be heartily praised, And, his greatness, is unsearchable.
texts.psa.145.4: Generation unto generation, shall celebrate thy works, and, thy mighty deeds, shall they tell:
texts.psa.145.5: The splendour of the glory of thy majesty, shall they speak, and, thy wonders, will I utter.
texts.psa.145.6: And, the might of thy terrible acts, shall men speak, and, as for thy greatness, I will recount it.
texts.psa.145.7: The memory of thy great goodness, shall men pour forth, and, thy righteousness, shall they shout aloud.
texts.psa.145.8: Gracious and compassionate, is Yahweh,—slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
texts.psa.145.9: Good is Yahweh to all, and, his tender compassions, are over all his works.
texts.psa.145.10: All thy works, O Yahweh, will give thanks unto thee,—and, thy men of lovingkindness, will bless thee:
texts.psa.145.11: The glory of thy kingdom, will they tell,—and, thy power, will they speak.
texts.psa.145.12: To make known to the sons of men, his mighty deeds, and the splendid glory of his kingdom.
texts.psa.145.13: Thy kingdom, is a kingdom of all ages,—and, thy dominion, is over generation after generation.
texts.psa.145.14: Yahweh is ready to uphold all who are falling, and to raise all who are laid prostrate.
texts.psa.145.15: The eyes of all, for thee, do wait, and, thou, givest them their food in its season.
texts.psa.145.16: Thou, openest thy hand, and fillest every living thing with gladness.
texts.psa.145.17: Righteous is Yahweh in all his ways, and kind in all his works.
texts.psa.145.18: Near is Yahweh to all who call upon him,—to all them who call upon him in faithfulness.
texts.psa.145.19: The desire of them who revere him, will he fulfil, and, their cry, will he hear, and will save them.
texts.psa.145.20: Yahweh preserveth all who love him, but, all the lawless, will he destroy.
texts.psa.145.21: The praise of Yahweh, my mouth shall speak, That all flesh may bless his holy Name, Unto times age-abiding and beyond.
texts.psa.146.1: Praise ye Yah, Praise, O my soul, Yahweh.
texts.psa.146.2: I will praise Yahweh while I live! I will make melody to my God while I continue!
texts.psa.146.3: Do not ye trust in nobles, in a son of man who hath no deliverance:
texts.psa.146.4: His spirit, goeth forth, he returneth to his ground, In that very day, his thoughts perish.
texts.psa.146.5: How happy is he that hath the GOD of Jacob as his help, whose hope, is on Yahweh his God:—
texts.psa.146.6: Who made The heavens and the earth, The sea and all that is therein, Who keepeth faithfulness to times age-abiding:
texts.psa.146.7: Who executeth justice for the oppressed, who giveth food to the famishing, Yahweh, who liberateth prisoners;
texts.psa.146.8: Yahweh, who opened [the eyes of] the blind, Yahweh, who raiseth the prostrate, Yahweh, who loveth the righteous;
texts.psa.146.9: Yahweh, who preserveth sojourners, The fatherless and widows, he relieveth,—but, the way of the lawless, he overturneth.
texts.psa.146.10: Yahweh, will reign, to times age-abiding, Thy God, O Zion, to generation after generation. Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.147.1: Praise ye Yah, For it is good, to make melody to our GOD,—For it is delightful, seemly is praise!
texts.psa.147.2: Yahweh, is building Jerusalem, The outcasts of Israel, will he gather together.
texts.psa.147.3: He is healing the broken in heart,—and binding up their hurts.
texts.psa.147.4: Counting the number of the stars, To all of them—names, he giveth.
texts.psa.147.5: Great is our Lord, and of abounding strength, And, his knowledge, cannot be expressed.
texts.psa.147.6: Yahweh, relieveth the humbled! casting the lawless down to the earth.
texts.psa.147.7: Respond to Yahweh with thanksgiving, Make melody to our God with the lyre.
texts.psa.147.8: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, preparing rain for the earth, who causeth the mountains to sprout grass:
texts.psa.147.9: Giving, to the beast, its food, to the young ravens, when they cry.
texts.psa.147.10: Not in the strength of the horse, doth he delight, Not in the legs of a man, hath he pleasure:
texts.psa.147.11: Yahweh, hath pleasure, in them who revere him, in them who wait for his lovingkindness.
texts.psa.147.12: Laud thou, O Jerusalem, Yahweh, Praise thy God, O Zion:
texts.psa.147.13: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates, He hath blessed thy children in thy midst:
texts.psa.147.14: Who maketh thy boundaries to be peace, With the marrow of wheat, doth he satisfy thee:
texts.psa.147.15: Who sendeth his utterance to the earth, How swiftly, runneth his word!
texts.psa.147.16: Who giveth snow like wool, Hoar-frost—like ashes, he scattereth:
texts.psa.147.17: Casting forth his ice like crumbs, Before his cold, who can stand?
texts.psa.147.18: He sendeth forth his word and melteth them, He causeth his wind to blow, the waters, stream along:
texts.psa.147.19: Declaring his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his regulations, unto Israel.
texts.psa.147.20: He hath not dealt so with any nation, and, his regulations, he maketh not known to them. Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.148.1: Praise ye Yah, Praise Yahweh, out of the heavens, Praise him, in the heights;
texts.psa.148.2: Praise him, all his messengers, Praise him, all his host;
texts.psa.148.3: Praise him, sun and moon, Praise him, all ye stars of light;
texts.psa.148.4: Praise him, O ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens;
texts.psa.148.5: Let them praise the Name of Yahweh, for, he, commanded, and they were created;
texts.psa.148.6: So caused he them to stand perpetually—age-abidingly, A decree, hath he given, and it passeth not beyond.
texts.psa.148.7: Praise Yahweh, out of the earth, sea monsters, and all resounding deeps;
texts.psa.148.8: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
texts.psa.148.9: Ye mountains, and all hills, fruit trees, and all cedars;
texts.psa.148.10: Thou wild-beast, and all ye cattle, crawling creature, and bird of wing;
texts.psa.148.11: Kings of earth, and all peoples, Rulers, and all judges of earth;
texts.psa.148.12: Young men, yea even virgins, elders, and children.
texts.psa.148.13: Let them praise the Name of Yahweh, for lofty is his Name alone, His splendour is over earth and heavens.
texts.psa.148.14: Therefore hath he exalted a horn for his people, a praise for all his men of lovingkindness, for the sons of Israel—a people near him, Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.149.1: Praise ye Yah, Sing to Yahweh a song that is new, his praise in the convocation of the men of lovingkindness.
texts.psa.149.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him, Let the sons of Zion exult in their king;
texts.psa.149.3: Let them praise his Name in the dance, with timbrel and lyre, Let them make music to him.
texts.psa.149.4: For Yahweh is taking pleasure in his people, He will beautify humbled ones with victory.
texts.psa.149.5: Let the men of lovingkindness exult as they glory, Let them shout aloud upon their beds:
texts.psa.149.6: The high songs of GOD be in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand:
texts.psa.149.7: To execute an avenging among the nations, rebukes among the peoples:
texts.psa.149.8: To bind their kings with fetters, and their honoured ones with iron bands:
texts.psa.149.9: To execute upon them the sentence written, An honour, shall it be to all his men of lovingkindness. Praise ye Yah!
texts.psa.150.1: Praise ye Yah, Praise ye GOD in his sanctuary, Praise him, in his strong expanse:
texts.psa.150.2: Praise him, for his mighty deeds, Praise him, according to his exceeding greatness:
texts.psa.150.3: Praise him, with the blast of a horn, Praise him, with the harp and lyre:
texts.psa.150.4: Praise him, with timbrel and dance,—Praise him, with stringed instrument and flute,
texts.psa.150.5: Praise him, with cymbals of clear tone,—Praise him, with cymbals of loud clang:
texts.psa.150.6: Let, every breathing thing, praise Yah, Praise ye Yah!

texts.psa.1.1: Bienaventurado el hombre que no sigue el consejo de los impíos, ni se detiene en la senda de los pecadores, ni en la reunión de burladores se sienta;
texts.psa.1.2: sino que en la ley de Yahvé está su delicia. En su ley medita de día y de noche.
texts.psa.1.3: Será como un árbol plantado junto a corrientes de agua, que da su fruto a su tiempo, y cuya hoja no se marchita. Todo lo que hace, prosperará.
texts.psa.1.4: No así los impíos, que son como la paja que se lleva el viento.
texts.psa.1.5: Por tanto, no se sostendrán los impíos en el juicio, ni los pecadores en la asamblea de los justos.
texts.psa.1.6: Porque Yahvé conoce el camino de los justos, mas la senda de los impíos perecerá.
texts.psa.2.1: ¿Por qué se amotinan las naciones, y los pueblos trazan planes vanos?
texts.psa.2.2: Se alzan los reyes de la tierra, y los príncipes conspiran a una contra Yahvé y contra su Ungido, diciendo:
texts.psa.2.3: «Rompamos sus ataduras, y sacudamos de nosotros sus cuerdas».
texts.psa.2.4: El que mora en los cielos se ríe; el Señor se burla de ellos.
texts.psa.2.5: Luego les hablará en su indignación, y los aterrará con su furor:
texts.psa.2.6: «Yo mismo he puesto a mi Rey sobre Sión, mi monte santo».
texts.psa.2.7: Proclamaré el decreto de Yahvé; él me dijo: «Tú eres mi hijo; yo te he engendrado hoy.
texts.psa.2.8: Pídeme, y te daré por herencia las naciones, y como posesión tuya los confines de la tierra.
texts.psa.2.9: Los quebrantarás con cetro de hierro; como vasija de alfarero los desmenuzarás».
texts.psa.2.10: Ahora, pues, oh reyes, sed sabios; admitid la corrección, jueces de la tierra.
texts.psa.2.11: Servid a Yahvé con temor, y alegraos con temblor.
texts.psa.2.12: Rendid homenaje al Hijo, no sea que se enoje y perezcáis en el camino; pues se inflama de pronto su ira. Bienaventurados todos los que en él confían.
texts.psa.3.1: ¡Yahvé, cómo han aumentado mis adversarios! Muchos son los que se levantan contra mí.
texts.psa.3.2: Son muchos los que dicen de mí, «No hay ayuda para él en Dios». Selah.
texts.psa.3.3: Pero tú, Yahvé, eres escudo en torno a mí, mi gloria, y el que levanta mi cabeza.
texts.psa.3.4: Con mi voz clamo a Yahvé, y él me responde desde su santo monte. Selah.
texts.psa.3.5: Yo me acosté y dormí; desperté, porque Yahvé me sostiene.
texts.psa.3.6: No temeré a miríadas de gentes que se han puesto contra mí en derredor.
texts.psa.3.7: ¡Levántate, Yahvé! ¡Sálvame, Dios mío! Pues tú has golpeado a todos mis enemigos en la mejilla; has roto los dientes de los malvados.
texts.psa.3.8: De Yahvé es la salvación. ¡Que tu bendición sea sobre tu pueblo! Selah.
texts.psa.4.1: Respóndeme cuando clamo, Dios de mi justicia. En la angustia me has dado alivio. Ten piedad de mí y escucha mi oración.
texts.psa.4.2: Hijos de los hombres, ¿hasta cuándo convertiréis mi gloria en deshonra? ¿Hasta cuándo amaréis la vanidad y buscaréis la falsedad? Selah.
texts.psa.4.3: Sabed, pues, que Yahvé ha apartado para sí al piadoso; Yahvé oirá cuando yo a él clame.
texts.psa.4.4: Temblad, y no pequéis; meditad en vuestro corazón sobre vuestro lecho, y guardad silencio. Selah.
texts.psa.4.5: Ofreced sacrificios de justicia, y confiad en Yahvé.
texts.psa.4.6: Muchos dicen: «¿Quién nos mostrará el bien?» ¡Alza sobre nosotros, oh Yahvé, la luz de tu rostro!
texts.psa.4.7: Has puesto alegría en mi corazón, mayor que la de ellos cuando abundan su grano y su mosto.
texts.psa.4.8: En paz me acostaré, y asimismo dormiré, porque solo tú, Yahvé, me haces vivir confiado.
texts.psa.5.1: Escucha mis palabras, oh Yahvé; considera mi gemido.
texts.psa.5.2: Atiende a la voz de mi clamor, Rey mío y Dios mío, porque a ti oro.
texts.psa.5.3: Oh Yahvé, de mañana oirás mi voz; de mañana me presentaré ante ti, y esperaré.
texts.psa.5.4: Porque tú no eres un Dios que se complace en la maldad; el mal no habitará junto a ti.
texts.psa.5.5: Los arrogantes no se mantendrán delante de tus ojos; aborreces a todos los que obran iniquidad.
texts.psa.5.6: Destruirás a los que hablan mentira; Yahvé aborrece al hombre sanguinario y engañador.
texts.psa.5.7: Mas yo, por la abundancia de tu misericordia, entraré en tu casa; me postraré hacia tu santo templo en tu temor.
texts.psa.5.8: Guíame, Yahvé, en tu justicia a causa de mis enemigos; endereza tu camino delante de mí.
texts.psa.5.9: Porque no hay sinceridad en su boca; sus entrañas son maldad. Sepulcro abierto es su garganta; con su lengua lisonjean.
texts.psa.5.10: Decláralos culpables, oh Dios; que caigan por sus propios consejos. Échalos por la multitud de sus transgresiones, porque se han rebelado contra ti.
texts.psa.5.11: Pero que se alegren todos los que en ti confían; que siempre den voces de júbilo, porque tú los defiendes. Que se regocijen en ti los que aman tu nombre.
texts.psa.5.12: Porque tú, oh Yahvé, bendecirás al justo; como con un escudo lo rodearás de tu favor.
texts.psa.6.1: Yahvé, no me reprendas en tu furor, ni me castigues en tu ira.
texts.psa.6.2: Ten piedad de mí, Yahvé, porque estoy desfallecido; sáname, Yahvé, porque mis huesos están estremecidos.
texts.psa.6.3: Mi alma también está muy angustiada. Y tú, Yahvé, ¿hasta cuándo?
texts.psa.6.4: Vuélvete, Yahvé, libra mi alma; sálvame por tu misericordia.
texts.psa.6.5: Porque en la muerte no hay memoria de ti. En el Seol, ¿quién te alabará?
texts.psa.6.6: Estoy agotado de tanto gemir. Cada noche inundo mi lecho; empapo mi cama con mis lágrimas.
texts.psa.6.7: Mis ojos se consumen por el dolor; han envejecido a causa de todos mis adversarios.
texts.psa.6.8: Apartaos de mí, todos los hacedores de iniquidad, porque Yahvé ha escuchado la voz de mi llanto.
texts.psa.6.9: Yahvé ha escuchado mi súplica; Yahvé ha recibido mi oración.
texts.psa.6.10: Que todos mis enemigos se avergüencen y se turben en gran manera; que retrocedan y sean deshonrados de repente.
texts.psa.7.1: Yahvé, Dios mío, en ti me refugio. Sálvame de todos los que me persiguen y líbrame,
texts.psa.7.2: para que no desgarren mi alma como un león, despedazándome sin que haya quien me libre.
texts.psa.7.3: Yahvé, Dios mío, si he hecho esto, si hay iniquidad en mis manos,
texts.psa.7.4: si he dado mal pago al que estaba en paz conmigo (yo que he librado al que sin causa era mi adversario),
texts.psa.7.5: que el enemigo persiga mi alma y la alcance; sí, que pise mi vida hasta la tierra, y ponga mi gloria en el polvo. Selah.
texts.psa.7.6: Levántate, Yahvé, en tu ira. Levántate contra la furia de mis adversarios. Despierta en mi favor; tú has ordenado el juicio.
texts.psa.7.7: Que la asamblea de los pueblos te rodee. Gobierna sobre ellos en las alturas.
texts.psa.7.8: Yahvé administra el juicio a los pueblos. Júzgame, Yahvé, según mi justicia, y conforme a la integridad que hay en mí.
texts.psa.7.9: Oh, que la maldad de los malvados llegue a su fin, y establece al justo; pues las mentes y los corazones son escudriñados por el Dios justo.
texts.psa.7.10: Mi escudo es Dios, que salva a los rectos de corazón.
texts.psa.7.11: Dios es un juez justo, sí, un Dios que se indigna cada día.
texts.psa.7.12: Si el hombre no se arrepiente, él afilará su espada; ha tensado y preparado su arco.
texts.psa.7.13: También ha preparado para sí mismo los instrumentos de muerte; prepara sus flechas ardientes.
texts.psa.7.14: He aquí que el malvado concibe iniquidad. Sí, se preña de maldad, y da a luz la falsedad.
texts.psa.7.15: Ha cavado un pozo, y lo ha hecho profundo, y ha caído en la fosa que él mismo hizo.
texts.psa.7.16: Su iniquidad volverá sobre su propia cabeza. Su violencia caerá sobre su propia coronilla.
texts.psa.7.17: Daré gracias a Yahvé conforme a su justicia, y cantaré alabanzas al nombre de Yahvé el Altísimo.
texts.psa.8.1: ¡Oh Yahvé, Señor nuestro, cuán glorioso es tu nombre en toda la tierra! Has puesto tu gloria sobre los cielos.
texts.psa.8.2: De la boca de los niños y de los que maman, fundaste la fortaleza, a causa de tus adversarios, para hacer callar al enemigo y al vengativo.
texts.psa.8.3: Cuando contemplo tus cielos, obra de tus dedos, la luna y las estrellas que tú formaste,
texts.psa.8.4: digo: ¿Qué es el hombre, para que tengas de él memoria? ¿Y el hijo del hombre, para que lo visites?
texts.psa.8.5: Pues lo has hecho un poco menor que los ángeles, y lo has coronado de gloria y honra.
texts.psa.8.6: Le hiciste señorear sobre las obras de tus manos; todo lo pusiste debajo de sus pies:
texts.psa.8.7: Ovejas y bueyes, todo ello, y asimismo las bestias del campo,
texts.psa.8.8: las aves de los cielos y los peces del mar; todo cuanto pasa por los senderos del mar.
texts.psa.8.9: ¡Oh Yahvé, Señor nuestro, cuán glorioso es tu nombre en toda la tierra!
texts.psa.9.1: Daré gracias a Yahvé de todo corazón; contaré todas tus maravillas.
texts.psa.9.2: Me alegraré y me regocijaré en ti; cantaré alabanzas a tu nombre, oh Altísimo.
texts.psa.9.3: Cuando mis enemigos retroceden, tropiezan y perecen delante de ti.
texts.psa.9.4: Porque has defendido mi causa y mi derecho; te has sentado en el trono, juzgando con justicia.
texts.psa.9.5: Has reprendido a las naciones, has destruido a los impíos; has borrado su nombre para siempre.
texts.psa.9.6: Los enemigos han perecido, asolados para siempre; has derribado sus ciudades, y hasta su recuerdo ha perecido.
texts.psa.9.7: Pero Yahvé permanece para siempre; ha preparado su trono para el juicio.
